Foundations.Algebra.involution_fixed_mod:
/-- **Parity principle.** An involution `f` of a finite set `α` has as many fixed points as
`α` has elements, modulo `2`. -/
theorem involution_fixed_mod_two {α : Type u} [FiniteType α] (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) :
    count (fun x => f x = x) % 2 = card α % 2 := by
  letI := involutionAction f hf
  have h := MulAction.count_fixed_mod (G := ZMod 2) (X := α) isPrime_two (k := 1)
    (by rw [ZMod.card])
  rw [← h]
  congr 1
  apply count_congr
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx k
    show (if (ZMod.val k).val = 0 then x else f x) = x
    split
    · rfl
    · exact hx
  · intro hx
    have := hx (ZMod.of ⟨1, by decide⟩)
    exact this

Foundations.Numbers.R.strictMono_of_deri:
/-- **Strict monotonicity test.** A function with positive derivative on `[a, b]` is strictly
increasing there. -/
theorem strictMono_of_deriv_pos {f f' : R → R} {a b : R}
    (hd : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hpos : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → 0 < f' x)
    {x y : R} (hax : a ≤ x) (hxy : x < y) (hyb : y ≤ b) : f x < f y := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := mean_value hxy
    (fun t h1 h2 => (hd t (by grind) (by grind)).continuousAt)
    (fun t h1 h2 => hd t (by grind) (by grind))
  have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (hpos c (by grind) (by grind)) (by grind : (0 : R) < y - x)
  grind

Foundations.Logic.Computability.eval_mon:
/-- `monusCode` computes truncated subtraction `b - a`. -/
theorem eval_monus (b : Nat) (xs : List Nat) : ∀ a, Eval monusCode (a :: b :: xs) (b - a)
  | 0 => by
      have := Eval.prec_zero (f := .proj 0)
        (g := .comp predCode (vec1 (.proj 1))) (xs := b :: xs) (n := b) .proj
      simpa using this
  | a + 1 => by

        (eval_comp1 (g := .proj 1) (xs := a :: (b - a) :: b :: xs) .proj (eval_pred [] (b - a)))

Foundations.Probability.FinProb.chebyshe:
/-- **Chebyshev's inequality.** For `ε > 0`, `P(|X − E X| ≥ ε) ≤ Var X / ε²`. -/
theorem chebyshev (X : α → R) {ε : R} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    P.prob (fun x => ε ≤ OF.abs (X x - P.E X)) ≤ P.Var X / (ε * ε) := by
  have hm := P.markov (X := fun x => (X x - P.E X) * (X x - P.E X)) (fun x _ => mul_self_nonneg _)
    (a := ε * ε) (by have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hε hε; grind)
  refine Std.le_trans (P.prob_mono fun x hx => ?_) hm
  exact sq_le_sq_of_le_abs (Std.le_of_lt hε) hx

Foundations.Numbers.R.HasDerivAt.continu:
/-- **Differentiable functions are continuous.** -/
theorem HasDerivAt.continuousAt {f : R → R} {d x : R} (h : HasDerivAt f d x) :
    ContinuousAt f x := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := h.lipschitz
  have hd := abs_nonneg d
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₁ (div_pos hε (by grind : 0 < abs d + 1))
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have k1 := h₁ y (by grind)
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show abs (y - x) < δ from hy)
    (by grind : 0 < abs d + 1)
  have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ2 (by grind : 0 ≤ abs d + 1)
  have e : (abs d + 1) * (ε / (abs d + 1)) = ε := by grind
  grind
Foundations.Sets.powTower_le:
/-- The tower only grows. -/
theorem powTower_le {m n : Nat} (h : m ≤ n) : CardLE (powTower m) (powTower n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Nat.le_zero.1 h]; exact CardLE.refl _
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with hlt | heq
    · exact (ih (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt)).trans (powTower_lt_succ n).1
    · rw [heq]; exact CardLE.refl _

Foundations.Logic.Computability.Comp.ldr:
/-- Iterated tail is computable. -/
theorem ldrop {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) (hg : Comp g) :
    Comp fun n => Computability.ldrop (f n) (g n) := by
  have := Comp.natRec hf (Comp.ltail (Comp.snd (Comp.snd Comp.id))) hg
  refine Comp.congr this fun n => ?_
  try dsimp only
  generalize g n = k
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp only [Computability.natRec, snd_pair, ih, Computability.ldrop]
Foundations.Topology.CFun.bounded:
/-- Two continuous functions on `[a, b]` differ by a bounded amount. -/
theorem bounded (f g : CFun a b) : ∃ M, ∀ x, abs (f.1 x - g.1 x) ≤ M := by
  have hab := LeFact.le (a := a) (b := b)
  have hc : ∀ x, R.ContinuousAt (fun x => f.1 x - g.1 x) x := fun x =>
    continuousAt_sub (f.2.2 x) (g.2.2 x)
  obtain ⟨c₁, -, -, h₁⟩ := extreme_value (f := fun x => f.1 x - g.1 x) hab fun x _ _ => hc x
  obtain ⟨c₂, -, -, h₂⟩ := extreme_value (f := fun x => 0 - (f.1 x - g.1 x)) hab
    fun x _ _ => continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_const 0 x) (hc x)
  refine ⟨abs (f.1 c₁ - g.1 c₁) + abs (0 - (f.1 c₂ - g.1 c₂)), fun x => ?_⟩
  have m := clamp_mem hab x
  have k1 := h₁ _ m.1 m.2
  have k2 := h₂ _ m.1 m.2
  rw [f.2.1, g.2.1] at k1 k2
  have := le_abs (f.1 c₁ - g.1 c₁); have := le_abs (0 - (f.1 c₂ - g.1 c₂))
  have := abs_nonneg (f.1 c₁ - g.1 c₁); have := abs_nonneg (0 - (f.1 c₂ - g.1 c₂))
  exact abs_le.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.size_subst:
/-- Substitution does not change the size of a formula. -/
theorem size_subst : ∀ (φ : Formula L) (σ : Nat → Term L), (φ.subst σ).size = φ.size
  | bot, _ => rfl
  | eq _ _, _ => rfl
  | rel _ _, _ => rfl
  | imp φ ψ, σ => by simp [subst, size, size_subst φ, size_subst ψ]
  | conj φ ψ, σ => by simp [subst, size, size_subst φ, size_subst ψ]
  | disj φ ψ, σ => by simp [subst, size, size_subst φ, size_subst ψ]
  | all φ, σ => by simp [subst, size, size_subst φ]
  | ex φ, σ => by simp [subst, size, size_subst φ]
Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.exists_:
/-- Approximating a square from below by squares of rationals: if `0 < z` and `0 ≤ q < z²`
then some rational `r` with `0 ≤ r < z` has `q < r²`. -/
theorem exists_rat_sq_between {K : Type} [Field K] [LE K] [LT K] [Std.IsLinearOrder K]
    [Std.LawfulOrderLT K] [OrderedRing K] (hA : Archimedean K) {z : K} (hz : 0 < z) {q : Q}
    (_hq0 : (0 : K) ≤ ofRat q) (hq : ofRat q < z * z) :
    ∃ r : Q, (0 : K) < ofRat r ∧ ofRat r < z ∧ ofRat (K := K) q < ofRat r * ofRat r := by
  let δ := z * z - ofRat q
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by grind
  have h2z : 0 < 2 * z := by grind
  have hε : 0 < δ / (2 * z) := div_pos hδ h2z
  let t := z - δ / (2 * z)
  have hr : ∃ r : Q, t < ofRat r ∧ 0 < ofRat (K := K) r ∧ ofRat r < z := by
    by_cases ht : t ≤ z / 2
    · obtain ⟨r, h1, h2⟩ := exists_rat_between hA (by grind : z / 2 < z)
      exact ⟨r, by grind, by grind, h2⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, h1, h2⟩ := exists_rat_between hA (by grind : t < z)
      exact ⟨r, h1, by grind, h2⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩ := hr
  refine ⟨r, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
  have k1 : (z - ofRat r) * (z + ofRat r) < (z - ofRat r) * (2 * z) :=
    OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by grind) (by grind)
  have k2 : (z - ofRat r) * (2 * z) < (δ / (2 * z)) * (2 * z) :=
    OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by grind) h2z
  have k3 : (δ / (2 * z)) * (2 * z) = δ := by grind
  grind

/-- `K` is **sequentially compact**: every sequence in `K` has a subsequence converging to a point
of `K`. -/
def IsSeqCompact (K : X → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : Nat → X, (∀ n, K (s n)) →

Foundations.Numbers.C.strictMono_lt:
/-- Strictly increasing index sequences preserve `<`. -/
theorem strictMono_lt {φ : Nat → Nat} (hφ : ∀ k, φ k < φ (k + 1)) {a b : Nat} (h : a < b) :
    φ a < φ b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => omega
  | succ b ih =>
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · rw [hab]; exact hφ b
    · have := ih (by omega); have := hφ b; omega

  ∀ U, τ.IsOpen U → U L → ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → U (s n)

Foundations.Numbers.R.sin_add_int_mul_pi:
/-- Shifting by an integer multiple of `π` preserves the zeros of sine. -/
theorem sin_add_int_mul_pi_eq_zero (x : R) (k : Int) : sin (x + (k : R) * pi) = 0 ↔ sin x = 0 := by
  have hnat : ∀ n : Nat, ∀ x : R, sin (x + (n : R) * pi) = 0 ↔ sin x = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro x; rw [show x + ((0 : Nat) : R) * pi = x by grind]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      rw [show x + ((n + 1 : Nat) : R) * pi = x + (n : R) * pi + pi by grind, sin_add_pi, ← ih x]
      constructor <;> intro h <;> grind
  cases k with
  | ofNat n =>
    have : ((Int.ofNat n : Int) : R) = (n : R) := Ring.intCast_natCast n
    rw [this]; exact hnat n x
  | negSucc n =>
    have e : ((Int.negSucc n : Int) : R) = -((n + 1 : Nat) : R) := by
      rw [Int.negSucc_eq, Ring.intCast_neg]
      have : (((n : Int) + 1 : Int) : R) = (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int) : R) := rfl
      rw [this, Ring.intCast_natCast]
    rw [e]
    have := hnat (n + 1) (x + -((n + 1 : Nat) : R) * pi)
    rw [show x + -((n + 1 : Nat) : R) * pi + ((n + 1 : Nat) : R) * pi = x by grind] at this
    exact this.symm
Foundations.Logic.Computability.rho_of_n:
/-- If `c` does not halt on `x`, then `rho a c x` halts on no unary input. -/
theorem rho_of_not_halts {a c : Code} {x : Nat} (hc : ¬ Halts c [x]) (y n : Nat) :
    ¬ Eval (rho a c x) [y] n := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨v₀, v₁, h₀, -, -⟩ := eval_comp2_inv h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hcu⟩ := eval_comp1_inv h₀
  have : u = x := Eval.det hu (eval_const _ x)
  subst this
  exact hc ⟨v₀, hcu⟩
Foundations.Algebra.factorization_unique:
/-- **Uniqueness of factorisation.** In an integral domain in which every irreducible element
is prime — for instance any principal ideal domain — two factorisations into irreducibles of
associated elements agree up to order and units: if `∏ L = u · ∏ M` with `u` a unit, then for
every `x`, `L` and `M` contain equally many factors associated to `x`. -/
theorem factorization_unique (hD : IsDomain R) (hprime : ∀ p : R, Irreducible p → IsPrimeElt p) :
    ∀ (L M : List R) (u : R), (∀ p, p ∈ L → Irreducible p) → (∀ q, q ∈ M → Irreducible q) →
      IsUnit u → lprod L = u * lprod M → ∀ x, countAssoc x L = countAssoc x M := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil =>
    intro M u _ hM hu h x
    cases M with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons q M =>
      exfalso
      apply (hM q List.mem_cons_self).2.1
      apply IsUnit.of_dvd ⟨1, Ring.mul_one 1⟩
      exact ⟨u * lprod M, by
        show (1 : R) = q * (u * lprod M)
        rw [show (1 : R) = lprod [] from rfl, h]
        show u * (q * lprod M) = _
        ac_rfl⟩
  | cons p L ih =>
    intro M u hL hM hu h x
    have hp := hprime p (hL p List.mem_cons_self)
    -- `p` divides `∏ M`, hence some `q ∈ M`, to which it is associated.
    have hdvd : Divides p (lprod M) := by
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
      exact ⟨v * lprod L, by
        calc lprod M = (u * v) * lprod M := by rw [hv, Ring.one_mul]
          _ = v * (u * lprod M) := by ac_rfl
          _ = v * (p * lprod L) := by rw [← h]; rfl
          _ = p * (v * lprod L) := by ac_rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqM, hpq⟩ := hp.dvd_lprod M hdvd
    have hassoc := (hM q hqM).associated_of_dvd hp.2.1 hpq
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcq⟩ := hassoc
    obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem hqM
    have hperm : (M₁ ++ q :: M₂).Perm (q :: (M₁ ++ M₂)) := List.perm_middle
    -- Cancel `p`.
    have h' : lprod L = (u * c) * lprod (M₁ ++ M₂) := by
      apply hD.mul_left_cancel hp.1
      calc p * lprod L = lprod (p :: L) := rfl
        _ = u * lprod (q :: (M₁ ++ M₂)) := by rw [h, lprod_perm hperm]
        _ = p * (u * c * lprod (M₁ ++ M₂)) := by
            show u * (q * _) = _; rw [hcq]; ac_rfl
    have hM' : ∀ r, r ∈ M₁ ++ M₂ → Irreducible r := by
      intro r hr
      apply hM r
      rw [List.mem_append] at hr ⊢
      rcases hr with hr | hr
      · exact Or.inl hr
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem q hr)
    have ihx := ih (M₁ ++ M₂) (u * c) (fun r hr => hL r (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hr)) hM'
      (hu.mul hc) h' x
    rw [countAssoc_perm x hperm, countAssoc_cons, countAssoc_cons, ihx]
    congr 1
    classical
    have : Associated x p ↔ Associated x q :=
      ⟨fun h1 => h1.trans ⟨c, hc, hcq⟩, fun h1 => h1.trans (Associated.symm ⟨c, hc, hcq⟩)⟩
    simp only [this]
Foundations.Algebra.dvd_count_of_saturat:
/-- **The tiling argument.** If a set `P` is a union of left cosets of `H` (i.e. closed under
right multiplication by elements of `H`), then `|H|` divides `|P|`. We peel off one coset
at a time: removing a coset from such a set leaves such a set, with `|H|` fewer elements. -/
theorem dvd_count_of_saturated (H : Subgroup G) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (P : G → Prop), count P = n →
      (∀ a h, P a → h ∈ H → P (a * h)) → count (· ∈ H) ∣ n := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro P hn hsat
    by_cases h0 : n = 0
    · rw [h0]; exact Nat.dvd_zero _
    · have hpos : 0 < count P := by omega
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := count_pos.1 hpos
      -- The coset `gH` lies inside `P`.
      have hsub : ∀ x, leftCoset g H x → P x := by
        intro x hx
        have := hsat g _ hg hx
        rwa [mul_inv_cancel_left] at this
      -- Split `P` into the coset `gH` and the rest.
      have hsplit := count_split P (leftCoset g H)
      have hC : count (fun x => P x ∧ leftCoset g H x) = count (· ∈ H) := by
        rw [← count_leftCoset g H]
        exact count_congr fun x => ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hsub x h, h⟩⟩
      have hHpos : 0 < count (· ∈ H) := count_pos.2 ⟨1, H.one_mem⟩
      -- The rest is again a union of cosets.
      have hsat' : ∀ a h, (P a ∧ ¬ leftCoset g H a) → h ∈ H →
          (P (a * h) ∧ ¬ leftCoset g H (a * h)) := by
        intro a h ⟨hPa, hna⟩ hh
        refine ⟨hsat a h hPa hh, fun hc => hna ?_⟩
        show g⁻¹ * a ∈ H
        have : g⁻¹ * a = (g⁻¹ * (a * h)) * h⁻¹ := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_right]
        rw [this]; exact H.mul_mem hc (H.inv_mem hh)
      have hrest := ih (count fun x => P x ∧ ¬ leftCoset g H x) (by omega) _ rfl hsat'
      rw [← hn, hsplit, hC]
      exact Nat.dvd_add (Nat.dvd_refl _) hrest
Foundations.Topology.IsPolyFn:
/-- The **polynomial functions** `ℝ → ℝ`: generated from the constants and `x ↦ x` by sums and
products. -/
inductive IsPolyFn : (R → R) → Prop
  /-- Constants are polynomials. -/
  | const (c : R) : IsPolyFn (fun _ => c)
  /-- The identity is a polynomial. -/
  | id : IsPolyFn (fun x => x)
  /-- Sums of polynomials are polynomials. -/
  | add {p q : R → R} : IsPolyFn p → IsPolyFn q → IsPolyFn (fun x => p x + q x)
  /-- Products of polynomials are polynomials. -/
  | mul {p q : R → R} : IsPolyFn p → IsPolyFn q → IsPolyFn (fun x => p x * q x)
Foundations.Numbers.C.cabs:
/-- **The modulus** `|z| = √(a² + b²)` of `z = a + bi`. -/
noncomputable def cabs (z : C) : R := sqrt (normSq z)
Foundations.Numbers.R.archimedean:
/-- **Archimedean property of ℝ.** Every real number is smaller than some natural number. -/
theorem archimedean (x : R) : ∃ n : Nat, x < (n : R) := by
  induction x using ind with | h a => ?_
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hB'⟩ := a.bounded
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Q.archimedean B
  refine ⟨n, n - B, by grind, 0, fun k _ => ?_⟩
  have := (abs_lt.1 (hB' k))
  show (n : Q) - B ≤ (n : Q) + -a k
  grind
Foundations.Categories.Monoid':
/-- A **monoid**: an associative multiplication with a two-sided unit. -/
class Monoid' (M : Type u) extends Mul M, One M where
  /-- Associativity. -/
  mul_assoc : ∀ a b c : M, a * b * c = a * (b * c)
  /-- `1` is a left unit. -/
  one_mul : ∀ a : M, 1 * a = a
  /-- `1` is a right unit. -/
  mul_one : ∀ a : M, a * 1 = a
Foundations.Types.STLC.subst:
/-- Simultaneous substitution. -/
def subst (σ : Nat → Term) : Term → Term
  | var n => σ n
  | app t u => app (subst σ t) (subst σ u)
  | lam t => lam (subst (up σ) t)
  | pair a b => pair (subst σ a) (subst σ b)
  | fst t => fst (subst σ t)
  | snd t => snd (subst σ t)
  | inl t => inl (subst σ t)
  | inr t => inr (subst σ t)
  | case t u₁ u₂ => case (subst σ t) (subst (up σ) u₁) (subst (up σ) u₂)
  | .absurd t => .absurd (subst σ t)

Foundations.Logic.FO.formsUpTo_succ:
/-- The lists of formulas are cumulative. -/
theorem formsUpTo_succ {φ : Formula L} : ∀ {k}, φ ∈ formsUpTo L k → φ ∈ formsUpTo L (k + 1)
  | 0, h => by simp [formsUpTo] at h
  | k + 1, h => by
      rw [mem_formsUpTo_succ] at h ⊢
      rcases h with h | ⟨s, hs, t, ht, h⟩ | ⟨j, hj, h⟩ | ⟨a, ha, b, hb, h⟩ | ⟨a, ha, h⟩
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨s, termsUpTo_succ hs, t, termsUpTo_succ ht, h⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨j, by omega,
          symbolAtoms_mono (fun _ h => termsUpTo_succ h) h⟩))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨a, formsUpTo_succ ha, b, formsUpTo_succ hb, h⟩)))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a, formsUpTo_succ ha, h⟩)))

Foundations.Sets.Zorn.ChainClosure.total:
/-- **The tower is linearly ordered by inclusion.** -/
theorem ChainClosure.total {c₁ c₂ : α → Prop} (hc₁ : ChainClosure r c₁)
    (hc₂ : ChainClosure r c₂) : Sub c₁ c₂ ∨ Sub c₂ c₁ := by
  rcases closure_succ_total_aux hc₂ (fun c₃ hc₃ hsub => closure_succ_total hc₃ hc₁ hsub) with h | h
  · exact Or.inl ((sub_succChain c₁).trans h)
  · exact Or.inr h
Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_exp_eq:
/-- **`exp` takes every positive value.** -/
theorem exists_exp_eq {y : R} (hy : 0 < y) : ∃ x, exp x = y := by
  have hc : ∀ x, ContinuousAt exp x := fun x => (hasDerivAt_exp x).continuousAt
  -- First for `y ≥ 1`, by the intermediate value theorem on `[0, y]`.
  have big : ∀ y : R, 1 ≤ y → ∃ x, exp x = y := fun y hy1 => by
    obtain ⟨x, -, -, hx⟩ := intermediate_value' (f := exp) (a := 0) (b := y) (v := y)
      (by grind) (fun x _ _ => hc x) (by rw [exp_zero]; exact hy1)
      (by have := one_add_le_exp (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ y); grind)
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  rcases (by grind : 1 ≤ y ∨ y < 1) with h | h
  · exact big y h
  · -- For `0 < y < 1` use `exp (−x) = 1 / exp x`.
    have hinv : 1 ≤ 1 / y := by
      have := one_div_le_one_div hy (Std.le_of_lt h); grind
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := big (1 / y) hinv
    refine ⟨-x, ?_⟩
    have := exp_mul_exp_neg x
    rw [hx] at this
    grind

theorem nonHaltsF_sentence (c : Code) (x : Nat) : IsSentence (nonHaltsF c x) := by
  intro y
  refine ⟨Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun n hn => ?_, trivial⟩
  cases n with
  | zero => exact numeral_fresh _ _
  | succ m =>
      refine var_fresh fun hm => hn ?_
      subst hm
      refine Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun n hn' => ?_
      cases n with
      | zero => exact numeral_fresh _ _
      | succ m' =>
          refine var_fresh fun hm' => hn' ?_
          subst hm'
          exact haltsF_fresh _ (by omega)
Foundations.Sets.WellOrdering.PWO:
/-- A **partial well-ordering** of `α`: a strict order `lt` on a part `dom` of `α`
that is total there and in which every non-empty part of `dom` has a minimal
element. -/
structure PWO (α : Type u) where
  /-- The part of `α` that is ordered. -/
  dom : α → Prop
  /-- The strict order. -/
  lt : α → α → Prop
  /-- The order only relates elements of the domain. -/
  lt_dom : ∀ x y, lt x y → dom x ∧ dom y
  /-- Irreflexivity. -/
  irrefl : ∀ x, ¬ lt x x
  /-- Transitivity. -/
  trans : ∀ x y z, lt x y → lt y z → lt x z
  /-- Totality on the domain. -/
  total : ∀ x y, dom x → dom y → lt x y ∨ x = y ∨ lt y x
  /-- Well-foundedness: every non-empty part of the domain has a minimal element. -/
  wf : ∀ S : α → Prop, (∃ x, S x ∧ dom x) → ∃ m, S m ∧ dom m ∧ ∀ y, S y → dom y → ¬ lt y m

/-- Every formula has only finitely many free variables: all large `x` are fresh. -/
theorem eventually_fresh : ∀ φ : Formula L, ∃ k, ∀ x, k ≤ x → φ.Fresh x
  | bot => ⟨0, fun _ _ => trivial⟩
  | eq t s => by
      obtain ⟨k₁, h₁⟩ := t.eventually_fresh
      obtain ⟨k₂, h₂⟩ := s.eventually_fresh
      exact ⟨max k₁ k₂, fun x hx => ⟨h₁ x (by omega), h₂ x (by omega)⟩⟩
  | rel _ ts => fin_eventually (fun i x => (ts i).Fresh x) (fun i => (ts i).eventually_fresh)
  | imp φ ψ | conj φ ψ | disj φ ψ => by
      obtain ⟨k₁, h₁⟩ := eventually_fresh φ
      obtain ⟨k₂, h₂⟩ := eventually_fresh ψ
      exact ⟨max k₁ k₂, fun x hx => ⟨h₁ x (by omega), h₂ x (by omega)⟩⟩
  | all φ | ex φ => by
      obtain ⟨k, h⟩ := eventually_fresh φ
      exact ⟨k, fun x hx => h (x + 1) (by omega)⟩

Foundations.Logic.Derives.toHilbert:
/-- **From natural deduction to Hilbert.** Every natural-deduction derivation can be
translated into a Hilbert-style derivation. -/
theorem Derives.toHilbert {Γ : Theory} {φ : Formula} (h : Γ ⊢ φ) : Γ ⊢ₕ φ := by
  induction h with
  | hyp hφ => exact .hyp hφ
  | impI _ ih => exact HDerives.deduction ih
  | impE _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .mp ih₁ ih₂
  | conjI _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .mp (.mp (.ax (.conjI _ _)) ih₁) ih₂
  | conjE₁ _ ih => exact .mp (.ax (.conjE₁ _ _)) ih
  | conjE₂ _ ih => exact .mp (.ax (.conjE₂ _ _)) ih
  | disjI₁ _ ih => exact .mp (.ax (.disjI₁ _ _)) ih
  | disjI₂ _ ih => exact .mp (.ax (.disjI₂ _ _)) ih
  | disjE _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
      exact .mp (.mp (.mp (.ax (.disjE _ _ _)) (HDerives.deduction ih₂))
        (HDerives.deduction ih₃)) ih₁
  | botE _ ih => exact HDerives.botE ih
  | raa _ ih => exact .mp (.ax (.dne _)) (HDerives.deduction ih)

Foundations.Sets.countable_sigma:
/-- **A countable union of countable types is countable.** If the index type `ι`
is countable and every `β i` is countable, then the (disjoint) union
`Σ i, β i` is countable. Uses choice to pick an injection for every `i` at once. -/
theorem countable_sigma {ι : Type _} {β : ι → Type _} (hι : Countable ι)
    (hβ : ∀ i, Countable (β i)) : Countable (Σ i, β i) := by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hι
  let f : ∀ i, β i → Nat := fun i => Classical.choose (hβ i)
  have hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f i) := fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hβ i)
  refine ⟨fun p => cantorPair (e p.1, f p.1 p.2), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨i, b⟩ ⟨j, c⟩ h
  have h' := cantorPair_injective h
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h'
  obtain ⟨hij, hbc⟩ := h'
  have hij' : i = j := he hij
  subst hij'
  rw [hf i hbc]

  have hab := Std.le_of_lt hpi_pos
  exact HasIntegral.mono hab (hasIntegral_integral hab fun x _ _ => continuousAt_cos_pow _ x)

/-- **ℝ is uncountable** (third proof, via Baire): no sequence `s` lists all real numbers. -/
theorem real_uncountable_baire (s : Nat → R) : ∃ x, ∀ n, x ≠ s n := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
  apply real_not_meagre (F := fun n x => x = s n)
  · intro n
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ⟨abs (x - s n), ?_, fun y hy h' => ?_⟩, fun x ε hε => ?_⟩
    · rcases abs_cases (x - s n) with h | h <;> grind
    · rw [h'] at hy; have : dist x (s n) = abs (x - s n) := rfl; grind
    · by_cases hx : x = s n
      · exact ⟨x + ε / 2, by
          show abs (x - (x + ε / 2)) < ε
          rw [show x - (x + ε / 2) = -(ε / 2) by grind, R.abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by grind)]; grind,
          by grind⟩
      · exact ⟨x, by rw [dist_self]; exact hε, hx⟩
  · intro x
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hx
    exact h ⟨x, fun n e => hx ⟨n, e⟩⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.HasIntegral.add_in:
/-- **Additivity over intervals.** `∫ₐᶜ f = ∫ₐᵇ f + ∫ᵇᶜ f` (when all three integrals exist and
`a ≤ b ≤ c`). -/
theorem HasIntegral.add_interval {f : R → R} {a b c I J K : R} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) (hJ : HasIntegral f b c J) (hK : HasIntegral f a c K) :
    K = I + J := by
  apply eq_of_abs_lt_all
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hI.2 (ε / 3) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h₂⟩ := hJ.2 (ε / 3) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃, h₃⟩ := hK.2 (ε / 3) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₄, hδ₄, h₄1, h₄2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₁ hδ₂
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₄ hδ₃
  obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁, hm₁⟩ := exists_tagged hab hδ
  obtain ⟨l₂, hl₂, hm₂⟩ := exists_tagged hbc hδ
  have k1 := abs_lt.1 (h₁ l₁ hl₁ (hm₁.mono (by grind)))
  have k2 := abs_lt.1 (h₂ l₂ hl₂ (hm₂.mono (by grind)))
  have k3 := abs_lt.1 (h₃ (l₁ ++ l₂) (hl₁.append hl₂) ((MeshLt.append hl₁ hm₁ hm₂).mono hδ2))
  rw [rsum_append f l₂ hl₁] at k3
  exact abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩

Foundations.Logic.FO.consistent_henkinAd:
/-- Adding an acceptable formula together with its witness preserves consistency. -/
theorem consistent_henkinAdd {A : List (Formula L)} {ψ : Formula L}
    (h : Consistent (union Γ₀ (ofList (ψ :: A)))) :
    Consistent (union Γ₀ (ofList (henkinAdd hΓ₀ A ψ ++ A))) := by
  -- `Γ₀ ∪ (ψ :: A)` written as an insertion
  have eqv : (union Γ₀ (ofList (ψ :: A))).Subset (insert (union Γ₀ (ofList A)) ψ) := by
    rintro χ (h | h)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
  have eqv' : (insert (union Γ₀ (ofList A)) ψ).Subset (union Γ₀ (ofList (ψ :: A))) := by
    rintro χ (rfl | h | h)
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
  rcases witnesses_cases hΓ₀ A ψ with hw | ⟨φ, rfl, hw⟩
  · intro hb
    refine h (hb.weaken ?_)
    rintro χ (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · simp only [henkinAdd, hw, ofList, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h
      exact Or.inr h
  · intro hb
    obtain ⟨hfΓ, hfA⟩ := freshVar_spec hΓ₀ A (ex φ)
    let x := freshVar hΓ₀ A (ex φ)
    refine h (Proves.witness (Δ := union Γ₀ (ofList (ex φ :: A))) (x := x) ?_ ?_
      (Proves.hyp (Or.inr (List.mem_cons_self ..))) (hb.weaken ?_))
    · rintro χ (h | h)
      · exact hfΓ χ h
      · exact hfA χ h
    · exact hfA _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    · rintro χ (h | h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
      · simp only [henkinAdd, hw, ofList, List.cons_append, List.mem_cons] at h
        rcases h with rfl | rfl | h
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (List.mem_cons_self ..))
        · exact Or.inl rfl
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h))

Foundations.Algebra.dim_spec:
/-- The defining properties of the dimension of a finite-dimensional space. -/
theorem dim_spec (hF : IsField K) (hfin : FinDim K V) :
    (∃ u : Fin (dim K V) → V, LinIndep K u) ∧ ¬ ∃ u : Fin (dim K V + 1) → V, LinIndep K u := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, w', hw⟩ := hfin
  have h : ∃ n, ¬ ∃ u : Fin (n + 1) → V, LinIndep K u :=
    ⟨m, fun ⟨u, hu⟩ => by

      rw [card_fin, card_fin] at this; omega⟩

    unfold dim; simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte]
  have hspec := Classical.choose_spec (FiniteType.exists_least _ h)
  rw [← hd] at hspec
  refine ⟨?_, hspec.1⟩
  rcases hk : dim K V with _ | k
  · exact ⟨fun i => absurd i.isLt (Nat.not_lt_zero _), linIndep_empty _⟩

/-- Substitutions agreeing away from a fresh variable act identically on a formula. -/
theorem subst_congr_fresh : ∀ (φ : Formula L) {x : Nat} {σ τ : Nat → Term L},
    (∀ n, n ≠ x → σ n = τ n) → φ.Fresh x → φ.subst σ = φ.subst τ
  | bot, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | eq t s, _, _, _, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst, Term.subst_congr_fresh h t hf.1, Term.subst_congr_fresh h s hf.2]
  | rel R ts, _, _, _, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst]; congr; funext i; exact Term.subst_congr_fresh h (ts i) (hf i)
  | imp φ ψ, _, _, _, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst, subst_congr_fresh φ h hf.1, subst_congr_fresh ψ h hf.2]
  | conj φ ψ, _, _, _, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst, subst_congr_fresh φ h hf.1, subst_congr_fresh ψ h hf.2]
  | disj φ ψ, _, _, _, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst, subst_congr_fresh φ h hf.1, subst_congr_fresh ψ h hf.2]
  | all φ, x, σ, τ, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst]; congr 1
      refine subst_congr_fresh φ (x := x + 1) (fun n hn => ?_) hf
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n => simp only [Subst.lift]; rw [h n (by omega)]
  | ex φ, x, σ, τ, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst]; congr 1
      refine subst_congr_fresh φ (x := x + 1) (fun n hn => ?_) hf
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n => simp only [Subst.lift]; rw [h n (by omega)]

Foundations.Logic.FO.henkin_lindenbaum:
/-- **Henkin–Lindenbaum lemma.** If the base theory has a fresh supply of variables
and is consistent together with the finite list `A₀`, then it extends (together with
`A₀`) to a maximal consistent Henkin theory. -/
theorem henkin_lindenbaum (hc : Consistent (union Γ₀ (ofList A₀))) :
    Γ₀.Subset (henkinLimit hΓ₀ A₀) ∧ (∀ χ ∈ A₀, henkinLimit hΓ₀ A₀ χ) ∧
      MaximalHenkin (henkinLimit hΓ₀ A₀) := by
  have cons_stage : ∀ n, Consistent (union Γ₀ (ofList (henkinStage hΓ₀ A₀ n))) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hc
    | succ n ih => exact consistent_extendH hΓ₀ _ _ ih
  have hcons : Consistent (henkinLimit hΓ₀ A₀) := by
    intro hb
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hd⟩ := Proves.finite_premises hb (Subset.refl _)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := henkinStage_finite hΓ₀ A₀ l hl
    exact cons_stage n (hd.weaken (union_mono (Subset.refl _) hn))
  -- inclusion of a stage-relative theory in the limit
  have into : ∀ {n : Nat} {A' : List (Formula L)} (ψ : Formula L),
      (∀ χ ∈ A', χ ∈ henkinStage hΓ₀ A₀ n) →
      (union Γ₀ (ofList (ψ :: A'))).Subset (insert (henkinLimit hΓ₀ A₀) ψ) := by
    intro n A' ψ hA' χ hχ
    rcases hχ with h | h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n, hA' χ h⟩)
  refine ⟨fun χ h => Or.inl h, fun χ h => Or.inr ⟨0, h⟩, hcons, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ψ
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_formsUpTo ψ
    obtain ⟨A', hA', h⟩ := extendH_decides hΓ₀ (formsUpTo L n) (henkinStage hΓ₀ A₀ n) ψ hn
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n + 1, h ψ (List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩)
    · exact Or.inr fun hc' => h fun hb => hc' (hb.weaken (into (n := n + 1) ψ hA'))
  · intro φ hφ
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_formsUpTo (ex φ)
    obtain ⟨A', hA', h⟩ :=
      extendH_decides hΓ₀ (formsUpTo L n) (henkinStage hΓ₀ A₀ n) (ex φ) hn
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact ⟨.var (freshVar hΓ₀ A' (ex φ)), Or.inr ⟨n + 1, h _ (by simp [henkinAdd, witnesses])⟩⟩
    · refine absurd ?_ h
      intro hb
      refine hcons ((hb.weaken (into (n := n + 1) _ hA')).weaken ?_)
      rintro χ (rfl | h)
      · exact hφ
      · exact h

Foundations.Types.STLC.ND:
/-- **Natural deduction** for intuitionistic propositional logic: `ND Γ A` means
`A` is derivable from the hypotheses `Γ`. -/
inductive ND : List Formula → Formula → Prop
  /-- Use a hypothesis. -/
  | hyp {Γ : List Formula} {n : Nat} {A : Formula} : Γ[n]? = some A → ND Γ A
  /-- `→`-introduction (discharging a hypothesis). -/
  | impI {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND (A :: Γ) B → ND Γ (.arr A B)
  /-- `→`-elimination (modus ponens). -/
  | impE {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ (.arr A B) → ND Γ A → ND Γ B
  /-- `∧`-introduction. -/
  | andI {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ A → ND Γ B → ND Γ (.prod A B)
  /-- `∧`-elimination, left. -/
  | andE₁ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ (.prod A B) → ND Γ A
  /-- `∧`-elimination, right. -/
  | andE₂ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ (.prod A B) → ND Γ B
  /-- `∨`-introduction, left. -/
  | orI₁ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ A → ND Γ (.sum A B)
  /-- `∨`-introduction, right. -/
  | orI₂ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ B → ND Γ (.sum A B)
  /-- `∨`-elimination (proof by cases). -/
  | orE {Γ : List Formula} {A B C : Formula} :
      ND Γ (.sum A B) → ND (A :: Γ) C → ND (B :: Γ) C → ND Γ C
  /-- `⊥`-elimination (ex falso quodlibet). -/
  | botE {Γ : List Formula} {C : Formula} : ND Γ .bot → ND Γ C

Foundations.Algebra.no_int_trisect_aux:
/-- `a³ - 3 a c² - c³ = 0` has no integer solution with `c ≠ 0` (descent). -/
theorem no_int_trisect_aux : ∀ (n : Nat) (a c : Int), c.natAbs = n → c ≠ 0 →
    a * a * a - 3 * a * (c * c) - c * c * c ≠ 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro a c hn hc h
    rcases Int.emod_two_eq a with ha | ha <;> rcases Int.emod_two_eq c with hc2 | hc2
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, a = 2 * k := ⟨a / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, c = 2 * l := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
      have hl : l ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hc; rw [h]; rfl
      have : k * k * k - 3 * k * (l * l) - l * l * l = 0 := by grind
      exact ih l.natAbs (by omega) k l rfl hl this
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, a = 2 * k := ⟨a / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, c = 2 * l + 1 := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
      have : (2 * k) * (2 * k) * (2 * k) - 3 * (2 * k) * ((2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1)) -
          (2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1) =
          2 * (4 * k * k * k - 3 * k * (4 * l * l + 4 * l + 1) - (4 * l * l * l + 6 * l * l + 3 * l)) - 1 := by
        grind
      omega
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, a = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨a / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, c = 2 * l := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
      have : (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1) - 3 * (2 * k + 1) * ((2 * l) * (2 * l)) -
          (2 * l) * (2 * l) * (2 * l) =
          2 * (4 * k * k * k + 6 * k * k + 3 * k - 3 * (2 * k + 1) * (2 * l * l) - 4 * l * l * l) + 1 := by
        grind
      omega
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, a = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨a / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, c = 2 * l + 1 := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
      have : (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1) - 3 * (2 * k + 1) * ((2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1)) -
          (2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1) =
          2 * (4 * k * k * k + 6 * k * k + 3 * k - 3 * (2 * k + 1) * (2 * l * l + 2 * l) - 3 * k
            - (4 * l * l * l + 6 * l * l + 3 * l) - 1) + 1 := by
        grind
      omega

/-- **Associativity** of multiplication. -/
theorem mul_assoc (p q r : List R) : Eqv (mul (mul p q) r) (mul p (mul q r)) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => intro n; rfl
  | cons a p ih =>
    intro n
    show coeff (mul (add (smul a q) (0 :: mul p q)) r) n = _
    rw [mul_add_left, coeff_add, smul_mul, coeff_smul, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_mul_cons,
      zero_mul, zero_add]
    cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => simp only [coeff_cons_succ]; rw [ih k]

Foundations.Geometry.Klein.segment_const:
/-- (A4) **Segment construction** in the Klein model. -/
theorem segment_construction (q a b c : KPt) : ∃ x, KBet q a x ∧ KCong a x b c := by
  have hK := one_le_inv b.2 c.2
  by_cases hqa : q = a
  · subst hqa
    obtain ⟨σ, _, hin, hinv⟩ := exists_on_ray (u := ⟨1, 0⟩) q.2 (by unfold n2; grind) hK
    exact ⟨⟨_, hin⟩, ⟨0, Std.le_refl 0, by grind, by grind, by grind⟩, hinv⟩
  · have hu : 0 < n2 ⟨a.1.x - q.1.x, a.1.y - q.1.y⟩ := by
      have := Pt.d2_pos (fun h => hqa (Subtype.ext h.symm) : a.1 ≠ q.1)
      unfold Pt.d2 at this; unfold n2; grind
    obtain ⟨σ, σ0, hin, hinv⟩ := exists_on_ray a.2 hu hK
    obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := div_mem_unit (u := 1) (v := 1 + σ) (by grind) (by grind) (by grind)
    have : 1 + σ ≠ 0 := by grind
    refine ⟨⟨_, hin⟩, ⟨1 / (1 + σ), t0, t1, ?_, ?_⟩, hinv⟩ <;> dsimp only <;> grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.inv_inv:
/-- Inversion is an involution: `(x⁻¹)⁻¹ = x`. -/
theorem inv_inv (x : R) : x⁻¹⁻¹ = x := by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [hx, inv_zero, inv_zero]
  · have h1 := mul_inv_cancel hx
    have hx' : x⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at h1; exact zero_ne_one h1
    have h2 := mul_inv_cancel hx'
    calc x⁻¹⁻¹ = (x * x⁻¹) * x⁻¹⁻¹ := by rw [h1, one_mul]
      _ = x * (x⁻¹ * x⁻¹⁻¹) := mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = x := by rw [h2, mul_one]
Foundations.Types.STLC.Term:
/-- **Terms** of the simply typed λ-calculus (untyped syntax, de Bruijn indices). -/
inductive Term where
  /-- Variable. -/
  | var (n : Nat)
  /-- Application `t u`. -/
  | app (t u : Term)
  /-- Abstraction `λ. t` (binds variable `0` in `t`). -/
  | lam (t : Term)
  /-- Pair `⟨a, b⟩`. -/
  | pair (a b : Term)
  /-- First projection. -/
  | fst (t : Term)
  /-- Second projection. -/
  | snd (t : Term)
  /-- Left injection. -/
  | inl (t : Term)
  /-- Right injection. -/
  | inr (t : Term)
  /-- Case analysis `case t of inl ⇒ u₁ | inr ⇒ u₂` (each branch binds variable `0`). -/
  | case (t u₁ u₂ : Term)
  /-- Ex falso: from a term of the empty type, anything. -/
  | absurd (t : Term)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

  | n + 1 => ξ n + 1

  induction p with
  | nil => rfl

    show a + x * evalList x p = 0

Foundations.Combinatorics.hall:
/-- **Hall's marriage theorem.** Let `A₀, …, A_{N−1}` be subsets of `{0, …, M−1}` such
that every subfamily `I` has at least `|I|` elements in its union. Then there is a
system of distinct representatives: an injective choice `f(i) ∈ Aᵢ`. -/
theorem hall (A : Nat → Nat → Prop)
    (hHall : ∀ I : Nat → Prop, cnt I N ≤ cnt (union N A I) M) :
    ∃ f : Nat → Nat, (∀ i, i < N → f i < M ∧ A i (f i)) ∧
      ∀ i j, i < N → j < N → i ≠ j → f i ≠ f j := by
  obtain ⟨f, h₁, h₂⟩ := hall_aux N M _ (fun _ => True) A rfl fun I _ => hHall I
  exact ⟨f, fun i hi => h₁ i hi trivial, fun i j hi hj hij => h₂ i j hi hj trivial trivial hij⟩

  pts := [true, false]

Foundations.Types.Lambda.Par.triangle:
/-- **The triangle property** (Takahashi): every parallel step from `t` can be
completed, by another parallel step, to the complete development `cd t`. -/
theorem Par.triangle {t u : Term} (h : Par t u) : Par u (cd t) := by
  induction h with
  | var n => exact Par.var n
  | lam _ ih => exact Par.lam ih
  | @app t t' u u' ht _ iht ihu =>
    cases t with
    | lam s =>
      obtain ⟨s', rfl, _⟩ := ht.lam_inv
      cases iht with
      | lam hs => exact Par.beta hs ihu
    | var n => exact Par.app iht ihu
    | app a b => exact Par.app iht ihu
  | beta _ _ iht ihu => exact Par.inst iht ihu

Foundations.Logic.FO.PA_iff:
/-- The axioms of PA are the closed axioms and the induction axioms. -/
theorem PA_iff (ψ : Formula Arith) : PA ψ ↔ ψ ∈ closedAx ∨ ∃ χ, ψ = indAx χ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h <;> first | exact Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩ | exact Or.inl (by simp [closedAx])
  · rintro (h | ⟨χ, rfl⟩)
    · simp only [closedAx, List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at h
      rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> constructor
    · exact PA.induction χ

Foundations.Categories.Functor.comp:

  obj X := G.obj (F.obj X)
  map f := G.map (F.map f)

  map_comp f g := by simp
Foundations.Topology.sum_kk_bern:
/-- `Σ_k k(k − 1) · C(n, k) xᵏ (1 − x)ⁿ⁻ᵏ = n(n − 1) x²` (here `n = m + 2`). -/
theorem sum_kk_bern (m : Nat) (x : R) :
    R.fsum (fun k => (k : R) * ((k : R) - 1) * bern (m + 2) k x) (m + 3) =
      ((m + 2 : Nat) : R) * (((m + 2 : Nat) : R) - 1) * (x * x) := by
  unfold bern
  have e : R.fsum (fun k => (k : R) * ((k : R) - 1) *
      ((fact (m + 2) : R) * (expTerm x k * expTerm (1 - x) (m + 2 - k)))) (m + 3) =
      (fact (m + 2) : R) * R.fsum (fun k => (k : R) * ((k : R) - 1) *
        (expTerm x k * expTerm (1 - x) (m + 2 - k))) (m + 3) := by
    rw [← fsum_const_mul]; apply fsum_congr; intro k _; grind
  rw [e, moment2, show x + (1 - x) = 1 by grind, expTerm_one, fact_succ', fact_succ']
  have := fact_pos' m; grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.mul_assoc:
/-- Multiplication of reals is associative. -/

  induction x using ind; induction y using ind; induction z using ind
  exact mk_eq_mk.2 (equiv_of_eq fun n => by simp; grind)
Foundations.Geometry.Klein.chord_coeffs:
/-- The data of a point `b` on the chord `ac`: coefficients `λ, μ` with
`ch(b, z) = λ ch(a, z) + μ ch(c, z)` for all `z`, `λ ≥ 0`, and `μ > 0` when `a ≠ b`. -/
theorem chord_coeffs {a b c : Pt R} (ha : n2 a < 1) (hb : n2 b < 1) (hc : n2 c < 1)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (h : Pt.Bet a b c) :
    ∃ l m : R, 0 ≤ l ∧ 0 < m ∧ ∀ z, n2 z < 1 → ch b z = l * ch a z + m * ch c z := by
  obtain ⟨t, t0, t1, hx, hy⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨sa, -⟩ := s_spec ha
  obtain ⟨sb, -⟩ := s_spec hb
  obtain ⟨sc, -⟩ := s_spec hc
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hab (Pt.ext' (by rw [h0] at hx; grind) (by rw [h0] at hy; grind))
  have hsb : s b ≠ 0 := by grind
  refine ⟨(1 - t) * s a / s b, t * s c / s b, ?_, ?_, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  · rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind) (by grind))
      (by have := Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 sb; grind)
  · rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact OrderedRing.mul_pos (OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind) sc) (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 sb)
  · have := stewart_ch ha hb hc hz hx hy
    grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.hasDerivAt_poly':
/-- **Derivative of a polynomial** in coefficient form: `(poly c d)' = poly (pderiv c) d`, if the
coefficients vanish from `d` on. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_poly' {c : Nat → R} {d : Nat} (hc : Vanish c d) (x : R) :
    HasDerivAt (poly c d) (poly (pderiv c) d x) x := by
  have h := hasDerivAt_poly c d x
  have e : fsum (fun k => c k * ((k : R) * x ^ (k - 1))) d = poly (pderiv c) d x := by
    cases d with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ d =>
      unfold poly
      rw [fsum_succ', fsum_succ]
      have : pderiv c d = 0 := by unfold R.pderiv; rw [hc (d + 1) (Nat.le_refl _)]; grind
      rw [this]
      have e0 : c 0 * (((0 : Nat) : R) * x ^ (0 - 1)) = 0 := by grind
      rw [e0]
      have : fsum (fun k => c (k + 1) * (((k + 1 : Nat) : R) * x ^ (k + 1 - 1))) d =
          fsum (fun k => pderiv c k * x ^ k) d := fsum_congr fun k _ => by
        unfold R.pderiv; rw [show k + 1 - 1 = k by omega]; grind
      rw [this]; grind
  rw [e] at h; exact h
Foundations.Numbers.Q.abs_mul_lt:
/-- A product estimate: if `|x| ≤ A` with `A > 0` and `|y| < δ`, then `|x · y| < A · δ`. -/
theorem abs_mul_lt {x y A δ : Q} (hx : abs x ≤ A) (hA : 0 < A) (hy : abs y < δ) :
    abs (x * y) < A * δ := by
  rw [abs_mul]
  have h1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx (abs_nonneg y)
  have h2 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy hA
  grind
Foundations.Categories.cantor_via_lawver:
/-- **Cantor's theorem from Lawvere's**: no type surjects onto its power type
`A → Prop`, because negation has no fixed point (`P = ¬P` is impossible). This is
the theorem `Sets.cantor_type` of Part I, now as a corollary of a fact about
categories. -/
theorem cantor_via_lawvere {A : Type} : ¬ ∃ f : A → (A → Prop), Function.Surjective f := by
  rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := lawvere_types f hf Not
  have hn : ¬ P := fun h => cast hP.symm h h
  exact hn (cast hP hn)

  | succ {c : α → Prop} : ChainClosure c → ChainClosure (succChain r c)

Foundations.Numbers.natToZ_embedding:
/-- **ℕ embeds in ℤ.** `natToZ` is injective and preserves `0`, `1`, `+`, `×` and `≤`. -/
theorem natToZ_embedding :
    natToZ 0 = 0 ∧ natToZ 1 = 1 ∧ (∀ a b, natToZ (a + b) = natToZ a + natToZ b) ∧
    (∀ a b, natToZ (a * b) = natToZ a * natToZ b) ∧ (∀ a b, a ≤ b ↔ natToZ a ≤ natToZ b) ∧
    (∀ a b, natToZ a = natToZ b → a = b) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, fun a b => ?_, fun a b => ?_, fun a b => ?_, fun a b h => ?_⟩
  · simp only [natToZ, Z.mk_add]
  · simp only [natToZ, Z.mk_mul, Z.mk_eq_mk]; simp
  · simp only [natToZ, Z.mk_le]; omega
  · simp only [natToZ, Z.mk_eq_mk] at h; omega
Foundations.Algebra.ConjAct.action:
/-- **Conjugation action.** `G` acts on (a copy of) itself by `g • x = g * x * g⁻¹`. Its orbits
are the *conjugacy classes*. -/
instance ConjAct.action (G : Type u) [Group G] : MulAction G (ConjAct G) where
  smul := fun g (x : G) => (g * x * g⁻¹ : G)
  one_smul := fun (x : G) => by show 1 * x * 1⁻¹ = x; rw [inv_one, mul_one, one_mul]
  mul_smul := fun g h (x : G) => by
    show g * h * x * (g * h)⁻¹ = g * (h * x * h⁻¹) * g⁻¹
    rw [mul_inv_rev]; simp only [Group.mul_assoc]
Foundations.Logic.Computability.eval_mul:
/-- `mulCode` computes multiplication. -/
theorem eval_mul (b : Nat) (xs : List Nat) : ∀ a, Eval mulCode (a :: b :: xs) (a * b)
  | 0 => by
      have := Eval.prec_zero (f := .zero)
        (g := .comp addCode (vec2 (.proj 1) (.proj 2))) (xs := b :: xs) .zero
      simpa using this
  | a + 1 => by
      have := Eval.prec_succ (eval_mul b xs a)
        (eval_comp2 (xs := a :: (a * b) :: b :: xs) .proj .proj (eval_add b [] (a * b)))
      simpa [Nat.succ_mul] using this
Foundations.Numbers.R.HasDerivAt.comp:
/-- **Chain rule.** `(g ∘ f)' (x) = g' (f x) · f' (x)`. -/
theorem HasDerivAt.comp {f g : R → R} {a b x : R} (hg : HasDerivAt g b (f x))
    (hf : HasDerivAt f a x) : HasDerivAt (fun y => g (f y)) (b * a) x := fun ε hε => by
  have ha := abs_nonneg a
  obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, hε₁c⟩ := exists_mul_le (abs a + 1) (by grind : 0 < ε / 2)
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by grind : 0 ≤ abs a + 1)] at hε₁c
  obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂, hε₂c⟩ := exists_mul_le b (by grind : 0 < ε / 2)
  obtain ⟨δg, hδg, hg'⟩ := hg ε₁ hε₁
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hf.continuousAt δg hδg
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h₂⟩ := hf.lipschitz
  obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃, h₃⟩ := hf ε₂ hε₂
  obtain ⟨δ₄, hδ₄, h₄1, h₄2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₁ hδ₂
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₄ hδ₃
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have t1 : abs (g (f y) - g (f x) - b * (f y - f x)) ≤ ε / 2 * abs (y - x) := by
    have k := hg' (f y) (h₁ y (by grind))
    have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h₂ y (by grind)) (Std.le_of_lt hε₁)
    have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε₁c (abs_nonneg (y - x))
    grind
  have t2 := abs_mul_bound (h₃ y (by grind)) hε₂c
  have s := abs_add (g (f y) - g (f x) - b * (f y - f x)) (b * (f y - f x - a * (y - x)))
  rw [show g (f y) - g (f x) - b * (f y - f x) + b * (f y - f x - a * (y - x)) =
    g (f y) - g (f x) - b * a * (y - x) by grind] at s
  grind

Foundations.Logic.Computability.ballLt_i:
/-- `ballLt` means what it says. -/
theorem ballLt_iff (q : Nat → Bool) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ m, ballLt q n m = true ↔ ∀ i, i < m → q (pair n i) = true
  | 0 => by simp [ballLt]
  | m + 1 => by
      simp only [ballLt, Bool.and_eq_true, ballLt_iff q n m]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ i hi
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hi with h | rfl

/-- `lnth` via `ldrop`. -/

Foundations.Geometry.bet_axis:
/-- From `B (u,0) (r,0) (v,0)` with `u < v`: `u ≤ r ≤ v`. -/
theorem bet_axis {u r v : Q} {s : Q} (huv : u < v)
    (h : Pt.Bet (⟨u, 0⟩ : Pt Q) ⟨r, s⟩ ⟨v, 0⟩) : u ≤ r ∧ r ≤ v ∧ s = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨t, t0, t1, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  dsimp only at h₁ h₂
  have a := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg t0 (by grind : (0 : Q) ≤ v - u)
  have b := mul_le_of_le_one t1 (by grind : (0 : Q) ≤ v - u)
  exact ⟨by grind, by grind, by grind⟩

    Consistent (extend Δ l)

Foundations.Categories.Functor:
/-- A **functor** from `C` to `D`: a map on objects and on arrows preserving identities
and composition. -/
structure Functor (C : Type u₁) [Category.{v₁} C] (D : Type u₂) [Category.{v₂} D] where
  /-- The action on objects. -/
  obj : C → D
  /-- The action on morphisms. -/
  map : {X Y : C} → (X ⟶ Y) → (obj X ⟶ obj Y)
  /-- Identities are preserved. -/
  map_id : ∀ X : C, map (𝟙 X) = 𝟙 (obj X)
  /-- Composition is preserved. -/
  map_comp : ∀ {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z), map (f ≫ g) = map f ≫ map g

Foundations.Topology.Vitali.vitali:
/-- **Vitali's theorem** (1905). There is no countably additive, translation-invariant (mod 1)
measure defined on *all* subsets of `[0, 1)` with `μ [0, 1) = 1`. -/
theorem vitali (M : InvariantMeasure) : False := by
  have hV : ∀ x, V x → I x := fun x h => h.1
  have hsh : ∀ r, I r → M.μ (shift V r) = M.μ V := fun r hr => M.invariant V hV r hr
  rcases (by have := M.nonneg V; grind : M.μ V = 0 ∨ 0 < M.μ V) with h0 | hpos
  · -- Countably many translates of measure `0` cover `[0, 1)`.
    let A : Nat → R → Prop := fun n x => (∀ k, k < n → q k ≠ q n) ∧ shift V (q n) x
    have h := M.additive A (fun n x h => h.2.1) (fun m n x hmn h1 h2 => by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hmn with hlt | hlt
      · exact shift_disjoint (q_mem m) (q_mem n) (h2.1 m hlt) (q_rel m n) h1.2 h2.2
      · exact shift_disjoint (q_mem m) (q_mem n) (fun e => h1.1 n hlt e.symm) (q_rel m n)
          h1.2 h2.2)
    have e : (fun x => ∃ n, A n x) = I := funext fun x => propext
      ⟨fun ⟨n, h⟩ => h.2.1, fun hx => by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := shift_cover hx
        obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀, hmin⟩ := nat_least (fun j => q j = q k) ⟨k, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨k₀, fun j hj e => hmin j hj (e.trans hk₀), hk₀ ▸ hk⟩⟩
    rw [e, M.unit] at h
    have hz : ∀ n, M.μ (A n) = 0 := fun n => by
      by_cases hn : ∀ k, k < n → q k ≠ q n
      · have : A n = shift V (q n) := funext fun x => propext ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hn, h⟩⟩
        rw [this, hsh _ (q_mem n), h0]
      · have : A n = fun _ => False := funext fun x => propext ⟨fun h => hn h.1, fun h => h.elim⟩
        rw [this, M.empty]
    have := h.unique (InvariantMeasure.hasSum_of_zero (m := 0) fun k _ => hz k)
    rw [fsum_zero] at this; grind
  · -- Finitely many disjoint translates already have total measure `> 1`.
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := archimedean (1 / M.μ V)
    have hmV : 1 < (m : R) * M.μ V := by
      have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hm hpos
      have : 1 / M.μ V * M.μ V = 1 := by grind
      grind
    let r : Nat → R := fun k => (k : R) / ((m : R) + 1)
    have hr : ∀ k, k < m → I (r k) := fun k hk => frac_mem (by omega)
    have hrinj : ∀ j k, r j = r k → j = k := fun j k e => by
      have hm := succ_pos m
      have : (j : R) = (k : R) := by
        have : (j : R) = r j * ((m : R) + 1) := by show _ = _ / _ * _; grind
        rw [this, e]; show _ / _ * _ = _; grind
      exact Nat.le_antisymm (OrderedRing.le_of_natCast_le_natCast (R := R) _ _ (by grind))
        (OrderedRing.le_of_natCast_le_natCast (R := R) _ _ (by grind))
    let A : Nat → R → Prop := fun k x => k < m ∧ shift V (r k) x
    have h := M.additive A (fun n x h => h.2.1) (fun j k x hjk h1 h2 =>
      shift_disjoint (hr j h1.1) (hr k h2.1) (fun e => hjk (hrinj j k e))
        (rel_trans (rel_frac_zero j m) (rel_symm (rel_frac_zero k m))) h1.2 h2.2)
    have hz : ∀ k, m ≤ k → M.μ (A k) = 0 := fun k hk => by
      have : A k = fun _ => False := funext fun x => propext ⟨fun h => by omega, fun h => h.elim⟩
      rw [this, M.empty]
    have hsum := h.unique (InvariantMeasure.hasSum_of_zero hz)
    have hval : ∀ j, j ≤ m → fsum (fun k => M.μ (A k)) j = (j : R) * M.μ V := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => intro _; rw [fsum_zero]; grind
      | succ j ih =>
        intro hj
        have : A j = shift V (r j) := funext fun x => propext ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨by omega, h⟩⟩
        rw [fsum_succ, ih (by omega), this, hsh _ (hr j (by omega))]; grind
    rw [hval m (Nat.le_refl m)] at hsum
    have := M.le_one (U := fun x => ∃ n, A n x) fun x ⟨n, h⟩ => h.2.1
    grind

Foundations.Algebra.isum_single':
/-- A sum in which only the term at `a` can be non-zero (any universe of index type). -/
theorem isum_single' {A : Type u} [AddAbGroup A] {ι : Type v} [FiniteType ι] (f : ι → A) (a : ι)
    (hf : ∀ i, i ≠ a → f i = 0) : isum f = f a := by
  classical
  have key : ∀ l : List ι, l.Nodup → lsum (l.map f) = if a ∈ l then f a else 0 := by
    intro l hl
    induction l with
    | nil => simp [lsum]
    | cons b l ih =>
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at hl
      show f b + lsum (l.map f) = _
      rw [ih hl.2]
      by_cases hb : b = a
      · subst hb; simp [hl.1, AddAbGroup.add_zero]
      · rw [hf b hb, AddAbGroup.zero_add]
        by_cases ha : a ∈ l
        · simp [ha]
        · have : a ∉ b :: l := by simp [ha, Ne.symm hb]
          simp [ha, this]
  unfold isum
  rw [key _ nodup]
  simp [complete]

/-- **Completeness of trees.** Every derivable judgement is the root of a valid tree. -/
theorem exists_tvalid {x : Nat} (h : Derivable step x) : ∃ t, tvalid step t = 1 ∧ troot t = x := by
  induction h with
  | intro x w l _ hstep ih =>
      obtain ⟨ts, hlen, hts⟩ := exists_list_witness (P := fun y t => tvalid step t = 1 ∧ troot t = y) l ih
      refine ⟨pair (pair x w) (pair (encList l) (encList ts)), ?_, by simp [troot]⟩
      refine (tvalid_iff step _).2 ⟨by simpa [troot] using hstep, by simp [llen_encList, hlen],
        fun i hi => ?_⟩
      simp only [snd_pair, fst_pair, llen_encList] at hi ⊢
      have hi' : i < l.length := by omega
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hts i hi' hi
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := lnth_lt ts i hi
        have := right_le_pair (encList l) (encList ts)
        have := right_le_pair (pair x w) (pair (encList l) (encList ts))
        omega
      · rw [lnth_encList, getD_eq_getElem' _ _ hi]; exact h₁
      · rw [lnth_encList, lnth_encList, getD_eq_getElem' _ _ hi,
          getD_eq_getElem' _ _ hi', h₂]

Foundations.Geometry.equilateral_of_sqrt:
/-- Over any ordered field containing a square root of `3`, every segment `ab` is the side
of an equilateral triangle `abc`; for `a ≠ b` the apex `c` is off the line `ab`. -/
theorem equilateral_of_sqrt3 {r : K} (hr : r * r = 3) (a b : Pt K) :
    ∃ c : Pt K, Pt.Cong a b a c ∧ Pt.Cong a b b c ∧
      (a ≠ b → ¬ Pt.Bet a c b ∧ ¬ Pt.Bet c a b ∧ ¬ Pt.Bet a b c) := by
  refine ⟨⟨(a.x + b.x) / 2 - r / 2 * (b.y - a.y), (a.y + b.y) / 2 + r / 2 * (b.x - a.x)⟩,
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold Pt.Cong Pt.d2; dsimp only; grind
  · unfold Pt.Cong Pt.d2; dsimp only; grind
  · intro hab
    have hD := Pt.d2_pos hab
    unfold Pt.d2 at hD
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hr; grind
    -- the apex is off the line: the "cross product" of `b − a` and `c − a` is `(r/2)|ab|² ≠ 0`
    have hcross : (b.x - a.x) * ((a.y + b.y) / 2 + r / 2 * (b.x - a.x) - a.y) -
        (b.y - a.y) * ((a.x + b.x) / 2 - r / 2 * (b.y - a.y) - a.x) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have : r * ((a.x - b.x) * (a.x - b.x) + (a.y - b.y) * (a.y - b.y)) = 0 := by grind
      have : (a.x - b.x) * (a.x - b.x) + (a.y - b.y) * (a.y - b.y) = 0 := by grind
      grind
    refine ⟨fun h => hcross ?_, fun h => hcross ?_, fun h => hcross ?_⟩
    · have := Pt.cross_of_bet h; dsimp only at this; grind
    · have := Pt.cross_of_bet h; dsimp only at this; grind
    · have := Pt.cross_of_bet h; dsimp only at this; grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.deriv_eq_zero_of_i:
/-- **Fermat's theorem.** At a local maximum the derivative vanishes. -/
theorem deriv_eq_zero_of_isLocalMax {f : R → R} {d c : R} (hd : HasDerivAt f d c)
    (hmax : IsLocalMax f c) : d = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, h₀⟩ := hmax
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hne
  have hpos : 0 < abs d := by rcases abs_cases d with h | h <;> grind
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hd (abs d / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₀ hδ₁
  have hh : abs (δ / 2) = δ / 2 := abs_of_nonneg (by grind)
  rcases (by grind : 0 < d ∨ d < 0) with hs | hs
  · -- To the right of `c`, the function would increase.
    have e : c + δ / 2 - c = δ / 2 := by grind
    have k1 := h₁ (c + δ / 2) (by rw [e, hh]; grind)
    have k2 := h₀ (c + δ / 2) (by rw [e, hh]; grind)
    rw [e, hh, abs_of_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hs)] at k1
    have := (abs_le.1 k1).1
    have := OrderedRing.mul_pos hs (by grind : (0 : R) < δ / 2)
    grind
  · -- To the left of `c`, the function would increase.
    have e : c - δ / 2 - c = -(δ / 2) := by grind
    have k1 := h₁ (c - δ / 2) (by rw [e, abs_neg, hh]; grind)
    have k2 := h₀ (c - δ / 2) (by rw [e, abs_neg, hh]; grind)
    rw [e, abs_neg, hh] at k1
    have ed : abs d = -d := by rcases abs_cases d with h | h <;> grind
    rw [ed] at k1
    have := (abs_le.1 k1).1
    have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : 0 < -d) (by grind : (0 : R) < δ / 2)
    grind

Foundations.Combinatorics.konig:
/-- **Kőnig's lemma.** Every infinite, finitely branching tree has an infinite branch. -/
theorem konig (hT : IsTree T) (hfb : FinBranching T) (hinf : InfTree T) :
    ∃ f : Nat → Nat, IsBranch T f := by
  -- the root is good
  have hroot : Good T [] := fun n => by
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hlen⟩ := hinf n; exact ⟨l, by simpa using hl, hlen⟩
  -- walk from good node to good child
  let G := {l : List Nat // Good T l}
  let step : G → G := fun g =>
    ⟨g.1 ++ [Classical.choose (good_child hT hfb g.2)],
      Classical.choose_spec (good_child hT hfb g.2)⟩
  let walk : Nat → G := fun n => Nat.rec ⟨[], hroot⟩ (fun _ g => step g) n
  let f : Nat → Nat := fun n => Classical.choose (good_child hT hfb (walk n).2)
  have hwalk : ∀ n, (walk n).1 = (List.range n).map f := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
        show (walk n).1 ++ [f n] = _
        rw [ih, List.range_succ, List.map_append]; rfl
  exact ⟨f, fun n => hwalk n ▸ (walk n).2.mem⟩
Foundations.Geometry.parallel_postulate_:
/-- **The independence of the parallel postulate.** There is a model of Tarski's axioms
(A1)–(A9) and (A11) in which Euclid's axiom (A10) fails — the Klein model — and one in
which it holds — the Cartesian plane `ℝ²`. Hence Euclid's axiom is neither provable nor
refutable from the other axioms (relative to the consistency of the real numbers). -/
theorem parallel_postulate_independent :
    (∃ (P : Type) (N : NeutralPlane P), ¬ EuclidAxiom N) ∧
    (∃ (P : Type) (N : NeutralPlane P), EuclidAxiom N) :=
  ⟨⟨Klein.KPt, kleinNeutral, klein_not_euclid⟩,
   ⟨Pt R, TarskiPlane.toNeutral (Pt R), TarskiPlane.toNeutral_euclid (Pt R)⟩⟩

Foundations.Probability.FinProb.E_mul_of:
/-- **Independence implies `E[XY] = E[X] E[Y]`.** -/
theorem E_mul_of_indep {X Y : α → R} (h : P.IndepRV X Y) : P.E (fun x => X x * Y x) = P.E X * P.E Y := by
  have hX : ∀ x ∈ P.pts, X x = sumL (P.vals X) (fun a => a * ind (fun y => X y = a) x) :=
    fun x hx => (decomp_vals X x _ (nodup_dedupL _) (mem_dedupL (List.mem_map_of_mem hx))).symm
  have hY : ∀ x ∈ P.pts, Y x = sumL (P.vals Y) (fun b => b * ind (fun y => Y y = b) x) :=
    fun x hx => (decomp_vals Y x _ (nodup_dedupL _) (mem_dedupL (List.mem_map_of_mem hx))).symm
  -- `E[XY] = ∑_a ∑_b a b P(X = a, Y = b)`
  have h₁ : P.E (fun x => X x * Y x) = sumL (P.vals X) fun a => sumL (P.vals Y) fun b =>
      a * b * P.prob (fun y => X y = a ∧ Y y = b) := by
    rw [P.E_congr (Y := fun x => sumL (P.vals X) fun a => sumL (P.vals Y) fun b =>
        a * b * (ind (fun y => X y = a) x * ind (fun y => Y y = b) x)) fun x hx => by
      rw [hX x hx, hY x hx, ← sumL_mul_right]
      refine sumL_congr fun a _ => ?_
      rw [← sumL_mul_left]; exact sumL_congr fun b _ => by grind]
    simp only [E, prob]
    rw [sumL_congr (fun x _ => (sumL_mul_left _ _ _).symm), sumL_comm]
    refine sumL_congr fun a _ => ?_
    rw [sumL_congr (fun x _ => (sumL_mul_left _ _ _).symm), sumL_comm]
    refine sumL_congr fun b _ => ?_
    rw [← sumL_mul_left]; exact sumL_congr fun x _ => by rw [ind_and]; grind
  rw [h₁, E_eq_vals P X, E_eq_vals P Y, ← sumL_mul_right]
  refine sumL_congr fun a _ => ?_
  rw [← sumL_mul_left]
  exact sumL_congr fun b _ => by rw [h a b]; grind

/-- **Injective homomorphisms embed.** An injective homomorphism `f : G →* H` is an

Foundations.Numbers.Arith.dvd_gcd:
/-- Every common divisor divides the gcd: so the gcd is the *greatest* common divisor. -/
theorem dvd_gcd {d a b : Nat} (ha : d ∣ a) (hb : d ∣ b) : d ∣ gcd a b := by
  induction a, b using gcd.induct with
  | case1 a => rw [gcd_zero]; exact ha
  | case2 a b ih =>
    rw [gcd_succ]
    apply ih hb
    have := Nat.mod_add_div a (b + 1)
    have h2 : d ∣ (b + 1) * (a / (b + 1)) := Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd hb _
    have : a % (b + 1) = a - (b + 1) * (a / (b + 1)) := by omega
    rw [this]
    exact Nat.dvd_sub ha h2

Foundations.Algebra.polynomial_isEuclide:
/-- **`F[x]` is a Euclidean domain** for every field `F`, with size `deg + 1` (and `0` for
the zero polynomial). -/
theorem polynomial_isEuclidean {F : Type u} [CommRing F] (hF : IsField F) :
    IsEuclidean (Polynomial F) := by
  refine ⟨Polynomial.isDomain hF.isDomain, Polynomial.len, fun a b hb => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨q, r, hqr, hr⟩ := Polynomial.div_mod hF a b hb
  refine ⟨q, r, hqr, ?_⟩
  by_cases hr0 : r = 0
  · exact Or.inl hr0
  · right
    rcases hr with h | h
    · exact absurd h hr0
    · rw [Polynomial.len_eq_natDegree_succ hr0, Polynomial.len_eq_natDegree_succ hb]; omega
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.E_eq_val:
/-- The expectation along the values: `E[X] = ∑_a a P(X = a)`. -/
theorem E_eq_vals (X : α → R) :
    P.E X = sumL (P.vals X) fun a => a * P.prob (fun y => X y = a) := by
  have h : ∀ x ∈ P.pts, X x = sumL (P.vals X) (fun a => a * ind (fun y => X y = a) x) :=
    fun x hx => (decomp_vals X x _ (nodup_dedupL _) (mem_dedupL (List.mem_map_of_mem hx))).symm
  rw [P.E_congr h]
  simp only [E, prob]
  rw [sumL_congr (fun x _ => (sumL_mul_left _ _ _).symm), sumL_comm]

/-- **Vector space** over `K` (a field, assumed where needed): an additive abelian group with
a scalar multiplication satisfying the distributive and associative laws. -/

  /-- Scalars distribute over vector addition. -/
  smul_add : ∀ (c : K) (x y : V), c • (x + y) = c • x + c • y
  /-- Scalar addition distributes. -/
  add_smul : ∀ (c d : K) (x : V), (c + d) • x = c • x + d • x
  /-- Scaling twice is scaling by the product. -/
  mul_smul : ∀ (c d : K) (x : V), (c * d) • x = c • (d • x)
  /-- Scaling by `1` does nothing. -/
  one_smul : ∀ x : V, (1 : K) • x = x

Foundations.Algebra.fixedField:
/-- The **fixed field** of a set `S` of automorphisms of `L`: the elements of `L` fixed by every
member of `S`. -/
def fixedField {K : Subfield Ω} (L : Subfield Ω) (S : FieldAut K L → Prop) : Subfield Ω where
  carrier x := ∃ h : x ∈ L, ∀ σ, S σ → σ.toFun ⟨x, h⟩ = ⟨x, h⟩
  zero_mem := ⟨L.zero_mem, fun σ _ => σ.map_zero⟩
  one_mem := ⟨L.one_mem, fun σ _ => σ.map_one⟩
  add_mem := fun ⟨ha, hfa⟩ ⟨hb, hfb⟩ => ⟨L.add_mem ha hb, fun σ hσ => by
    have := σ.map_add ⟨_, ha⟩ ⟨_, hb⟩
    rw [hfa σ hσ, hfb σ hσ] at this; exact this⟩
  neg_mem := fun ⟨ha, hfa⟩ => ⟨L.neg_mem ha, fun σ hσ => by
    have := σ.map_neg ⟨_, ha⟩
    rw [hfa σ hσ] at this; exact this⟩
  mul_mem := fun ⟨ha, hfa⟩ ⟨hb, hfb⟩ => ⟨L.mul_mem ha hb, fun σ hσ => by
    have := σ.map_mul ⟨_, ha⟩ ⟨_, hb⟩
    rw [hfa σ hσ, hfb σ hσ] at this; exact this⟩
  inv_mem := by
    intro a ⟨ha, hfa⟩ ha0
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := L.inv_mem ha ha0
    refine ⟨b, ⟨hb, fun σ hσ => ?_⟩, hab⟩
    let aL : L := ⟨a, ha⟩
    let bL : L := ⟨b, hb⟩
    have h2 : aL * bL = 1 := Subtype.ext hab
    have h1 : aL * σ.toFun bL = 1 := by
      have := σ.map_mul aL bL
      rw [h2, σ.map_one, hfa σ hσ] at this; exact this.symm
    calc σ.toFun bL = σ.toFun bL * (aL * bL) := by rw [h2, Ring.mul_one]
      _ = (aL * σ.toFun bL) * bL := by ac_rfl
      _ = bL := by rw [h1, Ring.one_mul]
Foundations.Algebra.exists_even_move3:
/-- **`A₅` acts transitively on ordered triples.** For distinct `a, b, c ∈ Fin 5` there is an
even permutation `π` with `π a = 0`, `π b = 1`, `π c = 2`. -/
theorem exists_even_move3 {a b c : Fin 5} (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hac : a ≠ c) :
    ∃ π : Perm (Fin 5), π ∈ alternating 5 ∧ π a = 0 ∧ π b = 1 ∧ π c = 2 := by
  let ρ1 := swap (0 : Fin 5) a
  let ρ2 := swap (1 : Fin 5) (ρ1 b)
  let ρ3 := swap (2 : Fin 5) (ρ2 (ρ1 c))
  have hρ1a : ρ1 a = 0 := swap_apply_right _ _
  have hb1 : ρ1 b ≠ 0 := fun h => hab (ρ1.injective (hρ1a.trans h.symm))
  have hρ2b : ρ2 (ρ1 b) = 1 := swap_apply_right _ _
  have hρ20 : ρ2 0 = 0 := swap_apply_of_ne (by decide) (Ne.symm hb1)
  have hc0 : ρ2 (ρ1 c) ≠ 0 := fun h => hac (ρ1.injective (ρ2.injective (by rw [h, hρ1a, hρ20])))
  have hc1 : ρ2 (ρ1 c) ≠ 1 := fun h => hbc (ρ1.injective (ρ2.injective (by rw [h, hρ2b])))
  let ρ := ρ3 * ρ2 * ρ1
  have hρa : ρ a = 0 := by
    show ρ3 (ρ2 (ρ1 a)) = 0
    rw [hρ1a, hρ20]; exact swap_apply_of_ne (by decide) (Ne.symm hc0)
  have hρb : ρ b = 1 := by
    show ρ3 (ρ2 (ρ1 b)) = 1
    rw [hρ2b]; exact swap_apply_of_ne (by decide) (Ne.symm hc1)
  have hρc : ρ c = 2 := by show ρ3 (ρ2 (ρ1 c)) = 2; exact swap_apply_right _ _
  cases hp : parity ρ
  · exact ⟨ρ, mem_alternating.2 hp, hρa, hρb, hρc⟩
  · refine ⟨swap 3 4 * ρ, mem_alternating.2 ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [parity_mul, parity_swap (by decide), hp]; rfl
    · show swap (3 : Fin 5) 4 (ρ a) = 0; rw [hρa]; decide
    · show swap (3 : Fin 5) 4 (ρ b) = 1; rw [hρb]; decide
    · show swap (3 : Fin 5) 4 (ρ c) = 2; rw [hρc]; decide

Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.div_mod_a:
/-- **Division with remainder by a polynomial with invertible leading coefficient.** If `g`
has degree `≤ m` and its coefficient at `m` is a unit (with inverse `u`), then every `p` can
be written `p = q * g + r` with `deg r < m`. Proved by long division: cancel the top
coefficient of `p` with a multiple `c u X^(k-m) g`, and recurse. -/
theorem div_mod_aux (g : Polynomial R) (m : Nat) (u : R) (hg : DegLT g (m + 1))
    (hu : coeff g m * u = 1) :
    ∀ (d : Nat) (p : Polynomial R), DegLT p d → ∃ q r, p = q * g + r ∧ DegLT r m := by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero => intro p hp; exact ⟨0, p, by rw [zero_mul, Ring.zero_add], hp.mono (Nat.zero_le m)⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro p hp
    by_cases hkm : k + 1 ≤ m
    · exact ⟨0, p, by rw [zero_mul, Ring.zero_add], hp.mono hkm⟩
    · have hmk : m ≤ k := by omega
      let c := coeff p k
      let t : Polynomial R := C (c * u) * (Xpow (k - m) * g)
      have hcoef : ∀ n, k ≤ n → coeff t n = if n = k then c else 0 := by
        intro n hn
        show coeff (C (c * u) * (Xpow (k - m) * g)) n = _
        rw [coeff_C_mul, coeff_Xpow_mul, ite_true_of (by omega)]
        by_cases hnk : n = k
        · rw [ite_true_of hnk, hnk, show k - (k - m) = m by omega, Ring.mul_assoc,
            CommRing.mul_comm u, hu, Ring.mul_one]
        · rw [ite_false_of hnk, hg _ (by omega), mul_zero]
      have hp' : DegLT (p + -t) k := by
        intro n hn
        rw [coeff_add, coeff_neg, hcoef n hn]
        by_cases hnk : n = k
        · rw [ite_true_of hnk, hnk, add_neg_cancel]
        · rw [ite_false_of hnk, hp n (by omega), neg_zero, add_zero]
      obtain ⟨q, r, hqr, hr⟩ := ih _ hp'
      refine ⟨q + C (c * u) * Xpow (k - m), r, ?_, hr⟩
      calc p = (p + -t) + t := by rw [Ring.add_assoc, neg_add_cancel, add_zero]
        _ = q * g + r + C (c * u) * (Xpow (k - m) * g) := by rw [hqr]
        _ = (q + C (c * u) * Xpow (k - m)) * g + r := by
          rw [right_distrib, Ring.mul_assoc]; ac_rfl

/-- **Terms are proofs**: erasing the term from a typing derivation leaves a
natural deduction derivation. -/
theorem HasType.toND {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A : Ty} (h : HasType Γ t A) : ND Γ A := by
  induction h with
  | var hn => exact .hyp hn
  | lam _ ih => exact .impI ih
  | app _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .impE ih₁ ih₂
  | pair _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .andI ih₁ ih₂
  | fst _ ih => exact .andE₁ ih
  | snd _ ih => exact .andE₂ ih
  | inl _ ih => exact .orI₁ ih
  | inr _ ih => exact .orI₂ ih
  | case _ _ _ ih ih₁ ih₂ => exact .orE ih ih₁ ih₂
  | absurd _ ih => exact .botE ih

  refine Zorn.zorn (r := @Le α e) (fun _ => ⟨fun _ h => h, fun _ _ h => h⟩)
    (fun _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => ⟨fun x h => h₂.1 x (h₁.1 x h), fun p c h => h₂.2 p c (h₁.2 p c h)⟩)
    (fun _ _ h₁ h₂ => PSq.ext (funext fun x => propext ⟨h₁.1 x, h₂.1 x⟩)
      (funext fun p => funext fun c => propext ⟨h₁.2 p c, h₂.2 p c⟩)) ?_
  intro C hC
  by_cases hne : ∃ W, C W
  · obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨unionPSq C hC W₀ hW₀, fun W hW => ⟨fun x h => ⟨W, hW, h⟩, fun p c h => ⟨W, hW, h⟩⟩⟩

Foundations.Logic.Computability.eval_dia:
/-- `diagCode` finds the diagonal `s` of `n = tri s + a` (`a ≤ s`). -/
theorem eval_diag {s a : Nat} (ha : a ≤ s) (xs : List Nat) :
    Eval diagCode ((tri s + a) :: xs) s := by
  have body : ∀ m, Eval (.comp monusCode (vec2 (.comp triCode (vec1 (.comp .succ (vec1 (.proj 0)))))
      (.comp .succ (vec1 (.proj 1))))) (m :: (tri s + a) :: xs) ((tri s + a + 1) - tri (m + 1)) :=
    fun m => eval_comp2 (eval_comp1 (eval_comp1 .proj .succ) (eval_tri [] _))
      (eval_comp1 .proj .succ) (eval_monus _ [] _)
  refine .mu (fun m => tri s + a - tri (m + 1)) ?_ (fun m hm => ?_)
  · have := body s
    rwa [show tri s + a + 1 - tri (s + 1) = 0 by simp [tri]; omega] at this
  · have h₁ := tri_mono (show m + 1 ≤ s by omega)
    have := body m
    rwa [show tri s + a + 1 - tri (m + 1) = tri s + a - tri (m + 1) + 1 by omega] at this

Foundations.Numbers.R.poly_nivenH:
/-- Evaluation: `Σ nivenHₖ xᵏ = xⁿ (a − b x)ⁿ`. -/
theorem poly_nivenH (a b x : R) (n : Nat) :
    poly (nivenH a b n) (2 * n + 1) x = x ^ n * (a - b * x) ^ n := by
  have h2 : fsum (fun k => nivenH a b n (n + k) * x ^ (n + k)) (n + 1) =
      x ^ n * poly (linPow a b n) (n + 1) x := by
    unfold poly; rw [← fsum_const_mul]
    exact fsum_congr fun k _ => by
      unfold nivenH
      split
      · rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, pow_add']; grind
      · omega
  unfold poly
  rw [show 2 * n + 1 = n + (n + 1) by omega, fsum_split]
  have h1 : fsum (fun k => nivenH a b n k * x ^ k) n = 0 := by
    rw [fsum_congr (b := fun _ => 0) fun k hk => by
      show nivenH a b n k * x ^ k = 0
      unfold nivenH; split
      · omega
      · grind]
    exact fsum_zero' (fun _ => rfl) n
  rw [h1, h2, poly_linPow]; grind
Foundations.Sets.no_injection_fin_succ:
/-- **Pigeonhole principle.** There is no injection `Fin (n + 1) → Fin n`. -/
theorem no_injection_fin_succ (n : Nat) (f : Fin (n + 1) → Fin n) : ¬ Function.Injective f := by
  intro hf
  let F : Nat → Nat := fun i => if h : i < n + 1 then (f ⟨i, h⟩).val else 0
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hj, he⟩ := pigeonhole_nat n F (fun i hi => by
    simp only [F, hi, ↓reduceDIte]; exact (f ⟨i, hi⟩).isLt)
  simp only [F, show i < n + 1 by omega, hj, ↓reduceDIte] at he
  have := hf (Fin.ext he)
  simp only [Fin.mk.injEq] at this
  omega

Foundations.Algebra.isFixed_coset_iff:
/-- **Fixed cosets.** The coset `gH` is fixed by the action of `H` exactly when `g` lies in
the normaliser of `H`. (One inclusion `g⁻¹ H g ⊆ H` suffices, by counting.) -/
theorem isFixed_coset_iff (H : Subgroup G) (g : G) :
    MulAction.IsFixed H (mk H g) ↔ g ∈ normalizer H := by
  have key : MulAction.IsFixed H (mk H g) ↔ ∀ h, h ∈ H → g⁻¹ * h * g ∈ H := by
    constructor
    · intro hf h hh
      have : mk H (h⁻¹ * g) = mk H g := hf ⟨h⁻¹, H.inv_mem hh⟩
      have := mk_eq_mk.1 this
      rwa [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv] at this
    · intro hc h
      show mk H (h.1 * g) = mk H g
      apply mk_eq_mk.2
      rw [mul_inv_rev]
      exact hc _ (H.inv_mem h.2)
  rw [key]
  constructor
  · intro hc h
    refine ⟨hc h, ?_⟩
    apply imp_of_count_eq (P := (· ∈ H)) (Q := fun h => g⁻¹ * h * g ∈ H) hc
    · exact count_comp_bij (fun h => g⁻¹ * h * g)
        (fun a b hab => by
          have := congrArg (fun x => g * x * g⁻¹) hab
          simpa only [Group.mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one] using this)
        (fun y => ⟨g * y * g⁻¹, by
          simp only [Group.mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]⟩)
        (· ∈ H) |>.symm
  · intro hn h hh; exact (hn h).1 hh
Foundations.Numbers.R.IsTagged.append:
/-- Concatenating tagged partitions of `[a, b]` and `[b, c]` gives one of `[a, c]`. -/
theorem IsTagged.append {a b c : R} {l₁ l₂ : List (R × R)} (h₁ : IsTagged a l₁ b)

  | nil => have : a = b := h₁; subst this; exact h₂

Foundations.Algebra.galois_correspondenc:
/-- **Galois correspondence (the part formalised here).** For a Galois extension `L/K` with
Galois group enumerated as `σ₁, …, σₙ`:
* `[L : Fix(G)] = |G| = [L : K]` and `Fix(G) = K`;
* for every finite subgroup `H` (given as a family `ρ`), `[L : Fix(H)] = |H|` and
  `Aut(L/Fix(H)) = H`. -/
theorem galois_correspondence (hΩ : IsField Ω) {K L : Subfield Ω} (hKL : K.le L)
    (hG : IsGalois K L hKL) :
    (∀ x, x ∈ fixedField L (fun _ : FieldAut K L => True) → x ∈ K) ∧
    ∀ {m : Nat} (ρ : Fin m → FieldAut K L), (∀ i j, ρ i = ρ j → i = j) → (∃ i, ρ i = 1) →
      (∀ i j, ∃ k, ρ k = ρ i * ρ j) →
      deg (famFix ρ) L (famFix_le ρ) = m ∧ ∀ τ : FieldAut (famFix ρ) L, ∃ i, (ρ i).toFun = τ.toFun :=
  ⟨galois_fixedField hΩ hKL hG, fun ρ hd ho hm =>
    ⟨(artin ρ hΩ hd ho hm).2, aut_fixedField ρ hΩ hd ho hm⟩⟩

    (h₂ : h ≫ p₂ = k ≫ p₂) : h = k := by
  have hw : (k ≫ p₁) ≫ f = (k ≫ p₂) ≫ g := by rw [assoc, hP.w, assoc]

/-- If `g ^ i = g ^ j` with `i < j`, then `g ^ (j - i) = 1`. -/
theorem pow_sub_eq_one {g : G} {i j : Nat} (hij : i < j) (h : g ^ i = g ^ j) :
    g ^ (j - i) = 1 := by
  have : g ^ j = g ^ i * g ^ (j - i) := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  rw [this] at h
  exact (mul_left_cancel (a := g ^ i) (by rw [mul_one]; exact h)).symm

/-- **Σ₁-completeness for halting**: if `c` halts on `x`, `Q` proves it. -/
theorem Q_proves_halts {c : Code} {x : Nat} (h : Halts c [x]) :
    Q ⊢₁ (haltsSigma c).inst (numeral x) := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := EvalB.complete hy
  refine Q_proves_of_models fun M e hM => ?_
  rw [sat_inst, eval_numeral_M]
  simp only [haltsSigma, evalSigma, Sat, sat_subst]
  refine ⟨numM M y, numM M w, ?_⟩
  have : (fun k => (Env.cons (v 1) (Env.cons (v 2) fun _ => v 0) k).eval M
      (Env.cons (numM M w) (Env.cons (numM M y) (Env.cons (numM M x) e)))) =
        Env.cons (numM M y) (Env.cons (numM M x) fun _ => numM M w) := by
    funext k; match k with
      | 0 => rfl
      | 1 => rfl
      | k + 2 => rfl
  rw [this, env3_numM, D0.absolute hM (grb_D0 c 1)]
  exact (sat_grb1 c y x w).2 hw

/-- **Extensionality for functions.** Two functions on `X` with the same values are equal. -/
theorem function_ext (hF : IsFunction F X A) (hG : IsFunction G X B)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ X, app F x = app G x) : F = G := by
  apply ext
  intro z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, _, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.1 (hF.1 hz)
    rw [kpair_mem_iff hF] at hz
    rw [kpair_mem_iff hG, ← h x hx]
    exact hz
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, _, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.1 (hG.1 hz)
    rw [kpair_mem_iff hG] at hz
    rw [kpair_mem_iff hF, h x hx]
    exact hz

Foundations.Geometry.Klein.bet_of_perp:
/-- Three points whose differences are orthogonal to a non-zero vector are collinear:
one of them lies between the other two. -/
theorem bet_of_perp {a b c : Pt R} {nx ny : R} (hn : ¬ (nx = 0 ∧ ny = 0))
    (hab : (b.x - a.x) * nx + (b.y - a.y) * ny = 0)
    (hac : (c.x - a.x) * nx + (c.y - a.y) * ny = 0) :
    Pt.Bet a b c ∨ Pt.Bet b c a ∨ Pt.Bet c a b := by
  have hN : nx * nx + ny * ny ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hn (sum_sq_eq_zero h)
  let w : Pt R := ⟨-ny, nx⟩
  have hb' : b.x = a.x + ((b.x - a.x) * (-ny) + (b.y - a.y) * nx) / (nx * nx + ny * ny) * w.x ∧
      b.y = a.y + ((b.x - a.x) * (-ny) + (b.y - a.y) * nx) / (nx * nx + ny * ny) * w.y := by
    have e₁ := congrArg (· * nx) hab
    have e₂ := congrArg (· * ny) hab
    dsimp only [w] at *
    constructor <;> grind
  have hc' : c.x = a.x + ((c.x - a.x) * (-ny) + (c.y - a.y) * nx) / (nx * nx + ny * ny) * w.x ∧
      c.y = a.y + ((c.x - a.x) * (-ny) + (c.y - a.y) * nx) / (nx * nx + ny * ny) * w.y := by
    have e₁ := congrArg (· * nx) hac
    have e₂ := congrArg (· * ny) hac
    dsimp only [w] at *
    constructor <;> grind
  have ha' : a.x = a.x + 0 * w.x ∧ a.y = a.y + 0 * w.y := ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
  generalize ((b.x - a.x) * (-ny) + (b.y - a.y) * nx) / (nx * nx + ny * ny) = β at hb'
  generalize ((c.x - a.x) * (-ny) + (c.y - a.y) * nx) / (nx * nx + ny * ny) = γ at hc'
  rcases Std.le_total (a := (0 : R)) (b := β) with h₁ | h₁ <;>
    rcases Std.le_total (a := β) (b := γ) with h₂ | h₂ <;>
    rcases Std.le_total (a := (0 : R)) (b := γ) with h₃ | h₃
  all_goals first
    | exact Or.inl (Pt.bet_of_line ha' hb' hc' (by grind))
    | exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Pt.bet_of_line hb' hc' ha' (by grind)))
    | exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Pt.bet_of_line hc' ha' hb' (by grind)))

Foundations.Sets.Zorn.closure_succ_total:
/-- In the tower, if `c₁ ⊆ c₂` then either `c₂ = c₁` or `succChain c₁ ⊆ c₂`. -/
theorem closure_succ_total {c₁ c₂ : α → Prop} (hc₁ : ChainClosure r c₁)
    (hc₂ : ChainClosure r c₂) (h : Sub c₁ c₂) : c₂ = c₁ ∨ Sub (succChain r c₁) c₂ := by
  induction hc₂ generalizing c₁ with
  | @succ c₂ _ ih =>
    rcases closure_succ_total_aux hc₁ (fun c₃ hc₃ hsub => ih hc₃ hsub) with h' | h'
    · exact Or.inl (Sub.antisymm h' h)
    · rcases ih hc₁ h' with h'' | h''
      · subst h''; exact Or.inr fun _ hx => hx
      · exact Or.inr (h''.trans (sub_succChain c₂))
  | @union S hS ih =>
    by_cases hsucc : Sub (succChain r c₁) (sUnionP S)
    · exact Or.inr hsucc
    · refine Or.inl (Sub.antisymm (fun x ⟨c, hc, hx⟩ => ?_) h)
      rcases closure_succ_total_aux hc₁ (fun c₃ hc₃ hsub => ih c hc hc₃ hsub) with h' | h'
      · exact h' x (sub_succChain c x hx)
      · rcases ih c hc hc₁ h' with h'' | h''
        · subst h''; exact hx
        · exact absurd (fun y hy => ⟨c, hc, h'' y hy⟩) hsucc

Foundations.Algebra.Subfield:
/-- **Subfield** of `Ω`: a subset containing `0` and `1`, closed under addition, negation,
multiplication, and inverses of non-zero elements. -/
structure Subfield (Ω : Type u) [CommRing Ω] where
  /-- The elements of the subfield. -/
  carrier : Ω → Prop
  /-- Contains `0`. -/
  zero_mem : carrier 0
  /-- Contains `1`. -/
  one_mem : carrier 1
  /-- Closed under addition. -/
  add_mem : ∀ {a b}, carrier a → carrier b → carrier (a + b)
  /-- Closed under negation. -/
  neg_mem : ∀ {a}, carrier a → carrier (-a)
  /-- Closed under multiplication. -/
  mul_mem : ∀ {a b}, carrier a → carrier b → carrier (a * b)
  /-- Contains inverses of its non-zero elements. -/
  inv_mem : ∀ {a}, carrier a → a ≠ 0 → ∃ b, carrier b ∧ a * b = 1

/-- **Non-strict order is inclusion**: `vn m ⊆ vn n ↔ m ≤ n`. -/

Foundations.Numbers.C.exp_I_mul:
/-- **Euler's formula.** `exp (iθ) = cos θ + i sin θ`. -/
theorem exp_I_mul (θ : R) : exp (I * ofReal θ) = ofReal (cos θ) + I * ofReal (sin θ) := by
  have e1 : I * ofReal θ = ⟨0, θ⟩ := by
    apply ext
    · show 0 * θ - 1 * 0 = 0; grind
    · show 0 * 0 + 1 * θ = θ; grind
  have e2 : ofReal (cos θ) + I * ofReal (sin θ) = ⟨cos θ, sin θ⟩ := by
    apply ext
    · show cos θ + (0 * sin θ - 1 * 0) = cos θ; grind
    · show 0 + (0 * 0 + 1 * sin θ) = sin θ; grind
  rw [e1, e2]
  have hterm : ∀ k, (cterm ⟨0, θ⟩ k).re = pterm cosCoeff θ k ∧
      (cterm ⟨0, θ⟩ k).im = pterm sinCoeff θ k := fun k => by
    unfold cterm pterm expTerm
    rw [div_natCast_re _ (fact_pos k), div_natCast_im _ (fact_pos k), pow_I_mul]
    have := fact_pos' k
    constructor <;> (show _ * θ ^ k / _ = _ * (θ ^ k / _); grind)
  refine (tendsto_exp _).unique ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (hasSum_pser (fun n => (abs_coeff_le n).1) θ : Tendsto _ _).congr_eventually 0
      fun N _ => ?_
    show fsum (pterm cosCoeff θ) N = (gsum (cterm ⟨0, θ⟩) N).re
    rw [gsum_re]; exact fsum_congr fun k _ => (hterm k).1.symm
  · refine (hasSum_pser (fun n => (abs_coeff_le n).2) θ : Tendsto _ _).congr_eventually 0
      fun N _ => ?_
    show fsum (pterm sinCoeff θ) N = (gsum (cterm ⟨0, θ⟩) N).im
    rw [gsum_im]; exact fsum_congr fun k _ => (hterm k).2.symm
Foundations.Combinatorics.ramsey_step:
/-- **The Erdős–Szekeres recursion** `R(s+1, t+1) ≤ R(s, t+1) + R(s+1, t)`. -/
theorem ramsey_step {s t N₁ N₂ : Nat} (h₁ : IsRamsey s (t + 1) N₁) (h₂ : IsRamsey (s + 1) t N₂)
    (hpos : 1 ≤ N₁ + N₂) : IsRamsey (s + 1) (t + 1) (N₁ + N₂) := by
  intro c hc V hV hl
  obtain ⟨v, W, rfl⟩ : ∃ v W, V = v :: W := by
    cases V with
    | nil => simp at hl; omega
    | cons v W => exact ⟨v, W, rfl⟩
  rw [List.nodup_cons] at hV
  obtain ⟨hvW, hW⟩ := hV
  let Red := W.filter fun w => c v w
  let Blue := W.filter fun w => !c v w
  have hsplit : Red.length + Blue.length = W.length := length_filter_add_not _ W
  have hl' : N₁ + N₂ ≤ W.length + 1 := by simpa using hl
  have hRedV : Red ⊆ v :: W := fun x hx => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ((List.mem_filter.1 hx).1)
  have hBlueV : Blue ⊆ v :: W := fun x hx => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ((List.mem_filter.1 hx).1)
  by_cases hR : N₁ ≤ Red.length
  · rcases h₁ c hc Red (nodup_filter _ hW) hR with ⟨S, hSR, hSn, hSl, hScl⟩ | ⟨S, hSR, hSn, hSl, hScl⟩
    · refine Or.inl ⟨v :: S, ?_, ?_, by simp [hSl], clique_cons hc hScl fun y hy => ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
        rcases hx with rfl | hx
        · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
        · exact hRedV (hSR hx)
      · exact List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨fun hv => hvW ((List.mem_filter.1 (hSR hv)).1), hSn⟩
      · have := hSR hy
        simp only [Red, List.mem_filter] at this
        exact this.2
    · exact Or.inr ⟨S, fun x hx => hRedV (hSR hx), hSn, hSl, hScl⟩
  · have hB : N₂ ≤ Blue.length := by omega
    rcases h₂ c hc Blue (nodup_filter _ hW) hB with ⟨S, hSB, hSn, hSl, hScl⟩ | ⟨S, hSB, hSn, hSl, hScl⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨S, fun x hx => hBlueV (hSB hx), hSn, hSl, hScl⟩
    · refine Or.inr ⟨v :: S, ?_, ?_, by simp [hSl], clique_cons hc hScl fun y hy => ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
        rcases hx with rfl | hx
        · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
        · exact hBlueV (hSB hx)
      · exact List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨fun hv => hvW ((List.mem_filter.1 (hSB hv)).1), hSn⟩
      · have := hSB hy
        simp only [Blue, List.mem_filter, Bool.not_eq_true'] at this
        exact this.2

Foundations.Algebra.Perm.conjHom:
/-- A bijection `e : α → β` (with inverse `e'`) transports permutations of `α` to
permutations of `β`: `σ ↦ e ∘ σ ∘ e'`. This is a homomorphism of permutation groups. -/
def Perm.conjHom {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (e : α → β) (e' : β → α)
    (h1 : ∀ x, e' (e x) = x) (h2 : ∀ y, e (e' y) = y) : Perm α →* Perm β where
  toFun σ := ⟨fun y => e (σ (e' y)), fun y => e (σ.invFun (e' y)),
    fun y => by
      show e (σ.invFun (e' (e (σ.toFun (e' y))))) = y
      rw [h1, σ.left_inv, h2],
    fun y => by
      show e (σ.toFun (e' (e (σ.invFun (e' y))))) = y
      rw [h1, σ.right_inv, h2]⟩
  map_mul σ τ := Perm.ext fun y => by
    show e (σ (τ (e' y))) = e (σ (e' (e (τ (e' y)))))
    rw [h1]
