Foundations.Logic.FO.proves_of_derivable:
/-- **Soundness of the rule system.** Every derivable judgement is the code of a
correct derivability statement `Ctx k Δ ⊢₁ φ`. -/
theorem proves_of_derivable {x : Nat} (h : Derivable paRule x) :
    ∃ k Δ φ, x = pj k (ccode Δ) (fcode φ) ∧ Ctx k Δ ⊢₁ φ := by
  induction h with
  | intro x w l hl hstep ih =>
    -- decode the conclusion
    obtain ⟨k, D, F, rfl⟩ : ∃ k D F, x = pj k D F :=
      ⟨fst x, fst (snd x), snd (snd x), by simp [pj, pair_fst_snd]⟩
    simp only [paRule, paStep, Bool.and_eq_true] at hstep
    obtain ⟨hwf, hrule⟩ := hstep
    simp only [wfC, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, ballLt_iff, qF, qD, pj, fst_pair, snd_pair] at hwf
    obtain ⟨Φ, rfl⟩ := (isFormulaC_iff F).1 hwf.1
    obtain ⟨Δ, rfl⟩ := exists_ccode D fun i hi => by simpa using hwf.2 i hi
    refine ⟨k, Δ, Φ, rfl, ?_⟩
    -- premises
    have prem : ∀ i, i < llen (encList l) → ∀ K D F, lnth (encList l) i = pj K D F →
        ∃ Δ' φ', D = ccode Δ' ∧ F = fcode φ' ∧ Ctx K Δ' ⊢₁ φ' := by
      intro i hi K D F he
      rw [llen_encList] at hi
      obtain ⟨k', Δ', φ', e, hd⟩ := ih _ (List.getElem_mem hi)
      rw [lnth_encList, getD_eq_getElem' _ _ hi, e] at he
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := pj_inj he
      exact ⟨Δ', φ', rfl, rfl, hd⟩
    rw [ruleC_iff] at hrule
    simp only [rC0, rC1, rC2, rC3, rC4, rC5, rC6, rC7, rC8, rC9, rC10, rC11, rC12, rC13, rC14,
      rC15, rC16, rC17, qtag, qdat, qjs, qprem, qk, qD, qF, pj, fst_pair, snd_pair,
      Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, decide_eq_true_eq] at hrule
    rcases hrule with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h
    · -- assumption
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hi⟩, he⟩ := h
      rw [llen_ccode] at hi
      rw [lnth_ccode _ _ hi] at he
      exact Proves.hyp (Or.inr (fcode_inj he ▸ List.getElem_mem hi))
    · -- axiom
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, h₁⟩, h₂⟩, h₃⟩, h₄⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := (isFormulaC_iff _).1 h₁
      obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := (isFormulaC_iff _).1 h₂
      rw [← hψ, shiftNC_fcode] at h₃
      rw [← hψ, ← hχ, isPAC_iff] at h₄
      exact Proves.hyp (Or.inl ⟨ψ, (PA_iff ψ).2 (h₄.imp id fun e => ⟨χ, e⟩), (fcode_inj h₃).symm⟩)
    · -- →I
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_imp ht
      simp only [fcode, fst_pair, snd_pair, lcons_ccode] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ', φ', e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd
      exact Proves.impI (hd.weaken (ctx_cons_sub k A Δ))
    · -- →E
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp₀⟩, hp₁⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨Δ₁, A, e₁, e₂, hd₁⟩ := prem 1 hl _ _ _ hp₁
      rw [e₂] at hp₀
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₃, e₄, hd₀⟩ := prem 0 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₀
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁] at hd₁
      rw [← fcode_imp] at e₄
      rw [← ccode_inj e₃, ← fcode_inj e₄] at hd₀
      exact Proves.impE hd₀ hd₁
    · -- ∧I
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hp₀⟩, hp₁⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_conj ht
      simp only [fcode, fst_pair, snd_pair] at hp₀ hp₁
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, A', e₁, e₂, hd₀⟩ := prem 0 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₀
      obtain ⟨Δ₁, B', e₃, e₄, hd₁⟩ := prem 1 hl _ _ _ hp₁
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd₀
      rw [← ccode_inj e₃, ← fcode_inj e₄] at hd₁
      exact Proves.conjI hd₀ hd₁
    · -- ∧E₁
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_conj (by rw [← e₂]; simp : fst (fcode C) = 3)
      simp only [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at e₂
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂.2.1] at hd
      exact Proves.conjE₁ hd
    · -- ∧E₂
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_conj (by rw [← e₂]; simp : fst (fcode C) = 3)
      simp only [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at e₂
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂.2.2] at hd
      exact Proves.conjE₂ hd
    · -- ∨I₁
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_disj ht
      simp only [fcode, fst_pair, snd_pair] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, A', e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd
      exact Proves.disjI₁ hd
    · -- ∨I₂
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_disj ht
      simp only [fcode, fst_pair, snd_pair] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, B', e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd
      exact Proves.disjI₂ hd
    · -- ∨E
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp₀⟩, hp₁⟩, hp₂⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd₀⟩ := prem 0 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₀
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_disj (by rw [← e₂]; simp : fst (fcode C) = 4)
      simp only [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at e₂
      obtain ⟨-, e₂⟩ := e₂
      rw [e₂] at hp₁ hp₂
      simp only [fst_pair, snd_pair, lcons_ccode] at hp₁ hp₂
      obtain ⟨Δ₁, φ₁, e₃, e₄, hd₁⟩ := prem 1 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₁
      obtain ⟨Δ₂, φ₂, e₅, e₆, hd₂⟩ := prem 2 hl _ _ _ hp₂
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁] at hd₀
      rw [← ccode_inj e₃, ← fcode_inj e₄] at hd₁
      rw [← ccode_inj e₅, ← fcode_inj e₆] at hd₂
      exact Proves.disjE hd₀ (hd₁.weaken (ctx_cons_sub k A Δ)) (hd₂.weaken (ctx_cons_sub k B Δ))
    · -- ⊥E
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj (e₂.symm.trans fcode_bot.symm).symm] at hd
      exact Proves.botE hd
    · -- RAA
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp⟩ := h
      rw [← fcode_neg, lcons_ccode] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj (e₂.symm.trans fcode_bot.symm).symm] at hd
      exact Proves.raa (hd.weaken (ctx_cons_sub k _ Δ))
    · -- ∀I
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hs⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_all ht
      have hs := (shiftedC_iff (Δ := Δ) (by simp only [qD, fst_pair, snd_pair])).1 hs
      rw [hs] at hp
      simp only [fcode, snd_pair] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, A', e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd
      exact Proves.allI (hd.weaken (ctx_shift_sub k Δ))
    · -- ∀E
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hp⟩, hi⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := tcode_of_isTermC ht
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_all (by rw [← e₂]; simp : fst (fcode C) = 5)
      simp only [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at e₂
      rw [e₂.2, ← hT, instC_fcode] at hi
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁] at hd
      rw [← fcode_inj hi]
      exact Proves.allE T hd
    · -- ∃I
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hT⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_ex ht
      obtain ⟨T, hT'⟩ := tcode_of_isTermC hT
      rw [← hT'] at hp
      simp only [fcode, snd_pair, instC_fcode] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd
      exact Proves.exI T hd
    · -- ∃E
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hs⟩, hp₀⟩, hp₁⟩ := h
      have hs := (shiftedC_iff (Δ := Δ) (by simp only [qD, fst_pair, snd_pair])).1 hs
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd₀⟩ := prem 0 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₀
      obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_ex (by rw [← e₂]; simp : fst (fcode C) = 6)
      simp only [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at e₂
      rw [e₂.2, hs, lcons_ccode, shiftC_fcode] at hp₁
      obtain ⟨Δ₁, φ₁, e₃, e₄, hd₁⟩ := prem 1 hl _ _ _ hp₁
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁] at hd₀
      rw [← ccode_inj e₃, ← fcode_inj e₄] at hd₁
      refine Proves.exE hd₀ (hd₁.weaken ?_)
      exact Subset.trans (ctx_cons_sub (k + 1) A _)
        (insert_mono (ctx_shift_sub k Δ) A)
    · -- reflexivity
      obtain ⟨⟨-, ht⟩, he⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨t, s, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_eq ht
      simp only [fcode, fst_pair, snd_pair] at he
      rw [tcode_inj he]
      exact Proves.refl s
    · -- Leibniz's law
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hA⟩, hS⟩, hT⟩, hp₀⟩, hp₁⟩, hi⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, hA'⟩ := (isFormulaC_iff _).1 hA
      obtain ⟨S, hS'⟩ := tcode_of_isTermC hS
      obtain ⟨T, hT'⟩ := tcode_of_isTermC hT
      rw [← pair_fst_snd (snd (snd w)), ← hS', ← hT', ← fcode_eq] at hp₀
      rw [← hA', ← hS', instC_fcode] at hp₁
      rw [← hA', ← hT', instC_fcode] at hi
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C₀, e₁, e₂, hd₀⟩ := prem 0 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₀
      obtain ⟨Δ₁, C₁, e₃, e₄, hd₁⟩ := prem 1 hl _ _ _ hp₁
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd₀
      rw [← ccode_inj e₃, ← fcode_inj e₄] at hd₁
      rw [← fcode_inj hi]
      exact Proves.subst hd₀ hd₁

/-- **ℤ embeds in ℚ.** `zToQ` is injective and preserves `0`, `1`, `+`, `×` and `≤`. -/
theorem zToQ_embedding :
    zToQ 0 = 0 ∧ zToQ 1 = 1 ∧ (∀ x y, zToQ (x + y) = zToQ x + zToQ y) ∧
    (∀ x y, zToQ (x * y) = zToQ x * zToQ y) ∧ (∀ x y, x ≤ y ↔ zToQ x ≤ zToQ y) ∧
    (∀ x y, zToQ x = zToQ y → x = y) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, fun x y => ?_, fun x y => ?_, fun x y => ?_, fun x y h => ?_⟩
  · simp only [zToQ, Q.mk_add, Q.mk_eq_mk, Z.toInt_add]; omega
  · simp only [zToQ, Q.mk_mul, Q.mk_eq_mk, Z.toInt_mul]; omega

Foundations.Logic.FO.mle_succ_numM_iff:
/-- Below a numeral, strictly: `S x ≤ n̄` iff `x = ī` with `i < n`. -/
theorem mle_succ_numM_iff (x : M.Dom) (n : Nat) :
    mle M (ms M x) (numM M n) ↔ ∃ i, i < n ∧ x = numM M i := by
  rw [mle_numM_iff hM]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, h⟩
    cases i with
    | zero => exact absurd h (hM.succ_ne_zero _)
    | succ i => exact ⟨i, by omega, hM.succ_inj _ _ h⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩; exact ⟨i + 1, by omega, rfl⟩

  carrier := C.space.carrier
  zero_mem := C.space.zero_mem

  add_mem := C.space.add_mem

  mul_mem := C.space_mul

Foundations.Combinatorics.nodup_map_of_i:
/-- Mapping an injective function preserves the absence of duplicates. -/
theorem nodup_map_of_inj {f : Nat → Nat} (hf : ∀ a b, f a = f b → a = b) :
    ∀ {l : List Nat}, l.Nodup → (l.map f).Nodup
  | [], _ => List.nodup_nil
  | a :: l, h => by
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at h
      rw [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons]
      refine ⟨fun hm => ?_, nodup_map_of_inj hf h.2⟩
      obtain ⟨b, hb, he⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hm
      exact h.1 (hf _ _ he ▸ hb)

/-- The partition points increase: a tagged partition of `[a, b]` has `a ≤ b`. -/
theorem IsTagged.le {a b : R} {l : List (R × R)} (h : IsTagged a l b) : a ≤ b := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => have : a = b := h; grind
  | cons p l ih => obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p; obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h; have := ih h3; grind
Foundations.Sets.WellOrdering.unionPWO:
/-- The union of a chain of partial well-orderings is a partial well-ordering. -/
noncomputable def unionPWO : PWO α where
  dom := unionDom C
  lt := unionLt C
  lt_dom := fun _ _ ⟨W, hW, h⟩ =>
    ⟨⟨W, hW, (W.lt_dom _ _ h).1⟩, ⟨W, hW, (W.lt_dom _ _ h).2⟩⟩
  irrefl := fun x ⟨W, _, h⟩ => W.irrefl x h
  trans := fun x y z ⟨W, hW, hxy⟩ ⟨V, hV, hyz⟩ => by
    have hy : V.dom y := (V.lt_dom y z hyz).1
    have hxy' : V.lt x y := (unionLt_iff C hC hV hy).1 ⟨W, hW, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨V, hV, V.trans x y z hxy' hyz⟩
  total := fun x y ⟨W, hW, hx⟩ ⟨V, hV, hy⟩ => by
    rcases hC W V hW hV with h | h
    · rcases V.total x y (h.1 x hx) hy with h' | h' | h'
      · exact Or.inl ⟨V, hV, h'⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h')
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨V, hV, h'⟩)
    · rcases W.total x y hx (h.1 y hy) with h' | h' | h'
      · exact Or.inl ⟨W, hW, h'⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h')
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨W, hW, h'⟩)
  wf := fun S ⟨x, hSx, W, hW, hx⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨m, hSm, hm, hmin⟩ := W.wf S ⟨x, hSx, hx⟩
    refine ⟨m, hSm, ⟨W, hW, hm⟩, fun y hSy _ hym => ?_⟩
    have hym' : W.lt y m := (unionLt_iff C hC hW hm).1 hym
    exact hmin y hSy (W.lt_dom y m hym').1 hym'

Foundations.Algebra.zagier_mem:
/-- Zagier's map preserves the set `S`. -/
theorem zagier_mem {t : Nat × Nat × Nat} (h : InS p t) : InS p (zagier t) := by
  obtain ⟨x, y, z⟩ := t
  unfold InS at h ⊢
  simp only at h
  unfold zagier
  simp only
  by_cases h1 : x + z < y
  · rw [ite_true_of h1]
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w, y = x + z + w := ⟨y - x - z, by omega⟩
    simp only
    rw [show x + z + w - x - z = w by omega]
    grind
  · rw [ite_false_of h1]
    by_cases h2 : x < 2 * y
    · rw [ite_true_of h2]
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, x + b = 2 * y := ⟨2 * y - x, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c, y + c = x + z := ⟨x + z - y, by omega⟩
      simp only
      rw [show 2 * y - x = b by omega, show x + z - y = c by omega]
      grind
    · rw [ite_false_of h2]
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, x = 2 * y + b := ⟨x - 2 * y, by omega⟩
      simp only
      rw [show x - 2 * y = b by omega, show x + z - y = y + b + z by omega]
      subst hb
      grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.sat_gr:
/-- **Definability of partial recursive functions.** The graph formula `gr c a` is
true in `ℕ` under an environment `e` exactly when `c`, run on the inputs
`e 1, …, e a`, outputs `e 0`. -/
theorem sat_gr : ∀ (c : Code) (a : Nat) (e : Nat → Nat),
    Sat stdModel e (gr c a) ↔ Eval c (List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => e (i + 1)) (e 0)
  | .zero, a, e => by
      simp only [gr, Sat, eval_zero, Term.eval]
      exact ⟨fun h => by rw [h]; exact .zero, fun h => Eval.det h .zero⟩
  | .succ, a, e => by
      simp only [gr, Sat, eval_succ, Term.eval]
      have : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => e (i + 1)).headD 0 =
          (if a = 0 then zero else v 1).eval stdModel e := by
        cases a with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ a => simp [List.ofFn_succ]; rfl
      rw [← this]
      exact ⟨fun h => by rw [h]; exact .succ, fun h => Eval.det h .succ⟩
  | .proj i, a, e => by
      simp only [gr, Sat, Term.eval]
      have : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => e (i + 1)).getD i 0 =
          (if i < a then v (i + 1) else zero).eval stdModel e := by
        by_cases h : i < a
        · simp [h, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]; rfl
        · simp [h, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
      rw [← this]
      exact ⟨fun h => by rw [h]; exact .proj, fun h => Eval.det h .proj⟩
  | @Code.comp k f gs, a, e => by
      simp only [gr, sat_exN, Sat, sat_conjL, List.mem_ofFn, forall_exists_index,
        forall_apply_eq_imp_iff, sat_subst_cons, sat_gr, Term.eval, Env.cons]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e', he', hg, hf⟩
        have h0 : e' k = e 0 := by simpa using he' 0
        have hxs : (List.ofFn fun j : Fin a => e' (j + 1 + k)) = List.ofFn fun j : Fin a => e (j + 1) :=
          by congr 1; funext j; exact he' _
        refine .comp (fun i => e' i) (fun i => ?_) ?_
        · have := hg i; rwa [hxs] at this
        · rwa [h0] at hf
      · intro h
        cases h with
        | comp vs hg hf =>
            refine ⟨fun n => if hn : n < k then vs ⟨n, hn⟩ else e (n - k), fun n => ?_, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
            · have : ¬ (n + k < k) := by omega
              simp [this]
            · simp only [Fin.is_lt, dite_true, show ∀ j : Nat, ¬ (j + 1 + k < k) from fun j => by omega,
                dite_false, show ∀ j : Nat, j + 1 + k - k = j + 1 from fun j => by omega]
              exact hg i
            · simp only [Fin.is_lt, dite_true, Nat.lt_irrefl, dite_false, Nat.sub_self]
              exact hf
  | .prec f g, 0, e => by
      simp only [gr, Sat, List.ofFn_zero, false_iff]
      intro h; cases h
  | .prec f g, a + 1, e => by
      rw [List.ofFn_succ, eval_prec_iff_beta]
      simp only [gr, Sat, sat_substL, sat_betaF, sat_ltF, sat_subst_cons, sat_gr, Term.eval,
        Env.cons, List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ, eval_zero, eval_succ]
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, List.ofFn_succ]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨A, B, ⟨⟨r₀, hr₀, hf⟩, hs⟩, hy⟩
        refine ⟨A, B, by rw [← hr₀]; exact hf, fun j hj => ?_, hy⟩
        obtain ⟨u, w, ⟨hu, hw⟩, hg⟩ := hs j hj
        rw [← hu, ← hw]; exact hg
      · rintro ⟨A, B, hf, hs, hy⟩
        exact ⟨A, B, ⟨⟨_, rfl, hf⟩, fun j hj => ⟨_, _, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, hs j hj⟩⟩, hy⟩
  | .mu f, a, e => by
      rw [eval_mu_iff]
      simp only [gr, Sat, sat_ltF_substL, sat_subst_cons, sat_gr, Term.eval, Env.cons, eval_zero,
        List.ofFn_succ, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ]
      rfl

/-- **Left injections of reducible terms are reducible.** -/

  refine ⟨SN.map_of_inv inl inl_inv ((cr A).1 _ ha), fun a' h => ?_, fun b h => ?_⟩

Foundations.Algebra.finite_field_card:
/-- **Finite fields have prime-power order.** Every finite field has `pⁿ` elements, where the
prime `p` is its characteristic and `n` is its dimension over the prime field. -/
theorem finite_field_card : ∃ p n, IsPrime p ∧ card F = p ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmin⟩ := exists_char (F := F)
  have hpr := char_prime hF hp hmin
  let P := primeSubfield hF hp
  let T := topSubfield hF
  have hPT : P.le T := fun _ _ => trivial
  let V := T.over P hPT
  have hFP := P.isField hF
  -- `F` is finite-dimensional over `P`: the family of all elements spans.
  have hspan : Spans P (fun y : F => (⟨y, trivial⟩ : V)) := by
    intro x
    classical
    refine ⟨fun i => if i = x.1 then 1 else 0, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [coe_isum]
    rw [isum_single _ x.1 (fun i hi => by
      show (if i = x.1 then (1 : P) else 0).1 * i = 0
      rw [ite_false_of hi]; exact Ring.zero_mul i)]
    show x.1 = (if x.1 = x.1 then (1 : P) else 0).1 * x.1
    rw [ite_true_of rfl]; exact (Ring.one_mul x.1).symm
  have hfin : FinDim P V := finDim_of_spans hspan
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_basis hFP hfin
  -- Coordinates with respect to the basis identify `F` with `Pⁿ`.
  let Φ : (Fin (dim P V) → P) → V := fun c => isum (fun i => c i • b i)
  have hinj : ∀ c d, Φ c = Φ d → c = d := by
    intro c d h
    have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simp only [Φ, coe_isum] at h'
    have hz := hb.1 (fun i => c i + -d i) (by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_isum]
      show isum (fun i => (c i + -d i).1 * (b i).1) = 0
      have e : (fun i => (c i + -d i).1 * (b i).1) =
          fun i => (c i • b i).1 + -(d i • b i).1 := by
        funext i; show ((c i).1 + -(d i).1) * (b i).1 = (c i).1 * (b i).1 + -((d i).1 * (b i).1)
        grind
      rw [e, isum_add, isum_neg, h']
      exact Ring.add_neg_cancel _)
    funext i
    apply Subtype.ext
    have := congrArg Subtype.val (hz i)
    show (c i).1 = (d i).1
    have e : (c i).1 + -(d i).1 = 0 := this
    grind
  have hsurj : ∀ v, ∃ c, Φ c = v := fun v => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hb.2 v; exact ⟨c, hc.symm⟩
  have h1 := count_comp_bij Φ hinj hsurj (fun _ => True)
  rw [count_true, count_true, card_tuple, card_primeSubfield hF hp hmin] at h1
  have h2 := count_comp_bij (fun v : V => v.1) (fun a b h => Subtype.ext h)
    (fun y => ⟨⟨y, trivial⟩, rfl⟩) (fun _ => True)
  rw [count_true, count_true] at h2
  exact ⟨p, dim P V, hpr, by rw [← h2, ← h1]⟩
Foundations.Topology.Cantor.val_injectiv:
/-- **Distinct digit sequences give distinct points.** -/
theorem val_injective : ∀ k (b b' : Nat → Bool), b k ≠ b' k → val b ≠ val b' := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro b b' hne; exact val_ne_of_head hne
  | succ k ih =>
    intro b b' hne he
    by_cases h0 : b 0 = b' 0
    · apply ih (fun j => b (j + 1)) (fun j => b' (j + 1)) hne
      have h := three_val b; have h' := three_val b'
      rw [h0] at h; grind
    · exact val_ne_of_head h0 he

Foundations.Numbers.C.nrm_pow_le:
/-- Powers and `‖·‖`: `‖zⁿ‖ ≤ ‖z‖ⁿ`. -/
theorem nrm_pow_le (z : C) (n : Nat) : nrm (z ^ n) ≤ nrm z ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    show nrm 1 ≤ 1; unfold nrm; rw [one_re, one_im, R.abs_zero, abs_of_nonneg (by grind)]; grind
  | succ n ih =>
    show nrm (z ^ n * z) ≤ nrm z ^ n * nrm z
    have := nrm_mul (z ^ n) z
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih (nrm_nonneg z)
    grind
Foundations.Numbers.OrderedFieldIso:
/-- An isomorphism of ordered fields: a bijection preserving addition, multiplication and
order. -/
structure OrderedFieldIso (F G : Type) [Add F] [Mul F] [LE F] [Add G] [Mul G] [LE G] where
  /-- The forward map. -/
  toFun : F → G
  /-- The inverse map. -/
  invFun : G → F
  /-- `invFun` undoes `toFun`. -/
  left_inv : ∀ x, invFun (toFun x) = x
  /-- `toFun` undoes `invFun`. -/
  right_inv : ∀ y, toFun (invFun y) = y
  /-- Addition is preserved. -/
  map_add : ∀ x y, toFun (x + y) = toFun x + toFun y
  /-- Multiplication is preserved. -/
  map_mul : ∀ x y, toFun (x * y) = toFun x * toFun y
  /-- Order is preserved and reflected. -/
  map_le : ∀ x y, x ≤ y ↔ toFun x ≤ toFun y
Foundations.Logic.mem_allUpTo_succ:
/-- Membership in the next enumeration list, unfolded one level. -/
theorem mem_allUpTo_succ {φ : Formula} {n : Nat} : φ ∈ allUpTo (n + 1) ↔
    φ = bot ∨ (∃ k, k < n + 1 ∧ var k = φ) ∨
      ∃ a ∈ allUpTo n, ∃ b ∈ allUpTo n, φ ∈ [imp a b, conj a b, disj a b] := by
  rw [allUpTo]
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append, List.mem_map, List.mem_range, List.mem_flatMap]
Foundations.Algebra.swap_mul_swap_c3:
/-- **Two transpositions make at most two 3-cycles.** -/
theorem swap_mul_swap_c3 {n : Nat} {a b c d : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hcd : c ≠ d) :
    ∃ L : List (Perm (Fin n)), (∀ t, t ∈ L → IsC3 t) ∧ gprod L = swap a b * swap c d := by
  by_cases hbc : b = c
  · subst hbc
    by_cases had : a = d
    · subst had; exact ⟨[], by simp, by rw [swap_comm b a, swap_mul_self]; rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨[c3 a b d], by simpa using ⟨a, b, d, hab, hcd, had, rfl⟩, Group.mul_one _⟩
  · by_cases hac : a = c
    · subst hac
      by_cases hbd : b = d
      · subst hbd; exact ⟨[], by simp, by rw [swap_mul_self]; rfl⟩
      · refine ⟨[c3 b a d], by simpa using ⟨b, a, d, Ne.symm hab, hcd, hbd, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        show c3 b a d * 1 = _; rw [Group.mul_one, swap_comm a b]; rfl
    · by_cases hbd : b = d
      · subst hbd
        refine ⟨[c3 a b c], by simpa using ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, hac, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        show c3 a b c * 1 = _; rw [Group.mul_one, swap_comm c b]; rfl
      · by_cases had : a = d
        · subst had
          refine ⟨[c3 b a c], by simpa using ⟨b, a, c, Ne.symm hab, Ne.symm hcd, hbc, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
          show c3 b a c * 1 = _; rw [Group.mul_one, swap_comm a b, swap_comm c a]; rfl
        · refine ⟨[c3 a b c, c3 b c d], ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro t ht
            simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at ht
            rcases ht with rfl | rfl
            · exact ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, hac, rfl⟩
            · exact ⟨b, c, d, hbc, hcd, hbd, rfl⟩
          · show c3 a b c * (c3 b c d * 1) = _
            unfold c3
            rw [Group.mul_one, Group.mul_assoc, ← Group.mul_assoc (swap b c), swap_mul_self,
              Group.one_mul]
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.total_pr:
/-- **The law of total probability** for a finite partition:
`P(A) = ∑ᵢ P(A ∩ Bᵢ)`, and `= ∑ᵢ P(A | Bᵢ) P(Bᵢ)` when every `Bᵢ` is possible. -/
theorem total_probability_partition {B : Nat → Event α} {n : Nat} (hB : P.IsPartition B n)

Foundations.Algebra.zagier_fixed_iff:
/-- **Zagier's involution has exactly one fixed point**, namely `(1, 1, (p - 1)/4)`. -/
theorem zagier_fixed_iff (hp : IsPrime p) (h4 : p % 4 = 1) {t : Nat × Nat × Nat}
    (h : InS p t) : zagier t = t ↔ t = (1, 1, p / 4) := by
  obtain ⟨x, y, z⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz, hb1, hb2⟩ := h.facts hp h4
  have hS := h
  unfold InS at hS
  simp only at hS
  constructor
  · intro hfix
    by_cases h1 : x + z < y
    · rw [zagier_eq1 x y z h1] at hfix; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and] at hfix; omega
    · by_cases h2 : x < 2 * y
      · rw [zagier_eq2 x y z h1 h2] at hfix
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hfix
        have hxy : y = x := by omega
        subst hxy
        -- Now `p = y (y + 4z)`, so `y ∣ p`.
        have hdvd : y ∣ p := ⟨y + 4 * z, by grind⟩
        rcases hp.2 y hdvd with h1' | h1'
        · subst h1'
          simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
          omega
        · exfalso
          have : y * y + 4 * y * z ≥ y * 1 + y * 4 := by
            have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left y (show 1 ≤ y by omega)
            have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left y (show 4 ≤ 4 * z by omega)
            grind
          omega
      · rw [zagier_eq3 x y z h1 h2] at hfix; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and] at hfix; omega
  · intro ht
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at ht
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := ht
    have hp5 : 5 ≤ p := by have := hp.1; omega
    rw [zagier_eq2 1 1 (p / 4) (by omega) (by omega)]
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and]; omega

/-- A common bound for finitely many monotone properties indexed by `j < m`. -/
theorem exists_bound_range (P : Nat → Nat → Prop) (hP : ∀ j x x', x ≤ x' → P j x → P j x') :
    ∀ m, (∀ j, j < m → ∃ x, P j x) → ∃ x, ∀ j, j < m → P j x
  | 0, _ => ⟨0, fun _ h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
  | m + 1, h => by
      obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ := exists_bound_range P hP m fun j hj => h j (by omega)
      obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := h m (by omega)
      refine ⟨max x₁ x₂, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hj with hj | rfl
      · exact hP j _ _ (Nat.le_max_left _ _) (hx₁ j hj)
      · exact hP j _ _ (Nat.le_max_right _ _) hx₂

Foundations.Sets.Comparability.maximal_t:
/-- A maximal partial injection is defined everywhere on `α` or hits everything in `β`. -/
theorem maximal_total {M : PInj α β} (hM : ∀ G, Le M G → G = M) :
    (∀ a, ∃ b, M.rel a b) ∨ (∀ b, ∃ a, M.rel a b) := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  have ha : ∃ a, ∀ b, ¬ M.rel a b := Classical.byContradiction fun h =>
    hn (Or.inl fun a => Classical.byContradiction fun h' => h ⟨a, fun b hb => h' ⟨b, hb⟩⟩)
  have hb : ∃ b, ∀ a, ¬ M.rel a b := Classical.byContradiction fun h =>
    hn (Or.inr fun b => Classical.byContradiction fun h' => h ⟨b, fun a ha => h' ⟨a, ha⟩⟩)
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := hb
  have heq := hM (M.add a₀ b₀ ha₀ hb₀) (fun a b h => Or.inl h)
  have : (M.add a₀ b₀ ha₀ hb₀).rel a₀ b₀ := Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [heq] at this
  exact ha₀ b₀ this
Foundations.Topology.Wallis.jordan:
/-- **Jordan's inequality**: `x ≤ (π/2) sin x` for `0 ≤ x ≤ π/2`. -/
theorem jordan {x : R} (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ hpi) : x ≤ hpi * sin x := by
  have hp := hpi_pos
  have hpi_le : hpi ≤ pi := by unfold hpi; have := pi_pos; grind
  rcases (by grind : x = 0 ∨ x = hpi ∨ (0 < x ∧ x < hpi)) with e | e | ⟨e1, e2⟩
  · rw [e, sin_zero]; grind
  · rw [e, sin_hpi]; grind
  · apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hneg
    let g : R → R := fun t => hpi * sin t - t
    let g' : R → R := fun t => hpi * cos t - 1
    have hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt g (g' t) t := fun t => by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_sin t).const_mul hpi).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)
      exact this
    obtain ⟨c₁, a1, a2, a3⟩ := mean_value (f := g) (f' := g') e1
      (fun t _ _ => (hd t).continuousAt) (fun t _ _ => hd t)
    obtain ⟨c₂, b1, b2, b3⟩ := mean_value (f := g) (f' := g') e2
      (fun t _ _ => (hd t).continuousAt) (fun t _ _ => hd t)
    have g0 : g 0 = 0 := by show hpi * sin 0 - 0 = 0; rw [sin_zero]; grind
    have gp : g hpi = 0 := by show hpi * sin hpi - hpi = 0; rw [sin_hpi]; grind
    have gx : g x < 0 := by show hpi * sin x - x < 0; grind
    rw [g0] at a3; rw [gp] at b3
    -- `g'(c₁) < 0 < g'(c₂)` but `g'` decreases.
    have k1 : g' c₁ < 0 := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
      have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind : 0 ≤ g' c₁) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ x - 0); grind
    have k2 : 0 < g' c₂ := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
      have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind : 0 ≤ -g' c₂) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ hpi - x); grind
    have k3 := cos_strictAnti (x := c₁) (y := c₂) (by grind) (by grind) (by grind)
    have k4 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left k3 hp
    have : g' c₁ = hpi * cos c₁ - 1 := rfl
    have : g' c₂ = hpi * cos c₂ - 1 := rfl
    grind

Foundations.Logic.FO.truth_lemma:
/-- **Truth lemma.** A formula is satisfied in the term model (under the canonical
environment) iff it belongs to the maximal consistent Henkin theory `M`. -/
theorem truth_lemma : ∀ φ : Formula L, Sat (termModel hM) (termEnv hM) φ ↔ M φ
  | .bot => ⟨False.elim, fun h => hM.consistent (.hyp h)⟩
  | .eq s t => by
      simp only [Sat, eval_termEnv]
      exact ⟨Quotient.exact, fun h => Quotient.sound h⟩
  | .rel R ts => by
      simp only [Sat, eval_termEnv]
      show M (.rel R fun i => rep hM (Quotient.mk _ (ts i))) ↔ M (.rel R ts)
      constructor
      · exact fun h => hM.closed (Proves.rel_congr R (fun i => .hyp (rep_mk hM (ts i))) (.hyp h))
      · exact fun h => hM.closed (Proves.rel_congr R
          (fun i => Proves.eq_symm (.hyp (rep_mk hM (ts i)))) (.hyp h))
  | .imp φ ψ => by
      simp only [Sat, truth_lemma φ, truth_lemma ψ, hM.imp_iff]
  | .conj φ ψ => by
      simp only [Sat, truth_lemma φ, truth_lemma ψ, hM.conj_iff]
  | .disj φ ψ => by
      simp only [Sat, truth_lemma φ, truth_lemma ψ, hM.disj_iff]
  | .all φ => by
      rw [hM.all_iff]
      show (∀ x, Sat (termModel hM) (Env.cons x (termEnv hM)) φ) ↔ _
      constructor
      · intro h t
        have := h (Quotient.mk _ t)
        rw [← eval_termEnv hM t, ← sat_inst] at this
        exact (truth_lemma (φ.inst t)).1 this
      · intro h x
        obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep x
        rw [← eval_termEnv hM t, ← sat_inst]
        exact (truth_lemma (φ.inst t)).2 (h t)
  | .ex φ => by
      rw [hM.ex_iff]
      show (∃ x, Sat (termModel hM) (Env.cons x (termEnv hM)) φ) ↔ _
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
        obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep x
        rw [← eval_termEnv hM t, ← sat_inst] at hx
        exact ⟨t, (truth_lemma (φ.inst t)).1 hx⟩
      · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
        refine ⟨Quotient.mk _ t, ?_⟩
        rw [← eval_termEnv hM t, ← sat_inst]
        exact (truth_lemma (φ.inst t)).2 ht
termination_by φ => φ.size
decreasing_by all_goals simp [Formula.size]; try omega

Foundations.Sets.tri_mono:
/-- Triangular numbers are monotone. -/
theorem tri_mono {s t : Nat} (h : s ≤ t) : tri s ≤ tri t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rw [Nat.le_zero.1 h]; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ t ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge s (t + 1) with hlt | hge
    · have := ih (by omega); simp only [tri]; omega
    · rw [Nat.le_antisymm h hge]; exact Nat.le_refl _

/-- **Any two quadratic towers lie in a common one**: adjoin the square roots of the second
on top of the first. -/
theorem IsQuadTower.common {F₁ F₂ : Subfield Ω} (h₁ : IsQuadTower hΩ hc F₁)
    (h₂ : IsQuadTower hΩ hc F₂) : ∃ F₃, IsQuadTower hΩ hc F₃ ∧ F₁.le F₃ ∧ F₂.le F₃ := by

  | step s hs _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨F₃, h₃, h13, hG3⟩ := ih

Foundations.Algebra.floorSum_add:
/-- **Eisenstein's lattice-point count**: `Σ ⌊kq/p⌋ + Σ ⌊kp/q⌋ = ((p-1)/2)((q-1)/2)`. -/
theorem floorSum_add : floorSum q p + floorSum p q = (half p : Int) * half q := by
  let I1 : Fin (half p) → Fin (half q) → Int := fun x y =>
    if p * (y.val + 1) < q * (x.val + 1) then 1 else 0
  let I2 : Fin (half p) → Fin (half q) → Int := fun x y =>
    if q * (x.val + 1) < p * (y.val + 1) then 1 else 0
  have hcol : ∀ x : Fin (half p), isum (fun y => I1 x y) = ((q * (x.val + 1) / p : Nat) : Int) := by
    intro x
    rw [← column_count hp hq hpo hqo hpq x.isLt]
    exact (isum_fin_val (half q) (fun n => if p * (n + 1) < q * (x.val + 1) then (1 : Int) else 0)).trans
      (lsum_indicator (fun n => p * (n + 1) < q * (x.val + 1)) _)
  have hrow : ∀ y : Fin (half q), isum (fun x => I2 x y) = ((p * (y.val + 1) / q : Nat) : Int) := by
    intro y
    rw [← column_count hq hp hqo hpo (Ne.symm hpq) y.isLt]
    exact (isum_fin_val (half p) (fun n => if q * (n + 1) < p * (y.val + 1) then (1 : Int) else 0)).trans
      (lsum_indicator (fun n => q * (n + 1) < p * (y.val + 1)) _)
  have h1 : floorSum q p = isum (fun x => isum (fun y => I1 x y)) := by
    unfold floorSum; congr 1; funext x; rw [hcol, Nat.mul_comm q]
  have h2 : floorSum p q = isum (fun x => isum (fun y => I2 x y)) := by
    unfold floorSum; rw [isum_comm]; congr 1; funext y; rw [hrow, Nat.mul_comm p]
  have hone : ∀ x y, I1 x y + I2 x y = 1 := by
    intro x y
    have ⟨_, _, h3p⟩ := half_spec hp hpo
    have hne : p * (y.val + 1) ≠ q * (x.val + 1) := fun e =>
      lattice_off_diag hp hq hpq (x := x.val + 1) (by omega) (by have := x.isLt; omega)
        ⟨y.val + 1, e.symm⟩
    simp only [I1, I2]
    by_cases hc : p * (y.val + 1) < q * (x.val + 1)
    · rw [ite_true_of hc, ite_false_of (by omega)]; rfl
    · rw [ite_false_of hc, ite_true_of (by omega)]; rfl
  rw [h1, h2, ← isum_add]
  rw [show (fun x => isum (fun y => I1 x y) + isum (fun y => I2 x y)) =
      fun _ : Fin (half p) => ((half q : Nat) : Int) * 1 from funext fun x => by
        rw [← isum_add, show (fun y => I1 x y + I2 x y) = fun _ => (1 : Int) from funext (hone x),
          isum_const_int]]
  rw [isum_const_int, Int.mul_one]

/-- Distinct numbers give distinct numerals. -/
theorem church_injective : Function.Injective church := by
  have : ∀ m n, iterApp (var 1) (var 0) m = iterApp (var 1) (var 0) n → m = n := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro n h; cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n => simp [iterApp] at h
    | succ m ih => intro n h; cases n with
      | zero => simp [iterApp] at h
      | succ n => simp only [iterApp, app.injEq, true_and] at h; rw [ih n h]
  intro m n h
  simp only [church, lam.injEq] at h
  exact this m n h

/-- Finitely many formulas of the limit already occur at a single stage. -/
theorem henkinStage_finite :
    ∀ l : List (Formula L), (∀ χ ∈ l, ∃ n, χ ∈ henkinStage hΓ₀ A₀ n) →
      ∃ n, ∀ χ ∈ l, χ ∈ henkinStage hΓ₀ A₀ n
  | [], _ => ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | ψ :: l, h => by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h ψ (by simp)
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := henkinStage_finite l (fun χ hχ => h χ (by simp [hχ]))
      refine ⟨max m n, fun χ hχ => ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hχ with rfl | hχ
      · exact henkinStage_mono hΓ₀ A₀ (Nat.le_max_left _ _) _ hm

Foundations.Types.STLC.cr:
/-- **Girard's conditions CR1–CR3**, proved simultaneously by induction on the type:
(CR1) reducible terms are strongly normalizing; (CR2) reducibility is closed under
reduction; (CR3) a neutral term whose one-step reducts are all reducible is reducible. -/
theorem cr (A : Ty) :
    (∀ t, RED A t → SN t) ∧ (∀ t t', RED A t → Step t t' → RED A t') ∧
    (∀ t, Neutral t → (∀ t', Step t t' → RED A t') → RED A t) := by
  induction A with
  | atom n => exact ⟨fun _ h => h, fun _ _ h hs => SN.step h hs, fun _ _ h => SN.intro h⟩
  | bot => exact ⟨fun _ h => h, fun _ _ h hs => SN.step h hs, fun _ _ h => SN.intro h⟩
  | arr A B ihA ihB =>
    have hv : RED A (var 0) := ihA.2.2 (var 0) trivial (fun _ h => by cases h)
    refine ⟨fun t h => ?_, fun t t' h hs u hu => ihB.2.1 _ _ (h u hu) (Step.appL hs),
      fun t hn h u hu => ?_⟩
    · exact SN.of_map (fun t => app t (var 0)) (fun _ _ => Step.appL) (ihB.1 _ (h _ hv))
    · have hsn := ihA.1 u hu
      revert hu
      induction hsn with
      | intro u _ ih =>
        intro hu
        refine ihB.2.2 _ (by exact trivial) ?_
        intro x hx
        cases hx with
        | beta => simp [Neutral] at hn
        | appL hx => exact h _ hx u hu
        | appR hx => exact ih _ hx (ihA.2.1 _ _ hu hx)
  | prod A B ihA ihB =>
    refine ⟨fun t h => SN.of_map fst (fun _ _ => Step.fst) (ihA.1 _ h.1),
      fun t t' h hs => ⟨ihA.2.1 _ _ h.1 (Step.fst hs), ihB.2.1 _ _ h.2 (Step.snd hs)⟩,
      fun t hn h => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · refine ihA.2.2 _ (by exact trivial) ?_
      intro x hx
      cases hx with
      | fstPair => simp [Neutral] at hn
      | fst hx => exact (h _ hx).1
    · refine ihB.2.2 _ (by exact trivial) ?_
      intro x hx
      cases hx with
      | sndPair => simp [Neutral] at hn
      | snd hx => exact (h _ hx).2
  | sum A B ihA ihB =>
    refine ⟨fun t h => h.1,
      fun t t' h hs => ⟨h.1.step hs, fun a ha => h.2.1 a (Star.head hs ha),
        fun b hb => h.2.2 b (Star.head hs hb)⟩,
      fun t hn h => ⟨SN.intro fun t' hs => (h t' hs).1, fun a ha => ?_, fun b hb => ?_⟩⟩
    · rcases ha.cases_head with rfl | ⟨x, hx, hxa⟩
      · simp [Neutral] at hn
      · exact (h x hx).2.1 a hxa
    · rcases hb.cases_head with rfl | ⟨x, hx, hxb⟩
      · simp [Neutral] at hn
      · exact (h x hx).2.2 b hxb

Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_angle:
/-- **Arguments.** Every point `(x, y)` with `x² + y² = 1` is `(cos θ, sin θ)` for some `θ`. -/
theorem exists_angle {x y : R} (h : x * x + y * y = 1) : ∃ θ, cos θ = x ∧ sin θ = y := by
  have hy2 := C.mul_self_nonneg y
  obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := abs_le_one_of_sq (x := x) (by grind)
  have hπ := pi_pos
  -- Cosine runs from `1` down to `−1` on `[0, π]`.
  obtain ⟨θ, h0, h1, hθ⟩ := intermediate_value' (f := fun t => 0 - cos t) (a := 0) (b := pi)
    (v := -x) (Std.le_of_lt hπ)
    (fun t _ _ => continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_const 0 t) (continuousAt_cos t))
    (by show 0 - cos 0 ≤ -x; rw [cos_zero]; grind)
    (by show -x ≤ 0 - cos pi; rw [cos_pi]; grind)
  have hc : cos θ = x := by have : 0 - cos θ = -x := hθ; grind
  have hs := sin_nonneg_of_mem h0 h1
  have hss : sin θ * sin θ = y * y := by have := sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ; rw [hc] at this; grind
  rcases (by grind : 0 ≤ y ∨ y < 0) with hy | hy
  · exact ⟨θ, hc, eq_of_mul_self_eq hs hy hss⟩
  · refine ⟨-θ, by rw [cos_neg, hc], ?_⟩
    rw [sin_neg, eq_of_mul_self_eq hs (by grind : 0 ≤ -y) (by grind)]; grind

  · exact h0
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨n / 2, by omega⟩

Foundations.Types.SystemF.lam_red_aux:
/-- The core of `lam_red`, by induction on strong normalization. -/
theorem lam_red_aux {ρ : Nat → Cand} {A B : Ty} : ∀ s, SN s → ∀ u, SN u → RED ρ A u →
    (∀ v, RED ρ A v → RED ρ B (inst s v)) → RED ρ B (app (lam s) u) := by
  intro s hs
  induction hs with
  | intro s _ ihs =>
    intro u hu₀
    induction hu₀ with
    | intro u huacc ihu =>
      intro hu h
      refine (interp ρ B).cr3 _ (by exact trivial) ?_
      intro x hx
      cases hx with
      | beta => exact h u hu
      | appL hx =>
        cases hx with
        | lam hx =>
          exact ihs _ hx u (SN.intro huacc) hu
            (fun v hv => (interp ρ B).cr2 _ _ (h v hv) (hx.subst _))
      | appR hx => exact ihu _ hx ((interp ρ A).cr2 _ _ hu hx) h

/-- **Constant multiple rule.** `(c f)' = c f'`. -/
theorem HasDerivAt.const_mul (c : R) {f : R → R} {a x : R} (hf : HasDerivAt f a x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => c * f y) (c * a) x := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηc⟩ := exists_mul_le c hε
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hf η hη
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  rw [show c * f y - c * f x - c * a * (y - x) = c * (f y - f x - a * (y - x)) by grind, abs_mul]
  have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h y hy) (abs_nonneg c)
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hηc (abs_nonneg (y - x))
  grind

/-- Dividing an inequality `c · p ≤ e` by `c > 0`. -/
theorem le_div_of_mul_le {c p e : R} (hc : 0 < c) (h : c * p ≤ e) : p ≤ e / c := by
  have hi : 0 ≤ 1 / c := Std.le_of_lt (OF.div_pos (by grind) hc)
  have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hi
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := fun h => by grind
  have e1 : 1 / c * (c * p) = p := by grind
  have e2 : 1 / c * e = e / c := by grind
  rw [e1, e2] at this; exact this

/-- **Abstract incompleteness theorem** (computational form of Gödel's first

hypotheses remain to be discharged for a concrete system such as PA).

Let `Provable c x` mean "the formal system proves that code `c` does not halt on
input `x`". Suppose the system is
* **sound** for such statements: it proves only true ones; and
* **computably enumerable**: some code `q` halts on `(⌜c⌝, x)` exactly when
  `Provable c x`.

Then the system is **incomplete**: there is an explicit code `c` and input `x` such
that `c` does not halt on `x`, yet this is not provable. Namely `c = godelCode q` and
`x = ⌜c⌝` — the statement "I am not provable", in computational dress. -/
theorem incompleteness (Provable : Code → Nat → Prop)
    (sound : ∀ c x, Provable c x → ¬ Halts c [x])
    {q : Code} (hq : ∀ c x, Halts q [encode c, x] ↔ Provable c x) :
    ¬ Halts (godelCode q) [encode (godelCode q)] ∧
      ¬ Provable (godelCode q) (encode (godelCode q)) := by
  let g := godelCode q
  have h₁ : Halts g [encode g] ↔ Provable g (encode g) :=
    (halts_godelCode_iff q (encode g)).trans (hq g (encode g))
  have hnp : ¬ Provable g (encode g) := fun hp => sound g _ hp (h₁.2 hp)
  exact ⟨fun hh => hnp (h₁.1 hh), hnp⟩
Foundations.Numbers.Bisect.close:
/-- Beyond some index, all endpoints are within `ε` of each other. -/
theorem close {ε : Q} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ N, ∀ m n, N ≤ m → N ≤ n →
    abs (lo P l u m - lo P l u n) < ε ∧ abs (hi P l u m - hi P l u n) < ε ∧
      abs (lo P l u n - hi P l u n) < ε := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := width_small hl hu hlu hε
  refine ⟨N, fun m n hm hn => ?_⟩
  have := nested hl hu hlu hm
  have := nested hl hu hlu hn
  have := (spec hl hu hlu m).2.2.1
  have := (spec hl hu hlu n).2.2.1
  refine ⟨abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩, abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩,
    abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩⟩

  simp only [betaB, Sat, sat_boundF_std, sat_le_std, betaDiv, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_succ,
    eval_zero, Term.eval, Env.cons, gbeta]

  · rintro ⟨q, -, h₁, h₂⟩
    rw [h₁, Nat.add_comm (q * _), Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  · intro h
    refine ⟨e 1 / (0 + 1 + (e 3 + 1) * e 2), Nat.div_le_self _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h, Nat.mul_comm]; simp only [Nat.zero_add]; exact (Nat.div_add_mod _ _).symm
    · rw [h]; simp only [Nat.zero_add]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)

Foundations.Algebra.symmetric_not_solvab:
/-- **`Sₙ` is not solvable for `n ≥ 5`.** Every term of its derived series contains the
3-cycle `(0 1 2)`, which is not the identity. (Together with Galois's criterion, this is why
the general equation of degree `n ≥ 5` is not solvable by radicals.) -/
theorem symmetric_not_solvable {n : Nat} (hn : 5 ≤ n) : ¬ IsSolvable (Perm (Fin n)) := by
  intro ⟨k, hk⟩
  let a : Fin n := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let b : Fin n := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  let c : Fin n := ⟨2, by omega⟩
  have hab : a ≠ b := fun h => absurd (congrArg Fin.val h) (by simp [a, b])
  have hbc : b ≠ c := fun h => absurd (congrArg Fin.val h) (by simp [b, c])
  have hac : a ≠ c := fun h => absurd (congrArg Fin.val h) (by simp [a, c])
  exact c3_ne_one hab hbc hac (hk _ (c3_mem_derivedSeries hn k a b c hab hbc hac))

  apply sqrt_eq (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (cabs_nonneg z) (cabs_nonneg w))

/-- The product of a tuple splits off the last entry. -/
theorem tprod_last : ∀ {m : Nat} (x : Fin (m + 1) → G),
    tprod x = tprod (fun i : Fin m => x i.castSucc) * x (Fin.last m)
  | 0, x => by
    show x 0 * 1 = 1 * x (Fin.last 0)
    rw [mul_one, one_mul]; rfl
  | m + 1, x => by
    show x 0 * tprod (ttail x) = x 0 * tprod (ttail (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => x i.castSucc)) * _
    rw [tprod_last (ttail x), mul_assoc]

Foundations.Algebra.iprod_mul:
/-- Products are multiplicative. -/
theorem iprod_mul {ι : Type} [FiniteType ι] (f g : ι → R) :
    iprod (fun i => f i * g i) = iprod f * iprod g := by
  unfold iprod
  induction (elems : List ι) with
  | nil => exact (Ring.mul_one 1).symm
  | cons a l ih =>
    show f a * g a * lprod (l.map _) = (f a * lprod (l.map f)) * (g a * lprod (l.map g))
    rw [ih]; grind
Foundations.Numbers.C.pow_I_mul:
/-- The powers of `iθ` cycle through the coefficients of cosine and sine:
`(iθ)ⁿ = cₙ θⁿ + i sₙ θⁿ`. -/
theorem pow_I_mul (θ : R) (n : Nat) :
    (⟨0, θ⟩ : C) ^ n = ⟨cosCoeff n * θ ^ n, sinCoeff n * θ ^ n⟩ := by
  induction n with
  | zero => apply ext <;> show _ = _ * 1 <;> rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    show (⟨0, θ⟩ : C) ^ n * ⟨0, θ⟩ = _
    rw [ih, pow_succ']
    apply ext
    · show cosCoeff n * θ ^ n * 0 - sinCoeff n * θ ^ n * θ = -sinCoeff n * (θ ^ n * θ); grind
    · show cosCoeff n * θ ^ n * θ + sinCoeff n * θ ^ n * 0 = cosCoeff n * (θ ^ n * θ); grind
Foundations.Numbers.Bisect.width_small:
/-- The intervals become arbitrarily short. -/
theorem width_small {ε : Q} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ N, hi P l u N - lo P l u N < ε := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Q.archimedean ((u - l) / ε)
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, h4⟩ := spec hl hu hlu N
  have k1 : u - l < N * ε := (Field.IsOrdered.mul_inv_lt_iff_lt_mul _ _ hε).1 hN
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (two_pow_ge N) (Q.le_of_lt' hε)
  have hpos : (0 : Q) < 2 ^ N := by have := two_pow_ge N; grind
  have : (hi P l u N - lo P l u N) * 2 ^ N < ε * 2 ^ N := by grind
  exact (Field.IsOrdered.mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hpos).1 this

Foundations.Numbers.OF.archimedean_of_lu:
/-- **Completeness implies the Archimedean property.** In an ordered field with the least upper
bound property, the natural numbers are unbounded. -/
theorem archimedean_of_lub (hL : LUBProperty K) : Archimedean K := by
  intro x
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hno
  have hbd : ∀ n : Nat, (n : K) ≤ x := fun n => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h; exact hno ⟨n, by grind⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := hL (fun y => ∃ n : Nat, y = n) ⟨_, 0, rfl⟩
    ⟨x, fun y ⟨n, hn⟩ => hn ▸ hbd n⟩
  -- `L − 1` is not an upper bound, so some `n > L − 1`; then `n + 1 > L`, a contradiction.
  have : ¬ ∀ y : K, (∃ n : Nat, y = n) → y ≤ L - 1 := fun h => by have := hL2 _ h; grind
  apply this
  intro y ⟨n, hn⟩
  have := hL1 ((n + 1 : Nat) : K) ⟨n + 1, rfl⟩
  rw [hn]; grind
Foundations.Algebra.Perm.conjHom_injecti:
/-- Transport along a bijection is injective. -/
theorem Perm.conjHom_injective {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (e : α → β) (e' : β → α)
    (h1 : ∀ x, e' (e x) = x) (h2 : ∀ y, e (e' y) = y) :
    ∀ σ τ, Perm.conjHom e e' h1 h2 σ = Perm.conjHom e e' h1 h2 τ → σ = τ := by
  intro σ τ h
  apply Perm.ext
  intro x
  have := congrArg (fun π : Perm β => e' (π (e x))) h
  simp only [Perm.conjHom, h1] at this
  exact this

/-- Recursively chosen indices `φ 0 < φ 1 < ⋯` with `d(s (φ k), L) < 1/(k+1)`, given that terms

noncomputable def chooseIdx (s : Nat → X) (L : X)
    (h : ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∀ N, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ dist (s n) L < ε) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => Classical.choose (h (1 / ((0 : Nat) + 1)) (eps_pos 0) 0)
  | k + 1 => Classical.choose (h (1 / ((k + 1 : Nat) + 1)) (eps_pos (k + 1)) (chooseIdx s L h k + 1))

/-- The triangle inequality for three steps. -/
theorem abs_sub_le3 (p q r s : R) : abs (p - s) ≤ abs (p - q) + abs (q - r) + abs (r - s) := by
  have h1 := OF.abs_add (p - q) (q - r)
  have h2 := OF.abs_add (p - q + (q - r)) (r - s)
  rw [show p - q + (q - r) = p - r by grind] at h1
  rw [show p - q + (q - r) + (r - s) = p - s by grind] at h2

/-- Multiplying a strict inequality by a positive element preserves it. -/

Foundations.Combinatorics.MonoEnd:
/-- A subsequence of length `k` that is `r`-monotone and ends at position `i`:
indices `s 0 < ⋯ < s (k-1) = i` with `r (a (s p)) (a (s q))` for `p < q`. -/
def MonoEnd (i k : Nat) : Prop :=

/-- While the Goodstein sequence is positive, its ordinals strictly decrease. -/
theorem goodstein_ord_lt (n k : Nat) (h : goodstein n k ≠ 0) :
    lt (ord (k + 1) (goodstein n (k + 1))) (ord k (goodstein n k)) := by
  show lt (ord (k + 1) (bump k (goodstein n k) - 1)) _
  rw [← ord_bump k (goodstein n k)]
  exact ord_lt (k + 1) _ _ (by have := bump_ne_zero k h; omega)
Foundations.Topology.Vitali.tri_surj:
/-- Every pair `(n, m)` with `m ≤ n` is reached. -/
theorem tri_surj : ∀ n m, m ≤ n → ∃ k, tri k = (n, m) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro m hm; exact ⟨0, by rw [show m = 0 by omega]; rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih n (Nat.le_refl n)
      exact ⟨k + 1, by simp [tri, hk]⟩
    | succ m ihm =>
      intro hm
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ihm (by omega)
      exact ⟨k + 1, by simp [tri, hk]; omega⟩

/-- `exp` is injective. -/
theorem exp_injective {x y : R} (h : exp x = exp y) : x = y := by
  rcases (by grind : x < y ∨ x = y ∨ y < x) with h' | h' | h'
  · have := exp_strictMono h'; grind
  · exact h'
  · have := exp_strictMono h'; grind
Foundations.Numbers.Z.bridge_int:
/-- **Bridge theorem (ℤ).** The equivalence `Z ≃ Int` preserves `0`, `1`, addition, negation,
multiplication and order. So the integers built from pairs of naturals are the same structure as
Lean's `Int`, and we use `Int` from now on. -/
theorem bridge_int :
    equivInt.toFun 0 = 0 ∧ equivInt.toFun 1 = 1 ∧
    (∀ x y, equivInt.toFun (x + y) = equivInt.toFun x + equivInt.toFun y) ∧
    (∀ x, equivInt.toFun (-x) = -equivInt.toFun x) ∧
    (∀ x y, equivInt.toFun (x * y) = equivInt.toFun x * equivInt.toFun y) ∧
    (∀ x y, x ≤ y ↔ equivInt.toFun x ≤ equivInt.toFun y) :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, toInt_add, toInt_neg, toInt_mul, toInt_le⟩
Foundations.Sets.cantor_bool:
/-- **Cantor's diagonal argument for binary sequences.** No function from `α` to
`α → Bool` is surjective. -/
theorem cantor_bool {α : Type _} : ¬ ∃ f : α → (α → Bool), Function.Surjective f := by
  rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hf (fun x => !(f x x))
  have := congrFun hd d
  cases h : f d d <;> simp [h] at this

/-- Freshness of a block of bounded existentials. -/

  | 0, _, _, _, h => h
  | k + 1, wi, x, hw, h =>
      ⟨boundF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega),
        bexN_fresh φ k (wi + 1) (x + 1) (by omega) (by rwa [show x + 1 + k = x + (k + 1) by omega])⟩

Foundations.Logic.FO.stdModel_isModel:
/-- **The standard model satisfies PA.** Every axiom of Peano arithmetic — including
every instance of the induction schema — is true in `(ℕ, 0, S, +, ×)` under every
assignment of the free variables. -/
theorem stdModel_isModel : IsModel stdModel PA := by
  refine ⟨⟨(0 : Nat)⟩, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ e
  cases hφ with
  | succ_ne_zero => intro (x : Nat) (h : x + 1 = 0); exact Nat.succ_ne_zero x h
  | succ_inj => intro (x : Nat) (y : Nat) (h : x + 1 = y + 1); exact Nat.succ.inj h
  | add_zero => intro (x : Nat); show x + 0 = x; rfl
  | add_succ => intro (x : Nat) (y : Nat); show x + (y + 1) = x + y + 1; rfl
  | mul_zero => intro (x : Nat); show x * 0 = 0; rfl
  | mul_succ => intro (x : Nat) (y : Nat); show x * (y + 1) = x * y + x; exact Nat.mul_succ x y
  | induction φ =>
      rintro ⟨h0, hstep⟩ n
      have h0' : Sat stdModel (Env.cons (0 : Nat) e) φ := (sat_inst φ e zero).1 h0
      have hstep' : ∀ x : Nat, Sat stdModel (Env.cons x e) φ →
          Sat stdModel (Env.cons (x + 1) e) φ := by
        intro x hx
        have := (sat_subst φ (Env.cons x e) succSubst).1 (hstep x hx)
        have henv : (fun n => (succSubst n).eval stdModel (Env.cons x e)) =
            Env.cons (x + 1) e := by
          funext n; cases n <;> rfl
        rwa [henv] at this
      induction n with
      | zero => exact h0'
      | succ n ih => exact hstep' n ih

/-- Analysing a reduction sequence by its first step: either it is empty, or it
begins with a step. -/
theorem cases_head {a c : α} (h : Star R a c) : a = c ∨ ∃ b, R a b ∧ Star R b c := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Or.inl rfl
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih =>
    rcases ih with rfl | ⟨x, hx, hxb⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨c, hbc, refl c⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨x, hx, tail hxb hbc⟩

Foundations.Logic.Computability.Derivabl:
/-- **Derivability** in a rule system: `x` is derivable if, for some witness `w` and
some list `l` of derivable premises, the rule test `step x w ⌜l⌝` succeeds. -/
inductive Derivable (step : Nat → Nat → Nat → Bool) : Nat → Prop where
  /-- Apply one rule to already derived premises. -/

      (∀ y ∈ l, Derivable step y) → step x w (encList l) = true → Derivable step x
Foundations.Algebra.Iso:
/-- **Group isomorphism.** A homomorphism with a two-sided inverse function. Isomorphic
groups are indistinguishable by anything expressible in terms of multiplication: this is
the structuralist's notion of sameness. -/
structure Iso (G : Type u) (H : Type v) [Group G] [Group H] extends Hom G H where
  /-- The inverse function. -/
  invFun : H → G
  /-- `invFun` undoes `toFun`. -/
  left_inv : ∀ x, invFun (toFun x) = x
  /-- `toFun` undoes `invFun`. -/
  right_inv : ∀ y, toFun (invFun y) = y
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.bayes_to:
/-- **Bayes' theorem with the law of total probability** in the denominator:
`P(B | A) = P(A | B) P(B) / (P(A | B) P(B) + P(A | Bᶜ) P(Bᶜ))`. -/
theorem bayes_total {A B : Event α} (hB : P.prob B ≠ 0) (hB' : P.prob (fun x => ¬ B x) ≠ 0) :
    P.cond B A = P.cond A B * P.prob B /
      (P.cond A B * P.prob B + P.cond A (fun x => ¬ B x) * P.prob (fun x => ¬ B x)) := by
  rw [← total_probability P hB hB']; exact bayes P hB

/-- **ℝ is not homeomorphic to ℝ ∖ {0}**: a homeomorphism would carry the connected line onto the
disconnected punctured line. -/
theorem not_homeomorphic_punctured :
    Topology.Homeomorph (Topology.metric R) (Topology.subspace (Topology.metric R) (fun x => x ≠ 0))

Foundations.Topology.Topology.indiscrete:
/-- The **indiscrete topology**: only `∅` and `X` are open. -/
def indiscrete (X : Type) : Topology X where
  IsOpen U := (∀ x, ¬ U x) ∨ (∀ x, U x)
  isOpen_univ := Or.inr fun _ => trivial
  isOpen_inter U V hU hV := by
    rcases hU with hU | hU
    · exact Or.inl fun x h => hU x h.1
    · rcases hV with hV | hV
      · exact Or.inl fun x h => hV x h.2
      · exact Or.inr fun x => ⟨hU x, hV x⟩
  isOpen_sUnion S hS := by
    by_cases h : ∃ U, S U ∧ ∀ x, U x
    · obtain ⟨U, hU, hU'⟩ := h; exact Or.inr fun x => ⟨U, hU, hU' x⟩
    · refine Or.inl fun x ⟨U, hU, hx⟩ => ?_
      rcases hS U hU with h' | h'
      · exact h' x hx
      · exact h ⟨U, hU, h'⟩

Foundations.Categories.yoneda:
/-- **The Yoneda lemma.** For every functor `F : C ⥤ Type` and object `A`, natural
transformations `Hom(A, −) ⟶ F` correspond bijectively to elements of `F A`, via
`α ↦ α_A(𝟙 A)`. -/
def yoneda (F : C ⥤ Type v) (A : C) : Bij (NatTrans (homFunctor A) F) (F.obj A) where
  toFun α := α.app A (𝟙 A)
  invFun x := yonedaInv F A x
  left_inv α := NatTrans.ext fun _ => funext fun h => (app_eq_map α h).symm
  right_inv x := congrFun (F.map_id A) x

Foundations.Logic.FO.fsub_fcode:
/-- **Correctness of substitution on Gödel numbers.** -/
theorem fsub_fcode (mode : Nat) (t : Term Arith) :
    ∀ (φ : Formula Arith) (d : Nat), fsub (pair mode (tcode t)) (pair (fcode φ) d) =
      fcode (φ.subst (liftN d (sigma mode t))) := by

  | hb => intro d; simp [fsub, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, fsubStep, fcode, Formula.subst]

  | hi φ ψ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro d
      simp only [fsub, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, fsubStep, fcode, Formula.subst, fst_pair, snd_pair]
      simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false, Bool.false_or, Bool.or_true]
      rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (pair_lt_pair_left (fst_lt_tagged (by omega))),
        histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (pair_lt_pair_left (snd_lt_tagged (by omega)))]
      exact pair_congr3 (ih₁ d) (ih₂ d)
  | hc φ ψ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro d
      simp only [fsub, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, fsubStep, fcode, Formula.subst, fst_pair, snd_pair]
      simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false, Bool.false_or, Bool.or_true]
      rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (pair_lt_pair_left (fst_lt_tagged (by omega))),
        histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (pair_lt_pair_left (snd_lt_tagged (by omega)))]
      exact pair_congr3 (ih₁ d) (ih₂ d)
  | hd φ ψ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro d
      simp only [fsub, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, fsubStep, fcode, Formula.subst, fst_pair, snd_pair]
      simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false, Bool.false_or, Bool.or_true]

      simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false, Bool.false_or, Bool.or_true]

Foundations.Numbers.R.extreme_value:
/-- **Extreme value theorem.** A function continuous on `[a, b]` attains a maximum there. -/
theorem extreme_value {f : R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ContinuousAt f x) :
    ∃ c, a ≤ c ∧ c ≤ b ∧ ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → f x ≤ f c := by
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := bounded_above hf
  let S : R → Prop := fun y => ∃ x, a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b ∧ y = f x
  obtain ⟨M, hM1, hM2⟩ := exists_lub S ⟨f a, a, by grind, hab, rfl⟩
    ⟨M₀, fun y ⟨x, h1, h2, hy⟩ => hy ▸ hM₀ x h1 h2⟩
  -- Choose points where `f` exceeds `M − 1/(n+1)`.
  have hx : ∀ n : Nat, ∃ x, (a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b) ∧ M - 1 / ((n : R) + 1) < f x := fun n => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
    have := hM2 (M - 1 / ((n : R) + 1)) fun y ⟨x, h1, h2, hy⟩ => by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h3; exact h ⟨x, ⟨h1, h2⟩, by grind⟩
    have := eps_pos n; grind
  let xs : Nat → R := fun n => (hx n).choose
  have hxs : ∀ n, (a ≤ xs n ∧ xs n ≤ b) ∧ M - 1 / ((n : R) + 1) < f (xs n) :=
    fun n => (hx n).choose_spec
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, L, hL⟩ := bolzano_weierstrass (bounded_of_mem fun n => (hxs n).1)
  have haL : a ≤ L := le_of_tendsto hL fun k => (hxs (φ k)).1.1
  have hLb : L ≤ b := tendsto_le hL fun k => (hxs (φ k)).1.2
  -- `f (x_{φ k}) → f L` by continuity, and `f (x_{φ k}) → M` by construction.
  have h1 := tendsto_comp (hf L haL hLb) hL
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun k => f (xs (φ k))) M := fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eps_small hε
    refine ⟨N, fun k hk => abs_lt.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have := (hxs (φ k)).2
      have := hN (φ k) (by have := le_of_strictMono hφ k; omega)
      grind
    · have := hM1 _ ⟨xs (φ k), (hxs (φ k)).1.1, (hxs (φ k)).1.2, rfl⟩; grind
  have hfL : f L = M := tendsto_unique h1 h2
  exact ⟨L, haL, hLb, fun x h1 h2 => by rw [hfL]; exact hM1 _ ⟨x, h1, h2, rfl⟩⟩

/-- **Infinite ⇔ Dedekind-infinite ⇔ ℕ ↪ α.** The three notions of infinity agree

theorem infinite_tfae (α : Type u) :

  ⟨⟨fun h => dedekindInfinite_of_nat_le (nat_le_of_isInfinite h),

Foundations.Logic.Computability.Comp.nat:
/-- **Closure under primitive recursion.** -/
theorem Comp.natRec {b s m : Nat → Nat} (hb : Comp b) (hs : Comp s) (hm : Comp m) :
    Comp fun n => Computability.natRec b s n (m n) := by
  obtain ⟨cb, hb⟩ := hb; obtain ⟨cs, hs⟩ := hs; obtain ⟨cm, hm⟩ := hm
  let step : Code := .comp cs (vec1 (pairOf (.proj 2) (pairOf (.proj 0) (.proj 1))))
  have key : ∀ n i, Eval (.prec cb step) [i, n] (Computability.natRec b s n i) := by
    intro n i
    induction i with
    | zero => exact .prec_zero (hb n)
    | succ i ih =>
        exact .prec_succ ih (eval_comp1 (eval_pairOf .proj (eval_pairOf .proj .proj)) (hs _))
  exact ⟨.comp (.prec cb step) (vec2 cm (.proj 0)), fun n => eval_comp2 (hm n) .proj (key n _)⟩
Foundations.Sets.cardLE_total_preorder:
/-- **Cardinality is a total preorder.** "At most as large as" is reflexive,
transitive and total on types, and two types are each at most as large as the
other exactly when they are equinumerous. -/
theorem cardLE_total_preorder :
    (∀ α : Type u, CardLE α α) ∧
    (∀ α β γ : Type u, CardLE α β → CardLE β γ → CardLE α γ) ∧
    (∀ α β : Type u, CardLE α β ∨ CardLE β α) ∧
    (∀ α β : Type u, (CardLE α β ∧ CardLE β α) ↔ Equinum α β) :=
  ⟨CardLE.refl, fun _ _ _ => CardLE.trans, card_comparable,
   fun _ _ => ⟨fun h => CardLE.antisymm h.1 h.2,
     fun h => ⟨CardLE.of_equinum h, CardLE.of_equinum h.symm⟩⟩⟩

noncomputable def nrm (z : C) : R := abs z.re + abs z.im
Foundations.Logic.Computability.recursio:
/-- **Kleene's recursion theorem** (classical fixed-point form). For every total
computable function `f` on program numbers there is a program number `e` such that
`φₑ` and `φ_{f(e)}` are the same partial function. -/
theorem recursion_theorem_fixed_point {f : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) :
    ∃ e, ∀ y n, phi e y n ↔ phi (f e) y n := by
  obtain ⟨cf, hcf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := recursion_theorem (.comp U (vec2 (.comp cf (vec1 (.proj 0))) (.proj 1)))
  refine ⟨encode q, fun y n => ?_⟩
  rw [phi_encode, hq]
  unfold phi
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨v₀, v₁, h₀, h₁, h⟩ := eval_comp2_inv h
    obtain ⟨u, hu, h₀⟩ := eval_comp1_inv h₀
    cases hu; cases h₁
    rwa [Eval.det h₀ (hcf _)] at h
  · intro h
    exact eval_comp2 (eval_comp1 .proj (hcf _)) .proj h
Foundations.Categories.types_product:
/-- **The cartesian product is a product** in the category of types. -/
def types_product (X Y : Type u) :
    IsProduct X Y (X × Y) (fun p : X × Y => p.1) (fun p : X × Y => p.2) where
  lift f g := fun w => (f w, g w)
  fac₁ _ _ := rfl
  fac₂ _ _ := rfl
  uniq f g h h₁ h₂ := funext fun w => by
    subst h₁ h₂
    rfl
Foundations.Topology.Cantor.val_mem_C:
/-- **Every such point lies in the Cantor set.** -/
theorem val_mem_C (b : Nat → Bool) : C (val b) := by
  intro n
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero => exact val_mem b
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := three_val b
    cases hb : b 0
    · left; rw [hb] at h; rw [h, show (if false = true then (2 : R) else 0) = 0 from rfl]
      rw [show (0 : R) + val (fun k => b (k + 1)) = val (fun k => b (k + 1)) by grind]; exact ih _
    · right; rw [hb] at h; rw [h, show (if true = true then (2 : R) else 0) = 2 from rfl]
      rw [show (2 : R) + val (fun k => b (k + 1)) - 2 = val (fun k => b (k + 1)) by grind]; exact ih _
Foundations.Logic.Computability.halts_di:
/-- The diagonal code halts on `e` iff `h(e, e) = 0`. -/
theorem halts_diagonal_iff (h : Code) (e : Nat) :
    Halts (diagonal h) [e] ↔ Eval h [e, e] 0 := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    cases hn with
    | mu _ h₀ _ =>
        obtain ⟨v₀, v₁, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := eval_comp2_inv h₀
        cases h₁; cases h₂
        exact h₃
  · intro h₀
    exact ⟨0, .mu (fun _ => 0) (eval_comp2 .proj .proj h₀) (fun m hm => absurd hm (by omega))⟩

Foundations.Algebra.no_int_trisect:
/-- **The rational root test for `8x³ - 6x - 1`**: `8a³ - 6ab² - b³ = 0` has no integer
solution with `b ≠ 0`. -/
theorem no_int_trisect (a b : Int) (hb : b ≠ 0) : 8 * (a * a * a) - 6 * a * (b * b) - b * b * b ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have e : b * b * b = 2 * (4 * (a * a * a) - 3 * (a * (b * b))) := by grind
  have hb2 : b % 2 = 0 := even_of_cube_even (by omega)
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, b = 2 * c := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hb; rw [h]; rfl
  exact no_int_trisect_aux c.natAbs a c rfl hc (by grind)
Foundations.Logic.FO.completeness:
/-- **Gödel's completeness theorem.** In a countable first-order language, every
semantic consequence is derivable: `Γ ⊨ φ → Γ ⊢ φ`. -/
theorem completeness {Γ : Theory L} {φ : Formula L} (h : Entails Γ φ) : Γ ⊢₁ φ := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hn => ?_
  have hc : Consistent (insert Γ φ.neg) := fun hb => hn (Proves.raa hb)
  obtain ⟨M, e, he, -⟩ := model_existence hc
  exact he _ (Or.inl rfl) (h M e fun ψ hψ => he ψ (Or.inr hψ))

Foundations.Algebra.exists_rpow_eq_one:
/-- Non-zero elements of a finite field have a power equal to `1`. -/
theorem exists_rpow_eq_one {x : F} (hx : x ≠ 0) : ∃ m, 0 < m ∧ rpow x m = 1 := by
  have hnz : ∀ n, rpow x n ≠ 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact fun h => hF.1 h.symm
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h
      rcases hF.isDomain.2 _ _ h with h1 | h1
      · exact ih h1
      · exact hx h1
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hno
  have hinj : ∀ i j : Nat, rpow x i = rpow x j → i = j := by
    intro i j h
    rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy i j with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exfalso; apply hno; refine ⟨j - i, by omega, ?_⟩
      have e := rpow_add x i (j - i)
      rw [show i + (j - i) = j by omega, ← h] at e
      have h0 : rpow x i * (rpow x (j - i) + -1) = 0 := by grind
      rcases hF.isDomain.2 _ _ h0 with h1 | h1
      · exact absurd h1 (hnz i)
      · grind
    · exact heq
    · exfalso; apply hno; refine ⟨i - j, by omega, ?_⟩
      have e := rpow_add x j (i - j)
      rw [show j + (i - j) = i by omega, h] at e
      have h0 : rpow x j * (rpow x (i - j) + -1) = 0 := by grind
      rcases hF.isDomain.2 _ _ h0 with h1 | h1
      · exact absurd h1 (hnz j)
      · grind
  have hnd := nodup_map_of_injective hinj (List.nodup_range (n := card F + 1))
  have := length_le_card hnd
  rw [List.length_map, List.length_range] at this
  omega

Foundations.Combinatorics.cnt_pos:
/-- A non-empty predicate has positive count. -/
theorem cnt_pos {P : Nat → Prop} : ∀ n, (∃ x, x < n ∧ P x) → 0 < cnt P n
  | 0, ⟨_, hx, _⟩ => absurd hx (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, ⟨x, hx, hpx⟩ => by
      simp only [cnt]
      by_cases hn : x = n
      · subst hn; simp [hpx]
      · have := cnt_pos n ⟨x, by omega, hpx⟩; omega
Foundations.Algebra.RingHom.range:
/-- The **image** of a ring homomorphism is a subring of the codomain. -/
def RingHom.range {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : RingHom R S) :
    Subring S where
  carrier y := ∃ x, f.toFun x = y
  zero_mem := ⟨0, f.map_zero⟩
  one_mem := ⟨1, f.map_one⟩
  add_mem := fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ => ⟨x + y, by rw [f.map_add, hx, hy]⟩
  neg_mem := fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => ⟨-x, by rw [f.map_neg, hx]⟩
  mul_mem := fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ => ⟨x * y, by rw [f.map_mul, hx, hy]⟩

Foundations.Geometry.Pt.d2_right:
/-- For `b = a + t (c − a)`: `|bc|² = (1−t)² |ac|²`. -/
theorem d2_right {a b c : Pt K} {t : K} (hx : b.x - a.x = t * (c.x - a.x))
    (hy : b.y - a.y = t * (c.y - a.y)) : d2 b c = (1 - t) * (1 - t) * d2 a c := by
  have ex : b.x = a.x + t * (c.x - a.x) := by grind
  have ey : b.y = a.y + t * (c.y - a.y) := by grind
  unfold d2; rw [ex, ey]; grind

Foundations.Algebra.Necklace.action:
/-- **Rotation action.** `k ∈ ℤ/pℤ` rotates a necklace by `k` places:
`(k • x)ᵢ = x_{i+k}`. -/
instance Necklace.action : MulAction (ZMod p) (Necklace G p) where
  smul k x := fun i => x (i + ZMod.val k)
  one_smul x := by
    funext i
    show x (i + 0) = x i
    congr 1; grind
  mul_smul j k x := by
    funext i
    show x (i + (ZMod.val j + ZMod.val k)) = x (i + ZMod.val j + ZMod.val k)
    congr 1; grind
Foundations.Numbers.Q.archimedean:
/-- **Archimedean property of ℚ.** Every rational number is smaller than some natural number. -/
theorem archimedean (x : Q) : ∃ n : Nat, x < (n : Q) := by
  induction x using ind with | h a b hb => ?_
  refine ⟨a.toNat + 1, ?_⟩
  simp only [natCast_def, mk_lt]
  have : ((a.toNat + 1 : Nat) : Int) * 1 ≤ ((a.toNat + 1 : Nat) : Int) * b :=
    Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

Foundations.Logic.FO.bezout:
/-- **Bézout's identity.** The greatest common divisor of `a` and `b` is an integer
combination `x·a + y·b`. (Proof: Euclid's algorithm.) -/
theorem bezout : ∀ (a b : Nat), ∃ x y : Int, x * a + y * b = (Nat.gcd a b : Int) := by
  intro a
  induction a using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ a ih =>
    intro b
    cases a with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, 1, by simp⟩
    | succ a =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, h⟩ := ih (b % (a + 1)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (a + 1)
      rw [Nat.gcd_rec]
      refine ⟨y - x * (b / (a + 1) : Nat), x, ?_⟩
      have hm := Nat.mod_add_div b (a + 1)
      have : ((b % (a + 1) : Nat) : Int) =
          (b : Int) - ((a + 1 : Nat) : Int) * ((b / (a + 1) : Nat) : Int) := by
        have := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : Int)) hm
        simp only [Int.natCast_add, Int.natCast_mul] at this
        omega
      rw [← h, this]
      grind

  Quotient.lift₂
    (fun p q => mk (p.num * q.num) (p.den * q.den) (Int.mul_pos p.den_pos q.den_pos))
    (fun _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => by
      apply Quotient.sound
      simp only [frac_rel_iff] at *; grind)
Foundations.Numbers.N.le_total:
/-- `≤` is total: any two numbers are comparable. -/
theorem le_total (a b : N) : a ≤ b ∨ b ≤ a := by
  induction a generalizing b with
  | zero => exact Or.inl (zero_le b)
  | succ a ih =>
    cases b with
    | zero => exact Or.inr (zero_le _)
    | succ b =>
      rcases ih b with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (succ_le_succ h)
      · exact Or.inr (succ_le_succ h)

  cases v with
  | zero =>

      cases h with
      | prec_succ _ h' => cases h'; simp

Foundations.Topology.Wallis.I_pos:
/-- All `Iₙ` are positive. -/
theorem I_pos (n : Nat) : 0 < I n := by
  have key : ∀ n, 0 < I n ∧ 0 < I (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rw [I_zero, show (0 : Nat) + 1 = 1 from rfl, I_one]; exact ⟨hpi_pos, by grind⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      refine ⟨ih.2, ?_⟩
      have := I_rec n
      have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
      have h3 := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < (n : R) + 1) ih.1
      rw [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 from rfl]
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
      have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by grind : I (n + 2) ≤ 0)
        (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) + 2)
      grind
  exact (key n).1

  refine ⟨mem_sep.2 ⟨kpair_mem_prod.2 ⟨empty_mem_omega, ha⟩, fun R hR => hR.1⟩, ?_⟩

  have hy : y ∈ A := (kpair_mem_prod.1 (recFun_subset hny)).2
  exact mem_sep.2 ⟨kpair_mem_prod.2 ⟨succ_mem_omega hn, hg y hy⟩,

Foundations.Geometry.Klein.continuity:
/-- (A11) **Continuity** in the Klein model, inherited from the Cartesian plane: the
separating point lies between points of the disc, hence in the disc. -/
theorem continuity (φ ψ : KPt → Prop) (h : ∃ a, ∀ x y, φ x → ψ y → KBet a x y) :
    ∃ b, ∀ x y, φ x → ψ y → KBet x b y := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
  by_cases hφ : ∃ x0, φ x0
  case neg => exact ⟨a, fun x _ hx _ => absurd ⟨x, hx⟩ hφ⟩
  by_cases hψ : ∃ y0, ψ y0
  case neg => exact ⟨a, fun _ y _ hy => absurd ⟨y, hy⟩ hψ⟩
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0⟩ := hφ
  obtain ⟨y0, hy0⟩ := hψ
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Pt.continuity_of_lub R.exists_lub (fun p => ∃ h, φ ⟨p, h⟩)
    (fun p => ∃ h, ψ ⟨p, h⟩) ⟨a.1, fun x y ⟨hx, hφx⟩ ⟨hy, hψy⟩ => ha ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ hφx hψy⟩
  have hb1 : n2 b < 1 := n2_lt_of_bet x0.2 y0.2 (hb x0.1 y0.1 ⟨x0.2, hx0⟩ ⟨y0.2, hy0⟩)
  exact ⟨⟨b, hb1⟩, fun x y hx hy => hb x.1 y.1 ⟨x.2, hx⟩ ⟨y.2, hy⟩⟩
Foundations.Algebra.Ideal:
/-- **Ideal** (Dedekind). An ideal of a commutative ring `R` is a set containing `0`, closed
under addition and negation (so an additive subgroup), and closed under multiplication by
*arbitrary* elements of `R`: it "absorbs" multiplication. -/
structure Ideal (R : Type u) [CommRing R] where
  /-- The elements of the ideal. -/
  carrier : R → Prop
  /-- `0` is in the ideal. -/
  zero_mem : carrier 0
  /-- Closure under addition. -/
  add_mem : ∀ {a b : R}, carrier a → carrier b → carrier (a + b)
  /-- Closure under negation. -/
  neg_mem : ∀ {a : R}, carrier a → carrier (-a)
  /-- Absorption: multiples of members are members. -/
  mul_mem : ∀ (r : R) {a : R}, carrier a → carrier (r * a)

Foundations.Topology.continuous_of_lipsc:
/-- A map that does not increase distances by more than a factor `K` (a **Lipschitz map**) is
continuous. -/
theorem continuous_of_lipschitz {f : X → Y} {K : R} (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (h : ∀ x y, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ K * dist x y) : Continuous f := fun x ε hε => by
  refine ⟨ε / (K + 1), div_pos hε (by grind), fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have k1 := h y x
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt hy) hK
  have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy (by grind : 0 < K + 1)
  have e : (K + 1) * (ε / (K + 1)) = ε := by grind
  have := dist_nonneg y x
  have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hK this
  grind

Foundations.Logic.FO.sat_diagTheta:
/-- The formula `θ`, semantically: in any model of `Q`, `θ(n̄)` holds iff `ψ` holds of
`d(n)‾`. -/
theorem sat_diagTheta {M : Structure Arith} (hM : IsQModel M) (ψ : Formula Arith) (n : Nat)
    (e : Nat → M.Dom) :
    Sat M (Env.cons (numM M n) e) (diagTheta ψ) ↔ Sat M (Env.cons (numM M (diagC n)) e) ψ := by
  unfold diagTheta
  simp only [Sat, sat_subst]
  have henv : ∀ y : M.Dom, (fun k => (Env.cons (v 0) (fun j => v (j + 2)) k).eval M
      (Env.cons y (Env.cons (numM M n) e))) = Env.cons y e := by
    intro y; funext k; cases k <;> rfl
  simp only [henv, sat_funF diagCode_spec hM]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl, h⟩; exact h
  · intro h; exact ⟨_, rfl, h⟩
Foundations.Numbers.R.hasSum_derTerm:
/-- The termwise derivative of the exponential series sums to `exp x`. -/
theorem hasSum_derTerm (x : R) : HasSum (derTerm x) (exp x) := by
  apply hasSum_succ_iff.1
  have e0 : derTerm x 0 = 0 := by unfold derTerm; show ((0 : Nat) : R) * x ^ (0 - 1) / _ = 0; grind
  rw [e0, show exp x - 0 = exp x by grind]
  refine (hasSum_exp x).congr fun n => ?_
  unfold derTerm expTerm
  rw [fact_succ', show n + 1 - 1 = n by omega]
  have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < (n : R) + 1) (fact_pos' n)
  have := fact_pos' n
  grind

Foundations.Algebra.parity_swap01:
/-- The transposition `(0 1)` has exactly one inversion. -/
theorem parity_swap01 (m : Nat) : parity (swap (0 : Fin (m + 2)) 1) = true := by
  have hv0 : (0 : Fin (m + 2)).val = 0 := rfl
  have hv1 : (1 : Fin (m + 2)).val = 1 := Fin.val_one m
  have h01 : (0 : Fin (m + 2)) < 1 := by
    show (0 : Fin (m + 2)).val < (1 : Fin (m + 2)).val; rw [hv0, hv1]; decide
  let p0 : Pairs (m + 2) := ⟨(0, 1), h01⟩
  unfold parity
  rw [isum_single _ p0]
  · show inv (swap (0 : Fin (m + 2)) 1 0) (swap 0 1 1) = true
    rw [swap_apply_left, swap_apply_right]
    show decide ((0 : Fin (m + 2)) < 1) = true
    simp [h01]
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hij⟩ := p
    have hij' : i.val < j.val := hij
    show decide (swap (0 : Fin (m + 2)) 1 j < swap 0 1 i) = false
    apply decide_eq_false
    simp only [swap_apply]
    have hne : ¬ (i = 0 ∧ j = 1) := fun ⟨a, b⟩ => hp (Subtype.ext (Prod.ext a b))
    intro hlt
    have hlt' := hlt
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := fun h => by rw [h, hi0] at hij'; omega
      have hj1 : j ≠ 1 := fun h => hne ⟨hi0, h⟩
      simp only [hi0, hj0, hj1, ↓reduceIte] at hlt'
      have : j.val ≠ 1 := fun e => hj1 (Fin.ext (e.trans hv1.symm))
      have : j.val ≠ 0 := fun e => hj0 (Fin.ext (e.trans hv0.symm))
      have : j.val < (1 : Fin (m + 2)).val := hlt'
      omega
    · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
      · have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := fun h => by
          have := congrArg Fin.val h; have := congrArg Fin.val hi1; omega
        have hj1 : j ≠ 1 := fun h => by rw [h, hi1] at hij'; omega
        simp only [hi1, hj0, hj1, ↓reduceIte, show (1 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 from
          fun e => by have := congrArg Fin.val e; omega] at hlt'
        have : j.val < (0 : Fin (m + 2)).val := hlt'
        omega
      · have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := fun h => by have := congrArg Fin.val h; omega
        have hj1 : j ≠ 1 := fun h => by
          have h' := congrArg Fin.val h
          have : i.val ≠ 0 := fun e => hi0 (Fin.ext (e.trans hv0.symm))
          omega
        simp only [hi0, hi1, hj0, hj1, ↓reduceIte] at hlt'
        have : j.val < i.val := hlt'
        omega
Foundations.Topology.heine_borel:
/-- **Heine–Borel theorem.** Every closed interval `[a, b]` of real numbers is compact. -/
theorem heine_borel (a b : R) : IsCompact (Topology.metric R) (fun x => a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b) := by
  intro ι U hU hcov
  by_cases hab' : ¬ a ≤ b
  · exact ⟨[], fun x hx => absurd (Std.le_trans hx.1 hx.2) hab'⟩
  have hab : a ≤ b := Classical.not_not.1 hab'
  -- `P x`: `[a, x]` is covered by finitely many `U i`.
  let P : R → Prop := fun x => a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b ∧
    ∃ l : List ι, ∀ y, a ≤ y → y ≤ x → ∃ i, i ∈ l ∧ U i y
  have hPa : P a := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov a ⟨Std.le_refl a, hab⟩
    exact ⟨Std.le_refl a, hab, [i], fun y h1 h2 => ⟨i, List.mem_singleton.2 rfl,
      by rw [show y = a by grind]; exact hi⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := exists_lub P ⟨a, hPa⟩ ⟨b, fun x hx => hx.2.1⟩
  have hac : a ≤ c := hc1 a hPa
  have hcb : c ≤ b := hc2 b fun x hx => hx.2.1
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov c ⟨hac, hcb⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := hU i c hi
  -- Some `x` with `P x` lies within `ε` of `c`.
  obtain ⟨x, hPx, hx⟩ : ∃ x, P x ∧ c - ε < x := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
    have := hc2 (c - ε) fun y hy => by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h; exact hno ⟨y, hy, by grind⟩
    grind
  have hxc : x ≤ c := hc1 x hPx
  obtain ⟨-, -, l, hl⟩ := hPx
  -- Then `[a, c']` is covered for `c' = min (c + ε/2) b`.
  have hext : ∀ c', c' ≤ b → c' ≤ c + ε / 2 → a ≤ c' → P c' := fun c' h1 h2 h3 =>
    ⟨h3, h1, i :: l, fun y hy1 hy2 => by
      rcases (by grind : y ≤ x ∨ x < y) with h | h
      · obtain ⟨j, hj, hj'⟩ := hl y hy1 h; exact ⟨j, List.mem_cons_of_mem i hj, hj'⟩
      · exact ⟨i, List.mem_cons_self, hball y (by
          show abs (c - y) < ε; exact abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩)⟩⟩
  rcases (by grind : c + ε / 2 ≤ b ∨ b < c + ε / 2) with h | h
  · have := hc1 _ (hext (c + ε / 2) h (Std.le_refl _) (by grind)); grind
  · obtain ⟨-, -, l', hl'⟩ := hext b (Std.le_refl b) (Std.le_of_lt h) hab
    exact ⟨l', fun y hy => hl' y hy.1 hy.2⟩
Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_nth_root:
/-- **Existence of `n`-th roots.** Every non-negative real `x` has a non-negative `n`-th root
for each `n ≥ 1`. -/
theorem exists_nth_root {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ x) {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ r, 0 ≤ r ∧ r ^ n = x := by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have h0 : (0 : R) ^ (m + 1) = 0 := by rw [pow_succ']; grind
  have h1 : x + 1 ≤ (x + 1) ^ (m + 1) := by
    rw [pow_succ']
    have := one_le_pow (by grind : (1 : R) ≤ x + 1) m
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ x + 1)
    grind
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := intermediate_value' (f := fun y => y ^ (m + 1)) (a := 0)
    (b := x + 1) (v := x) (by grind) (fun y _ _ => continuousAt_pow (m + 1) y)
    (by show (0 : R) ^ (m + 1) ≤ x; rw [h0]; exact hx) (by show x ≤ (x + 1) ^ (m + 1); grind)
  exact ⟨c, hc1, hc3⟩

/-- **Permutation.** A permutation of a type `α` is a bijection `α → α`, recorded together

  toFun : α → α

  /-- `toFun` undoes `invFun`. -/
  right_inv : ∀ x, toFun (invFun x) = x

Foundations.Combinatorics.InfOften.enum:
/-- An infinitely-often predicate can be enumerated by a strictly increasing sequence. -/
theorem InfOften.enum {P : Nat → Prop} (h : InfOften P) :
    ∃ g : Nat → Nat, (∀ i, P (g i)) ∧ ∀ i j, i < j → g i < g j := by
  let next : Nat → Nat := fun N => Classical.choose (h N)
  have hnext : ∀ N, N ≤ next N ∧ P (next N) := fun N => Classical.choose_spec (h N)
  let g : Nat → Nat := fun i => Nat.rec (next 0) (fun _ x => next (x + 1)) i
  have hg : ∀ i, g (i + 1) = next (g i + 1) := fun _ => rfl
  refine ⟨g, fun i => ?_, fun i j hij => ?_⟩
  · cases i with
    | zero => exact (hnext 0).2
    | succ i => rw [hg]; exact (hnext _).2
  · induction hij with
    | refl => rw [hg]; have := (hnext (g i + 1)).1; omega
    | @step m _ ih => rw [hg]; have := (hnext (g m + 1)).1; omega

/-- **Baire, second form.** A non-empty complete metric space is not a countable union of
closed nowhere dense sets. -/
theorem not_countable_union_nowhereDense (hX : Complete X) (x₀ : X) {F : Nat → X → Prop}
    (hF : ∀ n, NowhereDenseClosed (F n)) : ¬ ∀ x, ∃ n, F n x := by
  intro hcov
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := baire hX (U := fun n x => ¬ F n x) (fun n => (hF n).1)
    (fun n x ε hε => by obtain ⟨y, h1, h2⟩ := (hF n).2 x ε hε; exact ⟨y, h2, h1⟩) x₀ 1 (by grind)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hcov y
  exact hy n hn

  Dom := Quotient (termSetoid hM)

theorem extends_antisymm {W V : PWO α} (h₁ : Extends W V) (h₂ : Extends V W) : W = V := by
  have hdom : W.dom = V.dom := funext fun x => propext ⟨h₁.1 x, h₂.1 x⟩

Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.recursion_theorem:
/-- **Dedekind's recursion theorem.** Let `a ∈ A` and let `g` map `A` into `A`.
Then there is exactly one function `F` from `ω` to `A` (a set of pairs) with
`F(∅) = a` and `F(succ n) = g(F(n))` for all `n ∈ ω`. -/
theorem recursion_theorem {A a : ZFSet} (ha : a ∈ A) (g : ZFSet → ZFSet)
    (hg : ∀ x ∈ A, g x ∈ A) :
    ∃ F, IsFunction F ω A ∧ app F ∅ = a ∧ (∀ n ∈ ω, app F (succ n) = g (app F n)) ∧
      ∀ G, IsFunction G ω A → app G ∅ = a → (∀ n ∈ ω, app G (succ n) = g (app G n)) →
        G = F := by
  have hF := recFun_isFunction ha hg
  have hcl := recFun_closed ha hg
  have h0 : app (recFun A a g) ∅ = a := app_eq hF hcl.1
  have hs : ∀ n ∈ ω, app (recFun A a g) (succ n) = g (app (recFun A a g) n) := fun n hn =>
    app_eq hF (hcl.2 n _ hn (app_spec hF hn))
  refine ⟨recFun A a g, hF, h0, hs, fun G hG hG0 hGs => function_ext hG hF ?_⟩
  refine omega_induction _ (hG0.trans h0.symm) fun n hn ih => ?_
  rw [hGs n hn, hs n hn, ih]
