Foundations.Topology.continuousAt_iff_se:
/-- **ε-δ continuity ⇔ sequential continuity** (Heine). -/
theorem continuousAt_iff_seq (f : X → Y) (x : X) : ContinuousAt f x ↔ SeqContinuousAt f x := by
  constructor
  · intro hf s hs ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hf ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hs δ hδ
    exact ⟨N, fun n hn => h _ (hN n hn)⟩
  · intro hf
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
    -- Otherwise some `ε` defeats every `δ = 1/(n+1)`.
    have : ∃ ε : R, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ n : Nat, ∃ y, dist y x < 1 / ((n : R) + 1) ∧ ε ≤ dist (f y) (f x) := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h'
      apply hno; intro ε hε
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h''
      apply h'; refine ⟨ε, hε, fun n => ?_⟩
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h3
      exact h'' ⟨1 / ((n : R) + 1), eps_pos n, fun y hy => by
        apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h4; exact h3 ⟨y, hy, by grind⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hy⟩ := this
    let s : Nat → X := fun n => (hy n).choose
    have hs : ∀ n, dist (s n) x < 1 / ((n : R) + 1) ∧ ε ≤ dist (f (s n)) (f x) :=
      fun n => (hy n).choose_spec
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hf s (converges_of_dist_lt fun n => (hs n).1) ε hε
    have := hN N (Nat.le_refl N); have := (hs N).2; grind
Foundations.Logic.Derives.weaken:
/-- **Weakening.** Adding premises never destroys a derivation. -/
theorem weaken {Γ φ} (h : Γ ⊢ φ) : ∀ {Δ}, Γ.Subset Δ → Δ ⊢ φ := by
  induction h with
  | hyp hφ => exact fun hs => hyp (hs _ hφ)
  | impI _ ih => exact fun hs => impI (ih (insert_mono hs _))
  | impE _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact fun hs => impE (ih₁ hs) (ih₂ hs)
  | conjI _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact fun hs => conjI (ih₁ hs) (ih₂ hs)
  | conjE₁ _ ih => exact fun hs => conjE₁ (ih hs)
  | conjE₂ _ ih => exact fun hs => conjE₂ (ih hs)
  | disjI₁ _ ih => exact fun hs => disjI₁ (ih hs)
  | disjI₂ _ ih => exact fun hs => disjI₂ (ih hs)
  | disjE _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
      exact fun hs => disjE (ih₁ hs) (ih₂ (insert_mono hs _)) (ih₃ (insert_mono hs _))
  | botE _ ih => exact fun hs => botE (ih hs)
  | raa _ ih => exact fun hs => raa (ih (insert_mono hs _))

/-- The fixed points of the conjugation action are exactly the central elements. -/
theorem ConjAct.isFixed_iff {G : Type u} [Group G] (z : G) :
    MulAction.IsFixed G (ConjAct.of z) ↔ z ∈ center G := by
  constructor
  · intro h g
    have : g * z * g⁻¹ = z := h g
    calc g * z = g * z * g⁻¹ * g := (inv_mul_cancel_right _ _).symm
      _ = z * g := by rw [this]

Foundations.Numbers.C.exp_add:
/-- **Functional equation of the complex exponential.** `exp (z + w) = exp z · exp w`. -/
theorem exp_add (z w : C) : exp (z + w) = exp z * exp w := by
  have hprod := (tendsto_exp z).mul (tendsto_exp w)
  -- `Pₙ(z + w)` differs from `Pₙ(z) Pₙ(w)` by `Tₙ(z, w)`, and `‖Tₙ(z, w)‖ ≤ Tₙ(‖z‖, ‖w‖) → 0`.
  have hbound : ∀ N, nrm (gsum (cterm (z + w)) N - gsum (cterm z) N * gsum (cterm w) N) ≤
      gsum (fun i => expTerm (nrm z) i * gsum (fun k => expTerm (nrm w) (N - i + k)) i) N := by
    intro N
    have hcp := gsum_exp_mul (α := C) cterm cterm_zero cterm_rec natCast_add_one_ne_zero z w N
    rw [hcp, show gsum (cterm (z + w)) N - (gsum (cterm (z + w)) N +
      gsum (fun i => cterm z i * gsum (fun k => cterm w (N - i + k)) i) N) =
      -gsum (fun i => cterm z i * gsum (fun k => cterm w (N - i + k)) i) N by grind]
    have hneg : ∀ u : C, nrm (-u) = nrm u := fun u => by
      unfold nrm; rw [neg_re, neg_im, R.abs_neg, R.abs_neg]
    rw [hneg, gsum_eq_fsum]
    refine Std.le_trans (nrm_gsum_le _ N) (fsum_le_fsum (fun i => ?_) N)
    refine Std.le_trans (nrm_mul _ _) ?_
    have k1 := nrm_cterm_le z i
    have k2 : nrm (gsum (fun k => cterm w (N - i + k)) i) ≤
        gsum (fun k => expTerm (nrm w) (N - i + k)) i := by
      rw [gsum_eq_fsum]
      exact Std.le_trans (nrm_gsum_le _ i) (fsum_le_fsum (fun k => nrm_cterm_le w _) i)
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right k1
      (nrm_nonneg (gsum (fun k => cterm w (N - i + k)) i))
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 (expTerm_nonneg (nrm_nonneg z) i)
    grind
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun N => nrm (gsum (cterm (z + w)) N -
      gsum (cterm z) N * gsum (cterm w) N)) 0 :=
    tendsto_of_abs_le (tendsto_exp_remainder (nrm z) (nrm w)) fun N => by
      rw [show nrm (gsum (cterm (z + w)) N - gsum (cterm z) N * gsum (cterm w) N) - 0 =
        nrm (gsum (cterm (z + w)) N - gsum (cterm z) N * gsum (cterm w) N) by grind,
        abs_of_nonneg (nrm_nonneg _)]
      exact hbound N
  exact (tendsto_exp (z + w)).unique (CTendsto.of_nrm_sub hprod hzero)

Foundations.Topology.brouwer_one_dim:
/-- **Brouwer's fixed-point theorem, dimension 1.** Every continuous map `f : [0, 1] → [0, 1]` has
a fixed point. -/
theorem brouwer_one_dim {f : R → R} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → R.ContinuousAt f x)
    (hmaps : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1) : ∃ x, 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1 ∧ f x = x := by
  -- Apply the intermediate value theorem to `g x = x − f x`, with `g 0 ≤ 0 ≤ g 1`.
  obtain ⟨c, h0, h1, hc⟩ := intermediate_value_connected (f := fun x => x - f x) (a := 0) (b := 1)
    (v := 0) (by grind) (fun x h0 h1 => continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_id x) (hf x h0 h1))
    (by have := hmaps 0 (Std.le_refl 0) (by grind); show 0 - f 0 ≤ 0; grind)
    (by have := hmaps 1 (by grind) (Std.le_refl 1); show 0 ≤ 1 - f 1; grind)

Foundations.Probability.FinProb.Var_sumN:
/-- **Bienaymé's identity**: the variance of a sum of pairwise uncorrelated random
variables is the sum of their variances. -/
theorem Var_sumN (n : Nat) (X : Nat → α → R) (h : ∀ i j, i < j → j < n → P.Uncorr (X i) (X j)) :
    P.Var (fun x => sumN n fun i => X i x) = sumN n fun i => P.Var (X i) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [sumN, List.range_zero, sumL_nil]
      rw [Var_eq]; simp only [E_const]; grind
  | succ n ih =>
      have hsplit : ∀ f : Nat → R, sumN (n + 1) f = sumN n f + f n := by
        intro f; simp only [sumN]; rw [List.range_succ, sumL_append]; simp; grind
      have : (fun x => sumN (n + 1) fun i => X i x) = fun x => (sumN n fun i => X i x) + X n x := by
        funext x; exact hsplit _
      rw [this, Var_add, ih fun i j hij hj => h i j hij (by omega), hsplit, Cov_sumN]
      have hz : (sumN n fun i => P.Cov (X i) (X n)) = 0 := by
        simp only [sumN]
        rw [sumL_congr (g := fun _ => 0) fun i hi => h i n (List.mem_range.1 hi) (by omega),
          sumL_zero]
      rw [hz]; grind

/-- Removing the index `j` from the selection. -/
theorem psum_remove (len : Nat → R) {P : Nat → Prop} {j N : Nat} (hj : j < N) (hP : P j) :
    psum len P N = psum len (fun k => P k ∧ k ≠ j) N + len j ∧
      pcnt P N = pcnt (fun k => P k ∧ k ≠ j) N + 1 := by
  induction N with
  | zero => omega
  | succ N ih =>
    show psum len P N + _ = psum len _ N + _ + len j ∧ pcnt P N + _ = pcnt _ N + _ + 1
    dsimp only
    by_cases e : j = N
    · subst e
      have h0 : ∀ M, M ≤ j → psum len (fun k => P k ∧ k ≠ j) M = psum len P M ∧
          pcnt (fun k => P k ∧ k ≠ j) M = pcnt P M := by
        intro M hM
        induction M with
        | zero => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        | succ M ihM =>
          obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := ihM (by omega)
          show psum len _ M + _ = psum len P M + _ ∧ pcnt _ M + _ = pcnt P M + _
          dsimp only
          rw [a1, a2]
          by_cases hM' : P M
          · rw [ite_pos' ⟨hM', by omega⟩, ite_pos' hM', ite_pos' ⟨hM', by omega⟩, ite_pos' hM']
            exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
          · rw [ite_neg' (fun h => hM' h.1), ite_neg' hM', ite_neg' (fun h => hM' h.1), ite_neg' hM']
            exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := h0 j (Nat.le_refl j)
      rw [b1, b2, ite_pos' hP, ite_pos' hP, ite_neg' (fun h => h.2 rfl), ite_neg' (fun h => h.2 rfl)]
      constructor <;> grind
    · obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := ih (by omega)
      rw [a1, a2]
      by_cases hN : P N
      · rw [ite_pos' hN, ite_pos' ⟨hN, fun h => e h.symm⟩, ite_pos' hN, ite_pos' ⟨hN, fun h => e h.symm⟩]
        constructor <;> grind
      · rw [ite_neg' hN, ite_neg' (fun h => hN h.1), ite_neg' hN, ite_neg' (fun h => hN h.1)]
        constructor <;> grind
Foundations.Logic.Computability.halting_:
/-- **Undecidability of the halting problem** (Turing 1936). There is no code `h`
that is total on (Gödel numbers of codes, inputs) and outputs `1` when `c` halts on
`x` and `0` when it does not. -/
theorem halting_undecidable :
    ¬ ∃ h : Code, ∀ (c : Code) (x : Nat),
      (Eval h [encode c, x] 0 ∨ Eval h [encode c, x] 1) ∧
      (Eval h [encode c, x] 1 ↔ Halts c [x]) := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  refine no_code_zero_iff_not_halts ⟨h, fun c x => ⟨fun h0 hc => ?_, fun hc => ?_⟩⟩
  · have := Eval.det h0 ((hh c x).2.2 hc); omega
  · rcases (hh c x).1 with h0 | h1
    · exact h0
    · exact absurd ((hh c x).2.1 h1) hc
Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_sqrt_two:
/-- **Existence of √2.** There is a positive real number whose square is `2`. -/
theorem exists_sqrt_two : ∃ r : R, 0 < r ∧ r * r = 2 := by
  let P : Q → Prop := fun q => 2 ≤ q * q
  have hl : ¬ P 1 := by show ¬ (2 : Q) ≤ 1 * 1; grind
  have hu : P 2 := by show (2 : Q) ≤ 2 * 2; grind
  have hlu : (1 : Q) ≤ 2 := by grind
  let lo := Bisect.loSeq hl hu hlu
  let hi := Bisect.hiSeq hl hu hlu
  -- All left endpoints are at least `1`, all right endpoints at most `2`.
  have hbounds : ∀ n, 1 ≤ Bisect.lo P 1 2 n ∧ Bisect.hi P 1 2 n ≤ 2 ∧
      Bisect.lo P 1 2 n ≤ Bisect.hi P 1 2 n ∧ Bisect.lo P 1 2 n * Bisect.lo P 1 2 n < 2 ∧
      2 ≤ Bisect.hi P 1 2 n * Bisect.hi P 1 2 n := by
    intro n
    have h1 := Bisect.nested hl hu hlu (Nat.zero_le n)
    have h2 := Bisect.spec hl hu hlu n
    have e1 : Bisect.lo P 1 2 0 = 1 := rfl
    have e2 : Bisect.hi P 1 2 0 = 2 := rfl
    refine ⟨by grind, by grind, h2.2.2.1, ?_, h2.2.1⟩
    have := h2.1
    simp only [P] at this; grind
  refine ⟨mk hi, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- `√2 ≥ 1 > 0`.
    have : ofQ 1 ≤ mk hi := le_of_eventually_le ⟨0, fun n _ => by
      have := hbounds n
      show 1 ≤ Bisect.hi P 1 2 n
      grind⟩
    have h1 : (0 : R) < ofQ 1 := ofQ_lt.2 (by grind)
    grind
  · -- `hiₙ² − 2` is squeezed between `0` and `4 (hiₙ − loₙ)`, which tends to `0`.
    rw [mk_mul, ofNat_def]
    show mk _ = mk (const 2)
    rw [mk_eq_mk]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Bisect.width_small hl hu hlu (ε := ε / 4) (by grind)
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have hb := hbounds n
    have hnest := Bisect.nested hl hu hlu hn
    have k : (Bisect.hi P 1 2 n - Bisect.lo P 1 2 n) * (Bisect.hi P 1 2 n + Bisect.lo P 1 2 n) ≤
        (Bisect.hi P 1 2 n - Bisect.lo P 1 2 n) * 4 :=
      OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by grind) (by grind)
    show abs (Bisect.hi P 1 2 n * Bisect.hi P 1 2 n - 2) < ε
    apply abs_lt.2
    constructor <;> grind
Foundations.Numbers.R.pos_mul:
/-- The product of positive reals is positive. -/
theorem pos_mul {x y : R} : Pos x → Pos y → Pos (x * y) := by
  induction x using ind with | h a => ?_
  induction y using ind with | h b => ?_
  rintro ⟨ε₁, h₁, N₁, hN₁⟩ ⟨ε₂, h₂, N₂, hN₂⟩
  refine ⟨ε₁ * ε₂, OrderedRing.mul_pos h₁ h₂, max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have ha := hN₁ n (by omega); have hb := hN₂ n (by omega)
  simp only [mul_apply]
  have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha (Q.le_of_lt' h₂)
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by grind : (0 : Q) ≤ a n)
  grind
Foundations.Logic.eliminate_rows:
/-- **Eliminating row hypotheses.** If `φ` is derivable from `Γ` together with the
row hypotheses for every valuation, it is derivable from `Γ` alone. Proved by
removing one atom at a time with the excluded middle. -/
theorem eliminate_rows {Γ : Theory} {φ : Formula} :
    ∀ L : List Nat, (∀ v, Γ.union (rowHyps v L) ⊢ φ) → Γ ⊢ φ
  | [], h => (h fun _ => false).weaken fun ψ hψ => by
      rcases hψ with hψ | ⟨p, hp, _⟩
      · exact hψ
      · simp at hp
  | p :: L, h => by
      apply eliminate_rows L
      intro v
      -- Merge the two rows differing only at `p`.
      have key : ∀ b : Bool, (Γ.union (rowHyps v L)).insert (signed b (var p)) ⊢ φ := by
        intro b
        refine (h (Valuation.update v p b)).weaken ?_
        rintro ψ (hψ | ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hψ)
        · by_cases hqp : q = p
          · subst hqp; left; simp [Valuation.update]
          · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq
            · exact absurd rfl hqp
            · right; right; exact ⟨q, hq, by simp [Valuation.update, hqp]⟩
      exact Derives.byCases (key true) (key false)

Foundations.Sets.dedekindInfinite_of_nat:
/-- A type containing a copy of `ℕ` is Dedekind-infinite: shift the copy along. -/
theorem dedekindInfinite_of_nat_le {α : Sort u} (h : CardLE Nat α) : DedekindInfinite α := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h
  let f : α → α := fun x => if hx : ∃ n, e n = x then e (Classical.choose hx + 1) else x
  have hfe : ∀ n, f (e n) = e (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    have hx : ∃ m, e m = e n := ⟨n, rfl⟩
    simp only [f, hx, ↓reduceDIte]
    rw [he (Classical.choose_spec hx)]
  refine ⟨f, fun x y hxy => ?_, fun hs => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hx : ∃ n, e n = x <;> by_cases hy : ∃ n, e n = y
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [hfe, hfe] at hxy
      rw [show m = n by have := he hxy; omega]
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hx
      simp only [f, hy, ↓reduceDIte, hfe] at hxy
      exact absurd ⟨m + 1, hxy⟩ hy
    · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hy
      simp only [f, hx, ↓reduceDIte, hfe] at hxy
      exact absurd ⟨n + 1, hxy.symm⟩ hx
    · simpa only [f, hx, hy, ↓reduceDIte] using hxy
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs (e 0)
    by_cases hx' : ∃ n, e n = x
    · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hx'
      rw [hfe] at hx
      exact absurd (he hx) (by omega)
    · simp only [f, hx', ↓reduceDIte] at hx
      exact hx' ⟨0, hx.symm⟩

theorem tendsto_of_abs_le {a b : Nat → R} {L : R} (hb : Tendsto b 0)
    (h : ∀ n, abs (a n - L) ≤ b n) : Tendsto a L := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hb ε hε
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have := abs_lt.1 (hN n hn)
  have := h n
  grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.EvalB.mono:
/-- Bounded evaluation is monotone in the bound. -/
theorem EvalB.mono {w w' : Nat} (hw : w ≤ w') :
    ∀ {c : Code} {xs : List Nat} {y : Nat}, EvalB w c xs y → EvalB w' c xs y
  | .zero, _, _, h => h
  | .succ, _, _, h => h
  | .proj _, _, _, h => h
  | @Code.comp _ f gs, _, _, h => by
      obtain ⟨vs, hb, hg, hf⟩ := h
      exact ⟨vs, fun i => Nat.le_trans (hb i) hw, fun i => EvalB.mono hw (hg i), EvalB.mono hw hf⟩
  | .prec _ _, [], _, h => h.elim
  | .prec f g, m :: rest, y, h => by
      obtain ⟨A, hA, B, hB, ⟨⟨r, hr, e, hf⟩, hs⟩, hy⟩ := h
      refine ⟨A, by omega, B, by omega, ⟨⟨r, by omega, e, EvalB.mono hw hf⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩, hy⟩
      obtain ⟨u, hu, z, hz, e', hg⟩ := hs j hj
      exact ⟨u, by omega, z, by omega, e', EvalB.mono hw hg⟩
  | .mu f, xs, y, h => by
      obtain ⟨h₀, hlt⟩ := h
      refine ⟨EvalB.mono hw h₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hz', hz0⟩ := hlt m hm
      exact ⟨z, by omega, EvalB.mono hw hz', hz0⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.one_div_le_one_div:
/-- Taking reciprocals reverses the order of positive numbers. -/
theorem one_div_le_one_div {a b : R} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) : 1 / b ≤ 1 / a := by
  have hb : 0 < b := by grind
  have i1 := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show a ≠ 0 by grind)
  have i2 := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show b ≠ 0 by grind)
  have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab
    (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 ha))
      (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hb)))
  have e1 : a * (a⁻¹ * b⁻¹) = b⁻¹ := by rw [← Semiring.mul_assoc, i1, Semiring.one_mul]
  have e2 : b * (a⁻¹ * b⁻¹) = a⁻¹ := by
    rw [CommSemiring.mul_comm a⁻¹, ← Semiring.mul_assoc, i2, Semiring.one_mul]
  rw [e1, e2] at this
  rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Semiring.one_mul, Semiring.one_mul]
  exact this

/-- A strongly normalizing term has a normal form. The proof is constructive: at
each stage `step?` decides whether a further step is possible. -/
theorem SN.normalizes {t : Term} (h : SN t) : ∃ n, Red t n ∧ Normal n := by
  induction h with
  | intro t _ ih =>
    cases hs : step? t with
    | some t' =>
      have ht' := step?_sound _ _ hs
      obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := ih t' ht'
      exact ⟨n, Star.head ht' hn, hn'⟩
    | none => exact ⟨t, Star.refl t, (normal_iff_step?_none t).2 hs⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_mvt_point:
/-- On each piece `[a, x]` the increment of `F` is a value of `F'` times the length (mean value
theorem, also for degenerate pieces). -/
theorem exists_mvt_point {F f : R → R} {a x : R} (hax : a ≤ x)
    (hd : ∀ t, a ≤ t → t ≤ x → HasDerivAt F (f t) t) :
    ∃ c, a ≤ c ∧ c ≤ x ∧ F x - F a = f c * (x - a) := by
  rcases (by grind : a = x ∨ a < x) with h | h
  · subst h; exact ⟨a, Std.le_refl a, Std.le_refl a, by grind⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, h1, h2, h3⟩ := mean_value (f' := f) h
      (fun t h1 h2 => (hd t h1 h2).continuousAt) (fun t h1 h2 => hd t (by grind) (by grind))
    exact ⟨c, by grind, by grind, h3⟩
Foundations.Algebra.Group:
/-- **Group.** A group is a type `G` with a multiplication, a distinguished element `1`
and an inversion `a ↦ a⁻¹`, such that multiplication is associative, `1` is a left
identity and `a⁻¹` is a left inverse of `a`. (The right-handed versions are theorems,
proved below.) -/
class Group (G : Type u) extends Mul G, One G, Inv G where
  /-- Multiplication is associative. -/
  mul_assoc : ∀ a b c : G, a * b * c = a * (b * c)
  /-- `1` is a left identity. -/
  one_mul : ∀ a : G, 1 * a = a
  /-- `a⁻¹` is a left inverse of `a`. -/
  inv_mul_cancel : ∀ a : G, a⁻¹ * a = 1

/-- Codes of pairs below `V` are below `V²`. -/
theorem code_lt {x y V : Nat} (hxy : x < y) (hy : y < V) : y * y + x < V * V := by
  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (show y + 1 ≤ V by omega) (show y + 1 ≤ V by omega)
  have : (y + 1) * (y + 1) = y * y + y + y + 1 := by rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_succ]; omega
  omega

Foundations.Numbers.R.rsum_add:
/-- Riemann sums are additive in the function. -/
theorem rsum_add (f g : R → R) (a : R) (l : List (R × R)) :
    rsum (fun y => f y + g y) a l = rsum f a l + rsum g a l := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => show (0 : R) = 0 + 0; grind
  | cons p l ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p
    show (f t + g t) * (x - a) + rsum (fun y => f y + g y) x l =
      f t * (x - a) + rsum f x l + (g t * (x - a) + rsum g x l)
    rw [ih]; grind

Foundations.Algebra.exists_nontrivial_so:
/-- **Homogeneous systems with more unknowns than equations have non-zero solutions**
(Gaussian elimination). For an `m × n` system `∑ⱼ aᵢⱼ xⱼ = 0` over a field with `m < n`
there is a solution `x ≠ 0`. -/
theorem exists_nontrivial_solution {K : Type u} [CommRing K] (hF : IsField K) :
    ∀ (n m : Nat) (a : Fin m → Fin n → K), m < n →
      ∃ x : Fin n → K, (∃ j, x j ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ i, isum (fun j => a i j * x j) = 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro m _ h; omega
  | succ k ih =>
    intro m a hmn
    by_cases hcol : ∀ i, a i 0 = 0
    · refine ⟨tcons 1 (fun _ => 0), ⟨0, fun h => hF.1 h.symm⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [isum_fin_succ]
      show a i 0 * 1 + isum (fun j : Fin k => a i j.succ * 0) = 0
      rw [hcol i, Ring.zero_mul, Ring.zero_add]
      exact isum_eq_zero fun j => Ring.mul_zero _
    · have : ∃ p, a p 0 ≠ 0 := by
        apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
        exact hcol fun i => Classical.byContradiction fun h => hno ⟨i, h⟩
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := this
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hF.2 _ hp
      obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by have := p.isLt; omega⟩
      let a' : Fin m' → Fin k → K := fun i j =>
        a (skip p i) j.succ + -(a (skip p i) 0 * t) * a p j.succ
      obtain ⟨y, ⟨j0, hj0⟩, hy⟩ := ih m' a' (by omega)
      let S := isum (fun j : Fin k => a p j.succ * y j)
      refine ⟨tcons (-(t * S)) y, ⟨j0.succ, hj0⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [isum_fin_succ]
      show a i 0 * -(t * S) + isum (fun j : Fin k => a i j.succ * y j) = 0
      by_cases hip : i = p
      · subst hip
        rw [Ring.mul_neg, ← Ring.mul_assoc, ht, Ring.one_mul, Ring.neg_add_cancel]
      · obtain ⟨i', rfl⟩ := skip_surj p i hip
        have h1 := hy i'
        have e : isum (fun j => a' i' j * y j) =
            isum (fun j : Fin k => a (skip p i') j.succ * y j) + -(a (skip p i') 0 * t) * S := by
          rw [isum_mul_left, ← isum_add]
          congr 1; funext j
          show (a (skip p i') j.succ + -(a (skip p i') 0 * t) * a p j.succ) * y j = _
          rw [Ring.right_distrib, Ring.mul_assoc]
        rw [e] at h1
        rw [Ring.mul_neg, Ring.add_comm, ← h1, Ring.neg_mul, Ring.mul_assoc]

/-- **Comparison of notations**, lexicographic: first the leading exponents, then the
remainders. -/
def cmp : ON → ON → Ordering
  | zero, zero => .eq
  | zero, oadd _ _ => .lt
  | oadd _ _, zero => .gt
  | oadd a b, oadd a' b' =>
      match cmp a a' with
      | .eq => cmp b b'
      | o => o
Foundations.Numbers.CauSeq.abs_le_sumAbs:
/-- Each `|a k|` with `k ≤ N` is bounded by `|a 0| + ⋯ + |a N|`. -/
theorem abs_le_sumAbs (a : Nat → Q) {k N : Nat} (h : k ≤ N) : abs (a k) ≤ sumAbs a N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => have : k = 0 := by omega
            subst this; exact Q.le_refl _
  | succ N ih =>
    have := abs_nonneg (a (N + 1))
    simp only [sumAbs]
    by_cases hk : k ≤ N
    · have := ih hk; grind
    · have : k = N + 1 := by omega
      subst this; have := sumAbs_nonneg a N; grind

/-- Multiplying a sum on the right (in a commutative ring). -/
theorem isum_mul_right {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [FiniteType ι] (f : ι → R) (c : R) :
    isum f * c = isum (fun i => f i * c) := by
  rw [CommRing.mul_comm, isum_mul_left]; congr 1; funext i; exact CommRing.mul_comm _ _
Foundations.Numbers.Q.inv_inv:
/-- Inversion is an involution: `(x⁻¹)⁻¹ = x`. -/
theorem inv_inv (x : Q) : x⁻¹⁻¹ = x := by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [hx, inv_zero, inv_zero]
  · have h1 := mul_inv_cancel hx
    have hx' : x⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at h1; exact zero_ne_one h1
    have h2 := mul_inv_cancel hx'
    calc x⁻¹⁻¹ = (x * x⁻¹) * x⁻¹⁻¹ := by rw [h1, one_mul]
      _ = x * (x⁻¹ * x⁻¹⁻¹) := mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = x := by rw [h2, mul_one]
Foundations.Logic.FO.fresh_substL:
/-- A list substitution into a formula whose free variables are among the first
`ts.length` avoids `y` if all the substituted terms do. -/
theorem fresh_substL {φ : Formula Arith} {m : Nat} (hφ : ∀ n, m ≤ n → φ.Fresh n)
    {ts : List (Term Arith)} (hlen : m ≤ ts.length) {y : Nat} (hts : ∀ t ∈ ts, t.Fresh y) :
    (substL ts φ).Fresh y := by
  refine Formula.fresh_subst_of φ fun n hn => ?_
  have : n < ts.length := Classical.byContradiction fun h => hn (hφ n (by omega))
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem this]
  exact hts _ (List.getElem_mem this)
Foundations.Numbers.R.iterD_nivenC_isInt:
/-- **All derivatives of `f` at `0` are integers.** -/
theorem iterD_nivenC_isInt {a b : R} (ha : IsInt a) (hb : IsInt b) (n m : Nat) :
    IsInt (iterD m (nivenC a b n) 0) := by
  have h := fact_mul_iterD (nivenC a b n) m 0
  rw [Nat.zero_add, show fact 0 = 1 from rfl] at h
  have e : iterD m (nivenC a b n) 0 = (fact m : R) * nivenC a b n m := by grind
  rw [e]; unfold nivenC
  by_cases hm : n ≤ m
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := fact_dvd_fact hm
    have : (fact m : R) = (fact n : R) * (r : R) := by rw [hr]; grind
    rw [this]
    have := fact_pos' n
    have e2 : (fact n : R) * (r : R) * (nivenH a b n m / (fact n : R)) = (r : R) * nivenH a b n m := by
      grind
    rw [e2]; exact (isInt_natCast r).mul (nivenH_isInt ha hb n m)
  · unfold nivenH; rw [show (if n ≤ m then linPow a b n (m - n) else 0) = 0 by split <;> first | omega | rfl]
    exact ⟨0, by grind⟩

  induction A with
  | tvar n => intros; exact Iff.rfl

/-- Iterated tails of an encoded list. -/
theorem ldrop_encList (l : List Nat) : ∀ i, ldrop (encList l) i = encList (l.drop i)
  | 0 => rfl
  | i + 1 => by
      simp only [ldrop, ldrop_encList l i]
      cases h : l.drop i with
      | nil =>
          have : l.drop (i + 1) = [] := by
            rw [← List.drop_drop]; simp [h]
          rw [this]; rfl
      | cons x t =>
          have : l.drop (i + 1) = t := by
            rw [← List.drop_drop, h]; rfl
          rw [this]; exact ltail_cons x t
Foundations.Algebra.gaussMu_two:
/-- For `a = 2`, Gauss's count is `h - ⌊h/2⌋` with `h = (p-1)/2`. -/
theorem gaussMu_two {p : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) :
    gaussMu 2 p = half p - half p / 2 := by
  have ⟨_, _, h3⟩ := half_spec hp hodd
  unfold gaussMu
  rw [← countP_range_ge (half p / 2) (half p)]
  apply List.countP_congr
  intro k hk
  rw [List.mem_range] at hk
  unfold res
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
  omega

Foundations.Topology.isClosed_of_seq:
/-- Conversely, a set containing the limits of all its convergent sequences is closed. -/
theorem isClosed_of_seq {F : X → Prop}
    (h : ∀ (s : Nat → X) (L : X), (∀ n, F (s n)) → Converges s L → F L) : IsClosed F := by
  intro x hx
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
  have hpt : ∀ n : Nat, ∃ y, dist x y < 1 / ((n : R) + 1) ∧ F y := fun n => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h'
    exact hno ⟨1 / ((n : R) + 1), eps_pos n, fun y hy => fun hy' => h' ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩⟩
  let s : Nat → X := fun n => (hpt n).choose
  have hs : ∀ n, dist x (s n) < 1 / ((n : R) + 1) ∧ F (s n) := fun n => (hpt n).choose_spec
  exact hx (h s x (fun n => (hs n).2) (converges_of_dist_lt fun n => by
    rw [dist_comm]; exact (hs n).1))
Foundations.Algebra.MulAction.smul_eq_sm:
/-- `g • x = h • x` exactly when `h⁻¹ * g` stabilises `x`: the elements sending `x` to a given
point form a left coset of the stabiliser. -/
theorem smul_eq_smul_iff (g h : G) (x : X) :
    g • x = h • x ↔ leftCoset h (stabilizer G x) g := by
  show g • x = h • x ↔ (h⁻¹ * g) • x = x
  rw [mul_smul]
  constructor
  · intro e; rw [e, inv_smul_smul]
  · intro e; rw [← smul_inv_smul h (g • x), e]

Foundations.Numbers.C.exists_min_on_squa:
/-- **Two-dimensional extreme value theorem.** A non-negative function `g : ℂ → ℝ`, continuous
everywhere, attains its minimum on every closed square `|re z|, |im z| ≤ ρ`. -/
theorem exists_min_on_square {g : C → R} {ρ : R} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hg0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ g z)
    (hg : ∀ z₀, ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ z, cabs (z - z₀) < δ → abs (g z - g z₀) < ε) :
    ∃ zs, InSq ρ zs ∧ ∀ z, InSq ρ z → g zs ≤ g z := by
  have h0 : InSq ρ 0 := ⟨by rw [zero_re, R.abs_zero]; exact hρ, by rw [zero_im, R.abs_zero]; exact hρ⟩
  -- The infimum `m` of `g` over the square.
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := exists_lub (fun x => ∃ z, InSq ρ z ∧ x = -g z) ⟨_, 0, h0, rfl⟩
    ⟨0, fun x ⟨z, _, hx⟩ => by have := hg0 z; grind⟩
  have hm : ∀ z, InSq ρ z → -L ≤ g z := fun z hz => by have := hL1 _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩; grind
  have hx : ∀ n : Nat, ∃ z, InSq ρ z ∧ g z < -L + 1 / ((n : R) + 1) := fun n => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
    have := hL2 (L - 1 / ((n : R) + 1)) fun x ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩ => by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h; exact hno ⟨z, hz, by grind⟩
    have := eps_pos n; grind
  let zs : Nat → C := fun n => (hx n).choose
  have hzs : ∀ n, InSq ρ (zs n) ∧ g (zs n) < -L + 1 / ((n : R) + 1) := fun n => (hx n).choose_spec
  have bnd : ∀ n, abs (zs n).re ≤ ρ ∧ abs (zs n).im ≤ ρ := fun n => (hzs n).1
  -- Bolzano–Weierstrass twice.
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, x, hxlim⟩ := bolzano_weierstrass (a := fun n => (zs n).re) ⟨ρ, fun n => (bnd n).1⟩
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, y, hylim⟩ := bolzano_weierstrass (a := fun k => (zs (φ k)).im)
    ⟨ρ, fun k => (bnd (φ k)).2⟩
  let χ : Nat → Nat := fun k => φ (ψ k)
  have hχ : ∀ k, χ k < χ (k + 1) := fun k => strictMono_lt hφ (hψ k)
  have hxlim' : Tendsto (fun k => (zs (χ k)).re) x := tendsto_subseq hxlim hψ
  let zstar : C := ⟨x, y⟩
  have hin : InSq ρ zstar := by
    constructor
    · show abs x ≤ ρ
      exact abs_le.2 ⟨le_of_tendsto hxlim fun k => (abs_le.1 (bnd (φ k)).1).1,
        tendsto_le hxlim fun k => (abs_le.1 (bnd (φ k)).1).2⟩
    · show abs y ≤ ρ
      exact abs_le.2 ⟨le_of_tendsto hylim fun k => (abs_le.1 (bnd (φ (ψ k))).2).1,
        tendsto_le hylim fun k => (abs_le.1 (bnd (φ (ψ k))).2).2⟩
  -- By continuity, `g (zs (χ k)) → g z*`; by construction, `g (zs (χ k)) → m`.
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun k => g (zs (χ k))) (g zstar) := fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := hg zstar ε hε
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hxlim' (δ / 2) (by grind)
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := hylim (δ / 2) (by grind)
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun k hk => hδ' _ ?_⟩
    have k1 := hN₁ k (by omega)
    have k2 : abs ((zs (φ (ψ k))).im - y) < δ / 2 := hN₂ k (by omega)
    have := cabs_le_nrm (zs (χ k) - zstar)
    unfold nrm at this
    have e1 : (zs (χ k) - zstar).re = (zs (χ k)).re - x := by
      show (zs (χ k) + -zstar).re = _; simp only [add_re, neg_re]; grind
    have e2 : (zs (χ k) - zstar).im = (zs (χ k)).im - y := by
      show (zs (χ k) + -zstar).im = _; simp only [add_im, neg_im]; grind
    rw [e1, e2] at this
    have k1' : abs ((zs (χ k)).re - x) < δ / 2 := k1
    have k2' : abs ((zs (χ k)).im - y) < δ / 2 := k2
    grind
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun k => g (zs (χ k))) (-L) := fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eps_small hε
    refine ⟨N, fun k hk => abs_lt.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have := hm _ (hzs (χ k)).1; grind
    · have := (hzs (χ k)).2
      have := hN (χ k) (by have := le_of_strictMono hχ k; omega)
      grind
  have heq := tendsto_unique h1 h2
  exact ⟨zstar, hin, fun z hz => by rw [heq]; exact hm z hz⟩

Foundations.Geometry.Klein.ch_mul_self:

theorem ch_mul_self {a b : Pt R} (ha : n2 a < 1) (hb : n2 b < 1) : ch a b * ch a b = inv a b := by
  obtain ⟨sa, ea⟩ := s_spec ha
  obtain ⟨sb, eb⟩ := s_spec hb
  unfold ch inv
  rw [← ea, ← eb]

Foundations.Logic.lindenbaum_finite:
/-- Any finite list of members of the union lies in a single stage. -/
theorem lindenbaum_finite (Γ : Theory) :
    ∀ L : List Formula, (∀ ψ ∈ L, lindenbaum Γ ψ) → ∃ n, ∀ ψ ∈ L, stage Γ n ψ
  | [], _ => ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | ψ :: L, h => by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h ψ (by simp)
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := lindenbaum_finite Γ L (fun χ hχ => h χ (by simp [hχ]))
      refine ⟨max m n, fun χ hχ => ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hχ with rfl | hχ
      · exact stage_mono Γ (Nat.le_max_left _ _) _ hm
      · exact stage_mono Γ (Nat.le_max_right _ _) _ (hn χ hχ)

/-- **Reindexing** a product along a bijection. -/
theorem iprod_comp_bij {ι : Type} [FiniteType ι] (e : ι → ι) (inj : ∀ a b, e a = e b → a = b)
    (surj : ∀ y, ∃ x, e x = y) (f : ι → R) : iprod (fun i => f (e i)) = iprod f := by
  unfold iprod

    (h₁ : ∀ a, RED A a → RED C (inst u₁ a)) (h₂ : ∀ b, RED B b → RED C (inst u₂ b)) :

Foundations.Algebra.cayley_finite:
/-- **Cayley's theorem for finite groups.** A finite group of order `n` embeds into the
symmetric group `Sₙ = Perm (Fin n)`: there is an injective homomorphism
`G →* Perm (Fin (card G))`. -/
theorem cayley_finite [FiniteType G] :
    ∃ f : G →* Perm (Fin (card G)), ∀ a b, f a = f b → a = b := by
  let T := Perm.conjHom (toFin (α := G)) ofFin ofFin_toFin toFin_ofFin
  refine ⟨T.comp (leftRegular G), ?_⟩
  intro a b h
  exact leftRegular_injective a b
    (Perm.conjHom_injective _ _ ofFin_toFin toFin_ofFin _ _ h)

Foundations.Algebra.MulAction.count_smul:
/-- Counting by fibres: for any part `Q` of the orbit of `x`, the number of `g` with
`g • x ∈ Q` is `|Q| · |Stab x|`. Proved by removing one point of `Q` at a time. -/
theorem count_smul_mem (x : X) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (Q : X → Prop), count Q = n → (∀ y, Q y → orbit G x y) →
      count (fun g : G => Q (g • x)) = n * count (· ∈ stabilizer G x) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro Q hQ _
    rw [Nat.zero_mul, count_eq_zero]
    intro g hg
    exact count_eq_zero.1 hQ _ hg
  | succ n ih =>
    intro Q hQ hsub
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := count_pos.1 (by omega : 0 < count Q)
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hsub y hy
    have hsplit := count_split Q (· = h • x)
    rw [count_congr (P := fun z => Q z ∧ z = h • x) (Q := fun z => z = h • x)
      (fun z => ⟨fun hz => hz.2, fun hz => ⟨hz ▸ hy, hz⟩⟩), count_eq_self] at hsplit
    have hrest := ih (fun z => Q z ∧ ¬ z = h • x) (by omega) (fun z hz => hsub z hz.1)
    have hsplit' := count_split (fun g : G => Q (g • x)) (fun g => g • x = h • x)
    rw [count_congr (P := fun g : G => Q (g • x) ∧ g • x = h • x)
      (Q := fun g : G => g • x = h • x)
      (fun g => ⟨fun hg => hg.2, fun hg => ⟨hg ▸ hy, hg⟩⟩), count_fibre] at hsplit'
    rw [hsplit', hrest, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm]

/-- `≤` on the rationals is antisymmetric. -/

Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.arith_induc:
/-- **Induction over arithmetic formulas** (the language has no relation symbols
besides equality). -/
theorem Formula.arith_induction {P : Formula Arith → Prop} (hb : P bot)
    (he : ∀ t s, P (eq t s)) (hi : ∀ φ ψ, P φ → P ψ → P (imp φ ψ))
    (hc : ∀ φ ψ, P φ → P ψ → P (conj φ ψ)) (hd : ∀ φ ψ, P φ → P ψ → P (disj φ ψ))
    (ha : ∀ φ, P φ → P (all φ)) (hx : ∀ φ, P φ → P (ex φ)) : ∀ φ, P φ
  | .bot => hb
  | .eq t s => he t s
  | .rel R _ => (R : Empty).elim
  | .imp φ ψ => hi _ _ (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx φ)
      (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx ψ)
  | .conj φ ψ => hc _ _ (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx φ)
      (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx ψ)
  | .disj φ ψ => hd _ _ (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx φ)
      (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx ψ)
  | .all φ => ha _ (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx φ)
  | .ex φ => hx _ (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx φ)

Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.subst_subst:
/-- **Composition of substitutions (formulas).** `φ[τ][σ] = φ[n ↦ (τ n)[σ]]`, also
under binders. -/
theorem subst_subst : ∀ (φ : Formula L) (σ τ : Nat → Term L),
    (φ.subst τ).subst σ = φ.subst (fun n => (τ n).subst σ)
  | bot, _, _ => rfl
  | eq t s, σ, τ => by simp [subst, Term.subst_subst]
  | rel R ts, σ, τ => by simp [subst, Term.subst_subst]
  | imp φ ψ, σ, τ => by simp [subst, subst_subst φ, subst_subst ψ]
  | conj φ ψ, σ, τ => by simp [subst, subst_subst φ, subst_subst ψ]
  | disj φ ψ, σ, τ => by simp [subst, subst_subst φ, subst_subst ψ]
  | all φ, σ, τ => by simp only [subst, subst_subst φ, Subst.lift_comp]
  | ex φ, σ, τ => by simp only [subst, subst_subst φ, Subst.lift_comp]
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.regularity:
/-- **Regularity, in its classical form.** Every non-empty set `x` has an
∈-minimal member: some `y ∈ x` sharing no member with `x`. -/
theorem regularity (x : ZFSet) (hx : ∃ z, z ∈ x) : ∃ y ∈ x, ∀ z ∈ y, z ∉ x := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hne
  have key : ∀ y, y ∉ x := by
    refine mem_induction (fun y => y ∉ x) (fun y ih hy => hne ⟨y, hy, fun z hz hzx => ?_⟩)
    exact ih z hz hzx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
  exact key z hz

Foundations.Numbers.R.hasDerivAt_log:
/-- **The derivative of the logarithm.** `log' y = 1/y` for `y > 0`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_log {y : R} (hy : 0 < y) : HasDerivAt log (1 / y) y := fun ε hε => by
  -- The quadratic estimate `|exp k − 1 − k| ≤ C k²` with `C = exp 1 / 2`.
  let C := exp 1 / 2
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by have := exp_pos 1; grind
  have quad : ∀ k : R, abs k ≤ 1 → abs (exp k - 1 - k) ≤ C * (abs k * abs k) := fun k hk => by
    have := abs_exp_sub_le (x := 0) (y := k) (by rw [show k - 0 = k by grind]; exact hk)
    rw [exp_zero, abs_zero, show k - 0 = k by grind, show (0 : R) + 1 = 1 by grind] at this
    grind
  -- Choose how close `log z` must be to `log y`.
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hη₁a, hη₁b⟩ := exists_pos_le_both (by grind : (0 : R) < 1)
    (div_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < 1) (by grind : 0 < 2 * C + 1))
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηa, hηb⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hη₁
    (div_pos (OrderedRing.mul_pos hε hy) (by grind : 0 < 2 * C + 1))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := log_continuous hy hη
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hzpos, hk⟩ := hδ' z hz
  let k := log z - log y
  have hK := abs_nonneg k
  -- `z = y · exp k`.
  have hzk : z = y * exp k := by
    rw [show k = log z + -log y by grind, exp_add, ← exp_log hzpos]
    have := exp_mul_exp_neg (log y); rw [exp_log hy] at this; rw [log_exp]; grind
  have hq := quad k (by grind)
  clear quad hδ'
  -- `C |k| ≤ 1/2` and `C |k| ≤ ε y / 2`.
  have t1 : 2 * C + 1 ≠ 0 := by grind
  have c1 : C * abs k ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show abs k ≤ 1 / (2 * C + 1) by grind) hC
    have e : (2 * C + 1) * (1 / (2 * C + 1)) = 1 := by grind
    have := div_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < 1) (by grind : 0 < 2 * C + 1)
    grind
  have c2 : C * abs k ≤ ε * y / 2 := by
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (show abs k ≤ ε * y / (2 * C + 1) by grind) hC
    have e : (2 * C + 1) * (ε * y / (2 * C + 1)) = ε * y := by grind
    have := div_pos (OrderedRing.mul_pos hε hy) (by grind : 0 < 2 * C + 1)
    grind
  -- `|z − y| = y |exp k − 1| ≥ y |k| / 2`.
  have hzy : abs (z - y) = y * abs (exp k - 1) := by
    rw [hzk, show y * exp k - y = y * (exp k - 1) by grind, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by grind)]
  have hlow : abs k / 2 ≤ abs (exp k - 1) := by
    have := abs_add (exp k - 1) (-(exp k - 1 - k))
    rw [abs_neg, show exp k - 1 + -(exp k - 1 - k) = k by grind] at this
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right c1 hK
    grind
  -- The error is `|k − (exp k − 1)| ≤ C k² ≤ (ε y / 2) |k| ≤ ε |z − y|`.
  have herr : log z - log y - 1 / y * (z - y) = -(exp k - 1 - k) := by
    have e1 : z - y = y * (exp k - 1) := by rw [hzk]; grind
    have : y ≠ 0 := by grind
    show k - 1 / y * (z - y) = _
    rw [e1]; grind
  rw [herr, abs_neg]
  have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right c2 hK
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hε) (Std.le_of_lt hy))
  rw [hzy]
  grind

/-- The β-function as a bounded formula: `z = β(A, B, i)`, i.e.

Foundations.Logic.FO.consistent_of_finit:
/-- A finitely satisfiable theory is consistent. -/
theorem consistent_of_finitely_sat {Γ : Theory L}
    (h : ∀ l : List (Formula L), (∀ ψ ∈ l, Γ ψ) →
      ∃ (M : Structure L) (e : Nat → M.Dom), ∀ ψ ∈ l, Sat M e ψ) : Consistent Γ := by
  intro hb
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hd⟩ := Proves.finite_premises (Γ₀ := empty) hb (fun ψ h => Or.inr h)
  obtain ⟨M, e, he⟩ := h l hl
  exact Proves.soundness hd M e (fun ψ hψ => by
    rcases hψ with h | h
    · exact h.elim
    · exact he ψ h)
Foundations.Logic.FO.Proves:
/-- **First-order natural deduction.** `Proves Γ φ` (written `Γ ⊢₁ φ`) means that `φ`
has a derivation from premises in `Γ`. -/
inductive Proves : Theory L → Formula L → Prop where
  /-- Hypothesis. -/
  | hyp {Γ φ} : Γ φ → Proves Γ φ
  /-- `→`-introduction. -/
  | impI {Γ φ ψ} : Proves (insert Γ φ) ψ → Proves Γ (imp φ ψ)
  /-- `→`-elimination (modus ponens). -/
  | impE {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ (imp φ ψ) → Proves Γ φ → Proves Γ ψ
  /-- `∧`-introduction. -/
  | conjI {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ φ → Proves Γ ψ → Proves Γ (conj φ ψ)
  /-- `∧`-elimination, left. -/
  | conjE₁ {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ (conj φ ψ) → Proves Γ φ
  /-- `∧`-elimination, right. -/
  | conjE₂ {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ (conj φ ψ) → Proves Γ ψ
  /-- `∨`-introduction, left. -/
  | disjI₁ {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ φ → Proves Γ (disj φ ψ)
  /-- `∨`-introduction, right. -/
  | disjI₂ {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ ψ → Proves Γ (disj φ ψ)
  /-- `∨`-elimination. -/
  | disjE {Γ φ ψ χ} : Proves Γ (disj φ ψ) → Proves (insert Γ φ) χ →
      Proves (insert Γ ψ) χ → Proves Γ χ
  /-- Ex falso quodlibet. -/
  | botE {Γ φ} : Proves Γ bot → Proves Γ φ
  /-- Reductio ad absurdum (classical). -/
  | raa {Γ φ} : Proves (insert Γ (neg φ)) bot → Proves Γ φ
  /-- `∀`-introduction: prove the body for a fresh variable (premises shifted). -/
  | allI {Γ φ} : Proves (shift Γ) φ → Proves Γ (all φ)
  /-- `∀`-elimination: instantiate at any term. -/
  | allE {Γ : Theory L} {φ : Formula L} (t : Term L) : Proves Γ (all φ) → Proves Γ (φ.inst t)
  /-- `∃`-introduction: a witness term gives an existential. -/
  | exI {Γ : Theory L} {φ : Formula L} (t : Term L) : Proves Γ (φ.inst t) → Proves Γ (ex φ)
  /-- `∃`-elimination: reason from a fresh witness to a conclusion not mentioning it. -/
  | exE {Γ : Theory L} {φ ψ : Formula L} : Proves Γ (ex φ) → Proves (insert (shift Γ) φ) ψ.shift → Proves Γ ψ
  /-- Reflexivity of equality. -/
  | refl {Γ} (t : Term L) : Proves Γ (eq t t)
  /-- Substitutivity of equals (Leibniz's law). -/
  | subst {Γ : Theory L} {φ : Formula L} {s t : Term L} : Proves Γ (eq s t) → Proves Γ (φ.inst s) → Proves Γ (φ.inst t)

Foundations.Topology.extreme_value_inter:
/-- **Extreme value theorem on `[a, b]`**, re-derived from Heine–Borel; this is exactly the
statement of `R.extreme_value` from `Numbers/Continuity`, now as a corollary of compactness. -/
theorem extreme_value_interval {f : R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → R.ContinuousAt f x) :
    ∃ c, a ≤ c ∧ c ≤ b ∧ ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → f x ≤ f c := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := extreme_value_compact (heine_borel a b) ⟨a, Std.le_refl a, hab⟩
    (f := f) (fun x hx => hf x hx.1 hx.2)
  exact ⟨c, hc.1, hc.2, fun x h1 h2 => h x ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
Foundations.Algebra.PolyList.smul_mul:
/-- Scalars pull out of the left factor. -/
theorem smul_mul (c : R) (p q : List R) : Eqv (mul (smul c p) q) (smul c (mul p q)) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => intro n; simp [mul, smul]
  | cons a p ih =>
    intro n
    show coeff (mul ((c * a) :: smul c p) q) n = _
    rw [coeff_smul, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_mul_cons, left_distrib, Ring.mul_assoc]
    cases n with
    | zero => simp only [coeff_cons_zero, mul_zero]
    | succ k => simp only [coeff_cons_succ]; rw [ih k, coeff_smul]
Foundations.Numbers.R.HasDerivAt.lipschi:
/-- A differentiable function grows at most linearly near the point: `|f y − f x| ≤
(|d| + 1) |y − x|` for `y` near `x`. -/
theorem HasDerivAt.lipschitz {f : R → R} {d x : R} (h : HasDerivAt f d x) :
    ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y, abs (y - x) < δ → abs (f y - f x) ≤ (abs d + 1) * abs (y - x) := by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδf⟩ := h 1 (by grind)
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have k1 := hδf y hy
  have k2 := abs_add (f y - f x - d * (y - x)) (d * (y - x))
  rw [show f y - f x - d * (y - x) + d * (y - x) = f y - f x by grind, abs_mul] at k2
  grind
Foundations.Categories.yonedaInv:
/-- The natural transformation `Hom(A, −) ⟶ F` determined by an element `x : F A`:
`h ↦ F(h)(x)`. -/
def yonedaInv (F : C ⥤ Type v) (A : C) (x : F.obj A) : NatTrans (homFunctor A) F where
  app _ := fun h => F.map h x
  naturality f := funext fun g => congrFun (F.map_comp g f) x

/-- A sum of zeros is zero. -/
theorem isum_zero : isum (fun _ : ι => (0 : A)) = 0 := by
  unfold isum
  induction (elems : List ι) with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih => show 0 + lsum (l.map _) = 0; rw [ih, zero_add]

Foundations.Algebra.Subring:
/-- **Subring.** A subset of a ring containing `0` and `1` and closed under addition,
negation and multiplication. -/
structure Subring (S : Type v) [CommRing S] where
  /-- The elements of the subring. -/
  carrier : S → Prop
  /-- Contains `0`. -/
  zero_mem : carrier 0
  /-- Contains `1`. -/
  one_mem : carrier 1
  /-- Closed under addition. -/
  add_mem : ∀ {a b}, carrier a → carrier b → carrier (a + b)
  /-- Closed under negation. -/
  neg_mem : ∀ {a}, carrier a → carrier (-a)
  /-- Closed under multiplication. -/
  mul_mem : ∀ {a b}, carrier a → carrier b → carrier (a * b)

/-- The embedding preserves one. -/

Foundations.Algebra.Subgroup.inter:
/-- The **intersection** of two subgroups is a subgroup. -/
def inter (H K : Subgroup G) : Subgroup G where
  carrier x := x ∈ H ∧ x ∈ K
  one_mem := ⟨H.one_mem, K.one_mem⟩
  mul_mem := fun ha hb => ⟨H.mul_mem ha.1 hb.1, K.mul_mem ha.2 hb.2⟩
  inv_mem := fun ha => ⟨H.inv_mem ha.1, K.inv_mem ha.2⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.wfC_ok:
/-- Well-formedness holds for genuine judgements. -/
theorem wfC_ok (k : Nat) (Δ : List (Formula Arith)) (φ : Formula Arith) (r : Nat) :
    wfC (pair (pj k (ccode Δ) (fcode φ)) r) = true := by
  simp only [wfC, qF, qD, pj, fst_pair, snd_pair, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, ballLt_iff,
    isFormulaC_fcode, true_and]
  intro i hi
  rw [llen_ccode] at hi
  rw [lnth_ccode _ _ hi]; exact isFormulaC_fcode _

Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.isOrdinal_sUnion:
/-- **Suprema.** The union of a set of ordinals is an ordinal. -/
theorem isOrdinal_sUnion {s : ZFSet} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, IsOrdinal x) : IsOrdinal (⋃₀ s) := by
  refine ⟨fun y hy z hz => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := mem_sUnion.1 hy
    exact mem_sUnion.2 ⟨x, hx, (hs x hx).1 y hyx hz⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := mem_sUnion.1 hy
    exact ((hs x hx).mem hyx).1

Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.size:
/-- The *size* (logical complexity) of a formula: the number of connectives and
quantifiers in it. -/
def size : Formula L → Nat
  | bot => 0
  | eq _ _ => 0
  | rel _ _ => 0
  | imp φ ψ => size φ + size ψ + 1
  | conj φ ψ => size φ + size ψ + 1
  | disj φ ψ => size φ + size ψ + 1
  | all φ => size φ + 1
  | ex φ => size φ + 1

  by_cases h : 0 ≤ x
  · left; exact ⟨h, by unfold abs; exact ite_eq_left h⟩
  · right; exact ⟨by grind, by unfold abs; exact ite_eq_right h⟩

  let ⟨n, g, hg⟩ := hβ; ⟨n, g ∘ f, fun _ _ h => hf (hg h)⟩

/-- Drop the first entry of a tuple. -/

/-- `trename` is computable. -/
theorem Comp.trename {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) (hg : Comp g) :
    Comp fun n => FO.trename (f n) (g n) := by
  have hs : Comp trenameStep := by unfold trenameStep; comp_tac
  exact Comp.congr (Comp.comp (Comp.covRec hs) (Comp.pair hf hg)) fun n => by simp [FO.trename]
Foundations.Types.STLC.Ne:
/-- **Neutral derivations**: a chain of eliminations starting from a hypothesis
(the major premises run down the main branch). -/
inductive Ne : List Formula → Formula → Prop
  | hyp {Γ : List Formula} {n : Nat} {A : Formula} : Γ[n]? = some A → Ne Γ A
  | impE {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : Ne Γ (.arr A B) → Nf Γ A → Ne Γ B
  | andE₁ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : Ne Γ (.prod A B) → Ne Γ A
  | andE₂ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : Ne Γ (.prod A B) → Ne Γ B
  | orE {Γ : List Formula} {A B C : Formula} :
      Ne Γ (.sum A B) → Nf (A :: Γ) C → Nf (B :: Γ) C → Ne Γ C
  | botE {Γ : List Formula} {C : Formula} : Ne Γ .bot → Ne Γ C
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.prob_spl:
/-- An event splits along `B` and its complement. -/
theorem prob_split (A B : Event α) :
    P.prob A = P.prob (fun x => A x ∧ B x) + P.prob (fun x => A x ∧ ¬ B x) := by
  rw [← prob_or_disjoint P fun x h => h.2.2 h.1.2]
  exact prob_congr P fun x _ => ⟨fun ha => (Classical.em (B x)).elim (fun hb => Or.inl ⟨ha, hb⟩)
    fun hb => Or.inr ⟨ha, hb⟩, fun h => h.elim And.left And.left⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.sat_le_std:
/-- `t ≤ s` in `ℕ`. -/

Foundations.Algebra.doubling_the_cube_im:
/-- **Doubling the cube is impossible** (Wantzel, 1837). No number whose cube is `2` is
constructible: the side of a cube of twice the volume of the unit cube cannot be drawn with
straightedge and compass. -/
theorem doubling_the_cube_impossible {α : Ω} (h : α * α * α = 1 + 1) :
    ¬ Constructible hΩ hc α := by
  apply not_constructible_of_cubic hΩ hc
  exact {
    d := 1, a := 0, b := 0, c := -((2 : Int) : Ω)
    hd := (ratField hΩ hc).one_mem
    ha := (ratField hΩ hc).zero_mem
    hb := (ratField hΩ hc).zero_mem
    hc := (ratField hΩ hc).neg_mem (intCast_mem_ratField hΩ hc 2)
    d_ne := fun h => hΩ.1 h.symm
    root := by grind
    no_root := cube_two_no_rat_root hΩ hc }
Foundations.Algebra.leftCoset_eq_or_disj:
/-- **Cosets partition the group.** Two left cosets either coincide or are disjoint. -/
theorem leftCoset_eq_or_disjoint (H : Subgroup G) (a b : G) :
    (∀ x, leftCoset a H x ↔ leftCoset b H x) ∨
    (∀ x, ¬ (leftCoset a H x ∧ leftCoset b H x)) := by
  by_cases hab : a⁻¹ * b ∈ H
  · left
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      show b⁻¹ * x ∈ H
      have : b⁻¹ * x = (a⁻¹ * b)⁻¹ * (a⁻¹ * x) := by
        rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]
      rw [this]; exact H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem hab) hx
    · intro hx
      show a⁻¹ * x ∈ H
      have : a⁻¹ * x = (a⁻¹ * b) * (b⁻¹ * x) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]
      rw [this]; exact H.mul_mem hab hx
  · right
    intro x ⟨ha, hb⟩
    apply hab
    have : a⁻¹ * b = (a⁻¹ * x) * (b⁻¹ * x)⁻¹ := by
      rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]
    rw [this]; exact H.mul_mem ha (H.inv_mem hb)
Foundations.Numbers.Cut.ofR_le:
/-- `ofR` preserves and reflects the order. -/
theorem ofR_le (x y : R) : x ≤ y ↔ ofR x ≤ ofR y := by
  constructor
  · intro h q hq; show R.ofQ q < y; have : R.ofQ q < x := hq; grind
  · intro h
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hc
    obtain ⟨q, h1, h2⟩ := R_density (by grind : y < x)
    have := h q h2; have : R.ofQ q < y := this; grind
Foundations.Numbers.C.div_natCast_re:
/-- Real part of `w / r` for a real `r > 0`. -/
theorem div_natCast_re (w : C) {m : Nat} (hm : 0 < m) : (w / (m : C)).re = w.re / (m : R) := by
  have hpos : (0 : R) < (m : R) := OrderedRing.pos_natCast_of_pos _ hm
  show (w * (m : C)⁻¹).re = _
  rw [mul_re, inv_re, inv_im]
  show w.re * ((m : R) / ((m : R) * (m : R) + 0 * 0)) - w.im * (-0 / ((m : R) * (m : R) + 0 * 0)) = _
  grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.Proves.all_imp_ex:
/-- Example derivation: `∀x φ(x) → ∃x φ(x)` is derivable for any `φ` (reflecting the
convention that domains are non-empty): instantiate the universal at the variable
`0` and use it as the existential witness. -/
theorem all_imp_ex (Γ : Theory L) (φ : Formula L) : Γ ⊢₁ imp (all φ) (ex φ) :=
  impI (exI (.var 0) (allE (.var 0) (hyp (Or.inl rfl))))

Foundations.Topology.isConnected_univ_R:
/-- **The real line is connected.** -/
theorem isConnected_univ_R : IsConnected (Topology.metric R) (fun _ => True) := by
  rintro ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hcov, ⟨x, -, hxU⟩, ⟨y, -, hyV⟩, hdis⟩
  -- A separation of `ℝ` would separate the interval between `x` and `y`.
  have key : ∀ a b, U a → V b → a ≤ b → False := fun a b ha hb hab =>
    isConnected_interval a b ⟨U, V, hU, hV, fun z _ => hcov z trivial,
      ⟨a, ⟨Std.le_refl a, hab⟩, ha⟩, ⟨b, ⟨hab, Std.le_refl b⟩, hb⟩, fun z _ => hdis z trivial⟩
  rcases (by grind : x ≤ y ∨ y ≤ x) with h | h
  · exact key x y hxU hyV h
  · exact isConnected_interval y x ⟨V, U, hV, hU, fun z _ => (hcov z trivial).symm,
      ⟨y, ⟨Std.le_refl y, h⟩, hyV⟩, ⟨x, ⟨h, Std.le_refl x⟩, hxU⟩,
      fun z _ h1 h2 => hdis z trivial h2 h1⟩
Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_arccos:
/-- Every `x ∈ [−1, 1]` is the cosine of an angle in `[0, π]`. -/
theorem exists_arccos {x : R} (h1 : -1 ≤ x) (h2 : x ≤ 1) :
    ∃ θ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ ≤ pi ∧ cos θ = x := by
  obtain ⟨θ, h0, hπ, hθ⟩ := intermediate_value' (f := fun t => 0 - cos t) (a := 0) (b := pi)
    (v := -x) (Std.le_of_lt pi_pos)
    (fun t _ _ => continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_const 0 t) (continuousAt_cos t))
    (by show 0 - cos 0 ≤ -x; rw [cos_zero]; grind)
    (by show -x ≤ 0 - cos pi; rw [cos_pi]; grind)
  exact ⟨θ, h0, hπ, by have : 0 - cos θ = -x := hθ; grind⟩
Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_pos_le_both:
/-- Two positive numbers have a positive common lower bound. -/
theorem exists_pos_le_both {δ₁ δ₂ : R} (h₁ : 0 < δ₁) (h₂ : 0 < δ₂) :
    ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ δ₁ ∧ δ ≤ δ₂ := by
  rcases (by grind : δ₁ ≤ δ₂ ∨ δ₂ ≤ δ₁) with h | h
  · exact ⟨δ₁, h₁, by grind, h⟩
  · exact ⟨δ₂, h₂, h, by grind⟩

theorem eval_comp2 {f g₀ g₁ : Code} {xs : List Nat} {v₀ v₁ n : Nat} (h₀ : Eval g₀ xs v₀)
    (h₁ : Eval g₁ xs v₁) (hf : Eval f [v₀, v₁] n) : Eval (.comp f (vec2 g₀ g₁)) xs n := by
  refine .comp (vec2 v₀ v₁) (fun i => ?_) hf

/-- Below a point of a member `W` of the chain, the union order agrees with `W`. -/
theorem unionLt_iff {W : PWO α} (hW : C W) {x y : α} (hy : W.dom y) :
    unionLt C x y ↔ W.lt x y := by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨V, hV, hxy⟩ => ?_, fun h => ⟨W, hW, h⟩⟩
  rcases hC W V hW hV with h | h
  · exact (h.2 x y hy).1 hxy
  · exact (h.2 x y (V.lt_dom x y hxy).2).2 hxy

Foundations.Algebra.Hom.ker:
/-- The **kernel** of `f`: the elements sent to the identity. It is a subgroup of the
domain. -/
def ker (f : G →* H) : Subgroup G where
  carrier x := f x = 1
  one_mem := f.map_one
  mul_mem := by intro a b ha hb; show f (a * b) = 1; rw [f.map_mul', ha, hb, one_mul]
  inv_mem := by intro a ha; show f a⁻¹ = 1; rw [f.map_inv, ha, inv_one]
Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.canon_s:
/-- The canonical map preserves squares. -/
theorem canon_sq (x : F) : canon F G (x * x) = canon F G x * canon F G x := by
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · have h0 : 0 ≤ canon F G x := by
      have := (canon_le (G := G) 0 x).1 hx; rwa [canon_zero] at this
    exact canon_eq (sameCut_sq (archF (F := F)) (archG (G := G)) hx h0 (canon_spec x))
  · have hx' : 0 ≤ -x := by grind
    have h0 : 0 ≤ canon F G (-x) := by
      have := (canon_le (G := G) 0 (-x)).1 hx'; rwa [canon_zero] at this
    have := canon_eq (sameCut_sq (archF (F := F)) (archG (G := G)) hx' h0 (canon_spec (G := G) (-x)))
    have e : -x * -x = x * x := by grind
    rw [e, canon_neg] at this
    rw [this]; grind
Foundations.Numbers.R.log:

Foundations.Geometry.Pt.lagrange:
/-- **Lagrange's identity** in the plane: `|u|²|v|² − (u·v)² = (u × v)²`, with `u = b − a`,
`v = c − b`. -/
theorem lagrange (a b c : Pt K) :
    d2 a b * d2 b c - dot a b c * dot a b c =
      ((b.x - a.x) * (c.y - b.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - b.x)) *
      ((b.x - a.x) * (c.y - b.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - b.x)) := by
  unfold d2 dot; grind

/-- Finite sums of differences. -/

    fsum (fun k => a k - b k) n = fsum a n - fsum b n := by

Foundations.Types.STLC.Ne.toTerm:
/-- **Normal proofs are normal terms** (neutral case): a neutral derivation is
decorated by a normal, neutral, well-typed term. -/
theorem Ne.toTerm {Γ : List Formula} {A : Formula} :
    Ne Γ A → ∃ t, HasType Γ t A ∧ Normal t ∧ Neutral t
  | .hyp h => ⟨.var _, .var h, ⟨fun x (hs : Step (.var _) x) => (by cases hs), trivial⟩⟩
  | .impE h₁ h₂ => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, hneu⟩ := Ne.toTerm h₁
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hnu⟩ := Nf.toTerm h₂
    refine ⟨.app t u, .app ht hu, fun x hx => ?_, trivial⟩
    cases hx with
    | beta => exact hneu
    | appL h => exact hn _ h
    | appR h => exact hnu _ h
  | .andE₁ h => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, hneu⟩ := Ne.toTerm h
    refine ⟨.fst t, .fst ht, fun x hx => ?_, trivial⟩
    cases hx with
    | fstPair => exact hneu
    | fst h => exact hn _ h
  | .andE₂ h => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, hneu⟩ := Ne.toTerm h
    refine ⟨.snd t, .snd ht, fun x hx => ?_, trivial⟩
    cases hx with
    | sndPair => exact hneu
    | snd h => exact hn _ h
  | .orE h h₁ h₂ => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, hneu⟩ := Ne.toTerm h
    obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁, hn₁⟩ := Nf.toTerm h₁
    obtain ⟨u₂, hu₂, hn₂⟩ := Nf.toTerm h₂
    refine ⟨.case t u₁ u₂, .case ht hu₁ hu₂, fun x hx => ?_, trivial⟩
    cases hx with
    | caseInl => exact hneu
    | caseInr => exact hneu
    | case₀ h => exact hn _ h
    | case₁ h => exact hn₁ _ h
    | case₂ h => exact hn₂ _ h
  | .botE h => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, _⟩ := Ne.toTerm h

    cases hx with
    | absurd h => exact hn _ h

/-- Multiplying a strict inequality by a positive element preserves it. -/
theorem mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left {x y z : Q} : x < y → 0 < z → z * x < z * y := by
  induction x using ind with | h a b hb => ?_
  induction y using ind with | h c d hd => ?_
  induction z using ind with | h e f hf => ?_
  simp only [ofNat_def, mk_mul, mk_lt]
  intro h1 h2
  have h3 := Int.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 (Int.mul_pos (by omega : 0 < e) hf)
  grind

  refine ⟨isDomain, fun z => (norm z).toNat, fun a b hb => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨q, r, h, hr⟩ := div_small a b hb
  refine ⟨q, r, h, Or.inr ?_⟩
  show (norm r).toNat < (norm b).toNat

  omega

Foundations.Numbers.R.hasDerivAt_pow:
/-- **Power rule.** `(yⁿ⁺¹)' = (n + 1) yⁿ`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_pow (n : Nat) (x : R) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => y ^ (n + 1)) (((n : R) + 1) * x ^ n) x := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have h := (hasDerivAt_id x).congr (g := fun y => y ^ (0 + 1)) (fun y => by
      show y = y ^ 0 * y; grind)
    have e : (1 : R) = (((0 : Nat) : R) + 1) * x ^ 0 := by grind
    exact e ▸ h
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := (ih.mul (hasDerivAt_id x)).congr (g := fun y => y ^ (n + 1 + 1)) (fun y => rfl)
    have e : ((n : R) + 1) * x ^ n * x + x ^ (n + 1) * 1 = (((n + 1 : Nat) : R) + 1) * x ^ (n + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ']; grind
    exact e ▸ h

Foundations.Types.Lambda.church_rosser:
/-- **The Church–Rosser theorem.** β-reduction is confluent: if `t ⟶* u` and
`t ⟶* v`, then `u` and `v` have a common reduct. -/
theorem church_rosser {t u v : Term} (hu : Red t u) (hv : Red t v) :
    ∃ w, Red u w ∧ Red v w := by
  have toPar : ∀ {a b}, Red a b → Star Par a b :=
    fun h => Star.flatten (fun _ _ h => Star.single h.par) h
  have ofPar : ∀ {a b}, Star Par a b → Red a b :=
    fun h => Star.flatten (fun _ _ h => h.red) h
  obtain ⟨w, h₁, h₂⟩ := Par.confluent (toPar hu) (toPar hv)
  exact ⟨w, ofPar h₁, ofPar h₂⟩

Foundations.Probability.FinProb.decomp_v:
/-- **Decomposition along the values**: `X(x) = ∑_a a · 1[X = a](x)`. -/
theorem decomp_vals (X : α → R) (x : α) :
    ∀ V : List R, V.Nodup → X x ∈ V → sumL V (fun a => a * ind (fun y => X y = a) x) = X x := by
  intro V
  induction V with
  | nil => intro _ h; simp at h
  | cons b V ih =>
      intro hnd hmem
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at hnd
      simp only [sumL_cons]
      by_cases hb : X x = b
      · have hrest : sumL V (fun a => a * ind (fun y => X y = a) x) = 0 := by
          rw [← sumL_zero V]
          refine sumL_congr fun a ha => ?_
          have : ¬ X x = a := fun h => hnd.1 (hb ▸ h ▸ ha)
          simp [ind, this]; grind
        rw [hrest]; simp [ind, hb]; grind
      · have hx : X x ∈ V := (List.mem_cons.1 hmem).resolve_left hb
        rw [ih hnd.2 hx]; simp [ind, hb]; grind
Foundations.Algebra.tower_law:
/-- **The tower law.** For subfields `K ⊆ L ⊆ M` of a field `Ω` with `L` finite over `K` and
`M` finite over `L`, the extension `M / K` is finite and `[M : K] = [M : L] · [L : K]`. -/
theorem tower_law (hΩ : IsField Ω) {K L M : Subfield Ω} (hKL : K.le L) (hLM : L.le M)
    (h1 : FiniteExt K L hKL) (h2 : FiniteExt L M hLM) :
    FiniteExt K M (le_trans hKL hLM) ∧
      deg K M (le_trans hKL hLM) = deg L M hLM * deg K L hKL := by
  have hFK := K.isField hΩ
  have hFL := L.isField hΩ
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_basis hFK h1
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_basis hFL h2
  let a := deg K L hKL
  let b := deg L M hLM
  let g : Fin (dim K (L.over K hKL)) × Fin (dim L (M.over L hLM)) → M.over K (le_trans hKL hLM) :=
    fun p => ⟨(e p.1).1 * (f p.2).1, M.mul_mem (hLM _ (e p.1).2) (f p.2).2⟩
  have hspan : Spans K g := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hf.2 ⟨x.1, x.2⟩
    have hd' : x.1 = isum (fun j => (d j).1 * (f j).1) := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hd; rw [coe_isum] at this; exact this
    let c : Fin (dim L (M.over L hLM)) → Fin (dim K (L.over K hKL)) → K := fun j =>
      Classical.choose (he.2 (⟨(d j).1, (d j).2⟩ : L.over K hKL))
    have hc : ∀ j, (d j).1 = isum (fun i => (c j i).1 * (e i).1) := by
      intro j
      have := congrArg Subtype.val
        (Classical.choose_spec (he.2 (⟨(d j).1, (d j).2⟩ : L.over K hKL)))
      rw [coe_isum] at this; exact this
    refine ⟨fun p => c p.2 p.1, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [coe_isum, isum_prod, hd', isum_comm]
    congr 1; funext j
    rw [hc j, isum_mul_right]
    congr 1; funext i
    show (c j i).1 * (e i).1 * (f j).1 = (c j i).1 * ((e i).1 * (f j).1)
    rw [Ring.mul_assoc]
  have hind : LinIndep K g := by
    intro c hc
    have h0 : isum (fun p => (c p).1 * (g p).1) = 0 := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hc; rw [coe_isum] at this; exact this
    rw [isum_prod, isum_comm] at h0
    -- The coefficient of `f j` over `L`.
    let d : Fin (dim L (M.over L hLM)) → L := fun j =>
      ⟨isum (fun i => (c (i, j)).1 * (e i).1),
        (isum (fun i => c (i, j) • e i) : L.over K hKL).2 |> fun h => by
          rw [coe_isum] at h; exact h⟩
    have hdj : ∀ j, d j = 0 := by
      apply hf.1 d
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_isum]
      show isum (fun j => isum (fun i => (c (i, j)).1 * (e i).1) * (f j).1) = 0
      rw [← h0]
      congr 1; funext j
      rw [isum_mul_right]
      congr 1; funext i
      show (c (i, j)).1 * (e i).1 * (f j).1 = (c (i, j)).1 * ((e i).1 * (f j).1)
      rw [Ring.mul_assoc]
    intro p
    have := he.1 (fun i => c (i, p.2)) (by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_isum]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (hdj p.2)) p.1
    exact this
  have hfin : FiniteExt K M (le_trans hKL hLM) := finDim_of_spans hspan
  refine ⟨hfin, ?_⟩
  have := card_eq_dim hFK hfin ⟨hind, hspan⟩
  rw [card_prod, card_fin, card_fin] at this
  show dim K (M.over K _) = dim L (M.over L hLM) * dim K (L.over K hKL)
  rw [← this, Nat.mul_comm]
Foundations.Algebra.Subgroup.Normal:
/-- **Normal subgroup.** A subgroup `N` is normal if it is closed under conjugation: whenever
`n ∈ N`, every conjugate `g * n * g⁻¹` is in `N`. -/
class Subgroup.Normal (N : Subgroup G) : Prop where
  /-- Closure under conjugation. -/

Foundations.Logic.Formula.atoms:
/-- The list of atoms occurring in a formula (possibly with repetitions). -/
def atoms : Formula → List Nat
  | bot => []
  | var n => [n]
  | imp φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
  | conj φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
  | disj φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
Foundations.Algebra.exists_pow_eq_one:
/-- **Some power of every element is the identity** in a finite group. The powers
`g⁰, g¹, …, g^|G|` are `|G| + 1` elements of a set of size `|G|`, so by the pigeonhole
principle two coincide, and then `g ^ (j - i) = 1`. -/
theorem exists_pow_eq_one (g : G) : ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ g ^ n = 1 := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hno
  have hinj : ∀ i j : Nat, g ^ i = g ^ j → i = j := by
    intro i j h
    rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy i j with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exact absurd ⟨j - i, by omega, pow_sub_eq_one hlt h⟩ hno
    · exact heq
    · exact absurd ⟨i - j, by omega, pow_sub_eq_one hgt h.symm⟩ hno
  have hnd := nodup_map_of_injective hinj (List.nodup_range (n := card G + 1))
  have := length_le_card hnd
  rw [List.length_map, List.length_range] at this
  omega

Foundations.Types.STLC.HasType.subst:
/-- **Substitution lemma.** Substituting well-typed terms for variables preserves typing. -/
theorem HasType.subst {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A : Ty} (h : HasType Γ t A) :
    ∀ {Δ : Ctx} (σ : Nat → Term), (∀ n B, Γ[n]? = some B → HasType Δ (σ n) B) →
      HasType Δ (STLC.subst σ t) A := by
  have hup : ∀ {Γ Δ : Ctx} {A : Ty} (σ : Nat → Term),
      (∀ n B, Γ[n]? = some B → HasType Δ (σ n) B) →
      ∀ n B, (A :: Γ)[n]? = some B → HasType (A :: Δ) (up σ n) B := by
    intro Γ Δ A σ hσ n B hn
    cases n with
    | zero => exact .var hn
    | succ n =>
      exact (hσ n B (by simpa using hn)).rename Nat.succ (fun m C hm => by simpa using hm)
  induction h with
  | var hn => intro Δ σ hσ; exact hσ _ _ hn
  | lam _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .lam (ih _ (hup σ hσ))
  | app _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .app (ih₁ σ hσ) (ih₂ σ hσ)
  | pair _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .pair (ih₁ σ hσ) (ih₂ σ hσ)
  | fst _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .fst (ih σ hσ)
  | snd _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .snd (ih σ hσ)
  | inl _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .inl (ih σ hσ)
  | inr _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .inr (ih σ hσ)
  | case _ _ _ ih ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro Δ σ hσ; exact .case (ih σ hσ) (ih₁ _ (hup σ hσ)) (ih₂ _ (hup σ hσ))
  | absurd _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .absurd (ih σ hσ)
Foundations.Algebra.GaussInt.div_small:
/-- **Division with small remainder in `ℤ[i]`.** For `β ≠ 0` and any `α` there are `q`, `ρ`
with `α = qβ + ρ` and `N(ρ) < N(β)`. -/
theorem div_small (a b : GaussInt) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ q r : GaussInt, a = q * b + r ∧ norm r < norm b := by
  have hN : 0 < norm b := by
    have := norm_nonneg b
    have : norm b ≠ 0 := fun h => hb (norm_eq_zero.1 h)
    omega
  let N := norm b
  let u := a.re * b.re + a.im * b.im
  let v := a.im * b.re - a.re * b.im
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, hq1'⟩ := exists_round u N hN
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2, hq2'⟩ := exists_round v N hN
  let q : GaussInt := ⟨q1, q2⟩
  refine ⟨q, a + -(q * b), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ring.add_comm a, ← Ring.add_assoc, add_neg_cancel, Ring.zero_add]
  · -- `N(ρ) · N(β) = (u - q₁N)² + (v - q₂N)²`.
    have key : norm (a + -(q * b)) * N = (u - q1 * N) * (u - q1 * N) + (v - q2 * N) * (v - q2 * N) := by
      show norm (a + -(q * b)) * norm b = _
      unfold norm
      simp only [add_re, add_im, neg_re, neg_im, mul_re, mul_im]
      show _ = (a.re * b.re + a.im * b.im - q1 * (b.re * b.re + b.im * b.im)) *
          (a.re * b.re + a.im * b.im - q1 * (b.re * b.re + b.im * b.im)) +
        (a.im * b.re - a.re * b.im - q2 * (b.re * b.re + b.im * b.im)) *
          (a.im * b.re - a.re * b.im - q2 * (b.re * b.re + b.im * b.im))
      grind
    have s1 := sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hq1 (Int.le_of_lt hq1')
    have s2 := sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hq2 (Int.le_of_lt hq2')
    have e1 : 2 * (u - q1 * N) * (2 * (u - q1 * N)) = 4 * ((u - q1 * N) * (u - q1 * N)) := by grind
    have e2 : 2 * (v - q2 * N) * (2 * (v - q2 * N)) = 4 * ((v - q2 * N) * (v - q2 * N)) := by grind
    have hlt : norm (a + -(q * b)) * N < N * N := by
      have hNN : 0 < N * N := Int.mul_pos hN hN
      omega
    exact Int.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right hlt (Int.le_of_lt hN)

Foundations.Algebra.euler:
/-- **Euler's theorem.** If `a` is coprime to `n > 0`, then `a ^ φ(n) ≡ 1 (mod n)`. -/
theorem euler (n a : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (ha : Nat.Coprime a n) : a ^ totient n % n = 1 % n := by
  haveI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  let u : ZModUnits n := ⟨Fin.ofNat n a, by rw [Fin.val_ofNat, coprime_mod_iff]; exact ha⟩
  have h := pow_card_eq_one u
  rw [card_zmodUnits] at h
  have h' := congrArg (fun v : ZModUnits n => v.1.val) h
  simp only [ZModUnits.val_pow, ZModUnits.val_one] at h'
  rw [Nat.pow_mod, ← h']
  rfl

Foundations.Numbers.OF.exists_rat_betwee:
/-- **Density of the rationals.** In an Archimedean ordered field, between any two elements
lies a rational. -/
theorem exists_rat_between (hA : Archimedean K) {a b : K} (h : a < b) :
    ∃ q : Q, a < ofRat q ∧ ofRat q < b := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hA (1 / (b - a))
  have hba : 0 < b - a := by grind
  have h1 : 1 < (n : K) * (b - a) := by
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv] at hn
    exact (Field.IsOrdered.mul_inv_lt_iff_lt_mul _ _ hba).1 hn
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h0 | h0
    · subst h0; exfalso; grind
    · exact h0
  have hnK : (0 : K) < (n : K) := OrderedRing.pos_natCast_of_pos n hnpos
  have e := Ring.intCast_natCast (α := K) n
  obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm2⟩ := exists_floor hA ((n : K) * a)
  refine ⟨Q.mk (m + 1) n (by omega), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ofRat_mk]
    rw [← Field.IsOrdered.mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hnK]
    have : ((m + 1 : Int) : K) / ((n : Int) : K) * (n : K) = (m : K) + 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; grind
  · rw [ofRat_mk]
    rw [← Field.IsOrdered.mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hnK]
    have : ((m + 1 : Int) : K) / ((n : Int) : K) * (n : K) = (m : K) + 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.integral:
/-- **The integral** `∫ₐᵇ f`: the Riemann integral of `f` over `[a, b]` if it exists. If it does
not exist — in particular whenever `b < a`, since `HasIntegral` requires `a ≤ b` — the value is

Foundations.Logic.Computability.evalStep:
/-- **One evaluation step**, checked on Gödel numbers. The argument packs the judgement
`x = ⟨c, ⟨xs, n⟩⟩`, a witness `w` and the coded list `js` of premises. The tag of `c`
selects the rule:
`0` zero, `1` successor, `2` projection, `3` composition (witness: the list of
intermediate values), `4` primitive recursion (witness: the previous value),
`5` minimisation (witness: the list of non-zero values minus one). -/
def evalStep (q : Nat) : Bool :=
  -- abbreviations: x = fst q, w = fst (snd q), js = snd (snd q)
  -- c = fst (fst q), xs = fst (snd (fst q)), n = snd (snd (fst q))
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 0 && snd (snd (fst q)) == 0) ||
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 1 && snd (snd (fst q)) == lhead (fst (snd (fst q))) + 1) ||
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 2 && snd (snd (fst q)) == lnth (fst (snd (fst q))) (snd (fst (fst q)))) ||
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 3 &&
    llen (fst (snd q)) == llen (snd (snd (fst (fst q)))) &&
    lnth (snd (snd q)) (llen (snd (snd (fst (fst q))))) ==
      judg (fst (snd (fst (fst q)))) (fst (snd q)) (snd (snd (fst q))) &&
    ballLt (fun r => lnth (snd (snd (fst r))) (snd r) ==
        judg (lnth (snd (snd (fst (fst (fst r))))) (snd r)) (fst (snd (fst (fst r))))
          (lnth (fst (snd (fst r))) (snd r)))
      q (llen (snd (snd (fst (fst q)))))) ||
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 4 && !(fst (snd (fst q)) == 0) &&
    ((lhead (fst (snd (fst q))) == 0 &&
      lnth (snd (snd q)) 0 ==
        judg (fst (snd (fst (fst q)))) (ltail (fst (snd (fst q)))) (snd (snd (fst q)))) ||
     (!(lhead (fst (snd (fst q))) == 0) &&
      lnth (snd (snd q)) 0 ==
        judg (fst (fst q)) (lcons (lhead (fst (snd (fst q))) - 1) (ltail (fst (snd (fst q)))))
          (fst (snd q)) &&
      lnth (snd (snd q)) 1 ==
        judg (snd (snd (fst (fst q))))
          (lcons (lhead (fst (snd (fst q))) - 1) (lcons (fst (snd q)) (ltail (fst (snd (fst q))))))
          (snd (snd (fst q)))))) ||
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 5 &&
    lnth (snd (snd q)) 0 ==
      judg (snd (fst (fst q))) (lcons (snd (snd (fst q))) (fst (snd (fst q)))) 0 &&
    ballLt (fun r => lnth (snd (snd (fst r))) (snd r + 1) ==
        judg (snd (fst (fst (fst r)))) (lcons (snd r) (fst (snd (fst (fst r)))))
          (lnth (fst (snd (fst r))) (snd r) + 1))
      q (snd (snd (fst q))))
Foundations.Algebra.eval_Xpow_val:
/-- Values of powers in `Fin p`: evaluating `X^j` at `x` gives `x^j mod p`. -/
theorem eval_Xpow_val [NeZero p] (x : Fin p) (j : Nat) :
    (Polynomial.eval x (Polynomial.Xpow j)).val = x.val ^ j % p := by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    show (Polynomial.eval x 1).val = 1 % p
    rw [show Polynomial.eval x 1 = 1 from (Polynomial.evalHom x).map_one]
    exact Fin.val_ofNat p 1
  | succ j ih =>
    show (Polynomial.eval x (Polynomial.X * Polynomial.Xpow j)).val = _
    rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Fin.val_mul, ih, Nat.mul_mod_mod, Nat.pow_succ,
      Nat.mul_comm]

Foundations.Logic.FO.shiftedC_iff:
/-- The shifted-context test, decoded. -/
theorem shiftedC_iff {q c : Nat} {Δ : List (Formula Arith)} (hΔ : qD q = ccode Δ) :
    shiftedC q c = true ↔ c = ccode (Δ.map Formula.shift) := by
  simp only [shiftedC, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, ballLt_iff, fst_pair, snd_pair, hΔ,
    llen_ccode]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlen, h⟩
    exact ccode_map_shift Δ c hlen fun i hi => h i hi
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨by simp [llen_ccode], fun i hi => ?_⟩
    rw [lnth_ccode _ _ (by simpa using hi), lnth_ccode _ _ hi]; simp [shiftC_fcode]

/-- `rhoCode a` computes the Gödel number of `rho a c x`. -/
theorem eval_rhoCode (a c : Code) (x : Nat) :
    Eval (rhoCode a) [encode c, x] (encode (rho a c x)) := by
  simp only [rho, encode_comp2, encode_comp1]
  exact eval_pairOf (eval_const _ 3) (eval_pairOf (eval_const _ _) (eval_succOf (eval_pairOf
    (eval_pairOf (eval_const _ 3) (eval_pairOf .proj (eval_succOf (eval_pairOf
      (eval_comp1 .proj (eval_constEnc [] x)) (eval_const _ 0)))))
    (eval_succOf (eval_pairOf (eval_const _ _) (eval_const _ 0))))))

Foundations.Combinatorics.infinite_pigeo:
/-- Infinite pigeonhole for two colours. -/
theorem infinite_pigeonhole_bool (f : Nat → Bool) : ∃ b, InfOften fun i => f i = b := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hinf⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole 2 (fun i => (f i).toNat)
    (fun i => by cases f i <;> decide)
  refine ⟨c == 1, fun N => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := hinf N
  refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
  cases h : f i <;> simp [h] at he <;> subst he <;> simp [h]

Foundations.Algebra.legendre_cases:
/-- The Legendre symbol of a number prime to `p` is `±1`. -/
theorem legendre_cases (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) {a : Nat} (ha : ¬ p ∣ a) :
    (legendre a p = 1 ∧ a ^ half p % p = 1) ∨ (legendre a p = -1 ∧ a ^ half p % p = p - 1) := by
  classical
  have he := euler_criterion hp hodd ha
  have hl := legendre_eq_of_pow hp hodd ha
  by_cases hq : IsQR a p
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte] at he; exact Or.inl ⟨hl.1 he, he⟩
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte] at he; exact Or.inr ⟨hl.2 he, he⟩
Foundations.Topology.Wallis.A_rec:
/-- The Wallis recursion for `A`: `(2n + 2) A_{n+1} = (2n + 1) Aₙ`. -/
theorem A_rec (n : Nat) : (2 * (n : R) + 2) * A (n + 1) = (2 * (n : R) + 1) * A n := by
  have := I_rec (2 * n)
  unfold A; rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 by omega]
  have c : ((2 * n : Nat) : R) = 2 * (n : R) := by grind
  rw [c] at this; grind
Foundations.Algebra.Associated.trans:
/-- Associatedness is transitive. -/
theorem Associated.trans {a b c : R} (h1 : Associated a b) (h2 : Associated b c) :
    Associated a c := by
  obtain ⟨u, ⟨u', hu⟩, rfl⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨v, ⟨v', hv⟩, rfl⟩ := h2
  refine ⟨u * v, ⟨u' * v', ?_⟩, Ring.mul_assoc _ _ _⟩
  calc u * v * (u' * v') = (u * u') * (v * v') := by ac_rfl
    _ = 1 := by rw [hu, hv, Ring.mul_one]

Foundations.Logic.FO.sigma:
/-- The three substitutions needed by the proof rules: `sigma 0 t` instantiates
index `0` by `t` (and lowers the others), `sigma 1 _` shifts all indices up, and
`sigma 2 _` (or larger) is the induction substitution `x ↦ Sx`. -/
def sigma : Nat → Term Arith → Nat → Term Arith
  | 0, t => Subst.single t
  | 1, _ => fun n => .var (n + 1)
  | _ + 2, _ => succSubst
Foundations.Algebra.FiniteType.nodup_lis:
/-- `listSubtype` of a repetition-free list is repetition-free. -/
theorem nodup_listSubtype {γ : Type u} (P : γ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (l : List γ) (hl : l.Nodup) :
    (listSubtype P l).Nodup := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | cons y l ih =>
    rw [List.nodup_cons] at hl
    unfold listSubtype
    by_cases h : P y
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte]
      refine List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨?_, ih hl.2⟩
      rw [mem_listSubtype]; exact hl.1
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte]; exact ih hl.2

/-- The successor of an ordinal is an ordinal. -/
theorem IsOrdinal.succ {x : ZFSet} (hx : IsOrdinal x) : IsOrdinal (succ x) := by
  refine ⟨fun y hy z hz => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · rcases mem_succ.1 hy with rfl | hy
    · exact mem_succ.2 (Or.inr hz)
    · exact mem_succ.2 (Or.inr (hx.1 y hy hz))
  · rcases mem_succ.1 hy with rfl | hy
    · exact hx.1
    · exact hx.2 y hy

  | conj φ ψ => size φ + size ψ + 1

    (hψ : ∀ k, ψ k < ψ (k + 1)) : Tendsto (fun k => a (ψ k)) L := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h ε hε
  exact ⟨N, fun k hk => hN (ψ k) (by have := le_of_strictMono hψ k; omega)⟩

Foundations.Numbers.N.mul_right_cancel:
/-- **Cancellation for multiplication.** If `a * c = b * c` and `c ≠ 0` then `a = b`. -/
theorem mul_right_cancel {a b c : N} (hc : c ≠ zero) (h : a * c = b * c) : a = b := by
  induction a generalizing b with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_mul] at h
    rcases mul_eq_zero h.symm with h' | h'
    · exact h'.symm
    · exact absurd h' hc
  | succ a ih =>
    cases b with
    | zero =>
      rw [zero_mul, succ_mul] at h
      exact absurd (add_eq_zero h).2 hc
    | succ b =>
      rw [succ_mul, succ_mul] at h
      rw [ih (add_right_cancel h)]
