Foundations.Types.STLC.step?_complete:
/-- `step?` finds a reduct whenever there is one. -/
theorem step?_complete {t t' : Term} (h : Step t t') : (step? t).isSome := by
  induction h with
  | beta => simp [step?, lamBody, firstSome]
  | fstPair => simp [step?, pairFst, firstSome]
  | sndPair => simp [step?, pairSnd, firstSome]
  | caseInl => simp [step?, caseRedex, firstSome]
  | caseInr => simp [step?, caseRedex, firstSome]
  | appL _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_left (by simpa using ih))
  | appR _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_right (by simpa using ih))
  | lam _ ih => simpa [step?] using ih
  | pairL _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_left (by simpa using ih)
  | pairR _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (by simpa using ih)
  | fst _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (by simpa using ih)
  | snd _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (by simpa using ih)
  | inl _ ih => simpa [step?] using ih
  | inr _ ih => simpa [step?] using ih
  | case₀ _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_left (by simpa using ih))
  | case₁ _ ih =>
    exact firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_left (by simpa using ih)))
  | case₂ _ ih =>
    exact firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_right (by simpa using ih)))
  | absurd _ ih => simpa [step?] using ih
Foundations.Numbers.R.nivenH_vanish:
/-- Niven's polynomial vanishes from degree `2n + 1` on. -/
theorem nivenH_vanish (a b : R) (n : Nat) : Vanish (nivenH a b n) (2 * n + 1) := fun k hk => by
  unfold nivenH; split
  · exact linPow_vanish a b n (k - n) (by omega)
  · rfl
Foundations.Numbers.R.pi_irrational:
/-- **π is irrational** (Lambert 1761; proof of Niven 1947). There are no integers `p` and
`q > 0` with `π = p / q`. -/
theorem pi_irrational : ¬ ∃ p : Int, ∃ q : Nat, 0 < q ∧ pi = (p : R) / (q : R) := by
  rintro ⟨p, q, hq, hpq⟩
  have hπ := pi_pos
  have hb : (0 : R) < (q : R) := OrderedRing.pos_natCast_of_pos _ hq
  have hbP : (q : R) * pi = (p : R) := by rw [hpq]; grind
  have ha : (0 : R) < (p : R) := by rw [← hbP]; exact OrderedRing.mul_pos hb hπ
  -- Notation: `a = p`, `b = q`, and `n` so large that `π (π a)ⁿ / n! < 1`.
  generalize hA : (p : R) = a at ha hbP
  generalize hB : (q : R) = b at hb hbP
  have hai : IsInt a := ⟨p, hA.symm⟩
  have hbi : IsInt b := ⟨q, by rw [← hB]; exact (Ring.intCast_natCast q).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : Nat, pi * expTerm (pi * a) n < 1 := by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := tendsto_expTerm_zero (pi * a) (1 / pi) (div_pos (by grind) hπ)
    have := abs_lt.1 (hN N (Nat.le_refl N))
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    have k := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by grind : expTerm (pi * a) N < 1 / pi) hπ
    have : pi * (1 / pi) = 1 := by grind
    grind
  let d := 2 * n + 1
  let c := nivenC a b n
  let f : R → R := fun x => poly c d x
  let h : R → R := fun x => f x * sin x
  have hfd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (poly (pderiv c) d x) x := fun x =>
    hasDerivAt_poly' (nivenC_vanish a b n) x
  have hcont : ∀ x, ContinuousAt h x := fun x => ((hfd x).mul (hasDerivAt_sin x)).continuousAt
  -- The integral `∫₀^π f sin` equals `F(π) + F(0) = 2 F(0)`, an even integer.
  let G : R → R := fun x => nivenF a b n 1 x * sin x - nivenF a b n 0 x * cos x
  have hG : ∀ x, HasDerivAt G (h x) x := fun x => by
    have := ((hasDerivAt_nivenF a b n 1 x).mul (hasDerivAt_sin x)).sub
      ((hasDerivAt_nivenF a b n 0 x).mul (hasDerivAt_cos x))
    have e : nivenF a b n (1 + 1) x * sin x + nivenF a b n 1 x * cos x -
        (nivenF a b n (0 + 1) x * cos x + nivenF a b n 0 x * -sin x) = h x := by
      have := nivenF_two_add a b n x
      show _ = poly c d x * sin x
      rw [← this]; grind
    rw [e] at this; exact this
  have hI : integral h 0 pi = G pi - G 0 :=
    integral_eq_sub (Std.le_of_lt hπ) (fun t _ _ => hG t) (fun t _ _ => hcont t)
  have hrefl := poly_reflect (nivenC_vanish a b n) pi (poly_nivenC_reflect hbP n)
  have hFπ : nivenF a b n 0 pi = nivenF a b n 0 0 := by
    unfold nivenF
    apply fsum_congr; intro j _
    have := hrefl (2 * j + 0) 0
    rw [show pi - 0 = pi by grind, Nat.add_zero, neg_one_pow_two_mul] at this
    rw [Nat.add_zero, this]; grind
  have hF0 : IsInt (nivenF a b n 0 0) := isInt_fsum (fun j => (isInt_neg_one_pow j).mul (by
    show IsInt (poly (iterD (2 * j + 0) (nivenC a b n)) (2 * n + 1) 0)
    rw [poly_zero]; exact iterD_nivenC_isInt hai hbi n _)) (n + 1)
  have hIval : integral h 0 pi = 2 * nivenF a b n 0 0 := by
    rw [hI]; show nivenF a b n 1 pi * sin pi - nivenF a b n 0 pi * cos pi -
      (nivenF a b n 1 0 * sin 0 - nivenF a b n 0 0 * cos 0) = _
    rw [sin_pi, cos_pi, sin_zero, cos_zero, hFπ]; grind
  -- Pointwise bounds: `0 < f sin` on `(0, π)` and `f sin ≤ (π a)ⁿ / n!` on `[0, π]`.
  have hfval : ∀ x, f x = x ^ n * (a - b * x) ^ n / (fact n : R) := fun x => poly_nivenC a b x n
  have hfpos : ∀ x, 0 < x → x < pi → 0 < h x := fun x h0 h1 => by
    show 0 < f x * sin x
    rw [hfval]
    have k1 := pow_pos' h0 n
    have hbx : b * x < b * pi := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1 hb
    have k2 := pow_pos' (by grind : 0 < a - b * x) n
    exact OrderedRing.mul_pos (div_pos (OrderedRing.mul_pos k1 k2) (fact_pos' n))
      (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi h0 h1)
  have hfle : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ pi → h x ≤ expTerm (pi * a) n := fun x h0 h1 => by
    show f x * sin x ≤ _
    rw [hfval]
    have hbx : b * x ≤ b * pi := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Std.le_of_lt hb)
    have hbx0 : 0 ≤ b * x := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hb) h0
    have k1 := pow_le_pow_left h0 h1 n
    have k2 := pow_le_pow_left (by grind : 0 ≤ a - b * x) (by grind : a - b * x ≤ a) n
    have p1 := pow_le_pow_left.pow_nonneg h0 n
    have p2 := pow_le_pow_left.pow_nonneg (by grind : 0 ≤ a - b * x) n
    have p3 := pow_le_pow_left.pow_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hπ) n
    have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right k1 p2
    have k4 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 p3
    have hinv := Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 (fact_pos' n))
    have k5 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Std.le_trans k3 k4) hinv
    have hfx : 0 ≤ x ^ n * (a - b * x) ^ n / (fact n : R) := by
      rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg p1 p2) hinv
    have k6 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sin_le_one x) hfx
    unfold expTerm
    rw [mul_pow']
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv] at hfx k6 ⊢
    grind
  -- Lower bound: on `[π/4, 3π/4]` the integrand is at least its (positive) minimum.
  obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm2, hmin⟩ := extreme_value (f := fun x => 0 - h x) (a := pi / 4)
    (b := 3 * pi / 4) (by grind) (fun x _ _ => continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_const 0 x) (hcont x))
  have hmin' : ∀ x, pi / 4 ≤ x → x ≤ 3 * pi / 4 → h m ≤ h x := fun x h1 h2 => by
    have : 0 - h x ≤ 0 - h m := hmin x h1 h2
    grind
  have hm0 : 0 < h m := hfpos m (by grind) (by grind)
  have hnn : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ pi → 0 ≤ h t := fun t h1 h2 => by
    rcases (by grind : t = 0 ∨ t = pi ∨ (0 < t ∧ t < pi)) with e | e | ⟨e1, e2⟩
    · show 0 ≤ f t * sin t; rw [e, sin_zero]; grind
    · show 0 ≤ f t * sin t; rw [e, sin_pi]; grind
    · exact Std.le_of_lt (hfpos t e1 e2)
  have hc : ∀ u v : R, ∀ x, u ≤ x → x ≤ v → ContinuousAt h x := fun _ _ x _ _ => hcont x
  have I1 := HasIntegral.mono (by grind) (hasIntegral_const 0 (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ pi / 4))
    (hasIntegral_integral (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ pi / 4) (hc 0 (pi / 4)))
    (fun t h1 h2 => hnn t h1 (by grind))
  have I2 := HasIntegral.mono (by grind)
    (hasIntegral_const (h m) (by grind : pi / 4 ≤ 3 * pi / 4))
    (hasIntegral_integral (by grind : pi / 4 ≤ 3 * pi / 4) (hc (pi / 4) (3 * pi / 4)))
    (fun t h1 h2 => hmin' t h1 h2)
  have I3 := HasIntegral.mono (by grind) (hasIntegral_const 0 (by grind : 3 * pi / 4 ≤ pi))
    (hasIntegral_integral (by grind : 3 * pi / 4 ≤ pi) (hc (3 * pi / 4) pi))
    (fun t h1 h2 => hnn t (by grind) h2)
  have I4 := HasIntegral.mono (by grind)
    (hasIntegral_integral (Std.le_of_lt hπ) (hc 0 pi))
    (hasIntegral_const (expTerm (pi * a) n) (Std.le_of_lt hπ))
    (fun t h1 h2 => hfle t h1 h2)
  have A1 := integral_add_interval (f := h) (a := 0) (u := 3 * pi / 4) (v := pi) (by grind) (by grind)
    (hc 0 pi)
  have A2 := integral_add_interval (f := h) (a := 0) (u := pi / 4) (v := 3 * pi / 4) (by grind)
    (by grind) (hc 0 (3 * pi / 4))
  have hpos : 0 < integral h 0 pi := by
    have := OrderedRing.mul_pos hm0 (by grind : (0 : R) < 3 * pi / 4 - pi / 4)
    grind
  have hlt : integral h 0 pi < 1 := by grind
  -- So `2 F(0)` is an integer strictly between `0` and `1`.
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hF0
  rw [hIval, hz] at hpos hlt
  have z1 : ((0 : Int) : R) < ((2 * z : Int) : R) := by grind
  have z2 : ((2 * z : Int) : R) < ((1 : Int) : R) := by grind
  have := (intCast_lt (K := R)).1 z1
  have := (intCast_lt (K := R)).1 z2
  omega

/-- Sums of non-negative lengths are non-negative. -/
theorem psum_nonneg {len : Nat → R} (h : ∀ k, 0 ≤ len k) (P : Nat → Prop) (N : Nat) :

  | zero => exact Std.le_refl 0

Foundations.Algebra.finDim_of_no_indep:
/-- **A bound on independent families gives finite dimension.** If no `n + 1` vectors are
linearly independent, then `V` is finite-dimensional of dimension at most `n`. -/
theorem finDim_of_no_indep (hF : IsField K) (n : Nat) (h : ¬ ∃ u : Fin (n + 1) → V, LinIndep K u) :
    FinDim K V ∧ dim K V ≤ n := by
  have hex : ∃ m, ¬ ∃ u : Fin (m + 1) → V, LinIndep K u := ⟨n, h⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmin⟩ := FiniteType.exists_least _ hex
  have hfam : ∃ u : Fin m → V, LinIndep K u := by
    rcases m with _ | k
    · exact ⟨fun i => absurd i.isLt (Nat.not_lt_zero _), linIndep_empty _⟩
    · exact Classical.byContradiction fun hno => hmin k (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hno
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hfam
  have hspan : Spans K u := fun x =>
    Classical.byContradiction fun hx => hm ⟨_, linIndep_tcons hF hu hx⟩
  have hfin := finDim_of_spans hspan
  refine ⟨hfin, ?_⟩
  have h1 := dim_le_card hF hfin hspan
  rw [card_fin] at h1
  have h2 : m ≤ n := Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hlt => hmin n hlt h
  omega

Foundations.Combinatorics.ramsey_theorem:
/-- **The finite Ramsey theorem.** For all `s, t`, every symmetric 2-colouring of the
pairs of a set of `ramsey s t` vertices contains a red `s`-clique or a blue
`t`-clique. -/
theorem ramsey_theorem : ∀ s t, IsRamsey s t (ramsey s t)
  | 0, t => by rw [ramsey]; exact isRamsey_zero_left t
  | _ + 1, 0 => by rw [ramsey]; exact isRamsey_zero_right _
  | 1, t + 1 => by rw [ramsey]; exact isRamsey_one_left (t + 1)
  | s + 2, 1 => by rw [ramsey]; exact isRamsey_one_right (s + 2)
  | s + 2, t + 2 => by
      rw [ramsey]
      exact ramsey_step (ramsey_theorem (s + 1) (t + 2)) (ramsey_theorem (s + 2) (t + 1))
        (by have : 1 ≤ ramsey (s + 1) (t + 2) := ramsey_pos s (t + 1); omega)

/-- The elements obtainable from `S` by products, inverses and `1`. -/

  | of {x : G} : S x → Closure S x
  | one : Closure S 1
  | mul {x y : G} : Closure S x → Closure S y → Closure S (x * y)
  | inv {x : G} : Closure S x → Closure S x⁻¹

/-- `x ∈ gH` iff `x = g * h` for some `h ∈ H`. -/
theorem leftCoset_iff (g : G) (H : Subgroup G) (x : G) :
    leftCoset g H x ↔ ∃ h, h ∈ H ∧ g * h = x := by
  constructor
  · intro hx; exact ⟨g⁻¹ * x, hx, mul_inv_cancel_left g x⟩
  · intro ⟨h, hh, hx⟩
    show g⁻¹ * x ∈ H
    rw [← hx, inv_mul_cancel_left]; exact hh
Foundations.Algebra.fin_isField_iff_prim:
/-- **`ℤ/nℤ` is a field iff `n` is prime.** In `Fin n` (with arithmetic modulo `n`), every
non-zero element is invertible exactly when `n` is a prime number. For primes, the inverse
of `a` is `a ^ (p - 2)`, by Fermat's little theorem; for composite `n = d * e`, the
residue `d` is a zero divisor and cannot be invertible. -/
theorem fin_isField_iff_prime (n : Nat) [NeZero n] : IsField (Fin n) ↔ IsPrime n := by
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := NeZero.ne n
  have zero_val : ((0 : Fin n)).val = 0 := Fin.val_ofNat n 0 ▸ Nat.zero_mod n
  have one_val : ((1 : Fin n)).val = 1 % n := Fin.val_ofNat n 1
  constructor
  · intro ⟨h01, hinv⟩
    have h2 : 2 ≤ n := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction
      intro hlt
      have hn1 : n = 1 := by omega
      apply h01
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [zero_val, one_val, hn1]
    refine ⟨h2, ?_⟩
    intro d hd
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hne
    have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hd; exact hn0 (Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd hd)
    have hdle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hd
    have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by omega
    have hdn : d < n := by omega
    have he0 : 0 < e := by
      apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; intro h; rw [h, Nat.mul_zero] at he; exact hn0 he
    have hen : e < n := by
      have : 2 * e ≤ d * e := Nat.mul_le_mul_right e hd2
      omega
    let a : Fin n := ⟨d, hdn⟩
    let x : Fin n := ⟨e, hen⟩
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; rw [zero_val] at this; exact hd0 this
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hinv a ha0
    have hxa : x * a = 0 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_mul, zero_val]
      show e * d % n = 0
      rw [Nat.mul_comm, ← he, Nat.mod_self]
    have hx : x = 0 := by
      calc x = x * 1 := (Ring.mul_one x).symm
        _ = x * (a * b) := by rw [hb]
        _ = x * a * b := (Ring.mul_assoc x a b).symm
        _ = 0 * b := by rw [hxa]
        _ = 0 := Ring.zero_mul b
    have := congrArg Fin.val hx
    rw [zero_val] at this
    exact absurd this (by show e ≠ 0; omega)
  · intro hp
    have h2 := hp.1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      rw [zero_val, one_val, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at this
      exact absurd this (by omega)
    · intro a ha
      have ha0 : a.val ≠ 0 := by
        intro h; apply ha; apply Fin.ext; rw [h, zero_val]
      have hndvd : ¬ n ∣ a.val := fun h => ha0 (Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h a.isLt)
      refine ⟨Fin.ofNat n (a.val ^ (n - 2)), ?_⟩
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_mul, Fin.val_ofNat, Nat.mul_mod_mod, one_val, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < n)]
      have : a.val * a.val ^ (n - 2) = a.val ^ (n - 1) := by
        rw [Nat.mul_comm, ← Nat.pow_succ]; congr 1; omega
      rw [this]
      exact fermat n a.val hp hndvd

/-- Finite sums are additive. -/
theorem fsum_add (a b : Nat → R) (n : Nat) :
    fsum (fun k => a k + b k) n = fsum a n + fsum b n := by
  induction n with

Foundations.Sets.SquareAbsorb.code_inj:
/-- Coding is injective on `A ∪ B`. -/
theorem code_inj (he : Function.Injective e) {x y : α} (hx : dom' M g x) (hy : dom' M g y)
    (h : code M g x = code M g y) : x = y := by
  have hs := sigma_injective M he
  by_cases ax : M.dom x <;> by_cases ay : M.dom y
  · simp only [code, ax, ay, ↓reduceDIte] at h
    have := hs h
    simp only [Sum.inl.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq] at this
    exact this
  · have hy' := hy.resolve_left ay
    simp only [code, ax, ay, hy', ↓reduceDIte] at h
    exact absurd (hs h) (by intro h; cases h)
  · have hx' := hx.resolve_left ax
    simp only [code, ax, ay, hx', ↓reduceDIte] at h
    exact absurd (hs h) (by intro h; cases h)
  · have hx' := hx.resolve_left ax
    have hy' := hy.resolve_left ay
    simp only [code, ax, ay, hx', hy', ↓reduceDIte] at h
    have := hs h
    simp only [Sum.inr.injEq] at this
    rw [← Classical.choose_spec hx', ← Classical.choose_spec hy', this]
Foundations.Geometry.Klein.col_cross:
/-- In the Klein model, collinear points have vanishing cross product. -/
theorem Klein.col_cross {a b c : Klein.KPt} (h : kleinNeutral.Col a b c) :
    (b.1.x - a.1.x) * (c.1.y - a.1.y) - (b.1.y - a.1.y) * (c.1.x - a.1.x) = 0 := by
  rcases h with h | h | h
  · exact Pt.cross_of_bet h
  · have := Pt.cross_of_bet (show Pt.Bet b.1 c.1 a.1 from h); grind
  · have := Pt.cross_of_bet (show Pt.Bet c.1 a.1 b.1 from h); grind

Foundations.Types.STLC.rename:
/-- Renaming free variables. -/
def rename (ξ : Nat → Nat) : Term → Term
  | var n => var (ξ n)
  | app t u => app (rename ξ t) (rename ξ u)
  | lam t => lam (rename (upRen ξ) t)
  | pair a b => pair (rename ξ a) (rename ξ b)
  | fst t => fst (rename ξ t)
  | snd t => snd (rename ξ t)
  | inl t => inl (rename ξ t)
  | inr t => inr (rename ξ t)
  | case t u₁ u₂ => case (rename ξ t) (rename (upRen ξ) u₁) (rename (upRen ξ) u₂)
  | .absurd t => .absurd (rename ξ t)
Foundations.Algebra.InS.facts:
/-- Facts about points of Zagier's set when `p ≡ 1 (mod 4)` is prime: all coordinates are
positive, and the boundary cases `x = y - z` and `x = 2y` do not occur. -/
theorem InS.facts (hp : IsPrime p) (h4 : p % 4 = 1) {x y z : Nat} (h : InS p (x, y, z)) :
    0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z ∧ x + z ≠ y ∧ x ≠ 2 * y := by
  unfold InS at h
  simp only at h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; intro hx; subst hx
    have : p = 4 * (y * z) := by grind
    omega
  · apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; intro hy; subst hy
    exact not_prime_square (x := x) (by rw [show x * x = p by grind]; exact hp)
  · apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; intro hz; subst hz
    exact not_prime_square (x := x) (by rw [show x * x = p by grind]; exact hp)
  · intro hxy
    subst hxy
    exact not_prime_square (x := x + 2 * z) (by rw [show (x + 2 * z) * (x + 2 * z) = p by grind]; exact hp)
  · intro hx; subst hx
    have : p = 4 * (y * y + y * z) := by grind
    omega

Foundations.Algebra.linIndep_tcons:
/-- Adding a vector outside the span keeps a family independent. -/
theorem linIndep_tcons (hF : IsField K) {n : Nat} {u : Fin n → V} (hu : LinIndep K u) {x : V}
    (hx : ¬ InSpan K u x) : LinIndep K (tcons x u) := by
  intro c hc
  rw [isum_fin_succ] at hc
  have hc' : c 0 • x + isum (fun j : Fin n => c j.succ • u j) = 0 := hc
  have h0 : c 0 = 0 := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hne
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hF.2 _ hne
    apply hx
    refine ⟨fun j => -(t * c j.succ), ?_⟩
    have e := congrArg (fun z => t • z) (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero (Eq.trans (add_comm _ _) hc'))
    rw [← mul_smul, CommRing.mul_comm, ht, one_smul] at e
    rw [e, smul_neg, smul_isum, ← isum_neg]
    congr 1; funext j
    show -(t • c j.succ • u j) = (-(t * c j.succ)) • u j
    rw [neg_smul, mul_smul]
  have hrest := hu (fun j => c j.succ) (by rw [h0, zero_smul, zero_add] at hc'; exact hc')
  intro j
  cases j using Fin.cases with
  | zero => exact h0
  | succ j => exact hrest j
Foundations.Algebra.c3_apply:
/-- The values of a 3-cycle. -/
theorem c3_apply {n : Nat} {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hac : a ≠ c) (x : Fin n) :
    c3 a b c x = if x = a then b else if x = b then c else if x = c then a else x := by
  show swap a b (swap b c x) = _
  simp only [swap_apply]
  by_cases h1 : x = a
  · subst h1; simp [hab, hac]
  · by_cases h2 : x = b
    · subst h2; simp [Ne.symm hab, Ne.symm hbc, Ne.symm hac]
    · by_cases h3 : x = c
      · subst h3; simp [h1, h2]
      · simp [h1, h2, h3]

  ⟨(⟨t.1, (InS.bound (x := t.1) (y := t.2.1) (z := t.2.2) hp h4 h).1⟩,

    ⟨t.2.2, (InS.bound (x := t.1) (y := t.2.1) (z := t.2.2) hp h4 h).2.2⟩), h⟩

Foundations.Geometry.exists_above_of_sq_:
/-- Below a non-negative `r` with `r² < 2` there is room: some `r' > r` still has `r'² < 2`. -/
theorem exists_above_of_sq_lt_two {r : K} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (h : r * r < 2) :
    ∃ r', r < r' ∧ r' * r' < 2 := by
  have hd : (0 : K) < 2 * r + 3 := by grind
  have hd' : 2 * r + 3 ≠ 0 := by grind
  obtain ⟨δ0, δ1⟩ := div_mem_unit (u := 2 - r * r) (v := 2 * r + 3) (by grind)
    (by have := sq_nonneg' r; grind) hd
  have hδ : (2 - r * r) / (2 * r + 3) * (2 * r + 3) = 2 - r * r := by grind
  have hδpos : 0 < (2 - r * r) / (2 * r + 3) := by
    rcases Std.le_iff_lt_or_eq.1 δ0 with h' | h'
    · exact h'
    · rw [← h'] at hδ; grind
  have hsq := mul_le_of_le_one δ1 δ0
  refine ⟨r + (2 - r * r) / (2 * r + 3), by grind, ?_⟩
  grind
Foundations.Algebra.legendre_two:
/-- **The second supplement** to quadratic reciprocity: `(2/p) = (-1)^((p²-1)/8)` for an odd
prime `p`. -/
theorem legendre_two {p : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) :
    legendre 2 p = (-1) ^ ((p * p - 1) / 8) := by
  have h2 := hp.1
  have hnd : ¬ p ∣ 2 := fun h => by
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) h
    omega
  rw [gauss_lemma hp hodd hnd, gaussMu_two hp hodd, neg_one_pow_int, neg_one_pow_int]
  -- Compare parities by the residue of `p` mod 8.
  have key : (half p - half p / 2) % 2 = (p * p - 1) / 8 % 2 := by
    obtain ⟨m, r, hr, rfl⟩ : ∃ m r, r < 8 ∧ p = 8 * m + r := ⟨p / 8, p % 8, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide), by omega⟩
    unfold half
    have hsq : (8 * m + r) * (8 * m + r) = 64 * (m * m) + 16 * (m * r) + r * r := by grind
    rw [hsq]
    have : r = 1 ∨ r = 3 ∨ r = 5 ∨ r = 7 := by omega
    rcases this with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> omega
  rw [key]

Foundations.Combinatorics.infOften_split:
/-- If `A` is infinite, then for any vertex `x` and colouring of the vertices, the
elements of `A` above `x` of one of the two colours form an infinite set. -/
theorem infOften_split {A : Nat → Prop} (hA : InfOften A) (x : Nat) (col : Nat → Bool) :
    InfOften (fun y => A y ∧ x < y ∧ col y = true) ∨
      InfOften (fun y => A y ∧ x < y ∧ col y = false) := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hno => ?_
  have bound : ∀ b : Bool, ¬ InfOften (fun y => A y ∧ x < y ∧ col y = b) →
      ∃ N, ∀ y, N ≤ y → ¬ (A y ∧ x < y ∧ col y = b) := fun b hb =>
    Classical.byContradiction fun hc => hb fun N =>
      Classical.byContradiction fun hc' => hc ⟨N, fun y hy he => hc' ⟨y, hy, he⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := bound true fun h => hno (Or.inl h)
  obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := bound false fun h => hno (Or.inr h)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hAy⟩ := hA (max (max N₁ N₂) (x + 1))
  cases hc : col y
  · exact h₂ y (by omega) ⟨hAy, by omega, hc⟩
  · exact h₁ y (by omega) ⟨hAy, by omega, hc⟩

/-- A series that vanishes from index `m` on sums to its `m`-th partial sum. -/
theorem hasSum_of_zero {b : Nat → R} {m : Nat} (hb : ∀ k, m ≤ k → b k = 0) :
    HasSum b (fsum b m) :=
  (tendsto_const (fsum b m)).congr_eventually m fun n hn => by
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, n = m + j := ⟨n - m, by omega⟩
    show fsum b m = fsum b (m + j)
    induction j with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ j ih => rw [← Nat.add_assoc, fsum_succ, ← ih (by omega), hb (m + j) (by omega)]; grind

Foundations.Geometry.Pt.five_segment:
/-- (A5) **The five-segment axiom** in `K²`, via Stewart's relation. -/
theorem five_segment (a b c d a' b' c' d' : Pt K) (hab : a ≠ b) (h₁ : Bet a b c)
    (h₂ : Bet a' b' c') (e₁ : Cong a b a' b') (e₂ : Cong b c b' c') (e₃ : Cong a d a' d')
    (e₄ : Cong b d b' d') : Cong c d c' d' := by
  obtain ⟨t, t0, t1, hx, hy⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨s, s0, s1, hx', hy'⟩ := h₂
  unfold Cong at *
  have l₁ := d2_left hx hy
  have l₂ := d2_left hx' hy'
  have r₁ := d2_right hx hy
  have r₂ := d2_right hx' hy'
  have st₁ := stewart (d := d) hx hy
  have st₂ := stewart (d := d') hx' hy'
  have D0 := d2_nonneg a c
  have D0' := d2_nonneg a' c'
  -- the "geometric mean" `t (1−t) |ac|²` is determined by `|ab|²` and `|bc|²`
  have p0 : 0 ≤ t * (1 - t) * d2 a c :=
    OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg t0 (by grind)) D0
  have p0' : 0 ≤ s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c' :=
    OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg s0 (by grind)) D0'
  have psq : (t * (1 - t) * d2 a c) * (t * (1 - t) * d2 a c) =
      (s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c') * (s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c') := by
    have e : (t * (1 - t) * d2 a c) * (t * (1 - t) * d2 a c) = d2 a b * d2 b c := by
      rw [l₁, r₁]; grind
    have e' : (s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c') * (s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c') = d2 a' b' * d2 b' c' := by
      rw [l₂, r₂]; grind
    rw [e, e', e₁, e₂]
  have peq := eq_of_sq_eq p0 p0' psq
  -- hence `|ac|² = |a'c'|²`
  have hD : d2 a c = d2 a' c' := by
    have u : d2 a c = d2 a b + 2 * (t * (1 - t) * d2 a c) + d2 b c := by rw [l₁, r₁]; grind
    have u' : d2 a' c' = d2 a' b' + 2 * (s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c') + d2 b' c' := by
      rw [l₂, r₂]; grind
    rw [u, u', e₁, e₂, peq]
  -- and `t = s`
  have hab' : 0 < d2 a b := d2_pos hab
  have hDpos : d2 a c ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0] at l₁; grind
  have hts : t = s := by
    apply eq_of_sq_eq t0 s0
    have : t * t * d2 a c = s * s * d2 a c := by rw [← l₁, e₁, l₂, hD]
    grind
  subst hts
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0] at l₁; grind
  have key : t * d2 c d = t * d2 c' d' := by grind
  grind

Foundations.Numbers.Cut.ofR_mul:
/-- `ofR` carries multiplication of reals to multiplication of cuts. -/
theorem ofR_mul (x y : R) : ofR (x * y) = ofR x * ofR y := by
  show ofR (x * y) = mul (ofR x) (ofR y)
  unfold mul
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x <;> by_cases hy : 0 ≤ y
  · rw [ite_eq_left ((ofR_nonneg x).2 hx), ite_eq_left ((ofR_nonneg y).2 hy)]
    exact ofR_mul_nonneg hx hy
  · rw [ite_eq_left ((ofR_nonneg x).2 hx), ite_eq_right (fun h => hy ((ofR_nonneg y).1 h))]
    rw [← ofR_neg, ← ofR_mul_nonneg hx (by grind)]
    show _ = -ofR _
    rw [← ofR_neg]; congr 1; grind
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hx ((ofR_nonneg x).1 h)), ite_eq_left ((ofR_nonneg y).2 hy)]
    rw [← ofR_neg, ← ofR_mul_nonneg (by grind) hy]
    show _ = -ofR _
    rw [← ofR_neg]; congr 1; grind
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hx ((ofR_nonneg x).1 h)),
      ite_eq_right (fun h => hy ((ofR_nonneg y).1 h))]
    rw [← ofR_neg, ← ofR_neg, ← ofR_mul_nonneg (by grind) (by grind)]
    congr 1; grind

Foundations.Algebra.CubicRoot.space_inv:
/-- **Inverses.** Every non-zero element of the space has an inverse in the space:
multiplication by it is an injective linear map of a `3`-dimensional space, hence onto. -/
theorem CubicRoot.space_inv (hΩ : IsField Ω) (C : CubicRoot K α) {β : Ω} (hβ : C.space.carrier β) (hβ0 : β ≠ 0) :
    ∃ γ, C.space.carrier γ ∧ β * γ = 1 := by
  have hF := K.isField hΩ
  obtain ⟨hfin, hdim⟩ := C.dim_space hΩ
  let f : Fin 3 → C.space := fun i => ⟨β * (C.basis i).1, C.space_mul hβ (C.basis i).2⟩
  have hind : LinIndep K f := by
    intro c hc
    apply (C.isBasis hΩ).1 c
    apply Subtype.ext
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val hc
    rw [coe_isum] at h ⊢
    have e : isum (fun i => (c i • f i).1) = β * isum (fun i => (c i • C.basis i).1) := by
      rw [isum_mul_left]; congr 1; funext i
      show (c i).1 * (β * (C.basis i).1) = β * ((c i).1 * (C.basis i).1)
      grind
    rw [e] at h
    rcases hΩ.isDomain.2 _ _ h with h1 | h1
    · exact absurd h1 hβ0
    · exact h1
  have hspan := spans_of_card_eq_dim hF hfin hind (by rw [card_fin, hdim])
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan ⟨1, (C.basis 0).2⟩
  refine ⟨(isum (fun i => c i • C.basis i)).1, (isum (fun i => c i • C.basis i)).2, ?_⟩
  have h : (1 : Ω) = isum (fun i => (c i • f i).1) := by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hc; rw [coe_isum] at this; exact this
  calc β * (isum (fun i => c i • C.basis i)).1 = isum (fun i => (c i • f i).1) := by
        rw [coe_isum, isum_mul_left]; congr 1; funext i
        show β * ((c i).1 * (C.basis i).1) = (c i).1 * (β * (C.basis i).1)
        grind
    _ = 1 := h.symm

  have hs : Comp isFormulaStep := by
    unfold isFormulaStep

Foundations.Algebra.foldFin_bij:
/-- **The folded residues are a rearrangement of `1, …, (p-1)/2`**: `foldFin` is a bijection. -/
theorem foldFin_bij :
    (∀ j k, foldFin hp hodd ha j = foldFin hp hodd ha k → j = k) ∧
    (∀ y, ∃ x, foldFin hp hodd ha x = y) := by
  have inj : ∀ j k, foldFin hp hodd ha j = foldFin hp hodd ha k → j = k := by
    intro j k h
    have e := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [foldFin] at e
    have := fold_bounds hp hodd ha j.isLt
    have := fold_bounds hp hodd ha k.isLt
    exact Fin.ext (fold_inj hp hodd ha j.isLt k.isLt (by omega))

/-- The union of a chain of partial injections is a partial injection. -/
def unionPInj (C : PInj α β → Prop) (hC : Zorn.IsChain Le C) : PInj α β where
  rel a b := ∃ F, C F ∧ F.rel a b
  func a b b' := by
    rintro ⟨F, hF, h⟩ ⟨G, hG, h'⟩
    rcases hC F G hF hG with hle | hle
    · exact G.func a b b' (hle a b h) h'
    · exact F.func a b b' h (hle a b' h')
  inj a a' b := by
    rintro ⟨F, hF, h⟩ ⟨G, hG, h'⟩
    rcases hC F G hF hG with hle | hle
    · exact G.inj a a' b (hle a b h) h'
    · exact F.inj a a' b h (hle a' b h')

Foundations.Sets.koenig:
/-- **Kőnig's theorem.** If `κ i < μ i` for every index `i`, then
`Σ i, κ i < Π i, μ i`: the sum injects into the product, but not conversely. -/
theorem koenig {ι : Type u} {κ μ : ι → Type v} (h : ∀ i, CardLT (κ i) (μ i)) :
    CardLT (Σ i, κ i) (∀ i, μ i) := by
  classical
  -- injections `gᵢ : κ i → μ i`, and points `yᵢ` they miss
  have hg : ∀ i, ∃ g : κ i → μ i, Function.Injective g := fun i => (h i).1
  let g : ∀ i, κ i → μ i := fun i => Classical.choose (hg i)
  have ginj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (g i) := fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hg i)
  have hy : ∀ i, ∃ y : μ i, ∀ x, g i x ≠ y := fun i =>
    Classical.byContradiction fun hn => not_surjective_of_cardLT (h i) ⟨g i, fun y =>
      Classical.byContradiction fun hy => hn ⟨y, fun x hx => hy ⟨x, hx⟩⟩⟩
  let y : ∀ i, μ i := fun i => Classical.choose (hy i)
  have hymiss : ∀ i x, g i x ≠ y i := fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hy i)
  refine ⟨?_, fun hle => ?_⟩
  · -- `⟨i, x⟩ ↦` the function equal to `gᵢ x` at `i` and to `y` elsewhere
    let F : (Σ i, κ i) → ∀ j, μ j := fun s j => if h : s.1 = j then h ▸ g s.1 s.2 else y j
    refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨i, x⟩ ⟨i', x'⟩ hF
    have hi := congrFun hF i
    by_cases hii : i' = i
    · subst hii
      simp only [F, ↓reduceDIte] at hi
      rw [ginj _ hi]
    · simp only [F, hii, ↓reduceDIte] at hi
      exact absurd hi (hymiss i x)
  · -- an injection back would give a surjection, contradicting the surjection form
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hle
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_surjective_of_injective he y
    exact koenig_surj (fun i => not_surjective_of_cardLT (h i)) ⟨F, hF⟩

Foundations.Topology.Ascoli.grid_near:
/-- **The grid is a finite `δ`-net**: every `x ∈ [a, b]` lies within `(b − a)/(n + 1)` of a grid
point `a + (b − a)·m/(n + 1)` with `m ≤ n`. -/
theorem grid_near {a b x : R} (hab : a ≤ b) (h1 : a ≤ x) (h2 : x ≤ b) (n : Nat) :
    ∃ m, m ≤ n ∧ abs (x - (a + (b - a) * ((m : R) / ((n : R) + 1)))) ≤ (b - a) / ((n : R) + 1) := by
  have hn := Vitali.succ_pos n
  let u : Nat → R := fun j => a + (b - a) * ((j : R) / ((n : R) + 1))
  have hstep : ∀ j : Nat, u (j + 1) = u j + (b - a) / ((n : R) + 1) := fun j => by
    show a + (b - a) * (((j + 1 : Nat) : R) / ((n : R) + 1)) = _
    have : ((j + 1 : Nat) : R) = (j : R) + 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; show _ = a + (b - a) * ((j : R) / ((n : R) + 1)) + _; grind
  have hend : u (n + 1) = b := by
    show a + (b - a) * (((n + 1 : Nat) : R) / ((n : R) + 1)) = b
    have : ((n + 1 : Nat) : R) = (n : R) + 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; grind
  have hd : 0 ≤ (b - a) / ((n : R) + 1) := by
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind) (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hn))
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hmin⟩ := nat_least (fun j => x ≤ u (j + 1)) ⟨n, by rw [hend]; exact h2⟩
  have hjn : j ≤ n := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
    exact hmin n (by omega) (by rw [hend]; exact h2)
  cases j with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, abs_le.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have : u 0 = a := by show a + (b - a) * (((0 : Nat) : R) / ((n : R) + 1)) = a; grind
      show -((b - a) / ((n : R) + 1)) ≤ x - u 0; grind
    · have := hstep 0
      have : u 0 = a := by show a + (b - a) * (((0 : Nat) : R) / ((n : R) + 1)) = a; grind
      show x - u 0 ≤ _; grind
  | succ i =>
    have hi := hmin i (by omega)
    have := hstep (i + 1)
    refine ⟨i + 1, hjn, abs_le.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · show -((b - a) / ((n : R) + 1)) ≤ x - u (i + 1); grind
    · show x - u (i + 1) ≤ _; grind

Foundations.Algebra.QuotientRing.lift:
/-- **Universal property of the quotient ring.** A ring homomorphism vanishing on `I`
factors through `R ⧸ I`. -/
def lift (f : RingHom R S) (hf : ∀ x, x ∈ I → f.toFun x = 0) : RingHom (QuotientRing I) S where
  toFun := Quotient.lift f.toFun (fun a b (h : -a + b ∈ I) => by
    have := hf _ h
    rw [f.map_add, f.map_neg] at this
    have h2 := congrArg (f.toFun a + ·) this
    simp only [add_neg_cancel_left, add_zero] at h2
    exact h2.symm)
  map_add a b := by
    induction a using Quotient.ind; induction b using Quotient.ind
    exact f.map_add _ _
  map_mul a b := by
    induction a using Quotient.ind; induction b using Quotient.ind
    exact f.map_mul _ _
  map_one := f.map_one

Foundations.Numbers.R.bolzano_weierstras:
/-- **Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem.** Every bounded sequence of reals has a convergent
subsequence. -/
theorem bolzano_weierstrass {a : Nat → R} (hbdd : ∃ B, ∀ n, abs (a n) ≤ B) :
    ∃ φ : Nat → Nat, (∀ k, φ k < φ (k + 1)) ∧ ∃ L, Tendsto (fun k => a (φ k)) L := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hbdd
  -- `S` = the values exceeded by the sequence infinitely often; `L = sup S` (the limsup).
  let S : R → Prop := fun x => ∀ N, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ x ≤ a n
  have hS : S (-B) := fun N => ⟨N, Nat.le_refl _, by have := abs_le.1 (hB N); grind⟩
  have hSb : ∀ x, S x → x ≤ B := fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨n, _, hn⟩ := hx 0; have := abs_le.1 (hB n); grind
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := exists_lub S ⟨_, hS⟩ ⟨B, hSb⟩
  refine ⟨_, (exists_subseq_tendsto (L := L) ?_).choose_spec.1,
    L, (exists_subseq_tendsto (L := L) ?_).choose_spec.2⟩ <;>
  · intro ε hε N
    -- Some value above `L − ε` is exceeded infinitely often...
    have h1 : ∃ x, S x ∧ L - ε < x := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
      have := hL2 (L - ε) fun x hx => by
        apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h; exact hno ⟨x, hx, by grind⟩
      grind
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxL⟩ := h1
    -- ...while `L + ε/2` is exceeded only finitely often.
    have h2 : ∃ N₀, ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → a n < L + ε / 2 := by
      have : ¬ S (L + ε / 2) := fun h => by have := hL1 _ h; grind
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno; apply this; intro M
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hM
      exact hno ⟨M, fun n hn => by
        apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h; exact hM ⟨n, hn, by grind⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h2
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hxn⟩ := hx (max N N₀)
    exact ⟨n, by omega, abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by have := hN₀ n (by omega); grind⟩⟩

Foundations.Types.SystemF.step?_sound:
/-- `step?` only returns genuine reducts. -/
theorem step?_sound : ∀ (t t' : Term), step? t = some t' → Step t t' := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | var n => intro t' h; simp [step?] at h
  | app t u iht ihu =>
    intro x h
    simp only [step?] at h
    rcases firstSome_eq_some h with h | h
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h
      cases t <;> simp [lamBody] at hs
      subst hs
      exact Step.beta _ _
    rcases firstSome_eq_some h with h | h
    · obtain ⟨t', ht, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h; exact Step.appL (iht _ ht)
    · obtain ⟨u', hu, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h; exact Step.appR (ihu _ hu)
  | lam t ih =>
    intro x h
    obtain ⟨t', ht, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h; exact Step.lam (ih _ ht)
  | tlam t ih =>
    intro x h
    obtain ⟨t', ht, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h; exact Step.tlam (ih _ ht)
  | tapp t B ih =>
    intro x h
    simp only [step?] at h
    rcases firstSome_eq_some h with h | h
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h
      cases t <;> simp [tlamBody] at hs
      subst hs
      exact Step.tbeta _ _
    · obtain ⟨t', ht, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h; exact Step.tapp (ih _ ht)

Foundations.Algebra.parity_mul:
/-- **The parity is a homomorphism**: `parity (στ) = parity σ + parity τ`. -/
theorem parity_mul {n : Nat} (σ τ : Perm (Fin n)) : parity (σ * τ) = parity σ + parity τ := by
  -- `f x y` is symmetric for distinct `x`, `y`.
  let f : Fin n → Fin n → Bool := fun x y => inv (σ x) (σ y) + inv x y
  have hf : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → f x y = f y x := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hσ : σ x ≠ σ y := fun h => hxy (σ.injective h)
    show inv (σ x) (σ y) + inv x y = inv (σ y) (σ x) + inv y x
    rw [inv_swap hσ, inv_swap hxy]
    cases inv (σ x) (σ y) <;> cases inv x y <;> rfl
  -- `τ` permutes the pairs.
  have hne : ∀ p : Pairs n, τ p.1.1 ≠ τ p.1.2 := fun p h =>
    absurd (τ.injective h ▸ p.2) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  let φ : Pairs n → Pairs n := fun p =>
    if h : τ p.1.1 < τ p.1.2 then ⟨(τ p.1.1, τ p.1.2), h⟩
    else ⟨(τ p.1.2, τ p.1.1), by
      have := hne p
      have hv : (τ p.1.1).val ≠ (τ p.1.2).val := fun e => this (Fin.ext e)
      show (τ p.1.2).val < (τ p.1.1).val
      have : ¬ (τ p.1.1).val < (τ p.1.2).val := h
      omega⟩
  have hφ : ∀ p, f (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) = f (φ p).1.1 (φ p).1.2 := by
    intro p
    by_cases h : τ p.1.1 < τ p.1.2
    · simp only [φ, h, ↓reduceDIte]
    · simp only [φ, h, ↓reduceDIte]; exact hf _ _ (hne p)
  have hφ_val : ∀ p, ((φ p).1.1 = τ p.1.1 ∧ (φ p).1.2 = τ p.1.2) ∨
      ((φ p).1.1 = τ p.1.2 ∧ (φ p).1.2 = τ p.1.1) := by
    intro p
    by_cases h : τ p.1.1 < τ p.1.2
    · left; simp [φ, h]
    · right; simp [φ, h]
  have lt_asymm : ∀ {a b : Fin n}, a < b → b < a → False := fun h1 h2 =>
    absurd (Nat.lt_trans h1 h2) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  have hinj : ∀ p q, φ p = φ q → p = q := by
    intro p q hpq
    have e1 : (φ p).1.1 = (φ q).1.1 := by rw [hpq]
    have e2 : (φ p).1.2 = (φ q).1.2 := by rw [hpq]
    apply Subtype.ext
    rcases hφ_val p with ⟨a1, a2⟩ | ⟨a1, a2⟩ <;> rcases hφ_val q with ⟨b1, b2⟩ | ⟨b1, b2⟩
    · exact Prod.ext (τ.injective (by rw [← a1, ← b1, e1])) (τ.injective (by rw [← a2, ← b2, e2]))
    · have h1 := τ.injective (show τ p.1.1 = τ q.1.2 by rw [← a1, ← b1, e1])
      have h2 := τ.injective (show τ p.1.2 = τ q.1.1 by rw [← a2, ← b2, e2])
      exact absurd (h1 ▸ h2 ▸ p.2) (fun h => lt_asymm h q.2)
    · have h1 := τ.injective (show τ p.1.2 = τ q.1.1 by rw [← a1, ← b1, e1])
      have h2 := τ.injective (show τ p.1.1 = τ q.1.2 by rw [← a2, ← b2, e2])
      exact absurd (h1 ▸ h2 ▸ p.2) (fun h => lt_asymm h q.2)
    · exact Prod.ext (τ.injective (by rw [← a2, ← b2, e2])) (τ.injective (by rw [← a1, ← b1, e1]))
  have hsurj : ∀ q, ∃ p, φ p = q := by
    intro q
    let x := τ.invFun q.1.1
    let y := τ.invFun q.1.2
    have hxy : x ≠ y := fun h => absurd (by
      have := congrArg τ.toFun h; simp only [x, y] at this
      rw [τ.right_inv, τ.right_inv] at this; exact this ▸ q.2) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
    have hv : x.val ≠ y.val := fun e => hxy (Fin.ext e)
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hv with hl | hl
    · refine ⟨⟨(x, y), hl⟩, ?_⟩
      have hlt : τ x < τ y := by
        show (τ.toFun (τ.invFun q.1.1)) < τ.toFun (τ.invFun q.1.2)
        rw [τ.right_inv, τ.right_inv]; exact q.2
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [φ, hlt, ↓reduceDIte]
      exact Prod.ext (τ.right_inv _) (τ.right_inv _)
    · refine ⟨⟨(y, x), hl⟩, ?_⟩
      have hlt : ¬ τ y < τ x := by
        show ¬ (τ.toFun (τ.invFun q.1.2)) < τ.toFun (τ.invFun q.1.1)
        rw [τ.right_inv, τ.right_inv]; exact fun h => lt_asymm h q.2
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [φ, hlt, ↓reduceDIte]
      exact Prod.ext (τ.right_inv _) (τ.right_inv _)
  -- Assemble.
  have step : ∀ p : Pairs n, inv ((σ * τ) p.1.1) ((σ * τ) p.1.2) =
      f (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) + inv (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) := by
    intro p
    show inv (σ (τ p.1.1)) (σ (τ p.1.2)) = (inv (σ (τ p.1.1)) (σ (τ p.1.2)) + inv _ _) + inv _ _
    cases inv (σ (τ p.1.1)) (σ (τ p.1.2)) <;> cases inv (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) <;> rfl
  have hfp : ∀ p : Pairs n, f p.1.1 p.1.2 = inv (σ p.1.1) (σ p.1.2) := by
    intro p
    show inv (σ p.1.1) (σ p.1.2) + decide (p.1.2 < p.1.1) = _
    have : ¬ p.1.2 < p.1.1 := fun h => lt_asymm h p.2
    simp only [this, decide_false]
    cases inv (σ p.1.1) (σ p.1.2) <;> rfl
  unfold parity
  rw [show (fun p : Pairs n => inv ((σ * τ) p.1.1) ((σ * τ) p.1.2)) =
      fun p => f (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) + inv (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) from funext step, isum_add]
  congr 1
  rw [show (fun p : Pairs n => f (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2)) = fun p => f (φ p).1.1 (φ p).1.2 from
    funext hφ, isum_comp_bij φ hinj hsurj (fun p => f p.1.1 p.1.2)]
  exact congrArg isum (funext hfp)
Foundations.Algebra.PolyList.mul_smul:
/-- Scalars pull out of the right factor. -/
theorem mul_smul (c : R) (p q : List R) : Eqv (mul p (smul c q)) (smul c (mul p q)) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => intro n; simp [mul, mul_zero]
  | cons a p ih =>
    intro n
    rw [coeff_smul, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_smul, left_distrib]
    have e : a * (c * coeff q n) = c * (a * coeff q n) := by ac_rfl
    rw [e]
    cases n with
    | zero => simp only [coeff_cons_zero, mul_zero]
    | succ k => simp only [coeff_cons_succ]; rw [ih k, coeff_smul]

/-- **Uncountability of ℝ.** There is no surjection from the natural numbers onto the reals. -/

  rintro ⟨f, hf⟩

  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hf x
  exact hx n hn

Foundations.Algebra.CubicRoot.space:
/-- The `K`-subspace `{u + v α + w α²}` spanned by `1, α, α²`. -/
def CubicRoot.space (_C : CubicRoot K α) : KSubspace K where
  carrier x := ∃ u v w, u ∈ K ∧ v ∈ K ∧ w ∈ K ∧ x = u + v * α + w * (α * α)
  zero_mem := ⟨0, 0, 0, K.zero_mem, K.zero_mem, K.zero_mem, by grind⟩
  add_mem := by
    intro x y ⟨u, v, w, hu, hv, hw, hx⟩ ⟨u', v', w', hu', hv', hw', hy⟩
    exact ⟨u + u', v + v', w + w', K.add_mem hu hu', K.add_mem hv hv', K.add_mem hw hw',
      by rw [hx, hy]; grind⟩
  neg_mem := by
    intro x ⟨u, v, w, hu, hv, hw, hx⟩
    exact ⟨-u, -v, -w, K.neg_mem hu, K.neg_mem hv, K.neg_mem hw, by rw [hx]; grind⟩
  smul_mem := by
    intro k x hk ⟨u, v, w, hu, hv, hw, hx⟩
    exact ⟨k * u, k * v, k * w, K.mul_mem hk hu, K.mul_mem hk hv, K.mul_mem hk hw,
      by rw [hx]; grind⟩
Foundations.Numbers.Z.comm_ring:
/-- **ℤ is a commutative ring.** The integers satisfy all the axioms of a commutative ring
with `0 ≠ 1`. -/
theorem comm_ring :
    (∀ x y z : Z, x + y + z = x + (y + z)) ∧ (∀ x y : Z, x + y = y + x) ∧
    (∀ x : Z, x + 0 = x) ∧ (∀ x : Z, -x + x = 0) ∧
    (∀ x y z : Z, x * y * z = x * (y * z)) ∧ (∀ x y : Z, x * y = y * x) ∧
    (∀ x : Z, x * 1 = x) ∧ (∀ x y z : Z, x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z) ∧ (0 : Z) ≠ 1 :=
  ⟨add_assoc, add_comm, add_zero, neg_add_cancel, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_one, mul_add,
    zero_ne_one⟩
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.arith_bridge:
/-- **Arithmetic bridge.** Under `vn : Nat → ω`, zero, successor, addition and
multiplication of Lean's natural numbers correspond exactly to `∅`, `succ`, `+ω`
and `*ω`, which were defined purely set-theoretically by the recursion theorem. -/
theorem arith_bridge :
    vn 0 = ∅ ∧ (∀ n, vn (n + 1) = succ (vn n)) ∧
      (∀ m n, vn (m + n) = vn m +ω vn n) ∧ (∀ m n, vn (m * n) = vn m *ω vn n) :=
  ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl, vn_add, vn_mul⟩
Foundations.Combinatorics.pair_code_inj:
/-- Decoding a pair from `x·n + y`. -/
theorem pair_code_inj {n x y x' y' : Nat} (hy : y < n) (hy' : y' < n)
    (h : x * n + y = x' * n + y') : x = x' ∧ y = y' := by
  have hn : 0 < n := by omega
  have h₁ : (y + x * n) / n = (y' + x' * n) / n := by rw [Nat.add_comm y, Nat.add_comm y', h]
  rw [Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hn, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hn, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hy,
    Nat.div_eq_of_lt hy'] at h₁
  simp at h₁
  subst h₁
  exact ⟨rfl, by omega⟩
Foundations.Algebra.res_pos:
/-- For `k < (p-1)/2` the residue of `(k+1)·a` is non-zero. -/
theorem res_pos {k : Nat} (hk : k < half p) : 0 < res a p k := by
  have ⟨_, _, h3⟩ := half_spec hp hodd
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  intro h
  rcases hp.dvd_mul (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h) with hd | hd
  · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd; omega
  · exact ha hd

  rw [pow_gen, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (val a).isLt]

Foundations.Numbers.R.eps_small:
/-- `1/(k+1)` is eventually below any `ε > 0`. -/
theorem eps_small {ε : R} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ N : Nat, ∀ k : Nat, N ≤ k → 1 / ((k : R) + 1) < ε := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := archimedean (1 / ε)
  refine ⟨N, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  have hk' : (N : R) ≤ (k : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le _ _ hk
  have h0 : (0 : R) ≤ (k : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  have hpos : (0 : R) < (k : R) + 1 := by grind
  rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv] at hN
  have h1 : 1 < (N : R) * ε := (Field.IsOrdered.mul_inv_lt_iff_lt_mul 1 (N : R) hε).1 hN
  have h2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by grind : (N : R) ≤ (k : R) + 1)
    (Std.le_of_lt hε)
  exact (Field.IsOrdered.mul_inv_lt_iff_lt_mul 1 ε hpos).2 (by grind)

Foundations.Numbers.Cut.neg:
/-- Negation of a cut: `{q | q < r for some r with −r ∉ A}`. -/
def neg (A : Cut) : Cut where
  lower q := ∃ r, q < r ∧ ¬ A.lower (-r)
  nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := A.bounded
    exact ⟨-a₀ - 1, -a₀, by grind, by rw [show -(-a₀) = a₀ by grind]; exact ha₀⟩
  bounded := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.nonempty
    refine ⟨-a, fun ⟨r, hr, hnr⟩ => hnr (A.down ha (by grind))⟩
  down := fun ⟨r, hr, hnr⟩ h' => ⟨r, by grind, hnr⟩
  open_ := fun {q} ⟨r, hr, hnr⟩ => ⟨(q + r) / 2, by grind, r, by grind, hnr⟩

Foundations.Logic.Computability.exists_l:
/-- Existence of a least witness (a constructive-enough form of well-ordering). -/
theorem exists_least {p : Nat → Prop} (h : ∃ t, p t) : ∃ t, p t ∧ ∀ m, m < t → ¬ p m := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h
  induction t using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ t ih =>
      by_cases hm : ∃ m, m < t ∧ p m
      · obtain ⟨m, hmt, hpm⟩ := hm; exact ih m hmt hpm
      · exact ⟨t, ht, fun m hmt hpm => hm ⟨m, hmt, hpm⟩⟩

/-- Computation rule: the strict order on representatives. -/

  simp only [mk_le]; omega
Foundations.Topology.Cantor.C_uncountabl:
/-- **The Cantor set is uncountable**: no sequence of reals lists all of its points. -/
theorem C_uncountable (s : Nat → R) : ∃ x, C x ∧ ∀ n, x ≠ s n := by
  -- Cantor's diagonal argument on the digit sequences.
  let code : Nat → Nat → Bool := fun n =>
    open Classical in if h : ∃ b, val b = s n then h.choose else fun _ => false
  let d : Nat → Bool := fun n => !(code n n)
  refine ⟨val d, val_mem_C d, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hex : ∃ b, val b = s n := ⟨d, hn⟩
  have hc : code n = hex.choose := by
    show (open Classical in if h : ∃ b, val b = s n then h.choose else fun _ => false) = _
    rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true hex)]
  have hval : val (code n) = val d := by rw [hc, hex.choose_spec, hn]
  apply val_injective n (code n) d _ hval
  show code n n ≠ !(code n n)
  cases code n n <;> decide

/-- The terms of the exponential series tend to `0`. -/
theorem tendsto_expTerm_zero (x : R) : Tendsto (expTerm x) 0 := by
  have h := ((hasSum_exp x : Tendsto _ _).shift 1).sub (hasSum_exp x : Tendsto _ _)
  rw [show exp x - exp x = 0 by grind] at h
  exact h.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => by
    show fsum (expTerm x) (1 + n) - fsum (expTerm x) n = expTerm x n

theorem tendsto_le {a : Nat → R} {L c : R} (h : Tendsto a L) (hc : ∀ n, a n ≤ c) : L ≤ c := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hlt

Foundations.Numbers.R.HasIntegral.const_:
/-- **Linearity II.** `∫ c f = c ∫ f`. -/
theorem HasIntegral.const_mul (c : R) {f : R → R} {a b I : R} (hf : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    HasIntegral (fun y => c * f y) a b (c * I) := ⟨hf.1, fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηc⟩ := exists_mul_le c (by grind : 0 < ε / 2)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hf.2 η hη
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun l hl hm => ?_⟩
  rw [rsum_const_mul, show c * rsum f a l - c * I = c * (rsum f a l - I) by grind, abs_mul]
  have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt (h l hl hm)) (abs_nonneg c)
  grind⟩

Foundations.Numbers.Arith.gcd_dvd:
/-- The gcd divides both arguments. -/
theorem gcd_dvd (a b : Nat) : gcd a b ∣ a ∧ gcd a b ∣ b := by
  induction a, b using gcd.induct with
  | case1 a => rw [gcd_zero]; exact ⟨Nat.dvd_refl a, Nat.dvd_zero a⟩
  | case2 a b ih =>
    rw [gcd_succ]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨?_, h1⟩
    have := Nat.mod_add_div a (b + 1)
    have h3 := Nat.dvd_add h2 (Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd h1 (a / (b + 1)))
    rwa [this] at h3

/-- If `φₑ(e) = 1`, then `Q ⊢ ¬R(e)`. -/

Foundations.Combinatorics.pigeonhole:
/-- **The finite pigeonhole principle.** If `m` points are mapped into `k < m` holes
(values `< k`), two distinct points have the same image. -/
theorem pigeonhole : ∀ (k m : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat), (∀ i, i < m → f i < k) → k < m →
    ∃ i j, i < j ∧ j < m ∧ f i = f j := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro m f hf hm; exact absurd (hf 0 hm) (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro m f hf hm
    by_cases hk : ∃ i, i < m ∧ f i = k
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩ := hk
      by_cases h2 : ∃ j, j < m ∧ j ≠ i ∧ f j = k
      · obtain ⟨j, hj, hji, hfj⟩ := h2
        rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hji with h | h
        · exact ⟨j, i, h, hi, by rw [hfi, hfj]⟩
        · exact ⟨i, j, h, hj, by rw [hfi, hfj]⟩
      · -- remove the point `i`; all other values are `< k`
        let g : Nat → Nat := fun p => f (if p < i then p else p + 1)
        have hg : ∀ p, p < m - 1 → g p < k := by
          intro p hp
          have hne : (if p < i then p else p + 1) ≠ i := by split <;> omega
          have hlt : (if p < i then p else p + 1) < m := by split <;> omega
          have h₁ := hf _ hlt
          have h₂ : f (if p < i then p else p + 1) ≠ k := fun h => h2 ⟨_, hlt, hne, h⟩
          show f _ < k
          omega
        obtain ⟨p, q, hpq, hq, he⟩ := ih (m - 1) g hg (by omega)
        refine ⟨if p < i then p else p + 1, if q < i then q else q + 1, ?_, ?_, he⟩
        · split <;> split <;> omega
        · split <;> omega
    · have hf' : ∀ i, i < m → f i < k := by
        intro i hi
        have := hf i hi
        have : f i ≠ k := fun h => hk ⟨i, hi, h⟩
        omega
      exact ih m f hf' (by omega)

  have h1 : b⁻¹ * (a⁻¹ * a') * b⁻¹⁻¹ ∈ N := hN.conj_mem _ ha _

Foundations.Categories.lawvere_fixed_poi:
/-- **Lawvere's fixed-point theorem.** Let `A × A` be a product (projections `p₁, p₂`)
and `φ : A × A ⟶ B` be point-surjective with respect to `T`-points: for every
`g : A ⟶ B` there is `a : T ⟶ A` with `φ ∘ ⟨a, x⟩ = g ∘ x` for all `x : T ⟶ A`. Then every
`t : B ⟶ B` has a fixed `T`-point `b : T ⟶ B`, `b ≫ t = b`. -/
theorem lawvere_fixed_point {A B AA T : C} {p₁ p₂ : AA ⟶ A} (hP : IsProduct A A AA p₁ p₂)
    (φ : AA ⟶ B)
    (hφ : ∀ g : A ⟶ B, ∃ a : T ⟶ A, ∀ x : T ⟶ A, hP.lift a x ≫ φ = x ≫ g)
    (t : B ⟶ B) : ∃ b : T ⟶ B, b ≫ t = b := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hφ (hP.lift (𝟙 A) (𝟙 A) ≫ φ ≫ t)
  refine ⟨hP.lift a a ≫ φ, ?_⟩
  have h₁ := ha a
  have h₂ : a ≫ hP.lift (𝟙 A) (𝟙 A) = hP.lift a a := by rw [hP.comp_lift, comp_id]
  calc (hP.lift a a ≫ φ) ≫ t = (a ≫ hP.lift (𝟙 A) (𝟙 A)) ≫ φ ≫ t := by rw [h₂, assoc]
    _ = a ≫ (hP.lift (𝟙 A) (𝟙 A) ≫ φ ≫ t) := by rw [assoc]
    _ = hP.lift a a ≫ φ := h₁.symm

Foundations.Algebra.IsEuclidean.isPID:
/-- **Every Euclidean domain is a principal ideal domain.** An ideal is generated by any of
its non-zero elements of least size. -/
theorem IsEuclidean.isPID {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (hE : IsEuclidean R) : IsPID R := by
  obtain ⟨hD, size, hdiv⟩ := hE
  refine ⟨hD, fun I => ?_⟩
  by_cases hz : ∀ x, x ∈ I → x = 0
  · refine ⟨0, fun x => ⟨fun hx => ⟨0, by rw [hz x hx, mul_zero]⟩, fun ⟨c, hc⟩ => ?_⟩⟩
    rw [hc, zero_mul]; exact I.zero_mem
  · have hex : ∃ n, ∃ x, x ∈ I ∧ x ≠ 0 ∧ size x = n := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction
      intro hno
      exact hz fun x hx => Classical.byContradiction fun hne => hno ⟨_, x, hx, hne, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨n, ⟨g, hgI, hg0, hgn⟩, hmin⟩ := FiniteType.exists_least _ hex
    refine ⟨g, fun x => ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun ⟨c, hc⟩ => ?_⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨q, r, hqr, hr⟩ := hdiv x g hg0
      have hrI : r ∈ I := by
        have : r = x + -(q * g) := by rw [hqr, Ring.add_comm (q * g), Ring.add_assoc,
          add_neg_cancel, add_zero]
        rw [this]; exact I.add_mem hx (I.neg_mem (I.mul_mem q hgI))
      rcases hr with hr | hr
      · exact ⟨q, by rw [hqr, hr, add_zero, CommRing.mul_comm]⟩
      · by_cases hr0 : r = 0
        · exact ⟨q, by rw [hqr, hr0, add_zero, CommRing.mul_comm]⟩
        · exact absurd ⟨r, hrI, hr0, rfl⟩ (hmin _ (hgn ▸ hr))
    · rw [hc]; exact I.mul_mem_right c hgI
Foundations.Logic.Computability.encode_i:
/-- **The Gödel numbering is injective**: distinct codes have distinct numbers. -/
theorem encode_inj : ∀ {c c' : Code}, encode c = encode c' → c = c' := by
  intro c
  induction c with
  | zero => intro c' h; cases c' <;> simp only [encode] at h <;>
      first | rfl | (have := (pair_inj h).1; omega)
  | succ => intro c' h; cases c' <;> simp only [encode] at h <;>
      first | rfl | (have := (pair_inj h).1; omega)
  | proj i => intro c' h; cases c' <;> simp only [encode] at h <;>
      first | (have := (pair_inj h).1; omega) | (rw [(pair_inj h).2])
  | @comp k f gs ihf ihg =>
      intro c' h
      cases c' with
      | @comp k' f' gs' =>
          simp only [encode] at h
          obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := pair_inj (pair_inj h).2
          have hf := ihf h₁
          have hl := encList_inj h₂
          have hk : k = k' := by simpa using congrArg List.length hl
          subst hk hf
          have : gs = gs' := funext fun i => ihg i (by
            have := congrArg (fun l => l[i.val]?) hl
            simpa using this)
          rw [this]
      | _ => simp only [encode] at h; have := (pair_inj h).1; omega
  | prec f g ihf ihg =>
      intro c' h
      cases c' with
      | prec f' g' =>
          simp only [encode] at h
          obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := pair_inj (pair_inj h).2
          rw [ihf h₁, ihg h₂]
      | _ => simp only [encode] at h; have := (pair_inj h).1; omega
  | mu f ih =>
      intro c' h
      cases c' with
      | mu f' => simp only [encode] at h; rw [ih (pair_inj h).2]
      | _ => simp only [encode] at h; have := (pair_inj h).1; omega
Foundations.Logic.Computability.Eval:
/-- **Big-step evaluation.** `Eval c xs n` means: run on the argument list `xs`, the
algorithm `c` halts with output `n`. Non-termination is the absence of any `n`. -/
inductive Eval : Code → List Nat → Nat → Prop where
  /-- `zero` outputs `0`. -/
  | zero {xs} : Eval .zero xs 0
  /-- `succ` outputs the first argument plus one. -/
  | succ {xs} : Eval .succ xs (xs.headD 0 + 1)
  /-- `proj i` outputs the `i`-th argument. -/
  | proj {i xs} : Eval (.proj i) xs (xs.getD i 0)
  /-- Composition: if each `gs i` outputs `vs i`, and `f` outputs `n` on these values,
  the composite outputs `n`. -/
  | comp {k : Nat} {f : Code} {gs : Fin k → Code} {xs : List Nat} {n : Nat}
      (vs : Fin k → Nat) : (∀ i, Eval (gs i) xs (vs i)) → Eval f (List.ofFn vs) n →
      Eval (.comp f gs) xs n
  /-- Primitive recursion, base case. -/
  | prec_zero {f g xs n} : Eval f xs n → Eval (.prec f g) (0 :: xs) n
  /-- Primitive recursion, step case. -/
  | prec_succ {f g m xs r n} : Eval (.prec f g) (m :: xs) r → Eval g (m :: r :: xs) n →
      Eval (.prec f g) ((m + 1) :: xs) n
  /-- Minimisation: `f(n, x⃗) = 0`, and `f(m, x⃗)` is defined and non-zero for all `m < n`
  (the values `ks m + 1` witness this). -/
  | mu {f xs n} (ks : Nat → Nat) : Eval f (n :: xs) 0 →
      (∀ m, m < n → Eval f (m :: xs) (ks m + 1)) → Eval (.mu f) xs n

Foundations.Algebra.int_exists_factoriza:
/-- **Existence of factorisations in `ℤ`** (fundamental theorem of arithmetic, existence
half). Every non-zero non-unit integer is a product of irreducibles. -/
theorem int_exists_factorization :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (a : Int), a.natAbs = n → a ≠ 0 → ¬ IsUnit a →
      ∃ L : List Int, (∀ p, p ∈ L → Irreducible p) ∧ lprod L = a := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro a han ha0 hau
    by_cases hirr : Irreducible a
    · exact ⟨[a], fun p hp => by rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hp]; exact hirr,
        show a * 1 = a from Int.mul_one a⟩
    · have : ∃ b c, a = b * c ∧ ¬ IsUnit b ∧ ¬ IsUnit c := by
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hno
        apply hirr
        refine ⟨ha0, hau, fun b c hbc => ?_⟩
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hbc'
        exact hno ⟨b, c, hbc, fun h => hbc' (Or.inl h), fun h => hbc' (Or.inr h)⟩
      obtain ⟨b, c, rfl, hb, hc⟩ := this
      have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply ha0; rw [h]; exact Int.zero_mul c
      have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply ha0; rw [h]; exact Int.mul_zero b
      have hb2 : 2 ≤ b.natAbs := by
        have h1 : b.natAbs ≠ 1 := fun e => hb ((int_isUnit_iff b).2 e)
        have h2 : b.natAbs ≠ 0 := fun e => hb0 (Int.natAbs_eq_zero.1 e)
        omega
      have hc2 : 2 ≤ c.natAbs := by
        have h1 : c.natAbs ≠ 1 := fun e => hc ((int_isUnit_iff c).2 e)
        have h2 : c.natAbs ≠ 0 := fun e => hc0 (Int.natAbs_eq_zero.1 e)
        omega
      have hmul : (b * c).natAbs = b.natAbs * c.natAbs := Int.natAbs_mul b c
      have hbl : b.natAbs < n := by
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b.natAbs hc2; omega
      have hcl : c.natAbs < n := by
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right c.natAbs hb2; omega
      obtain ⟨L1, hL1, hp1⟩ := ih _ hbl b rfl hb0 hb
      obtain ⟨L2, hL2, hp2⟩ := ih _ hcl c rfl hc0 hc
      refine ⟨L1 ++ L2, fun p hp => ?_, by rw [lprod_append, hp1, hp2]⟩
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hp with h | h
      · exact hL1 p h
      · exact hL2 p h

Foundations.Logic.FO.rosser_sep:
/-- **The Rosser separation lemma.** Let `A(w, x)` and `B(w, x)` be bounded formulas
such that for no `n` both `∃w A(w, n)` and `∃w B(w, n)` hold in `ℕ`. Then `Q` proves
`Sep(n̄)` whenever `∃w A(w, n)` is true, and refutes it whenever `∃w B(w, n)` is true. -/
theorem rosser_sep {A B : Formula Arith} (hA : D0 A) (hB : D0 B)
    (hdisj : ∀ n w u, holds A w n → holds B u n → False) (n : Nat) :
    ((∃ w, holds A w n) → Q ⊢₁ (sepF A B).inst (numeral n)) ∧
    ((∃ w, holds B w n) → Q ⊢₁ neg ((sepF A B).inst (numeral n))) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    refine Q_proves_of_models fun M e hM => ?_
    rw [sat_inst, eval_numeral_M, sat_sepF]
    refine ⟨numM M w, ?_, fun u hu hBu => ?_⟩
    · rw [penv_numM, D0.absolute hM hA]; exact hw
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (mle_numM_iff hM _ _).1 hu
      rw [penv_numM, D0.absolute hM hB] at hBu
      exact hdisj n w i hw hBu
  · rintro ⟨w₁, hw₁⟩
    refine Q_proves_of_models fun M e hM => ?_
    rw [sat_neg, sat_inst, eval_numeral_M, sat_sepF]
    rintro ⟨w, hAw, hBw⟩
    rcases mle_numM_or hM w w₁ with h | h
    · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := (mle_numM_iff hM _ _).1 h
      rw [penv_numM, D0.absolute hM hA] at hAw
      exact hdisj n i w₁ hAw hw₁
    · refine hBw _ h ?_
      rw [penv_numM, D0.absolute hM hB]; exact hw₁
Foundations.Sets.SquareAbsorb.basePSq:
/-- The starting partial squaring: the copy of `ℕ`, squared by Cantor's pairing function. -/
def basePSq (he : Function.Injective e) : PSq e where
  dom x := ∃ n, e n = x
  rel p c := ∃ m n, p = (e m, e n) ∧ c = e (cantorPair (m, n))
  rel_dom p c := by
    rintro ⟨m, n, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨m, rfl⟩, ⟨n, rfl⟩, ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩
  func p c c' := by
    rintro ⟨m, n, rfl, rfl⟩ ⟨m', n', hp, rfl⟩
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hp
    rw [he hp.1, he hp.2]
  inj p p' c := by
    rintro ⟨m, n, rfl, rfl⟩ ⟨m', n', rfl, hc⟩
    have := cantorPair_injective (he hc)
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at this
    rw [this.1, this.2]
  total x y := by
    rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, m, n, rfl, rfl⟩
  base n := ⟨n, rfl⟩

Foundations.Numbers.CauSeq.add:
/-- The termwise sum of two Cauchy sequences is Cauchy. -/
def add (a b : CauSeq) : CauSeq where
  seq n := a n + b n
  isCauchy ε hε := by
    obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := a.isCauchy (ε / 2) (by grind)
    obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := b.isCauchy (ε / 2) (by grind)
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun m n hm hn => ?_⟩
    have := h₁ m n (by omega) (by omega)
    have := h₂ m n (by omega) (by omega)
    have := abs_add (a m - a n) (b m - b n)
    have e : a m - a n + (b m - b n) = a m + b m - (a n + b n) := by grind
    rw [e] at this
    grind

/-- **Extreme value theorem** (from compactness). A real function continuous at every point of a
non-empty compact set attains a maximum on it. -/
theorem extreme_value_compact {K : X → Prop} (hK : IsCompact (Topology.metric X) K)
    (hne : ∃ x, K x) {f : X → R} (hf : ∀ x, K x → ContinuousAt f x) :
    ∃ c, K c ∧ ∀ x, K x → f x ≤ f c := by
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩, hs⟩ := (hK.image_of_continuousAt hf).exists_max
    (by obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne; exact ⟨f x, x, hx, rfl⟩)
  exact ⟨c, hc, fun x hx => hs _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩

    ((look tblG k 0 ≠ look tblG k 1 ∧ look tblG k 1 ≠ look tblG k 2 ∧ look tblG k 0 ≠ look tblG k 2) ∧

Foundations.Topology.Wallis.partial_sum:
/-- **Telescoping**: `Σ_{k<N} 1/(k+1)² = 2 B₀/A₀ − 2 B_N/A_N`. -/
theorem partial_sum (N : Nat) :
    fsum (fun k => 1 / (((k : R) + 1) * ((k : R) + 1))) N = 2 * (B 0 / A 0) - 2 * (B N / A N) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => rw [fsum_zero]; grind
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [fsum_succ, ih]
    have k := key N
    have r := A_rec N
    have p1 := A_pos N; have p2 := A_pos (N + 1)
    have : (0 : R) ≤ (N : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    generalize A N = a at *
    generalize A (N + 1) = a' at *
    generalize B N = b at *
    generalize B (N + 1) = b' at *
    generalize B 0 / A 0 = s at *
    generalize (N : R) = n at *
    -- `1/(n+1)² = 2b/a − 2b'/a'`.
    have hP : (n + 1) * (n + 1) ≠ 0 := by
      have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < n + 1) (by grind : (0 : R) < n + 1); grind
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := by grind
    have ha' : a' ≠ 0 := by grind
    have hY : (n + 1) * (n + 1) * a' ≠ 0 := by
      have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < n + 1)
        (by grind : (0 : R) < n + 1)) p2; grind
    have f1 : 2 * (b / a) = (2 * b) / a := by rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; grind
    have r' := congrArg (· * (b * (n + 1))) r
    have k' := congrArg (· * a) k
    have f2 : (2 * b) / a = (a' + 2 * (n + 1) * (n + 1) * b') / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a') :=
      div_eq_div_of ha hY (by grind)
    have f3 : 1 / ((n + 1) * (n + 1)) = a' / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a') :=
      div_eq_div_of hP hY (by grind)
    have f4 : b' / a' = ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * b') / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a') :=
      div_eq_div_of ha' hY (by grind)
    have f5 : a' / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a') + 2 * (((n + 1) * (n + 1) * b') / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a'))
        = (a' + 2 * (n + 1) * (n + 1) * b') / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a') := by
      rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; grind
    rw [← f3, ← f4] at f5
    have e : 1 / ((n + 1) * (n + 1)) = 2 * (b / a) - 2 * (b' / a') := by
      rw [f1, f2, ← f5]; grind
    rw [e]; grind
Foundations.Numbers.R.hasDerivAt_exp:
/-- **`exp` is its own derivative**: `exp' = exp`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_exp (x : R) : HasDerivAt exp (exp x) x := by
  have hE : 0 ≤ exp (abs x + 1) := by
    have := one_add_le_exp (by have := abs_nonneg x; grind : 0 ≤ abs x + 1)
    have := abs_nonneg x; grind
  refine hasDerivAt_of_quadratic (C := exp (abs x + 1) / 2) (by grind) fun y hy => ?_
  have k := abs_exp_sub_le (x := x) (y := y) hy
  rw [show exp y - exp x - (y - x) * exp x = exp y - exp x - exp x * (y - x) by grind] at k
  grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.fresh_subst:
/-- If every substituted term avoids `x`, so does the result of substitution. -/
theorem fresh_subst : ∀ (φ : Formula L) {x : Nat} {σ : Nat → Term L},
    (∀ n, (σ n).Fresh x) → (φ.subst σ).Fresh x
  | bot, _, _, _ => trivial
  | eq t s, _, _, h => ⟨Term.fresh_subst h t, Term.fresh_subst h s⟩
  | rel _ ts, _, _, h => fun i => Term.fresh_subst h (ts i)
  | imp φ ψ, _, _, h => ⟨fresh_subst φ h, fresh_subst ψ h⟩
  | conj φ ψ, _, _, h => ⟨fresh_subst φ h, fresh_subst ψ h⟩
  | disj φ ψ, _, _, h => ⟨fresh_subst φ h, fresh_subst ψ h⟩
  | all φ, x, σ, h | ex φ, x, σ, h => by
      refine fresh_subst φ (x := x + 1) (fun n => ?_)
      cases n with
      | zero => simp only [Subst.lift, Term.Fresh]; omega
      | succ n => exact Term.fresh_rename_succ _ (h n)

    IsCompact (Topology.prod τ σ) (fun p => K p.1 ∧ L p.2) := by
  intro ι W hW hcov
  -- Boxes around every point of `K × L`, each inside some `W i`.
  have hbox : ∀ x : {x // K x}, ∀ y : {y // L y}, ∃ i : ι, ∃ U V, τ.IsOpen U ∧ σ.IsOpen V ∧
      U x.1 ∧ V y.1 ∧ ∀ q : X × Y, U q.1 → V q.2 → W i q := fun x y => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov (x.1, y.1) ⟨x.2, y.2⟩
    obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, h1, h2, h⟩ := hW i _ hi
    exact ⟨i, U, V, hU, hV, h1, h2, h⟩
  let idx : {x // K x} → {y // L y} → ι := fun x y => (hbox x y).choose
  let BU : {x // K x} → {y // L y} → X → Prop := fun x y => (hbox x y).choose_spec.choose
  let BV : {x // K x} → {y // L y} → Y → Prop := fun x y => (hbox x y).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose
  have hB : ∀ x y, τ.IsOpen (BU x y) ∧ σ.IsOpen (BV x y) ∧ BU x y x.1 ∧ BV x y y.1 ∧
      ∀ q : X × Y, BU x y q.1 → BV x y q.2 → W (idx x y) q :=
    fun x y => (hbox x y).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec
  -- For each `x`, finitely many boxes cover the slice `{x} × L`.
  have hslice : ∀ x : {x // K x}, ∃ ly : List {y // L y}, ∀ y, L y → ∃ y', y' ∈ ly ∧ BV x y' y :=
    fun x => hL {y // L y} (BV x) (fun y => (hB x y).2.1)
      (fun y hy => ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, (hB x ⟨y, hy⟩).2.2.2.1⟩)
  let ly : {x // K x} → List {y // L y} := fun x => (hslice x).choose
  have hly : ∀ x y, L y → ∃ y', y' ∈ ly x ∧ BV x y' y := fun x => (hslice x).choose_spec
  -- The tubes `Uₓ × L` with `Uₓ = ⋂_{y ∈ ly x} BU x y`; finitely many cover `K × L`.
  let T : {x // K x} → X → Prop := fun x z => ∀ y, y ∈ ly x → BU x y z
  obtain ⟨lx, hlx⟩ := hK {x // K x} T
    (fun x => isOpen_list_inter τ (BU x) (fun y => (hB x y).1) (ly x))
    (fun z hz => ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, fun y _ => (hB ⟨z, hz⟩ y).2.2.1⟩)
  refine ⟨lx.flatMap (fun x => (ly x).map (idx x)), fun p hp => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hTx⟩ := hlx p.1 hp.1
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hVy⟩ := hly x p.2 hp.2
  exact ⟨idx x y, List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨x, hx, List.mem_map.2 ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩,
    (hB x y).2.2.2.2 p (hTx y hy) hVy⟩

    (hfin : FiniteExt K M (le_trans hKL hLM)) : FiniteExt L M hLM := by
  obtain ⟨n, w, hw⟩ := hfin

Foundations.Sets.WellOrdering.well_order:
/-- **Zermelo's well-ordering theorem.** Every type `α` carries a well-ordering:
a strict total order `lt` in which every non-empty part has a least element.
Proved from Zorn's lemma. -/
theorem well_ordering_theorem (α : Type u) :
    ∃ lt : α → α → Prop, (∀ x, ¬ lt x x) ∧ (∀ x y z, lt x y → lt y z → lt x z) ∧
      (∀ x y, lt x y ∨ x = y ∨ lt y x) ∧
      (∀ S : α → Prop, (∃ x, S x) → ∃ m, S m ∧ ∀ y, S y → ¬ lt y m) := by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Zorn.zorn (r := @Extends α) extends_refl (fun _ _ _ => extends_trans)
    (fun _ _ => extends_antisymm)
    (fun C hC => ⟨unionPWO C hC, fun _ hW => extends_unionPWO C hC hW⟩)
  have hall : ∀ a, M.dom a := fun a => Classical.byContradiction fun ha => by
    have heq := hM _ (extends_append M a ha)
    have : (M.append a ha).dom a := Or.inr rfl
    rw [heq] at this
    exact ha this
  refine ⟨M.lt, M.irrefl, M.trans, fun x y => M.total x y (hall x) (hall y), fun S ⟨x, hx⟩ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hSm, _, hmin⟩ := M.wf S ⟨x, hx, hall x⟩
  exact ⟨m, hSm, fun y hy => hmin y hy (hall y)⟩
Foundations.Algebra.cauchy:
/-- **Cauchy's theorem.** If a prime `p` divides the order of a finite group `G`, then `G`
has an element of order exactly `p`. -/
theorem cauchy {p : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) (hdvd : p ∣ card G) : ∃ g : G, orderOf g = p := by
  have hp2 := hp.1
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, p = m + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by omega⟩
  -- The fixed-point congruence for the rotation action.
  have hcong := MulAction.count_fixed_mod (G := ZMod (m + 1)) (X := McKaySet G (m + 1)) hp
    (k := 1) (by rw [ZMod.card, Nat.pow_one])
  rw [card_mcKaySet] at hcong
  have h0 : card G ^ m % (m + 1) = 0 := by
    apply Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, m = j + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [Nat.pow_succ]; exact Nat.dvd_mul_left_of_dvd hdvd _
  rw [h0] at hcong
  -- The constant necklace `(1, …, 1)` is a fixed point.
  let one : McKaySet G (m + 1) := ⟨fun _ => 1, by rw [tprod_const, one_pow]⟩
  have hone : MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) one := fun k => Subtype.ext rfl
  -- Hence there are at least `p` fixed points, and one of them is not `(1, …, 1)`.
  have hpos : 0 < count (MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) (X := McKaySet G (m + 1))) :=
    count_pos.2 ⟨one, hone⟩
  have hge : m + 1 ≤ count (MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) (X := McKaySet G (m + 1))) :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd hpos (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hcong)
  have hsplit := count_split (MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) (X := McKaySet G (m + 1)))
    (· = one)
  have hle : count (fun x : McKaySet G (m + 1) =>
      MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) x ∧ x = one) ≤ 1 := by
    exact Nat.le_trans (count_mono fun _ h => h.2) (Nat.le_of_eq (count_eq_self one))
  obtain ⟨x, hxfix, hxne⟩ := count_pos.1 (by omega :
    0 < count (fun x : McKaySet G (m + 1) => MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) x ∧ ¬ x = one))
  -- That fixed point is a constant necklace `(g, …, g)` with `g ≠ 1` and `g ^ p = 1`.
  have hconst := Necklace.const_of_fixed x.1 (congrArg Subtype.val (hxfix ZMod.gen))
  refine ⟨x.1 0, ?_⟩
  have hx1 : x.1 = fun _ => x.1 0 := funext hconst
  have hpow : x.1 0 ^ (m + 1) = 1 := by
    have := x.2
    rw [hx1, tprod_const] at this
    exact this
  have hne1 : x.1 0 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hxne
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hx1, h]
  rcases hp.2 _ ((pow_eq_one_iff_dvd _ _).1 hpow) with h | h
  · exfalso; apply hne1
    have := pow_orderOf (x.1 0)
    rwa [h, pow_one] at this
  · exact h

Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.sat_subst:
/-- **Substitution lemma.** `M, e ⊨ φ[σ]` iff `M, (n ↦ ⟦σ n⟧ₑ) ⊨ φ`: syntactic
substitution corresponds exactly to semantic re-assignment of variables. -/
theorem sat_subst : ∀ (φ : Formula L) (e : Nat → M.Dom) (σ : Nat → Term L),
    Sat M e (φ.subst σ) ↔ Sat M (fun n => (σ n).eval M e) φ
  | bot, _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | eq t s, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, Term.eval_subst]
  | rel R ts, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, Term.eval_subst]
  | imp φ ψ, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, sat_subst φ, sat_subst ψ]
  | conj φ ψ, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, sat_subst φ, sat_subst ψ]
  | disj φ ψ, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, sat_subst φ, sat_subst ψ]
  | all φ, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, sat_subst φ, lift_eval]
  | ex φ, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, sat_subst φ, lift_eval]
Foundations.Logic.Formula.truthTable_iff:
/-- **Correctness of truth tables.** The truth-table procedure returns `true`
exactly when the formula is a tautology. -/
theorem truthTable_iff (φ : Formula) : truthTable φ = true ↔ Tautology φ := by
  constructor
  · intro h v
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hagree⟩ := Valuation.exists_row v (atoms φ)
    have hw' : eval w φ = true := by
      simp only [truthTable, List.all_eq_true] at h
      exact h w hw
    rw [← hw']
    exact eval_congr φ (fun a ha => (hagree a ha).symm)
  · intro h
    simp only [truthTable, List.all_eq_true]
    exact fun v _ => h v

/-- `0 ≤ dₖ 3^{-(k+1)} ≤ (2/3) 3^{-k}`. -/
theorem term_bounds (b : Nat → Bool) (k : Nat) :

  have hp : (0 : R) ≤ (1 / 3) ^ k := pow_le_pow_left.pow_nonneg (by grind) k
  unfold term; rw [pow_succ']
  constructor
  · split
    · exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind) (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hp (by grind))
    · grind
  · split <;> grind

Foundations.Logic.Ordinals.goodstein_ter:
/-- **Goodstein's theorem** (Goodstein 1944). Every Goodstein sequence eventually
reaches `0`. (By Kirby–Paris 1982 this is not provable in Peano arithmetic; our proof
uses the well-foundedness of ε₀ from `Ordinals`.) -/
theorem goodstein_terminates (n : Nat) : ∃ k, goodstein n k = 0 := by

Foundations.Geometry.Klein.n2_lt_of_bet:
/-- **Convexity of the disc**: a point between two points of the disc lies in the disc. -/
theorem n2_lt_of_bet {a b c : Pt R} (ha : n2 a < 1) (hc : n2 c < 1) (h : Pt.Bet a b c) :
    n2 b < 1 := by
  obtain ⟨t, t0, t1, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  have ex : b.x = (1 - t) * a.x + t * c.x := by grind
  have ey : b.y = (1 - t) * a.y + t * c.y := by grind
  have e : n2 b = (1 - t) * (1 - t) * n2 a + 2 * (t * (1 - t)) * dot a c + t * t * n2 c := by
    unfold n2 dot; rw [ex, ey]; grind
  have htt : 0 ≤ t * (1 - t) := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg t0 (by grind)
  have hd := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (two_dot_le a c) htt
  have k₁ := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt ha) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 1 - t)
  -- `|b|² ≤ (1−t)|a|² + t|c|² < 1`
  by_cases ht : t = 0
  · subst ht; grind
  · have tpos : 0 < t := by grind
    have k₃ := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hc tpos
    grind

Foundations.Numbers.Bisect.spec:
/-- The bisection invariant: `P` fails at each left end, holds at each right end, the intervals
are ordered, and the `n`-th interval has length `(u − l)/2ⁿ`. -/
theorem spec (n : Nat) :
    ¬ P (lo P l u n) ∧ P (hi P l u n) ∧ lo P l u n ≤ hi P l u n ∧
      (hi P l u n - lo P l u n) * 2 ^ n = u - l := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have : (2 : Q) ^ 0 = 1 := rfl
    exact ⟨hl, hu, hlu, by simp only [hi, lo, pair]; grind⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, _, _, k6⟩ := step_spec h1 h2 h3
    have : (2 : Q) ^ (n + 1) = 2 ^ n * 2 := rfl
    refine ⟨k1, k2, k3, ?_⟩
    show ((step P (pair P l u n)).2 - (step P (pair P l u n)).1) * 2 ^ (n + 1) = u - l
    simp only [hi, lo] at h4
    grind
Foundations.Algebra.PolyList.mul_top:
/-- **Top coefficients multiply** (list version). If `p` vanishes from index `s + 1` on and
`q` from index `t + 1` on, then the coefficient of `p·q` at `s + t` is `pₛ·qₜ`, and `p·q`
vanishes from index `s + t + 1` on. -/
theorem mul_top (q : List R) (t : Nat) (hq : ∀ n, t + 1 ≤ n → coeff q n = 0) :
    ∀ (p : List R) (s : Nat), (∀ n, s + 1 ≤ n → coeff p n = 0) →
      coeff (mul p q) (s + t) = coeff p s * coeff q t ∧
      ∀ n, s + t + 1 ≤ n → coeff (mul p q) n = 0 := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    intro s _
    exact ⟨by rw [show mul [] q = [] from rfl, coeff_nil, coeff_nil, zero_mul], fun n _ => rfl⟩
  | cons a p ih =>
    intro s hp
    cases s with
    | zero =>
      have hp0 : Eqv p [] := fun n => hp (n + 1) (by omega)
      have key : ∀ n, coeff (mul (a :: p) q) n = a * coeff q n := by
        intro n
        rw [coeff_mul_cons]
        cases n with
        | zero => rw [coeff_cons_zero, add_zero]
        | succ k => rw [coeff_cons_succ, coeff_mul_of_eqv_nil hp0, add_zero]
      refine ⟨by rw [Nat.zero_add, key]; rfl, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      rw [key, hq n (by omega), mul_zero]
    | succ s =>
      have hp' : ∀ n, s + 1 ≤ n → coeff p n = 0 := fun n hn => hp (n + 1) (by omega)
      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih s hp'
      refine ⟨?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      · rw [show s + 1 + t = (s + t) + 1 by omega, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_cons_succ, ih1,
          hq _ (by omega), mul_zero, Ring.zero_add]
        rfl
      · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [coeff_mul_cons, coeff_cons_succ, ih2 k (by omega), hq _ (by omega), mul_zero,
          add_zero]

between Lean's natural numbers and the members of `ω`. -/

Foundations.Logic.Derives.finite_premise:
/-- **Finiteness of derivations.** Any derivation from `Γ` uses only finitely many
premises: there is a finite list `L` of premises of `Γ` with `L ⊢ φ`. -/
theorem finite_premises {Γ φ} (h : Γ ⊢ φ) :
    ∃ L : List Formula, (∀ ψ ∈ L, Γ ψ) ∧ ofList L ⊢ φ := by
  -- Helper: discharge a hypothesis `θ` from a finite list of premises of `insert Γ θ`.
  have drop : ∀ {Γ : Theory} {θ : Formula} (L : List Formula), (∀ ψ ∈ L, insert Γ θ ψ) →
      (∀ ψ ∈ L.filter (· ≠ θ), Γ ψ) ∧ (ofList L).Subset (insert (ofList (L.filter (· ≠ θ))) θ) := by
    intro Γ θ L hL
    constructor
    · intro ψ hψ
      simp only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at hψ
      rcases hL ψ hψ.1 with h | h
      · exact absurd h hψ.2
      · exact h
    · intro ψ hψ
      by_cases e : ψ = θ
      · exact Or.inl e
      · exact Or.inr (by simp [ofList, List.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hψ, e⟩)
  have sub_append_l : ∀ L₁ L₂ : List Formula, (ofList L₁).Subset (ofList (L₁ ++ L₂)) :=
    fun L₁ L₂ ψ hψ => List.mem_append_left L₂ hψ
  have sub_append_r : ∀ L₁ L₂ : List Formula, (ofList L₂).Subset (ofList (L₁ ++ L₂)) :=
    fun L₁ L₂ ψ hψ => List.mem_append_right L₁ hψ
  have all_append : ∀ {Γ : Theory} (L₁ L₂ : List Formula), (∀ ψ ∈ L₁, Γ ψ) →
      (∀ ψ ∈ L₂, Γ ψ) → ∀ ψ ∈ L₁ ++ L₂, Γ ψ := by
    intro Γ L₁ L₂ h₁ h₂ ψ hψ
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hψ with h | h
    · exact h₁ ψ h
    · exact h₂ ψ h
  induction h with
  | @hyp Γ φ hφ => exact ⟨[φ], by simpa using hφ, hyp (by simp [ofList])⟩
  | @impI Γ φ ψ _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := drop L hL
      exact ⟨_, h₁, impI (hd.weaken h₂)⟩
  | impE _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁, hd₁⟩ := ih₁
      obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂, hd₂⟩ := ih₂
      exact ⟨L₁ ++ L₂, all_append _ _ hL₁ hL₂,
        impE (hd₁.weaken (sub_append_l _ _)) (hd₂.weaken (sub_append_r _ _))⟩
  | conjI _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁, hd₁⟩ := ih₁
      obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂, hd₂⟩ := ih₂
      exact ⟨L₁ ++ L₂, all_append _ _ hL₁ hL₂,
        conjI (hd₁.weaken (sub_append_l _ _)) (hd₂.weaken (sub_append_r _ _))⟩
  | conjE₁ _ ih => obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih; exact ⟨L, hL, conjE₁ hd⟩
  | conjE₂ _ ih => obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih; exact ⟨L, hL, conjE₂ hd⟩
  | disjI₁ _ ih => obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih; exact ⟨L, hL, disjI₁ hd⟩
  | disjI₂ _ ih => obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih; exact ⟨L, hL, disjI₂ hd⟩
  | @disjE Γ φ ψ χ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
      obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁, hd₁⟩ := ih₁
      obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂, hd₂⟩ := ih₂
      obtain ⟨L₃, hL₃, hd₃⟩ := ih₃
      obtain ⟨h₂a, h₂b⟩ := drop L₂ hL₂
      obtain ⟨h₃a, h₃b⟩ := drop L₃ hL₃
      refine ⟨L₁ ++ (L₂.filter (· ≠ φ) ++ L₃.filter (· ≠ ψ)),
        all_append _ _ hL₁ (all_append _ _ h₂a h₃a), ?_⟩
      refine disjE (hd₁.weaken (sub_append_l _ _)) (hd₂.weaken ?_) (hd₃.weaken ?_)
      · exact h₂b.trans (insert_mono ((sub_append_l _ _).trans (sub_append_r _ _)) _)
      · exact h₃b.trans (insert_mono ((sub_append_r _ _).trans (sub_append_r _ _)) _)
  | botE _ ih => obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih; exact ⟨L, hL, botE hd⟩
  | @raa Γ φ _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := drop L hL
      exact ⟨_, h₁, raa (hd.weaken h₂)⟩

/-- The census of tuples has no repetitions. -/
theorem nodup_tuples (L : List α) (hL : L.Nodup) : ∀ n, (tuples L n).Nodup
  | 0 => List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨by simp, List.Pairwise.nil⟩
  | n + 1 => by
    apply nodup_flatMap hL
    · intro a
      apply nodup_map_of_injective _ (nodup_tuples L hL n)
      intro f g h
      have := congrArg ttail h
      simpa using this
    · intro a b hab x hx hx'
      rw [List.mem_map] at hx hx'
      obtain ⟨f, _, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := hx'
      exact hab (congrFun hg 0).symm

    {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) (hg : Comp g) : Comp fun n => op (f n) (g n) := by
  obtain ⟨cf, hf⟩ := hf; obtain ⟨cg, hg⟩ := hg

Foundations.Numbers.Cut.ofR:
/-- The cut of a Cauchy real `x`: the rationals below `x`. -/
def ofR (x : R) : Cut where
  lower q := R.ofQ q < x
  nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := R.archimedean (-x)
    refine ⟨-(n : Q) - 1, ?_⟩
    have : R.ofQ (-(n : Q) - 1) = -(n : R) - 1 := rfl
    rw [this]; grind
  bounded := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := R.archimedean x
    exact ⟨n, by have : R.ofQ (n : Q) = (n : R) := rfl
                 rw [this]; grind⟩
  down h h' := by have := R.ofQ_lt.2 h'; grind
  open_ h := by
    obtain ⟨r, h1, h2⟩ := R_density h
    exact ⟨r, R.ofQ_lt.1 h1, h2⟩
Foundations.Combinatorics.infinite_pigeo:
/-- **The infinite pigeonhole principle.** If infinitely many points are mapped into
finitely many holes (values `< k`), some hole receives infinitely many points. -/
theorem infinite_pigeonhole (k : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) (hf : ∀ i, f i < k) :
    ∃ c, c < k ∧ InfOften fun i => f i = c := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hno => ?_
  -- every value `c < k` stops occurring beyond some bound; take a common bound
  have hbound : ∀ k', k' ≤ k → ∃ N, ∀ i, N ≤ i → k' ≤ f i := by
    intro k'
    induction k' with
    | zero => intro _; exact ⟨0, fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _⟩
    | succ k' ih =>
      intro hk'
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := ih (by omega)
      have hnot : ¬ InfOften fun i => f i = k' := fun h => hno ⟨k', by omega, h⟩
      obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ : ∃ N₂, ∀ i, N₂ ≤ i → f i ≠ k' :=
        Classical.byContradiction fun hc => hnot fun N =>
          Classical.byContradiction fun hc' => hc ⟨N, fun i hi he => hc' ⟨i, hi, he⟩⟩
      refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      have h₁ := hN₁ i (by omega)
      have h₂ := hN₂ i (by omega)
      omega
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hbound k (Nat.le_refl _)
  have := hN N (Nat.le_refl _)
  have := hf N
  omega

/-- Clearing the denominators of `ch`: `s_x s_z ch(x, z) = 1 − x·z`. -/
theorem ch_mul {x z : Pt R} (hx : n2 x < 1) (hz : n2 z < 1) : s x * s z * ch x z = 1 - dot x z := by
  obtain ⟨sx, -⟩ := s_spec hx
  obtain ⟨sz, -⟩ := s_spec hz
  have : s x * s z ≠ 0 := by have := OrderedRing.mul_pos sx sz; grind
  unfold ch
  grind
