Foundations.Numbers.R.abs_fsum_le:
/-- **Triangle inequality for finite sums.** -/
theorem abs_fsum_le (a : Nat → R) (n : Nat) : abs (fsum a n) ≤ fsum (fun k => abs (a k)) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => show abs (0 : R) ≤ 0; rw [abs_zero]; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [fsum_succ, fsum_succ]; have := abs_add (fsum a n) (a n); grind
Foundations.Topology.IsCompact.image_of_:
/-- The image of a compact set under a map continuous at each of its points is compact. -/
theorem IsCompact.image_of_continuousAt {K : X → Prop} (hK : IsCompact (Topology.metric X) K)
    {f : X → Y} (hf : ∀ x, K x → ContinuousAt f x) :
    IsCompact (Topology.metric Y) (fun y => ∃ x, K x ∧ f x = y) := by
  intro ι V hV hcov
  -- `W i` = interior of the preimage of `V i`.
  let W : ι → X → Prop := fun i x => ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ z, dist z x < δ → V i (f z)
  have hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i) := by
    intro i x hx
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨δ / 2, by grind, fun y hy => ⟨δ / 2, by grind, fun z hz => h z (by
      have := dist_triangle z y x; have := dist_comm x y; grind)⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hK ι W hW fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov (f x) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := hV i (f x) hi
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := hf x hx ε hε
    exact ⟨i, δ, hδ, fun z hz => hball _ (by rw [dist_comm]; exact hδ' z hz)⟩
  refine ⟨l, fun y ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, δ, hδ, h⟩ := hl x hx
  exact ⟨i, hi, hxy ▸ h x (by rw [dist_self]; exact hδ)⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.subst_var:
/-- Substituting every variable by itself does nothing. -/
theorem subst_var : ∀ φ : Formula L, φ.subst Term.var = φ
  | bot => rfl
  | eq t s => by simp [subst, Term.subst_var]
  | rel R ts => by simp [subst, Term.subst_var]
  | imp φ ψ => by simp [subst, subst_var φ, subst_var ψ]
  | conj φ ψ => by simp [subst, subst_var φ, subst_var ψ]
  | disj φ ψ => by simp [subst, subst_var φ, subst_var ψ]
  | all φ => by simp [subst, Subst.lift_var, subst_var φ]
  | ex φ => by simp [subst, Subst.lift_var, subst_var φ]
Foundations.Numbers.R.poly_reflect:
/-- **Reflection of derivatives.** If `poly e d (P − y) = poly e d y` for all `y`, then the
`m`-th derivative satisfies `e⁽ᵐ⁾(P − y) = (−1)ᵐ e⁽ᵐ⁾(y)`. -/
theorem poly_reflect {e : Nat → R} {d : Nat} (he : Vanish e d) (P : R)
    (h0 : ∀ y, poly e d (P - y) = poly e d y) :
    ∀ m y, poly (iterD m e) d (P - y) = (-1) ^ m * poly (iterD m e) d y := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => intro y; show poly e d (P - y) = (-1) ^ 0 * poly e d y; rw [h0]; show _ = 1 * _; grind
  | succ m ih =>
    intro y
    -- Differentiate both sides of the identity for `m`.
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => poly (iterD m e) d (P - y))
        (poly (iterD (m + 1) e) d (P - y) * (0 - 1)) y :=
      (hasDerivAt_poly' (he.iterD m) (P - y)).comp (f := fun y => P - y)
        ((hasDerivAt_const P y).sub (hasDerivAt_id y))
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => (-1) ^ m * poly (iterD m e) d y)
        ((-1) ^ m * poly (iterD (m + 1) e) d y) y :=
      (hasDerivAt_poly' (he.iterD m) y).const_mul _
    have := h1.unique (h2.congr fun y => (ih y).symm)
    rw [pow_succ']; grind
Foundations.Algebra.CharZero.cast_inj:
/-- In characteristic zero, integers with equal images are equal. -/
theorem CharZero.cast_inj (hc : CharZero Ω) {a b : Int} (h : (Int.cast (a) : Ω) = (Int.cast (b) : Ω)) : a = b := by
  have := hc (a - b) (by rw [Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_sub, h]; grind)

Foundations.Algebra.isum_comp_bij:
/-- **Reindexing** a sum along a bijection. -/
theorem isum_comp_bij {κ : Type w} [FiniteType κ] (e : ι → κ) (inj : ∀ a b, e a = e b → a = b)
    (surj : ∀ y, ∃ x, e x = y) (f : κ → A) : isum (fun i => f (e i)) = isum f := by
  unfold isum
  have hperm : ((elems : List ι).map e).Perm (elems : List κ) := by
    rw [List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup (nodup_map_of_injective inj nodup) nodup]
    intro y
    simp only [List.mem_map, complete, true_and, iff_true]
    exact surj y
  rw [← lsum_perm (hperm.map f), List.map_map]; rfl
Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.lift_shift_:
/-- Lifting the shift and instantiating with the new variable is the identity. -/
theorem lift_shift_inst_zero (φ : Formula L) :
    (φ.subst (Subst.lift fun n => .var (n + 1))).inst (.var 0) = φ := by
  simp only [inst, subst_subst]
  conv => rhs; rw [← subst_var φ]
  apply subst_ext; intro n; cases n <;> rfl
Foundations.Algebra.crtHom:
/-- The **reduction map** `ℤ/mnℤ → ℤ/mℤ × ℤ/nℤ`, `a ↦ (a mod m, a mod n)`, is a ring
homomorphism. -/
def crtHom : RingHom (Fin (m * n)) (Fin m × Fin n) where
  toFun a := (Fin.ofNat m a.val, Fin.ofNat n a.val)
  map_add a b := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply Fin.ext
    · show (Fin.ofNat m (a + b).val).val = (Fin.ofNat m a.val + Fin.ofNat m b.val).val
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_add, fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val,
        Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (Nat.dvd_mul_right m n), ← Nat.add_mod]
    · show (Fin.ofNat n (a + b).val).val = (Fin.ofNat n a.val + Fin.ofNat n b.val).val
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_add, fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val,
        Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (Nat.dvd_mul_left n m), ← Nat.add_mod]
  map_mul a b := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply Fin.ext
    · show (Fin.ofNat m (a * b).val).val = (Fin.ofNat m a.val * Fin.ofNat m b.val).val
      rw [Fin.val_mul, Fin.val_mul, fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val,
        Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (Nat.dvd_mul_right m n), ← Nat.mul_mod]
    · show (Fin.ofNat n (a * b).val).val = (Fin.ofNat n a.val * Fin.ofNat n b.val).val
      rw [Fin.val_mul, Fin.val_mul, fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val,
        Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (Nat.dvd_mul_left n m), ← Nat.mul_mod]
  map_one := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply Fin.ext
    · show (Fin.ofNat m (Fin.ofNat (m * n) 1).val).val = (Fin.ofNat m 1).val
      rw [fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val,
        Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (Nat.dvd_mul_right m n)]
    · show (Fin.ofNat n (Fin.ofNat (m * n) 1).val).val = (Fin.ofNat n 1).val
      rw [fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val, fin_ofNat_val,
        Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (Nat.dvd_mul_left n m)]

Foundations.Geometry.Pt.euclid:
/-- (A10) **Euclid's axiom** in `K²`: stretch the segments `ab`, `ac` by the factor `1/u`. -/
theorem euclid (a b c d t : Pt K) (h₁ : Bet a d t) (h₂ : Bet b d c) (had : a ≠ d) :
    ∃ x y, Bet a b x ∧ Bet a c y ∧ Bet x t y := by
  obtain ⟨u, u0, u1, hdx, hdy⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨s, s0, s1, hdx', hdy'⟩ := h₂
  have hu : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact had (ext' (by grind) (by grind))
  refine ⟨⟨a.x + (b.x - a.x) / u, a.y + (b.y - a.y) / u⟩,
    ⟨a.x + (c.x - a.x) / u, a.y + (c.y - a.y) / u⟩,
    ⟨u, u0, u1, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨u, u0, u1, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨s, s0, s1, ?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> dsimp only <;> grind
Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.sameCut:
/-- The ones of two ordered fields have the same cut. -/
theorem sameCut_one : SameCut (1 : F) (1 : G) := fun q => by
  have h1 := ofRat_lt (K := F) (p := q) (q := 1)
  have h2 := ofRat_lt (K := G) (p := q) (q := 1)
  rw [ofRat_one] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2]
Foundations.Numbers.R.fsum_mono:
/-- Partial sums of non-negative terms increase. -/
theorem fsum_mono {a : Nat → R} (h : ∀ k, 0 ≤ a k) {m n : Nat} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    fsum a m ≤ fsum a n :=
  mono_le (a := fsum a) (fun n => by rw [fsum_succ]; have := h n; grind) hmn

/-- The order type of the initial segment below `a` is the rank of `a`. -/
theorem WFRel.otype_below (W : WFRel α) (a : α) : (W.below a).otype = rank W.R W.wf a := by
  apply ext
  intro z

  constructor

Foundations.Algebra.not_prime_square:
/-- A square is never prime. -/
theorem not_prime_square {x : Nat} (hp : IsPrime (x * x)) : False := by
  have h2 := hp.1
  rcases hp.2 x ⟨x, rfl⟩ with h | h
  · rw [h] at h2; simp at h2
  · have hx : 2 ≤ x := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hlt
      have : x * x ≤ 1 * 1 := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
      omega
    have : 2 * x ≤ x * x := Nat.mul_le_mul_right x hx
    omega
Foundations.Logic.Ordinals.ON.cmp_swap:
/-- Comparison is antisymmetric: swapping the arguments swaps the result. -/
theorem cmp_swap : ∀ x y, cmp y x = (cmp x y).swap
  | zero, zero => rfl
  | zero, oadd _ _ => rfl
  | oadd _ _, zero => rfl
  | oadd a b, oadd a' b' => by
      simp only [cmp, cmp_swap a a']
      cases cmp a a' <;> simp [Ordering.swap, cmp_swap b b']
Foundations.Algebra.Hom.ker_normal:
/-- **Kernels are normal.** The kernel of any homomorphism is a normal subgroup. -/
instance Hom.ker_normal {K : Type v} [Group K] (f : G →* K) : f.ker.Normal :=
  ⟨fun n hn g => by
    show f (g * n * g⁻¹) = 1
    rw [f.map_mul', f.map_mul', show f n = 1 from hn, mul_one, ← f.map_mul', mul_inv_cancel,
      f.map_one]⟩

Foundations.Sets.chosenSeq_mem_chosenLis:
/-- Earlier points stay in later lists. -/
theorem chosenSeq_mem_chosenList {m n : Nat} (hmn : m < n) : chosenSeq h m ∈ chosenList h n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact absurd hmn (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [chosenList, List.mem_cons]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hmn) with hlt | heq
    · exact Or.inr (ih hlt)
    · subst heq; exact Or.inl rfl

Foundations.Combinatorics.ramsey:
/-- The Ramsey bounds given by the recursion: `ramsey s t` with `ramsey 1 t = ramsey s 1 = 1`
and `ramsey (s+1) (t+1) = ramsey s (t+1) + ramsey (s+1) t` (for `s, t ≥ 1`). -/
def ramsey : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _ => 0
  | _ + 1, 0 => 0
  | 1, _ + 1 => 1
  | _ + 2, 1 => 1
  | s + 2, t + 2 => ramsey (s + 1) (t + 2) + ramsey (s + 2) (t + 1)
Foundations.Numbers.R.HasIntegral.integr:
/-- If `f` has integral `I` over `[a, b]` (with `a ≤ b`), then `∫ₐᵇ f = I`. -/
theorem HasIntegral.integral_eq {f : R → R} {a b I : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (h : HasIntegral f a b I) : integral f a b = I := by
  have hex : ∃ I, HasIntegral f a b I := ⟨I, h⟩
  unfold integral
  rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true hex)]
  exact hex.choose_spec.unique hab h

  refine comp ⟨rightCode, fun n => ?_⟩ hf

Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.kpair_mem_powerse:
/-- The pair `⟪a, b⟫` of members of `x` and `y` lies in `𝒫(𝒫(x ∪ y))`. -/
theorem kpair_mem_powerset_powerset {x y a b : ZFSet} (ha : a ∈ x) (hb : b ∈ y) :
    ⟪a, b⟫ ∈ powerset (powerset (x ∪ y)) := by
  rw [mem_powerset]
  intro z hz
  rw [mem_powerset]
  rcases mem_kpair.1 hz with rfl | rfl
  · intro w hw
    rw [mem_singleton.1 hw]
    exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha)
  · intro w hw
    rcases mem_pair.1 hw with rfl | rfl
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha)
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hb)
Foundations.Topology.Topology.continuous:
/-- **Universal property of the product**: a map into `X × Y` is continuous when both of its
components are. -/
theorem continuous_pair {ρ : Topology Z} {τ : Topology X} {σ : Topology Y} {f : Z → X} {g : Z → Y}
    (hf : Continuous ρ τ f) (hg : Continuous ρ σ g) :
    Continuous ρ (prod τ σ) (fun z => (f z, g z)) := fun W hW => by
  -- The preimage is the union of the preimages of the boxes inside `W`.
  refine ρ.isOpen_congr (ρ.isOpen_sUnion (fun O => ∃ U V, τ.IsOpen U ∧ σ.IsOpen V ∧
      (∀ q : X × Y, U q.1 → V q.2 → W q) ∧ O = fun z => U (f z) ∧ V (g z)) ?_) fun z => ?_
  · rintro O ⟨U, V, hU, hV, -, rfl⟩
    exact ρ.isOpen_inter _ _ (hf U hU) (hg V hV)
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨O, ⟨U, V, -, -, hUV, rfl⟩, h1, h2⟩; exact hUV _ h1 h2
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, h1, h2, h⟩ := hW _ hz
      exact ⟨_, ⟨U, V, hU, hV, h, rfl⟩, h1, h2⟩

Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.mulω_comm:
/-- Multiplication on ω is commutative. -/
theorem mulω_comm {m n : ZFSet} (hm : m ∈ ω) (hn : n ∈ ω) : m *ω n = n *ω m := by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := mem_omega.1 hm
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := mem_omega.1 hn
  rw [← vn_mul, ← vn_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.div_mod:
/-- **The division algorithm over a field.** If `g ≠ 0`, then every polynomial `p` can be
written `p = q * g + r` where `r = 0` or `deg r < deg g`. -/
theorem div_mod (hF : IsField R) (p g : Polynomial R) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ∃ q r, p = q * g + r ∧ (r = 0 ∨ natDegree r < natDegree g) := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hF.2 _ (leadingCoeff_ne_zero hg)
  obtain ⟨q, r, hqr, hr⟩ :=
    div_mod_aux g (natDegree g) u (degLT_natDegree hg) hu (len p) p (degLT_len p)
  refine ⟨q, r, hqr, ?_⟩
  by_cases hr0 : r = 0
  · exact Or.inl hr0
  · right
    have := len_le hr
    rw [len_eq_natDegree_succ hr0] at this
    omega

Foundations.Algebra.IsField.isDomain:
/-- **Every field is an integral domain.** -/
theorem IsField.isDomain {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (hF : IsField R) : IsDomain R := by
  refine ⟨hF.1, fun a b hab => ?_⟩
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · exact Or.inl ha
  · right
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hF.2 a ha
    calc b = (a * c) * b := by rw [hc, Ring.one_mul]
      _ = c * (a * b) := by rw [CommRing.mul_comm a c, Ring.mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hab, mul_zero]
Foundations.Algebra.lprod:
/-- The **product** of a list of ring elements. -/
def lprod : List R → R

Foundations.Types.STLC.pair_red_aux:
/-- The core of `pair_red`, by induction on the strong normalization of the components. -/
theorem pair_red_aux {A B : Ty} : ∀ a, SN a → ∀ b, SN b → RED A a → RED B b →
    RED (.prod A B) (pair a b) := by
  intro a hsa
  induction hsa with
  | intro a _ iha =>
    intro b hsb
    induction hsb with
    | intro b hbacc ihb =>
      intro ha hb
      constructor
      · refine (cr A).2.2 _ (by exact trivial) ?_
        intro x hx
        cases hx with
        | fstPair => exact ha
        | fst hx => cases hx with
          | pairL hx => exact (iha _ hx b (SN.intro hbacc) ((cr A).2.1 _ _ ha hx) hb).1
          | pairR hx => exact (ihb _ hx ha ((cr B).2.1 _ _ hb hx)).1
      · refine (cr B).2.2 _ (by exact trivial) ?_
        intro x hx
        cases hx with
        | sndPair => exact hb
        | snd hx => cases hx with
          | pairL hx => exact (iha _ hx b (SN.intro hbacc) ((cr A).2.1 _ _ ha hx) hb).2
          | pairR hx => exact (ihb _ hx ha ((cr B).2.1 _ _ hb hx)).2

/-- **Bayes' theorem**: `P(B | A) = P(A | B) P(B) / P(A)`. -/

    P.cond B A = P.cond A B * P.prob B / P.prob A := by
  rw [← prob_and_eq_cond_mul P hB]
  simp only [cond]
  rw [prob_congr P (A := fun x => B x ∧ A x) (B := fun x => A x ∧ B x) fun x _ => And.comm]

/-- A non-zero element times its inverse is one. -/
theorem mul_inv_cancel {A : Cut} (hA : A ≠ 0) : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := by
  have h : ∃ B, A * B = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := surj A
    have hx : x ≠ 0 := fun h => hA (by rw [h, ofR_zero])
    refine ⟨ofR x⁻¹, ?_⟩
    rw [← ofR_mul, one_eq]; congr 1; grind
  show A * inv A = 1
  unfold inv; rw [dite_eq_left h]; exact Classical.choose_spec h
Foundations.Numbers.R.pser_zero:
/-- The value at `0` is the constant coefficient. -/
theorem pser_zero {c : Nat → R} (hc : ∀ n, abs (c n) ≤ 1) : pser c 0 = c 0 := by
  have h : HasSum (pterm c 0) (c 0) := by
    apply (tendsto_const (c 0)).congr_eventually 1
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      show c 0 = 0 + c 0 * ((0 : R) ^ 0 / ((1 : Nat) : R)); grind
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [fsum_succ, ← ih (by omega)]
      unfold pterm; rw [expTerm_succ]; grind
  exact (hasSum_pser hc 0).unique h

  | hv n => rfl
  | hz => simp only [eval_zero_M, mz_std]; rfl
  | hs t ih => simp only [eval_succ_M, ms_std, ih]; rfl
  | ha t s iht ihs => simp only [eval_add_M, madd_std, iht, ihs, numM_add hM]

/-- **Injective maps between finite sets of the same size are surjective.** -/
theorem FiniteType.surjective_of_injective_card {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [FiniteType α]
    [FiniteType β] (f : α → β) (inj : ∀ a b, f a = f b → a = b) (hc : card α = card β) :
    ∀ y, ∃ x, f x = y := by
  have hL := nodup_map_of_injective inj (nodup (α := α))
  have h : count (fun y => y ∈ (elems : List α).map f) = card β := by
    rw [count_eq_length hL (fun _ => Iff.rfl), List.length_map]; exact hc
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := List.mem_map.1 (count_eq_card.1 h y)

Foundations.Logic.FO.D0.subst:
/-- **Bounded formulas are closed under substitution.** -/
theorem D0.subst {φ : Formula Arith} (h : D0 φ) : ∀ σ : Nat → Term Arith, D0 (φ.subst σ) := by
  induction h with
  | eq t s => intro σ; exact D0.eq _ _
  | le t s => intro σ; rw [substL_subst]; exact D0.le _ _
  | bot => intro σ; exact D0.bot
  | imp _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro σ; exact D0.imp (ih₁ σ) (ih₂ σ)
  | conj _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro σ; exact D0.conj (ih₁ σ) (ih₂ σ)
  | disj _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro σ; exact D0.disj (ih₁ σ) (ih₂ σ)
  | ball T _ ih =>
      intro σ; simp only [Formula.subst]; rw [boundF_subst]; exact D0.ball _ (ih _)
  | ballS T _ ih =>
      intro σ; simp only [Formula.subst]; rw [boundSF_subst]; exact D0.ballS _ (ih _)
  | bex T _ ih =>
      intro σ; simp only [Formula.subst]; rw [boundF_subst]; exact D0.bex _ (ih _)

/-- The inverse of an isomorphism is an isomorphism. -/
def symm (e : G ≃* H) : H ≃* G where
  toFun := e.invFun
  map_mul a b := by
    have h : e.toFun (e.invFun (a * b)) = e.toFun (e.invFun a * e.invFun b) := by
      rw [e.map_mul, e.right_inv, e.right_inv, e.right_inv]
    have h2 := congrArg e.invFun h
    rwa [e.left_inv, e.left_inv] at h2
  invFun := e.toFun
  left_inv := e.right_inv
  right_inv := e.left_inv

Foundations.Numbers.R.avoidStep_spec:
/-- One step of Cantor's construction shrinks the interval and moves it away from `y`. -/
theorem avoidStep_spec (y : R) {p : Q × Q} (h : p.1 < p.2) :
    (avoidStep y p).1 < (avoidStep y p).2 ∧ p.1 ≤ (avoidStep y p).1 ∧
      (avoidStep y p).2 ≤ p.2 ∧ (y < ofQ (avoidStep y p).1 ∨ ofQ (avoidStep y p).2 < y) := by
  unfold avoidStep
  by_cases hy : y < ofQ ((p.1 + 2 * p.2) / 3)
  · rw [ite_eq_left hy]; exact ⟨by grind, by grind, by grind, Or.inl hy⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_right hy]
    refine ⟨by grind, by grind, by grind, Or.inr ?_⟩
    have : ofQ ((2 * p.1 + p.2) / 3) < ofQ ((p.1 + 2 * p.2) / 3) := ofQ_lt.2 (by grind)
    grind

Foundations.Topology.CFun.complete:
/-- **`C[a, b]` is complete**: a Cauchy sequence for the sup metric converges uniformly to a
continuous function. -/
theorem complete : Complete (CFun a b) := by
  intro s hs
  have hab := LeFact.le (a := a) (b := b)
  -- Pointwise Cauchy, hence pointwise convergent.
  have hpt : ∀ x, ∃ L, Tendsto (fun n => (s n).1 x) L := fun x => cauchy_complete fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hs ε hε
    exact ⟨N, fun m n hm hn => Std.lt_of_le_of_lt (le_supDist _ _ x) (hN m n hm hn)⟩
  let g : R → R := fun x => (hpt x).choose
  have hg : ∀ x, Tendsto (fun n => (s n).1 x) (g x) := fun x => (hpt x).choose_spec
  -- The convergence is uniform.
  have hunif : ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → ∀ x, abs ((s n).1 x - g x) ≤ ε / 2 := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hs (ε / 2) (by grind)
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn x => ?_⟩
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hlt
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hg x (abs ((s n).1 x - g x) - ε / 2) (by grind)
    have k1 := hM (max M N) (by omega)
    have k2 : abs ((s n).1 x - (s (max M N)).1 x) < ε / 2 :=
      Std.lt_of_le_of_lt (le_supDist _ _ x) (hN n (max M N) hn (by omega))
    have := OF.abs_add ((s n).1 x - (s (max M N)).1 x) ((s (max M N)).1 x - g x)
    rw [show (s n).1 x - (s (max M N)).1 x + ((s (max M N)).1 x - g x) = (s n).1 x - g x by
      grind] at this
    grind
  have hu : UnifOn (fun n => (s n).1) g (fun _ => True) := fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hunif ε hε
    exact ⟨N, fun n hn x _ => Std.lt_of_le_of_lt (hN n hn x) (by grind)⟩
  have hcont := hu.contOn fun n => contOn_of_continuousAt fun x _ => (s n).2.2 x
  have hgc : ∀ x, g (clamp a b x) = g x := fun x =>
    tendsto_unique (hg (clamp a b x)) (by
      have : (fun n => (s n).1 (clamp a b x)) = (fun n => (s n).1 x) :=
        funext fun n => (s n).2.1 x
      rw [this]; exact hg x)
  refine ⟨⟨g, hgc, fun x ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hcont x trivial ε hε; exact ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => h y trivial hy⟩⟩,
    fun ε hε => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hunif ε hε
  exact ⟨N, fun n hn => Std.lt_of_le_of_lt (supDist_le fun x => hN n hn x) (by grind)⟩

  induction h with
  | intro t _ ih =>

      obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := ih t' ht'

    | none => exact ⟨t, Star.refl t, (normal_iff_step?_none t).2 hs⟩

Foundations.Categories.Adjunction:
/-- An **adjunction** `F ⊣ G`: a bijection between arrows `F X ⟶ Y` and `X ⟶ G Y`,
natural in `X` and `Y`. -/
structure Adjunction (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ C) where
  /-- The bijection `(F X ⟶ Y) ≅ (X ⟶ G Y)`. -/
  homEquiv : (X : C) → (Y : D) → Bij (F.obj X ⟶ Y) (X ⟶ G.obj Y)
  /-- Naturality in `X`. -/
  natural_left : ∀ {X' X : C} {Y : D} (f : X' ⟶ X) (g : F.obj X ⟶ Y),
    (homEquiv X' Y).toFun (F.map f ≫ g) = f ≫ (homEquiv X Y).toFun g
  /-- Naturality in `Y`. -/
  natural_right : ∀ {X : C} {Y Y' : D} (g : F.obj X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Y'),
    (homEquiv X Y').toFun (g ≫ h) = (homEquiv X Y).toFun g ≫ G.map h

Foundations.Categories.IsPullback:
/-- A commutative square `p₁ ≫ f = p₂ ≫ g` is a **pullback** of the cospan
`X ⟶ Z ⟵ Y` when every other commutative square over the cospan factors uniquely
through it. -/
structure IsPullback {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (P : C) (p₁ : P ⟶ X) (p₂ : P ⟶ Y) where
  /-- The square commutes. -/
  w : p₁ ≫ f = p₂ ≫ g
  /-- The factorisation of another commutative square. -/
  lift : {W : C} → (k₁ : W ⟶ X) → (k₂ : W ⟶ Y) → k₁ ≫ f = k₂ ≫ g → (W ⟶ P)
  /-- First component of the factorisation. -/
  fac₁ : ∀ {W : C} (k₁ : W ⟶ X) (k₂ : W ⟶ Y) (hk : k₁ ≫ f = k₂ ≫ g), lift k₁ k₂ hk ≫ p₁ = k₁
  /-- Second component of the factorisation. -/
  fac₂ : ∀ {W : C} (k₁ : W ⟶ X) (k₂ : W ⟶ Y) (hk : k₁ ≫ f = k₂ ≫ g), lift k₁ k₂ hk ≫ p₂ = k₂
  /-- Uniqueness of the factorisation. -/
  uniq : ∀ {W : C} (k₁ : W ⟶ X) (k₂ : W ⟶ Y) (hk : k₁ ≫ f = k₂ ≫ g) (h : W ⟶ P),
    h ≫ p₁ = k₁ → h ≫ p₂ = k₂ → h = lift k₁ k₂ hk
Foundations.Sets.prod_equinum_max:
/-- **Infinite products are maxima.** If `α` is infinite and `β` non-empty, then
`α × β` is equinumerous with the larger of `α` and `β`. -/
theorem prod_equinum_max {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (h : IsInfinite α) (b₀ : β) :
    (CardLE β α ∧ Equinum (α × β) α) ∨ (CardLE α β ∧ Equinum (α × β) β) := by
  rcases card_comparable β α with hle | hle
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hle, prod_equinum_of_le h hle b₀⟩
  · have hβ : IsInfinite β := isInfinite_of_nat_le ((nat_le_of_isInfinite h).trans hle)
    obtain ⟨e, _⟩ := nat_le_of_isInfinite h
    exact Or.inr ⟨hle, (prod_comm_equinum α β).trans (prod_equinum_of_le hβ hle (e 0))⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.hasSum_shift_iff:
/-- Dropping the first `N` terms: `Σ aₙ = s` iff `Σ aₙ₊ₖ = s − (a₀ + ⋯ + a_{N−1})`. -/
theorem hasSum_shift_iff {a : Nat → R} {s : R} (N : Nat) :
    HasSum (fun n => a (N + n)) (s - fsum a N) ↔ HasSum a s := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h2 := Tendsto.add (tendsto_const (fsum a N)) h
    rw [show fsum a N + (s - fsum a N) = s by grind] at h2
    exact Tendsto.of_shift N (h2.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => (fsum_split a N n).symm)
  · intro h
    exact (Tendsto.sub (h.shift N) (tendsto_const (fsum a N))).congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => by
      show fsum a (N + n) - fsum a N = fsum (fun k => a (N + k)) n
      rw [fsum_split]; grind
Foundations.Algebra.PolyList.coeff_mul_n:
/-- `p · [] ≡ 0`. -/
theorem coeff_mul_nil (p : List R) (n : Nat) : coeff (mul p []) n = 0 := by
  induction p generalizing n with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a p ih =>
    rw [coeff_mul_cons, coeff_nil, mul_zero, zero_add]
    cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => exact ih k
Foundations.Numbers.R.exp_zero:
/-- `exp 0 = 1`. -/
theorem exp_zero : exp 0 = 1 := by
  have h : HasSum (expTerm 0) 1 := by
    apply (tendsto_const 1).congr_eventually 1
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    induction k with
    | zero => show (1 : R) = 0 + (0 : R) ^ 0 / ((fact 0 : Nat) : R); show (1 : R) = 0 + 1 / ((1 : Nat) : R); grind
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [fsum_succ, ← ih (by omega), expTerm_succ]; grind
  exact (hasSum_exp 0).unique h
Foundations.Types.SystemF.Step:
/-- **One-step reduction** of System F: term β, type β (`(Λ. t) [B] ⟶ t[B]`), and
congruences. -/
inductive Step : Term → Term → Prop
  | beta (t u : Term) : Step (app (lam t) u) (inst t u)
  | tbeta (t : Term) (B : Ty) : Step (tapp (tlam t) B) (tyInst t B)
  | appL {t t' u : Term} : Step t t' → Step (app t u) (app t' u)
  | appR {t u u' : Term} : Step u u' → Step (app t u) (app t u')
  | lam {t t' : Term} : Step t t' → Step (lam t) (lam t')
  | tlam {t t' : Term} : Step t t' → Step (tlam t) (tlam t')
  | tapp {t t' : Term} {B : Ty} : Step t t' → Step (tapp t B) (tapp t' B)
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.mem_vn:
/-- **Each number is the set of smaller numbers.** The members of `vn n` are
exactly the `vn m` with `m < n`. -/
theorem mem_vn {n : Nat} {x : ZFSet} : x ∈ vn n ↔ ∃ m, m < n ∧ x = vn m := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [vn_zero]
    exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (not_mem_empty x), fun ⟨m, hm, _⟩ => absurd hm (Nat.not_lt_zero m)⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [vn_succ, mem_succ, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro (rfl | ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩)
      · exact ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨m, by omega, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
      by_cases h : m = n
      · exact Or.inl (h ▸ rfl)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨m, by omega, rfl⟩

Foundations.Numbers.C.inv_inv:
/-- Inversion is an involution. -/
theorem inv_inv (z : C) : z⁻¹⁻¹ = z := by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · rw [hz, inv_zero, inv_zero]
  · have h1 := mul_inv_cancel hz
    have hz' : z⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at h1; exact zero_ne_one h1
    have h2 := mul_inv_cancel hz'
    calc z⁻¹⁻¹ = (z * z⁻¹) * z⁻¹⁻¹ := by rw [h1, one_mul]
      _ = z * (z⁻¹ * z⁻¹⁻¹) := mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = z := by rw [h2, mul_one]
Foundations.Numbers.R.rsum_fine_self:
/-- A fine partition of a one-point interval has Riemann sum `0`. -/
theorem rsum_fine_self (f : R → R) {A B δ a : R} {l : List (R × R)} (h : Fine A B δ a l a) :
    rsum f a l = 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p l ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p
    obtain ⟨h1, -, -, -, -, h6⟩ := h
    have := h6.le
    have hx : x = a := by grind
    subst hx
    show f t * (x - x) + rsum f x l = 0
    rw [ih h6]; grind

  have := fundamental h (fun _ => snCand) var Ty.tvar (fun n B _ => (interp _ B).var n)

Foundations.Logic.FO.funF_fresh:
/-- `funF c` has free variables among `0, 1`. -/
theorem funF_fresh (c : Code) : ∀ x, 2 ≤ x → (funF c).Fresh x := by
  intro x hx
  have hvar : ∀ m k, m ≠ k → (v m).Fresh k := fun m k h => h
  refine ⟨fresh_substL leF_fresh (by simp) ?_, Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun m _ => ?_,
    boundF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega), boundF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega),
    Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun m _ => ?_, hvar _ _ (by omega), hvar _ _ (by omega)⟩
  · intro t ht; simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at ht
    rcases ht with rfl | rfl <;> exact var_fresh (by omega)
  · match m with
    | 0 => exact var_fresh (by omega)
    | 1 => exact var_fresh (by omega)
    | m + 2 => exact var_fresh (by omega)
  · match m with
    | 0 => exact var_fresh (by omega)
    | 1 => exact var_fresh (by omega)
    | m + 2 => exact var_fresh (by omega)

Foundations.Topology.exists_subseq_conve:
/-- If terms arbitrarily close to `L` occur arbitrarily late, a subsequence converges to `L`. -/
theorem exists_subseq_converges {s : Nat → X} {L : X}
    (h : ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∀ N, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ dist (s n) L < ε) :
    ∃ φ : Nat → Nat, (∀ k, φ k < φ (k + 1)) ∧ Converges (fun k => s (φ k)) L := by
  have spec : ∀ k, dist (s (chooseIdx s L h k)) L < 1 / ((k : R) + 1) := fun k => by
    cases k with
    | zero => exact (Classical.choose_spec (h (1 / ((0 : Nat) + 1)) (eps_pos 0) 0)).2
    | succ k => exact (Classical.choose_spec (h (1 / ((k + 1 : Nat) + 1)) (eps_pos (k + 1))
        (chooseIdx s L h k + 1))).2
  refine ⟨chooseIdx s L h, fun k => ?_, converges_of_dist_lt spec⟩
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (h (1 / ((k + 1 : Nat) + 1)) (eps_pos (k + 1))
    (chooseIdx s L h k + 1))).1
Foundations.Topology.Wallis.wp:
/-- The partial **Wallis products** `Π_{k=1}^{n} (2k)² / ((2k − 1)(2k + 1))`. -/

  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => wp n * ((2 * (n : R) + 2) * (2 * (n : R) + 2) / ((2 * (n : R) + 1) * (2 * (n : R) + 3)))

/-- The chosen variable really is fresh for everything in sight. -/
theorem freshVar_spec (A : List (Formula L)) (ψ : Formula L) :

theorem HasDerivAt.sub {f g : R → R} {a b x : R} (hf : HasDerivAt f a x) (hg : HasDerivAt g b x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => f y - g y) (a - b) x := by

Foundations.Geometry.rat_not_segment_con:
/-- **Segment construction fails in `ℚ²`**: on the ray from `(0,0)` through `(1,0)` one
cannot lay off, beyond `(1,0)`, a segment as long as the diagonal from `(0,0)` to
`(1,1)` — its length would be `√2`. -/
theorem rat_not_segment_construction :
    ¬ ∃ x : Pt Q, Pt.Bet ⟨0, 0⟩ ⟨1, 0⟩ x ∧ Pt.Cong ⟨1, 0⟩ x ⟨0, 0⟩ ⟨1, 1⟩ := by
  rintro ⟨x, ⟨t, -, -, h₁, h₂⟩, h⟩
  dsimp only at h₁ h₂
  unfold Pt.Cong Pt.d2 at h
  dsimp only at h
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0] at h₁; grind
  have hy : x.y = 0 := by grind
  rw [hy] at h
  exact Q.sqrt_two_irrational ⟨x.x - 1, by grind⟩
Foundations.Numbers.C.nrm_mul:
/-- `‖·‖` is submultiplicative. -/
theorem nrm_mul (z w : C) : nrm (z * w) ≤ nrm z * nrm w := by
  unfold nrm; simp only [mul_re, mul_im]
  have k1 := OF.abs_add (z.re * w.re) (-(z.im * w.im))
  have k2 := OF.abs_add (z.re * w.im) (z.im * w.re)
  rw [R.abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_mul] at k1
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul] at k2
  rw [show z.re * w.re + -(z.im * w.im) = z.re * w.re - z.im * w.im by grind] at k1
  grind

Foundations.Numbers.Q.inv:
/-- Inversion of rationals, well defined on classes. -/
def inv : Q → Q :=
  Quotient.lift invFrac (fun p q h => by
    have hp := num_pos_iff h
    have hn : p.num < 0 ↔ q.num < 0 := by
      have := num_pos_iff (p := ⟨-p.num, p.den, p.den_pos⟩) (q := ⟨-q.num, q.den, q.den_pos⟩)
        (by simp only [frac_rel_iff] at *; grind)
      simp only at this; omega
    have h' : p.num * q.den = q.num * p.den := h
    unfold invFrac
    by_cases h1 : 0 < p.num
    · have h2 := hp.1 h1
      simp only [h1, h2, dite_true, mk_eq_mk]; grind
    · have h2 : ¬ 0 < q.num := fun h => h1 (hp.2 h)
      by_cases h3 : p.num < 0
      · have h4 := hn.1 h3
        simp only [h1, h2, h3, h4, dite_true, dite_false, mk_eq_mk]; grind
      · have h4 : ¬ q.num < 0 := fun h => h3 (hn.2 h)
        simp only [h1, h2, h3, h4, dite_false])

      (firstSome ((step? t).map (fun t' => app t' u)) ((step? u).map (app t)))
  | lam t => (step? t).map lam

Foundations.Logic.FO.mle_numM_or:
/-- **Comparability with numerals.** Every element `x` of a model of `Q` satisfies
`x ≤ n̄` or `n̄ ≤ x`. -/
theorem mle_numM_or (x : M.Dom) : ∀ n, mle M x (numM M n) ∨ mle M (numM M n) x
  | 0 => Or.inr ⟨x, hM.add_zero x⟩
  | n + 1 => by
      rcases mle_numM_or x n with h | ⟨d, hd⟩
      · obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (mle_numM_iff hM x n).1 h
        exact Or.inl ((mle_numM_iff hM _ _).2 ⟨i, by omega, rfl⟩)
      · rcases hM.zero_or_succ d with rfl | ⟨d', rfl⟩
        · rw [zero_add_numM hM] at hd
          subst hd
          exact Or.inl ((mle_numM_iff hM _ _).2 ⟨n, by omega, rfl⟩)
        · refine Or.inr ⟨d', ?_⟩
          rw [madd_numM_succ hM, ← succ_add_numM hM, hd]

Foundations.Algebra.coprime_prime_iff:
/-- For a prime `p`, a number is coprime to `p` exactly when `p` does not divide it. -/
theorem coprime_prime_iff {p a : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) : Nat.Coprime a p ↔ ¬ p ∣ a := by
  constructor
  · intro h hdvd
    have : p ∣ Nat.gcd a p := Nat.dvd_gcd hdvd (Nat.dvd_refl p)
    rw [h] at this
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) this
    have := hp.1
    omega
  · intro h
    rcases hp.2 _ (Nat.gcd_dvd_right a p) with h1 | h1
    · exact h1
    · exfalso; apply h; rw [← h1]; exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left a p

Foundations.Algebra.IsPrimeElt.dvd_lprod:
/-- **Euclid's lemma for products of many factors.** A prime dividing a product of a list
divides one of its entries. -/
theorem IsPrimeElt.dvd_lprod {p : R} (hp : IsPrimeElt p) :
    ∀ M : List R, Divides p (lprod M) → ∃ q, q ∈ M ∧ Divides p q := by
  intro M
  induction M with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd (IsUnit.of_dvd ⟨1, Ring.mul_one 1⟩ h) hp.2.1
  | cons q M ih =>
    intro h
    rcases hp.2.2 q (lprod M) h with h1 | h1
    · exact ⟨q, List.mem_cons_self, h1⟩
    · obtain ⟨q', hq', hd⟩ := ih h1
      exact ⟨q', List.mem_cons_of_mem q hq', hd⟩
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.burali_forti:
/-- **Burali-Forti paradox.** There is no set of all ordinals: no set `Ω` contains
every ordinal. -/
theorem burali_forti : ¬ ∃ Ω : ZFSet, ∀ x, IsOrdinal x → x ∈ Ω := by
  rintro ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩
  -- the set of all ordinals, separated out of `Ω`
  let O := sep IsOrdinal Ω
  have hO : ∀ x, x ∈ O ↔ IsOrdinal x := fun x =>
    ⟨fun h => (mem_sep.1 h).2, fun h => mem_sep.2 ⟨hΩ x h, h⟩⟩
  have hOrd : IsOrdinal O :=
    isOrdinal_of_transitive_of_ordinals
      (fun y hy z hz => (hO z).2 (((hO y).1 hy).mem hz))
      (fun y hy => (hO y).1 hy)
  exact mem_irrefl O ((hO O).2 hOrd)

/-- For `x ≥ 0`, `exp x ≥ 1 + x` (the first two terms of the series). -/
theorem one_add_le_exp {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 1 + x ≤ exp x := by
  have := fsum_le_of_hasSum (expTerm_nonneg hx) (hasSum_exp x) 2
  have e : fsum (expTerm x) 2 = 1 + x := by
    rw [fsum_succ, fsum_succ, fsum_zero, expTerm_succ]

    grind
  grind

onto `gH`, so `|gH| = |H|`. -/

    count (leftCoset g H) = count (· ∈ H) :=
  count_comp_bij (fun x => g⁻¹ * x)

Foundations.Numbers.R.integral_pow:
/-- **Integral of a power.** `∫ₐᵇ tⁿ dt = (bⁿ⁺¹ − aⁿ⁺¹)/(n + 1)`. -/
theorem integral_pow (n : Nat) {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    integral (fun t => t ^ n) a b = (b ^ (n + 1) - a ^ (n + 1)) / ((n : R) + 1) := by
  have hn : (0 : R) < (n : R) + 1 := by
    have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg; grind
  have hd : ∀ t, a ≤ t → t ≤ b →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => 1 / ((n : R) + 1) * s ^ (n + 1)) (t ^ n) t := fun t _ _ => by
    have := (hasDerivAt_pow n t).const_mul (1 / ((n : R) + 1))
    rw [show 1 / ((n : R) + 1) * (((n : R) + 1) * t ^ n) = t ^ n by grind] at this
    exact this
  rw [integral_eq_sub hab hd fun t _ _ => continuousAt_pow n t]
  grind

  | 0, h => h 0 (Nat.le_refl _)
  | n + 1, h => Nat.Coprime.mul_right (coprime_prodUpTo n fun j hj => h j (by omega)) (h _ (Nat.le_refl _))
Foundations.Numbers.R.monotone_of_deriv_:
/-- **Monotonicity test.** A function with non-negative derivative on `[a, b]` is increasing
there. -/
theorem monotone_of_deriv_nonneg {f f' : R → R} {a b : R}
    (hd : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hpos : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → 0 ≤ f' x)
    {x y : R} (hax : a ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) (hyb : y ≤ b) : f x ≤ f y := by
  rcases (by grind : x = y ∨ x < y) with h | h
  · rw [h]; grind
  · obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := mean_value h
      (fun t h1 h2 => (hd t (by grind) (by grind)).continuousAt)
      (fun t h1 h2 => hd t (by grind) (by grind))
    have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (hpos c (by grind) (by grind)) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ y - x)
    grind

Foundations.Algebra.quadratic_reciprocit:
/-- **Reciprocity, classical form.** For distinct odd primes `p`, `q`: if either is `≡ 1 (mod 4)`
then `(p/q) = (q/p)`; if both are `≡ 3 (mod 4)` then `(p/q) = -(q/p)`. -/
theorem quadratic_reciprocity' {p q : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) (hq : IsPrime q) (hpo : p % 2 = 1)
    (hqo : q % 2 = 1) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    ((p % 4 = 1 ∨ q % 4 = 1) → legendre p q = legendre q p) ∧
    ((p % 4 = 3 ∧ q % 4 = 3) → legendre p q = -legendre q p) := by
  have hr := quadratic_reciprocity hp hq hpo hqo hpq
  have hpq' : ¬ p ∣ q := fun h => by
    rcases hq.2 p h with h1 | h1
    · have := hp.1; omega
    · exact hpq h1
  have hcases := legendre_cases hp hpo hpq'
  rw [neg_one_pow_int] at hr
  have hpar : (half p * half q) % 2 = 0 ↔ (p % 4 = 1 ∨ q % 4 = 1) := by
    unfold half
    rw [Nat.mul_mod]
    have : (p - 1) / 2 % 2 = 0 ∨ (p - 1) / 2 % 2 = 1 := by omega
    have : (q - 1) / 2 % 2 = 0 ∨ (q - 1) / 2 % 2 = 1 := by omega
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases ‹(p - 1) / 2 % 2 = 0 ∨ _› with h1 | h1 <;>
        rcases ‹(q - 1) / 2 % 2 = 0 ∨ _› with h2 | h2 <;> rw [h1, h2] at h <;> first | omega | simp at h
    · intro h
      rcases h with h | h
      · rw [show (p - 1) / 2 % 2 = 0 by omega]; simp
      · rw [show (q - 1) / 2 % 2 = 0 by omega]; simp
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ?_⟩
  · rw [ite_true_of (hpar.2 h)] at hr
    rcases hcases with ⟨hl, _⟩ | ⟨hl, _⟩ <;> rw [hl] at hr ⊢ <;> omega
  · rw [ite_false_of (fun e => by rcases hpar.1 e with e | e <;> omega)] at hr
    rcases hcases with ⟨hl, _⟩ | ⟨hl, _⟩ <;> rw [hl] at hr ⊢ <;> omega

/-- **Sierpiński space**: the two points `false, true`, with open sets `∅`, `{true}`, and

  IsOpen U := U false → U true
  isOpen_univ := fun _ => trivial
  isOpen_inter _ _ hU hV := fun h => ⟨hU h.1, hV h.2⟩

Foundations.Algebra.sylow_first:
/-- **Sylow's first theorem.** If `p` is prime and `p ^ k` divides the order of the finite
group `G`, then `G` has a subgroup of order exactly `p ^ k`. -/
theorem sylow_first {p k : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) (hdvd : p ^ k ∣ card G) :
    ∃ H : Subgroup G, card H = p ^ k := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨Subgroup.bot, ?_⟩
    rw [card_subtype, Nat.pow_zero]
    exact count_eq_self 1
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := ih (Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ k)) hdvd)
    exact exists_subgroup_card_pow_succ hp H hH hdvd

Foundations.Algebra.Perm.conj_swap:
/-- **Conjugating a transposition** relabels it: `σ (a b) σ⁻¹ = (σa σb)`. -/
theorem conj_swap (σ : Perm α) (a b : α) : σ * swap a b * σ⁻¹ = swap (σ a) (σ b) := by
  apply ext; intro x
  simp only [mul_apply, inv_toFun, swap_apply]
  by_cases h1 : σ.invFun x = a
  · have : x = σ a := by rw [← h1, apply_inv]
    simp [this]
  · by_cases h2 : σ.invFun x = b
    · have hxb : x = σ b := by rw [← h2, apply_inv]
      have hxa : x ≠ σ a := fun h => h1 (by rw [h, inv_apply])
      have hba : b ≠ a := fun e => h1 (h2.trans e)
      have hσ : σ b ≠ σ a := fun e => hba (σ.injective e)
      rw [h2, hxb]
      simp [hba, hσ]
    · have e1 : x ≠ σ a := fun h => h1 (by rw [h, inv_apply])
      have e2 : x ≠ σ b := fun h => h2 (by rw [h, inv_apply])
      simp [h1, h2, e1, e2]

Foundations.Numbers.C.growth:
/-- **Growth.** For a polynomial `t` with a non-zero coefficient, `|z · t(z)| → ∞`. -/
theorem growth (t : List C) (ht : NonZero t) :
    ∀ B : R, ∃ ρ, 0 ≤ ρ ∧ ∀ z, ρ ≤ cabs z → B ≤ cabs (z * peval t z) := by
  induction t with
  | nil => obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := ht; cases ha
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro B
    by_cases ht' : NonZero t
    · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, h⟩ := ih ht' (abs B + cabs a)
      refine ⟨ρ + 1, by grind, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      have k := h z (by grind)
      show B ≤ cabs (z * (a + z * peval t z))
      rw [cabs_mul]
      have k1 := cabs_add (a + z * peval t z) (-a)
      rw [show a + z * peval t z + -a = z * peval t z by grind, cabs_neg] at k1
      have hB := le_abs B
      have hX : 0 ≤ cabs (a + z * peval t z) := cabs_nonneg _
      have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by grind : (1 : R) ≤ cabs z) hX
      grind
    · have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hb0⟩ := ht
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with e | e
        · exact e ▸ hb0
        · exact absurd ⟨b, e, hb0⟩ ht'
      have hpa := cabs_pos ha
      have hρ : 0 ≤ abs B / cabs a := by
        rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
        exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg B)
          (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hpa))
      refine ⟨abs B / cabs a, hρ, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      show B ≤ cabs (z * (a + z * peval t z))
      rw [peval_of_not_nonZero ht' z, show a + z * 0 = a by grind, cabs_mul]
      have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz (cabs_nonneg a)
      have e : abs B / cabs a * cabs a = abs B := by grind
      have := le_abs B
      grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.mean_value:
/-- **Mean value theorem** (Lagrange). If `f` is continuous on `[a, b]` and differentiable on
`(a, b)`, then the chord slope is attained as a derivative: `f b − f a = f' c · (b − a)` for some
`c` strictly between `a` and `b`. -/
theorem mean_value {f f' : R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a < b)
    (hc : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ContinuousAt f x)
    (hd : ∀ x, a < x → x < b → HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) :
    ∃ c, a < c ∧ c < b ∧ f b - f a = f' c * (b - a) := by
  -- Apply Rolle to `g y = f y · (b − a) − y · (f b − f a)`, which has `g a = g b`.
  let g : R → R := fun y => f y * (b - a) - y * (f b - f a)
  have hgc : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ContinuousAt g x := fun x h1 h2 =>
    continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_mul (hc x h1 h2) (continuousAt_const _ x))
      (continuousAt_mul (continuousAt_id x) (continuousAt_const _ x))
  have hgd : ∀ x, a < x → x < b →
      HasDerivAt g (f' x * (b - a) + f x * 0 - (1 * (f b - f a) + x * 0)) x := fun x h1 h2 =>
    ((hd x h1 h2).mul (hasDerivAt_const _ x)).sub ((hasDerivAt_id x).mul (hasDerivAt_const _ x))
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := rolle hab hgc hgd (by grind)
  exact ⟨c, hc1, hc2, by grind⟩

Foundations.Algebra.IsGalois:
/-- A finite extension `L/K` is **Galois** if it has exactly `[L : K]` automorphisms: there is
an enumeration of `Aut(L/K)` without repetitions of length `[L : K]`. -/
def IsGalois (K L : Subfield Ω) (hKL : K.le L) : Prop :=
  FiniteExt K L hKL ∧ ∃ (n : Nat) (σ : Fin n → FieldAut K L), (∀ i j, σ i = σ j → i = j) ∧

Foundations.Algebra.imp_of_count_eq:
/-- If `P` implies `Q` and both are satisfied equally often, then `Q` implies `P`. -/
theorem imp_of_count_eq {α : Type u} [FiniteType α] {P Q : α → Prop} (hPQ : ∀ x, P x → Q x)
    (hc : count P = count Q) : ∀ x, Q x → P x := by
  have h := count_split Q P
  have h1 : count (fun x => Q x ∧ P x) = count P :=
    count_congr fun x => ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hPQ x h, h⟩⟩
  have h0 : count (fun x => Q x ∧ ¬ P x) = 0 := by omega
  intro x hq
  exact Classical.byContradiction fun hp => count_eq_zero.1 h0 x ⟨hq, hp⟩

/-- Evaluation of Niven's polynomial: `f(x) = xⁿ (a − b x)ⁿ / n!`. -/
theorem poly_nivenC (a b x : R) (n : Nat) :
    poly (nivenC a b n) (2 * n + 1) x = x ^ n * (a - b * x) ^ n / (fact n : R) := by
  have := poly_nivenH a b x n
  unfold poly at this ⊢
  have e : fsum (fun k => nivenC a b n k * x ^ k) (2 * n + 1) =
      (1 / (fact n : R)) * fsum (fun k => nivenH a b n k * x ^ k) (2 * n + 1) := by
    rw [← fsum_const_mul]; exact fsum_congr fun k _ => by unfold nivenC; grind
  rw [e, this]; grind

theorem RED_subst (A : Ty) : ∀ ρ σ t, RED ρ (A.subst σ) t ↔ RED (fun n => interp ρ (σ n)) A t := by
  induction A with
  | tvar n => intros; exact Iff.rfl
  | arr A B ihA ihB => intros; simp only [RED, Ty.subst, ihA, ihB]
  | all A ih =>
    intro ρ σ t
    have henv : ∀ C, (fun n => interp (extend C ρ) (Ty.up σ n)) = extend C (fun n => interp ρ (σ n)) := by
      intro C
      funext n
      cases n with
      | zero => exact Cand.ext fun _ => Iff.rfl
      | succ n => exact Cand.ext fun t => RED_rename (σ n) (extend C ρ) Nat.succ t
    simp only [RED, Ty.subst, ih, henv]

(A corollary of the abstract incompleteness theorem.) -/

    (sound : ∀ c x, Provable c x → ¬ Halts c [x])
    (ce : ∃ q : Code, ∀ c x, Halts q [encode c, x] ↔ Provable c x) :

Foundations.Algebra.isum_single:
/-- A sum over a finite type in which only the term at `a` can be non-zero equals that term. -/
theorem isum_single {A : Type u} [AddAbGroup A] {ι : Type u} [FiniteType ι] (f : ι → A) (a : ι)
    (hf : ∀ i, i ≠ a → f i = 0) : isum f = f a := by
  have key : ∀ l : List ι, l.Nodup → lsum (l.map f) = (by classical exact if a ∈ l then f a else 0) := by
    intro l hl
    classical
    induction l with
    | nil => simp [lsum]
    | cons b l ih =>
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at hl
      show f b + lsum (l.map f) = _
      rw [ih hl.2]
      by_cases hb : b = a
      · subst hb; simp [hl.1, AddAbGroup.add_zero]
      · rw [hf b hb, AddAbGroup.zero_add]
        by_cases ha : a ∈ l
        · simp [ha]
        · have : a ∉ b :: l := by simp [ha, Ne.symm hb]
          simp [ha, this]
  classical
  unfold isum
  rw [key _ nodup]
  simp [complete]

Foundations.Algebra.FiniteType.count_com:
/-- **Bijections preserve counts** — the Cantor–Frege principle that equinumerosity is the
existence of a one-to-one correspondence. If `f : α → β` is a bijection, then exactly as
many elements of `α` satisfy `Q ∘ f` as elements of `β` satisfy `Q`. -/
theorem count_comp_bij [FiniteType β] (f : α → β) (inj : ∀ a b, f a = f b → a = b)
    (surj : ∀ y, ∃ x, f x = y) (Q : β → Prop) :
    count (fun x => Q (f x)) = count Q := by
  classical
  rw [count_eq_countP, count_eq_countP]
  have hperm : ((elems : List α).map f).Perm (elems : List β) := by
    rw [List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup (nodup_map_of_injective inj nodup) nodup]
    intro y
    simp only [List.mem_map, complete, true_and, iff_true]
    exact surj y
  rw [← hperm.countP_eq, List.countP_map]
  rfl
Foundations.Algebra.FieldAut:
/-- **Automorphism of a field extension** `L/K` (subfields of `Ω`): a bijection `L → L` that
preserves addition and multiplication and fixes every element of `K`. -/
structure FieldAut (K L : Subfield Ω) where
  /-- The map. -/
  toFun : L → L
  /-- Its inverse. -/
  invFun : L → L
  /-- `invFun` undoes `toFun`. -/
  left_inv : ∀ x, invFun (toFun x) = x
  /-- `toFun` undoes `invFun`. -/
  right_inv : ∀ x, toFun (invFun x) = x
  /-- Additivity. -/
  map_add : ∀ x y, toFun (x + y) = toFun x + toFun y
  /-- Multiplicativity. -/
  map_mul : ∀ x y, toFun (x * y) = toFun x * toFun y
  /-- Elements of `K` are fixed. -/
  fix : ∀ x : L, x.1 ∈ K → toFun x = x

  induction hv with
  | refl => exact ⟨u, Star.refl u, hu⟩
  | tail _ hstep ih =>
    obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀, hv₀⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨w, h₁, h₂⟩ := Par.diamond hv₀ hstep
    exact ⟨w, hw₀.tail h₁, h₂⟩
Foundations.Logic.Ordinals.pow_lg_le:
/-- `b^lg(n) ≤ n`. -/
theorem pow_lg_le {b : Nat} (hb : 2 ≤ b) : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → b ^ lg b n ≤ n := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hn
    rw [lg]
    split
    · next h =>
        have hq : 1 ≤ n / b := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).2 (by omega)
        have := ih (n / b) (Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) (by omega)) hq
        rw [Nat.pow_succ]
        exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right b this) (Nat.div_mul_le_self n b)
    · simpa using hn

Foundations.Numbers.R.summable_of_abs:
/-- **Absolute convergence implies convergence.** If `Σ |aₙ|` converges, so does `Σ aₙ`, and
`|Σ aₙ| ≤ Σ |aₙ|`. -/
theorem summable_of_abs {a : Nat → R} {t : R} (h : HasSum (fun n => abs (a n)) t) :
    ∃ s, HasSum a s ∧ abs s ≤ t := by
  have hc := h.isCauchySeq
  have key : ∀ m k, abs (fsum a (m + k) - fsum a m) ≤
      fsum (fun n => abs (a n)) (m + k) - fsum (fun n => abs (a n)) m := fun m k => by
    rw [fsum_split, fsum_split (fun n => abs (a n))]
    have := abs_fsum_le (fun n => a (m + n)) k
    rw [show fsum a m + fsum (fun n => a (m + n)) k - fsum a m = fsum (fun n => a (m + n)) k by grind]
    grind
  have hcs : IsCauchySeq (fsum a) := fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hc ε hε
    refine ⟨N, fun m n hm hn => ?_⟩
    rcases (by omega : m ≤ n ∨ n ≤ m) with h' | h'
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = m + k := ⟨n - m, by omega⟩
      have := abs_le.1 (key m k)
      have := (abs_lt.1 (hN (m + k) m hn hm)).2
      rw [abs_sub_comm]
      exact abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = n + k := ⟨m - n, by omega⟩
      have := abs_le.1 (key n k)
      have := (abs_lt.1 (hN (n + k) n hm hn)).2
      exact abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := cauchy_complete hcs
  exact ⟨s, hs, abs_hasSum_le (fun n => Std.le_refl _) hs h⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.poly_linPow:
/-- Evaluation: `Σ_{k ≤ j} linPow j k · xᵏ = (a − b x)ʲ`. -/
theorem poly_linPow (a b x : R) (j : Nat) : poly (linPow a b j) (j + 1) x = (a - b * x) ^ j := by
  induction j with
  | zero => show 0 + 1 * x ^ 0 = (a - b * x) ^ 0; show (0 : R) + 1 * 1 = 1; grind
  | succ j ih =>
    unfold poly at ih ⊢
    rw [fsum_succ']
    have e1 : fsum (fun k => linPow a b (j + 1) (k + 1) * x ^ (k + 1)) (j + 1) =
        a * fsum (fun k => linPow a b j (k + 1) * x ^ (k + 1)) (j + 1) -
          b * x * fsum (fun k => linPow a b j k * x ^ k) (j + 1) := by
      rw [← fsum_const_mul, ← fsum_const_mul, ← fsum_sub]
      exact fsum_congr fun k _ => by
        show (a * linPow a b j (k + 1) - b * linPow a b j k) * x ^ (k + 1) = _
        rw [pow_succ']; grind
    have e2 := fsum_succ' (fun k => linPow a b j k * x ^ k) (j + 1)
    rw [fsum_succ, linPow_vanish a b j (j + 1) (by omega), ih] at e2
    rw [e1, ih, pow_succ']
    show a * linPow a b j 0 * x ^ 0 + _ = _
    have : linPow a b j 0 * x ^ 0 + fsum (fun k => linPow a b j (k + 1) * x ^ (k + 1)) (j + 1) =
        (a - b * x) ^ j := by grind
    grind

Foundations.Logic.FO.compactness_entails:

already entail `φ`. -/
theorem compactness_entails {Γ : Theory L} {φ : Formula L} (h : Entails Γ φ) :
    ∃ l : List (Formula L), (∀ ψ ∈ l, Γ ψ) ∧ Entails (ofList l) φ := by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hd⟩ := Proves.finite_premises (Γ₀ := empty) (completeness h)

Foundations.Algebra.intCast_mem_ratField:

/-- For every `c` and `ε > 0` there is `η > 0` with `|c| · η ≤ ε` (take `η = ε / (|c| + 1)`). -/
theorem exists_mul_le (c : R) {ε : R} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ η : R, 0 < η ∧ abs c * η ≤ ε := by
  have hc := abs_nonneg c
  refine ⟨ε / (abs c + 1), div_pos hε (by grind), ?_⟩
  have hη : 0 < ε / (abs c + 1) := div_pos hε (by grind)
  have e : (abs c + 1) * (ε / (abs c + 1)) = ε := by grind
  grind

    rw [← h] at this

    exact absurd this (mem_irrefl _)

theorem hall_necessary (A : Nat → Nat → Prop) (f : Nat → Nat)
    (hf : ∀ i, i < N → f i < M ∧ A i (f i)) (hinj : ∀ i j, i < N → j < N → i ≠ j → f i ≠ f j)

Foundations.Topology.IsConnected.mem_of_:
/-- **Connected sets of reals are intervals**: if a connected set contains `u ≤ w`, it contains
every `v` between them. -/
theorem IsConnected.mem_of_between {A : R → Prop} (hA : IsConnected (Topology.metric R) A)
    {u v w : R} (hu : A u) (hw : A w) (huv : u ≤ v) (hvw : v ≤ w) : A v := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hv
  have hlt : ∀ y, A y → y < v ∨ v < y := fun y hy => by
    rcases (by grind : y < v ∨ y = v ∨ v < y) with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact absurd (h ▸ hy) hv
    · exact Or.inr h
  have hu' : u < v := by rcases hlt u hu with h | h <;> grind
  have hw' : v < w := by rcases hlt w hw with h | h <;> grind
  exact hA ⟨fun y => y < v, fun y => v < y,
    fun y hy => ⟨v - y, by grind, fun z hz => by have := abs_lt.1 hz; grind⟩,
    fun y hy => ⟨y - v, by grind, fun z hz => by have := abs_lt.1 hz; grind⟩,
    hlt, ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩, ⟨w, hw, hw'⟩, fun y _ h1 h2 => by grind⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.tendsto_pow_zero:
/-- Powers of a number in `[0, 1)` tend to `0`. -/
theorem tendsto_pow_zero {r : R} (h0 : 0 ≤ r) (h1 : r < 1) : Tendsto (fun n => r ^ n) 0 := by
  -- The powers decrease and are bounded below, so they converge, say to `L`; then `L = r L`.
  have hnn : ∀ n : Nat, 0 ≤ r ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => show (0 : R) ≤ 1; grind
    | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ']; exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg ih h0
  have hdec : ∀ n : Nat, r ^ (n + 1) ≤ r ^ n := fun n => by
    rw [pow_succ']
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt h1) (hnn n)
    grind
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := monotone_convergence (a := fun n => -r ^ n) (fun n => by
    have := hdec n; show -r ^ n ≤ -r ^ (n + 1); grind) ⟨0, fun n => by
      have := hnn n; show -r ^ n ≤ 0; grind⟩
  have hL' : Tendsto (fun n => r ^ n) (-L) := by
    have := hL.const_mul (-1)
    rw [show -1 * L = -L by grind] at this
    exact this.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => by show -1 * -r ^ n = r ^ n; grind
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun n => r ^ (1 + n)) (r * -L) := by
    have := hL'.const_mul r
    exact this.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => by
      show r * r ^ n = r ^ (1 + n); rw [Nat.add_comm, pow_succ']; grind
  have := tendsto_unique (hL'.shift 1) h2
  have : -L = 0 := by
    have hr : (1 - r) * -L = 0 := by grind
    have hne : 1 - r ≠ 0 := by grind
    have : (1 - r)⁻¹ * ((1 - r) * -L) = -L := by grind
    grind
  rw [this] at hL'; exact hL'

/-- A premise read off a coded list of derivable judgements is true (out-of-range reads
give `0 = judg 0 0 0`, the true judgement "`zero` outputs `0` on the empty input"). -/
theorem eval_of_lnth {l : List Nat}
    (ih : ∀ y ∈ l, ∀ (c : Code) (xs : List Nat) (n : Nat), y = judg (encode c) (encList xs) n →
      Eval c xs n)
    {i : Nat} {c : Code} {xs : List Nat} {n : Nat}
    (h : lnth (encList l) i = judg (encode c) (encList xs) n) : Eval c xs n := by
  by_cases hi : i < l.length
  · exact ih _ (List.getElem_mem hi) c xs n (by rw [← h, lnth_encList, getD_eq_getElem' l i hi])
  · rw [lnth_encList, getD_eq_zero' _ _ (by omega)] at h
    have h1 := pair_inj (show pair 0 0 = pair (encode c) (pair (encList xs) n) from h)
    have h2 := pair_inj (show pair 0 0 = pair (encList xs) n from h1.2)
    have hc : c = .zero := encode_inj (show encode c = encode .zero from h1.1.symm)
    subst hc; rw [← h2.2]; exact .zero

Foundations.Topology.dist_orbit_succ:
/-- Consecutive orbit points get closer geometrically: `d(xₙ₊₁, xₙ) ≤ qⁿ d(x₁, x₀)`. -/
theorem dist_orbit_succ {f : X → X} {q : R} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q)
    (hf : ∀ x y, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ q * dist x y) (x₀ : X) (n : Nat) :
    dist (orbit f x₀ (n + 1)) (orbit f x₀ n) ≤ q ^ n * dist (orbit f x₀ 1) x₀ := by
  induction n with
  | zero => show dist (orbit f x₀ 1) x₀ ≤ 1 * _; clear hf; grind
  | succ n ih =>
    have := hf (orbit f x₀ (n + 1)) (orbit f x₀ n)
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hq0
    show dist (f (orbit f x₀ (n + 1))) (f (orbit f x₀ n)) ≤ q ^ (n + 1) * _
    rw [pow_succ']; grind

Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.kpair_inj:
/-- **Characteristic property of ordered pairs.** `⟪a, b⟫ = ⟪c, d⟫` if and only if
`a = c` and `b = d`. -/
theorem kpair_inj {a b c d : ZFSet} : ⟪a, b⟫ = ⟪c, d⟫ ↔ a = c ∧ b = d := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    -- `{a}` is a member of the right-hand side
    have h1 : ({a} : ZFSet) = {c} ∨ ({a} : ZFSet) = {c, d} :=
      mem_kpair.1 (mem_of_eq h (mem_kpair.2 (Or.inl rfl)))
    have hac : a = c := by
      rcases h1 with h1 | h1
      · exact singleton_inj.1 h1
      · exact (mem_singleton.1 (mem_of_eq h1.symm (mem_pair.2 (Or.inl rfl)))).symm
    subst hac
    -- `{a, b}` is a member of the right-hand side, `{a, d}` of the left-hand side
    have h2 : ({a, b} : ZFSet) = {a} ∨ ({a, b} : ZFSet) = {a, d} :=
      mem_kpair.1 (mem_of_eq h (mem_kpair.2 (Or.inr rfl)))
    have h3 : ({a, d} : ZFSet) = {a} ∨ ({a, d} : ZFSet) = {a, b} :=
      mem_kpair.1 (mem_of_eq h.symm (mem_kpair.2 (Or.inr rfl)))
    have hb : b = a ∨ b = d := by
      rcases h2 with h2 | h2
      · exact Or.inl (mem_singleton.1 (mem_of_eq h2 (mem_pair.2 (Or.inr rfl))))
      · exact mem_pair.1 (mem_of_eq h2 (mem_pair.2 (Or.inr rfl)))
    have hd : d = a ∨ d = b := by
      rcases h3 with h3 | h3
      · exact Or.inl (mem_singleton.1 (mem_of_eq h3 (mem_pair.2 (Or.inr rfl))))
      · exact mem_pair.1 (mem_of_eq h3 (mem_pair.2 (Or.inr rfl)))
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    rcases hb with hb | hb
    · rcases hd with hd | hd
      · exact hb.trans hd.symm
      · exact hd.symm
    · exact hb
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl

Foundations.Numbers.gsum_mul_gsum:
/-- **Product of partial sums.** `(Σ_{i<N} f i)(Σ_{j<N} g j)` is the "triangle" `i + j < N` plus
the remainder `Σ_{i<N} f i · Σ_{k<i} g (N − i + k)`. -/
theorem gsum_mul_gsum (f g : Nat → α) (N : Nat) :
    gsum f N * gsum g N = gsum (fun n => gsum (fun i => f i * g (n - i)) (n + 1)) N +
      gsum (fun i => f i * gsum (fun k => g (N - i + k)) i) N := by
  rw [← gsum_triangle, ← gsum_add, ← gsum_mul_right]
  apply gsum_congr
  intro i hi
  have := gsum_split g (N - i) i
  rw [show N - i + i = N by omega] at this
  rw [this]; grind

/-- From `γ₁ → ⋯ → γₙ → φ` and the premises `γᵢ`, modus ponens yields `φ`. -/
theorem derives_of_impChain {φ : Formula} :
    ∀ (l : List Formula) {Δ : Theory}, (∀ ψ ∈ l, Δ ψ) → Δ ⊢ impChain l φ → Δ ⊢ φ
  | [], _, _, h => h
  | a :: l, Δ, hl, h =>
      derives_of_impChain l (fun ψ hψ => hl ψ (by simp [hψ]))

Foundations.Topology.Outer.finite_cover:
/-- **Finitely many open intervals covering `[a, b]` have total length `> b − a`.** -/
theorem finite_cover {lo hi : Nat → R} (hlh : ∀ k, lo k ≤ hi k) (N : Nat) (b : R) :
    ∀ n (P : Nat → Prop) (a : R), pcnt P N ≤ n → a ≤ b →
      (∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ∃ k, k < N ∧ P k ∧ lo k < x ∧ x < hi k) →
      b - a < psum (fun k => hi k - lo k) P N := by
  have hlen : ∀ k, 0 ≤ hi k - lo k := fun k => by have := hlh k; grind
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro P a hc hab hcov
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hP, -, -⟩ := hcov a (Std.le_refl a) hab
    have := (psum_remove (fun k => hi k - lo k) hj hP).2; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro P a hc hab hcov
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hP, h1, h2⟩ := hcov a (Std.le_refl a) hab
    obtain ⟨r1, r2⟩ := psum_remove (fun k => hi k - lo k) hj hP
    rcases (by grind : b < hi j ∨ hi j ≤ b) with hb | hb
    · have := le_psum hlen hj hP; grind
    · have := ih (fun k => P k ∧ k ≠ j) (hi j) (by omega) hb fun x hx1 hx2 => by
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hPk, k1, k2⟩ := hcov x (by grind) hx2
        exact ⟨k, hk, ⟨hPk, fun e => by subst e; grind⟩, k1, k2⟩
      rw [r1]; grind

Foundations.Algebra.Subgroup.prodNormal:
/-- The **product** `HN = {h * n | h ∈ H, n ∈ N}` of a subgroup and a normal subgroup is a
subgroup. -/
def Subgroup.prodNormal : Subgroup G where
  carrier x := ∃ h, h ∈ H ∧ ∃ n, n ∈ N ∧ h * n = x
  one_mem := ⟨1, H.one_mem, 1, N.one_mem, one_mul 1⟩
  mul_mem := by
    intro a b ⟨h, hh, n, hn, ha⟩ ⟨h', hh', n', hn', hb⟩
    refine ⟨h * h', H.mul_mem hh hh', h'⁻¹ * n * h'⁻¹⁻¹ * n',
      N.mul_mem (hN.conj_mem n hn h'⁻¹) hn', ?_⟩
    rw [← ha, ← hb, inv_inv]
    simp only [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]
  inv_mem := by
    intro a ⟨h, hh, n, hn, ha⟩
    refine ⟨h⁻¹, H.inv_mem hh, h * n⁻¹ * h⁻¹, hN.conj_mem _ (N.inv_mem hn) h, ?_⟩
    rw [← ha, mul_inv_rev, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]

Foundations.Logic.FO.stdModel_PAClosure:

Foundations.Numbers.C.cabs_add:
/-- **Triangle inequality** for the modulus: `|z + w| ≤ |z| + |w|`. -/
theorem cabs_add (z w : C) : cabs (z + w) ≤ cabs z + cabs w := by
  apply le_of_mul_self_le (by have := cabs_nonneg z; have := cabs_nonneg w; grind)
  have hz := cabs_mul_self z
  have hw := cabs_mul_self w
  -- Cauchy–Schwarz: `ac + bd ≤ |z| |w|`.
  have hcs : z.re * w.re + z.im * w.im ≤ cabs z * cabs w := by
    apply le_of_mul_self_le (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (cabs_nonneg z) (cabs_nonneg w))
    have : cabs z * cabs w * (cabs z * cabs w) = normSq z * normSq w := by rw [← hz, ← hw]; grind
    rw [this]; unfold normSq
    have := mul_self_nonneg (z.re * w.im - z.im * w.re)
    grind
  rw [cabs_mul_self]
  unfold normSq at hz hw ⊢
  simp only [add_re, add_im]
  grind

/-- A least element of a nonempty set of natural numbers (a convenient form of the
well-ordering principle `N.well_ordering`). -/
theorem nat_least (P : Nat → Prop) (h : ∃ n, P n) : ∃ n, P n ∧ ∀ m, m < n → ¬ P m := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hno
  have : ∀ n, ∀ m, m ≤ n → ¬ P m := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro m hm hP; exact hno ⟨m, hP, fun k hk => by omega⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro m hm hP
      by_cases h' : m ≤ n
      · exact ih m h' hP
      · exact hno ⟨m, hP, fun k hk => ih k (by omega)⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
  exact this n n (Nat.le_refl n) hn

Foundations.Numbers.R.abs_powErr_le:
/-- Size of the error term: if `|x|, |y| ≤ M` then
`|E (n+2)| ≤ (n+2)(n+1)/2 · Mⁿ · |y − x|²`. -/
theorem abs_powErr_le {x y M : R} (hx : abs x ≤ M) (hy : abs y ≤ M) (n : Nat) :
    abs (powErr x y (n + 2)) ≤
      ((n : R) + 2) * ((n : R) + 1) / 2 * M ^ n * (abs (y - x) * abs (y - x)) := by
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := Std.le_trans (abs_nonneg x) hx
  have hk := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg (y - x)) (abs_nonneg (y - x))
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have e : powErr x y (0 + 2) = (y - x) * (y - x) := by
      unfold powErr; show y ^ 2 - x ^ 2 - ((2 : Nat) : R) * x ^ 1 * (y - x) = _; grind
    rw [e, abs_mul]
    grind
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show n + 1 + 2 = (n + 2) + 1 by omega, powErr_succ, show n + 2 - 1 = n + 1 by omega]
    have hn : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    have t1 := abs_mul_le hy ih
    have t2 : abs (((n + 2 : Nat) : R) * x ^ (n + 1) * ((y - x) * (y - x))) ≤
        ((n : R) + 2) * M ^ (n + 1) * (abs (y - x) * abs (y - x)) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg)]
      have := pow_le_pow_left (abs_nonneg x) hx (n + 1)
      have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) + 2)
      have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hk
      grind
    have t3 := abs_add (y * powErr x y (n + 2)) (((n + 2 : Nat) : R) * x ^ (n + 1) * ((y - x) * (y - x)))
    rw [pow_succ' M n] at t2 ⊢
    grind

Foundations.Algebra.card_mcKaySet:
/-- **Counting McKay's set directly.** `|X| = |G| ^ (p - 1)`: the first entry of a necklace
with product `1` is determined by the remaining `p - 1` free entries. -/
theorem card_mcKaySet (m : Nat) : card (McKaySet G (m + 1)) = card G ^ m := by
  rw [← card_tuple (α := G) m, ← count_true, ← count_true]
  let e : (Fin m → G) → McKaySet G (m + 1) := fun y =>
    ⟨tcons (tprod y)⁻¹ y, by show (tprod y)⁻¹ * tprod (ttail (tcons _ y)) = 1;
                             rw [ttail_tcons, inv_mul_cancel]⟩
  refine (count_comp_bij e ?_ ?_ (fun _ => True)).symm
  · intro y y' h
    have := congrArg (fun x : McKaySet G (m + 1) => ttail x.1) h
    simpa [e] using this
  · intro ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨ttail x, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    show tcons (tprod (ttail x))⁻¹ (ttail x) = x
    have h0 : (tprod (ttail x))⁻¹ = x 0 := by
      have : x 0 * tprod (ttail x) = 1 := hx
      rw [← inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one this, inv_inv]
    rw [h0]; exact tcons_self_ttail x

Foundations.Topology.Wallis.key:
/-- **The key identity** `A_{n+1} + 2(n+1)² B_{n+1} = (n+1)(2n+1) Bₙ` (two integrations by
parts, packaged as one application of the fundamental theorem of calculus). -/
theorem key (j : Nat) :
    A (j + 1) + 2 * ((j : R) + 1) * ((j : R) + 1) * B (j + 1) =
      ((j : R) + 1) * (2 * (j : R) + 1) * B j := by
  have hab := Std.le_of_lt hpi_pos
  let n1 : R := (j : R) + 1
  let g : R → R := fun x => cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1) +
    (2 * n1 * n1 * (x * x * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) + (-(n1 * (2 * (j : R) + 1))) * (x * x * cos x ^ (2 * j)))
  let F : R → R := fun x => x * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1) + n1 * (x * x * (sin x * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1)))
  have hd : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ hpi → HasDerivAt F (g t) t := fun t _ _ => by
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul (hasDerivAt_cos_pow (2 * j + 1) t)).add
      ((((hasDerivAt_id t).mul (hasDerivAt_id t)).mul
        ((hasDerivAt_sin t).mul (hasDerivAt_cos_pow (2 * j) t))).const_mul n1)
    have e : 1 * cos t ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1) + t * (((2 * j + 1 : Nat) + 1) * cos t ^ (2 * j + 1) * -sin t) +
        n1 * ((1 * t + t * 1) * (sin t * cos t ^ (2 * j + 1)) +
          t * t * (cos t * cos t ^ (2 * j + 1) + sin t * (((2 * j : Nat) + 1) * cos t ^ (2 * j) * -sin t)))
        = g t := by
      have p1 : cos t ^ (2 * j + 1) = cos t ^ (2 * j) * cos t := rfl
      have p2 : cos t ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1) = cos t ^ (2 * j) * cos t * cos t := rfl
      have py := sin_sq_add_cos_sq t
      have c1 : ((2 * j + 1 : Nat) : R) = 2 * (j : R) + 1 := by grind
      have c2 : ((2 * j : Nat) : R) = 2 * (j : R) := by grind
      show _ = cos t ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1) + (2 * n1 * n1 * (t * t * cos t ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) +
        (-(n1 * (2 * (j : R) + 1))) * (t * t * cos t ^ (2 * j)))
      rw [p1, p2, c1, c2]
      generalize cos t ^ (2 * j) = C
      show _ = _ + (2 * ((j : R) + 1) * ((j : R) + 1) * _ + -(((j : R) + 1) * _) * _)
      show _ + _ + ((j : R) + 1) * _ = _
      grind
    rw [e] at h; exact h
  have c3 : ∀ t, R.ContinuousAt (fun x => x * x * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) t := continuousAt_x2cos _
  have c4 : ∀ t, R.ContinuousAt (fun x => x * x * cos x ^ (2 * j)) t := continuousAt_x2cos _
  have hgc : ∀ t, R.ContinuousAt g t := fun t =>
    continuousAt_add (continuousAt_cos_pow _ t)
      (continuousAt_add (continuousAt_cmul _ (c3 t)) (continuousAt_cmul _ (c4 t)))
  have h1 := integral_eq_sub hab hd fun t _ _ => hgc t
  rw [integral_add' hab (continuousAt_cos_pow _) (fun t => continuousAt_add
      (continuousAt_cmul _ (c3 t)) (continuousAt_cmul _ (c4 t))),
    integral_add' hab (fun t => continuousAt_cmul _ (c3 t)) (fun t => continuousAt_cmul _ (c4 t)),
    integral_const_mul' _ hab c3, integral_const_mul' _ hab c4] at h1
  have hF0 : F 0 = 0 := by show 0 * _ + n1 * (0 * 0 * _) = 0; grind
  have hFp : F hpi = 0 := by
    show hpi * cos hpi ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1) + n1 * (hpi * hpi * (sin hpi * cos hpi ^ (2 * j + 1))) = 0
    rw [cos_hpi]
    have : (0 : R) ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1) = 0 := by show (0 : R) ^ (2 * j + 1) * 0 = 0; grind
    have : (0 : R) ^ (2 * j + 1) = 0 := by show (0 : R) ^ (2 * j) * 0 = 0; grind
    grind
  rw [hF0, hFp] at h1
  have eA : A (j + 1) = integral (fun x => cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) 0 hpi := by
    unfold A I; rw [show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 1 + 1 by omega]
  have eB : B (j + 1) = integral (fun x => x * x * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) 0 hpi := by
    unfold B; rw [show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 1 + 1 by omega]
  have eB' : B j = integral (fun x => x * x * cos x ^ (2 * j)) 0 hpi := rfl
  rw [← eA, ← eB, ← eB'] at h1
  show _ = n1 * _ * _
  grind

Foundations.Geometry.Klein.equidistant_l:
/-- Points hyperbolically equidistant from `p` and `q` satisfy a *linear* equation:

  obtain ⟨sq, -⟩ := s_spec hq

  grind

/-- **Congruence via `ch`**: `ab ≡ cd` iff `ch a b = ch c d`. -/
theorem inv_eq_iff_ch_eq {a b c d : Pt R} (ha : n2 a < 1) (hb : n2 b < 1) (hc : n2 c < 1)
    (hd : n2 d < 1) : inv a b = inv c d ↔ ch a b = ch c d := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact eq_of_sq_eq (Std.le_of_lt (ch_pos ha hb)) (Std.le_of_lt (ch_pos hc hd))
      (by rw [ch_mul_self ha hb, ch_mul_self hc hd, h])
  · intro h
    rw [← ch_mul_self ha hb, ← ch_mul_self hc hd, h]
Foundations.Numbers.C.abs_im_le_cabs:
/-- `|im z| ≤ |z|`. -/
theorem abs_im_le_cabs (z : C) : abs z.im ≤ cabs z := by
  apply le_of_mul_self_le (cabs_nonneg z)
  rw [cabs_mul_self, ← abs_mul]; unfold normSq
  have := mul_self_nonneg z.re
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_self_nonneg z.im)]; grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.e_irrational:
/-- **Irrationality of `e`** (Fourier, 1815). There are no integers `p` and `q > 0` with
`e = p / q`. -/
theorem e_irrational : ¬ ∃ p : Int, ∃ q : Nat, 0 < q ∧ e = (p : R) / (q : R) := by
  rintro ⟨p, q, hq, he⟩
  let m := q + 1
  have hm : (2 : R) ≤ (m : R) := by
    have := OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le (R := R) 2 m (by omega); grind
  -- `m! · e` is an integer, because `q ∣ m!`.
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := dvd_fact (q := q) (m := m) hq (by omega)
  have hqpos : (0 : R) < (q : R) := OrderedRing.pos_natCast_of_pos _ hq
  have hme : (fact m : R) * e = (((r : Int) * p : Int) : R) := by
    rw [he, hr]
    have : (((q * r : Nat)) : R) = (q : R) * (r : R) := by grind
    rw [this]
    have : ((r : Int) : R) = (r : R) := Ring.intCast_natCast r
    grind
  -- `m! · (1/0! + ⋯ + 1/m!)` is a natural number.
  have hS : ∀ j, j ≤ m + 1 → ∃ N : Nat, (fact m : R) * fsum (expTerm 1) j = (N : R) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro _; exact ⟨0, by show (fact m : R) * 0 = ((0 : Nat) : R); grind⟩
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ih (by omega)
      obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := fact_dvd_fact (k := j) (m := m) (by omega)
      refine ⟨N + r', ?_⟩
      rw [fsum_succ, expTerm_one, hr']
      have := fact_pos' j
      have : (((fact j * r' : Nat)) : R) = (fact j : R) * (r' : R) := by grind
      rw [this]
      rw [hr'] at hN
      rw [this] at hN
      grind
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hS (m + 1) (Nat.le_refl _)
  -- The tail `m! · Σ_{n > m} 1/n!` …
  let T := (fact m : R) * (e - fsum (expTerm 1) (m + 1))
  have ht : HasSum (fun k => (fact m : R) * expTerm 1 (m + 1 + k)) T :=
    ((hasSum_shift_iff (a := expTerm 1) (s := e) (m + 1)).2 (hasSum_exp 1)).const_mul _
  let ρ : R := 1 / ((m : R) + 1)
  have hm0 : (0 : R) ≤ (m : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := div_pos (by grind) (by grind)
  have hpos : ∀ k, 0 ≤ (fact m : R) * expTerm 1 (m + 1 + k) := fun k =>
    OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt (fact_pos' m)) (expTerm_nonneg (by grind) _)
  have h0 : (fact m : R) * expTerm 1 (m + 1 + 0) = ρ := by
    rw [Nat.add_zero, expTerm_succ, expTerm_one]
    have := fact_pos' m
    grind
  -- … is positive (its first term is `1/(m+1)`) …
  have hTpos : 0 < T := by
    have := fsum_le_of_hasSum hpos ht 1
    rw [fsum_succ, fsum_zero, h0] at this
    grind
  -- … and at most `Σ_{k ≥ 1} (1/(m+1))ᵏ = 1/m ≤ 1/2`.
  have hdom : ∀ k, abs ((fact m : R) * expTerm 1 (m + 1 + k)) ≤ ρ * ρ ^ k := fun k => by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hpos k)]
    induction k with
    | zero => rw [h0]; show ρ ≤ ρ * 1; grind
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, expTerm_succ, pow_succ']
      have hk : (0 : R) ≤ ((m + 1 + k : Nat) : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
      have hle : 1 / (((m + 1 + k : Nat) : R) + 1) ≤ ρ :=
        one_div_le_one_div (by grind) (by
          have := OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le (R := R) m (m + 1 + k) (by omega); grind)
      have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih (Std.le_of_lt (div_pos
        (by grind : (0 : R) < 1) (by grind : (0 : R) < ((m + 1 + k : Nat) : R) + 1)))
      have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle
        (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hρ) (Std.le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (abs_le_pow ρ k hρ)))
      grind
  have hgeo := (hasSum_geometric (r := ρ) (by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hρ)]
    have := one_div_le_one_div (by grind : (0 : R) < 2) (by grind : (2 : R) ≤ (m : R) + 1)
    grind)).const_mul ρ
  have hT := abs_hasSum_le hdom ht hgeo
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hTpos)] at hT
  have hval : ρ * (1 / (1 - ρ)) = 1 / (m : R) := by
    have i1 := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show (m : R) + 1 ≠ 0 by grind)
    have i2 := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show (m : R) ≠ 0 by grind)
    have i3 : 1 - ρ = (m : R) * ((m : R) + 1)⁻¹ := by grind
    rw [i3]
    have i4 := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show (m : R) * ((m : R) + 1)⁻¹ ≠ 0 by
      intro h
      have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < (m : R))
        (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 (by grind : (0 : R) < (m : R) + 1))
      grind)
    grind
  have hhalf := one_div_le_one_div (by grind : (0 : R) < 2) hm
  -- But `T = m! e − m! Σ_{n ≤ m} 1/n!` is an integer: contradiction.
  let z : Int := (r : Int) * p - (N : Int)
  have hz : (z : R) = T := by
    show (((r : Int) * p - (N : Int) : Int) : R) = (fact m : R) * (e - fsum (expTerm 1) (m + 1))
    have : ((N : Int) : R) = (N : R) := Ring.intCast_natCast N
    have : (((r : Int) * p - (N : Int) : Int) : R) = (((r : Int) * p : Int) : R) - ((N : Int) : R) := by
      grind
    grind
  have z1 : ((0 : Int) : R) < (z : R) := by rw [hz]; grind
  have z2 : (z : R) < ((1 : Int) : R) := by rw [hz]; grind
  have := (intCast_lt (K := R)).1 z1
  have := (intCast_lt (K := R)).1 z2
  omega
where
  /-- For `ρ > 0`, `|ρᵏ| ≤ ρᵏ`. -/
  abs_le_pow (ρ : R) (k : Nat) (hρ : 0 < ρ) : abs (ρ ^ k) ≤ ρ ^ k := by
    rw [abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hρ)]; exact Std.le_refl _

Foundations.Geometry.TarskiPlane.bet_sym:
/-- **Betweenness is symmetric**: `B a b c → B c b a`. Proved from Pasch's axiom. -/
theorem bet_symm {a b c : P} (h : B a b c) : B c b a := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := pasch a b c b c h (bet_trivial b c)
  have : b = x := bet_identity b x hx₁
  subst this
  exact hx₂

/-- `swap a b` sends `b` to `a`. -/
@[simp] theorem swap_apply_right (a b : α) : swap a b b = a := by
  show (if b = a then b else if b = b then a else b) = a
  by_cases h : b = a <;> simp [h]
Foundations.Algebra.isum_prod:
/-- **Sums over a product** are iterated sums. -/
theorem isum_prod {κ : Type w} [FiniteType κ] (f : ι × κ → A) :
    isum f = isum (fun i => isum (fun k => f (i, k))) := by
  show lsum (((elems : List ι).flatMap (fun a => (elems : List κ).map (fun b => (a, b)))).map f) = _
  unfold isum
  induction (elems : List ι) with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_append, lsum_append, ih, List.map_map]; rfl
Foundations.Categories.MonCat.forget_pre:
/-- **Consequence**: the forgetful functor from monoids preserves products — because it
is a right adjoint. -/
def MonCat.forget_preservesProduct {X Y P : MonCat.{u}} {π₁ : P ⟶ X} {π₂ : P ⟶ Y}
    (hP : IsProduct X Y P π₁ π₂) :
    IsProduct (MonCat.forget.obj X) (MonCat.forget.obj Y) (MonCat.forget.obj P)
      (MonCat.forget.map π₁) (MonCat.forget.map π₂) :=
  freeForgetAdjunction.preservesProduct hP

/-- The code of a list is at least its length. -/
theorem length_le_encList : ∀ l : List Nat, l.length ≤ encList l
  | [] => Nat.le_refl _
  | x :: l => by

      have := right_le_pair x (encList l)
      simp [encList]; omega

Foundations.Algebra.legendre_eq_of_pow:
/-- **Euler's criterion, Legendre-symbol form.** `(a/p) = 1` exactly when `a^((p-1)/2) ≡ 1`, and
`(a/p) = -1` exactly when `a^((p-1)/2) ≡ -1`. -/
theorem legendre_eq_of_pow (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) {a : Nat} (ha : ¬ p ∣ a) :
    (a ^ half p % p = 1 → legendre a p = 1) ∧ (a ^ half p % p = p - 1 → legendre a p = -1) := by
  classical
  have h3 := hp.1
  have he := euler_criterion hp hodd ha
  unfold legendre
  simp only [ha, ↓reduceIte]
  by_cases hq : IsQR a p
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte] at he ⊢
    exact ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun h => by omega⟩
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte] at he ⊢
    exact ⟨fun h => by omega, fun _ => trivial⟩

  simp only [tcode_zero] at h₁
  simp only [indC, indAx, fcode, h₁, succSubC_fcode]
Foundations.Numbers.C.cterm:
/-- The `n`-th term `zⁿ / n!` of the complex exponential series. -/
noncomputable def cterm (z : C) (n : Nat) : C := z ^ n / ((fact n : Nat) : C)
Foundations.Algebra.Group.pow_mul_inv_po:
/-- The inverse of a power: `(a ^ n)⁻¹ * a ^ n = 1` is automatic, and more usefully
`a ^ n * (a⁻¹) ^ n = 1`. -/
theorem pow_mul_inv_pow (a : G) (n : Nat) : a ^ n * a⁻¹ ^ n = 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ', mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc a, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul, ih]
Foundations.Numbers.C.exp_ofReal:
/-- **On the real axis the complex exponential is the real one.** -/
theorem exp_ofReal (x : R) : exp (ofReal x) = ofReal (R.exp x) := by
  have h : CTendsto (fun N => gsum (cterm (ofReal x)) N) (ofReal (R.exp x)) := by
    constructor
    · refine (hasSum_exp x : Tendsto _ _).congr_eventually 0 fun N _ => ?_
      show fsum (expTerm x) N = (gsum (cterm (ofReal x)) N).re
      rw [gsum_re]; apply fsum_congr; intro k _
      unfold cterm expTerm; rw [div_natCast_re _ (fact_pos k), ofReal_pow]; rfl
    · refine (tendsto_const 0).congr_eventually 0 fun N _ => ?_
      show (0 : R) = (gsum (cterm (ofReal x)) N).im
      rw [gsum_im]
      have : ∀ n, fsum (fun k => (cterm (ofReal x) k).im) n = 0 := fun n => by
        induction n with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ n ih =>
          rw [fsum_succ, ih]; unfold cterm
          rw [div_natCast_im _ (fact_pos n), ofReal_pow]; show 0 + 0 / _ = (0 : R); grind
      rw [this]
  exact (tendsto_exp _).unique h
Foundations.Logic.FO.grb_D0:
/-- **The bounded graph formulas are bounded.** -/
theorem grb_D0 : ∀ (c : Code) (a : Nat), D0 (grb c a)
  | .zero, _ => D0.eq _ _
  | .succ, _ => D0.eq _ _
  | .proj _, _ => D0.eq _ _
  | @Code.comp k f gs, a => by
      simp only [grb]
      refine D0.bexN (D0.conj (D0.conjL _ fun φ hφ => ?_) ((grb_D0 f k).subst _)) _ _
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hφ
      exact (grb_D0 (gs i) a).subst _
  | .prec _ _, 0 => D0.bot
  | .prec f g, a + 1 => by
      simp only [grb]
      exact D0.bex _ (D0.bex _ (D0.conj (D0.conj
        (D0.bex _ (D0.conj (betaB_D0.subst _) ((grb_D0 f a).subst _)))
        (D0.ballS _ (D0.bex _ (D0.bex _ (D0.conj (D0.conj (betaB_D0.subst _) (betaB_D0.subst _))
          ((grb_D0 g (a + 2)).subst _)))))) (betaB_D0.subst _)))
  | .mu f, a => by
      simp only [grb]
      exact D0.conj ((grb_D0 f (a + 1)).subst _)
        (D0.ballS _ (D0.bex _ (D0.conj ((grb_D0 f (a + 1)).subst _) (D0.eq _ _).neg)))

/-- Components of a code with positive tag are smaller than the code. -/
theorem fst_lt_tagged {a b c : Nat} (ha : 0 < a) : b < pair a (pair b c) :=
  Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (left_le_pair b c) (lt_pair_of_pos ha)
Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.evalList_:
/-- Evaluation of a product. -/
theorem evalList_mul (x : R) (p q : List R) :
    evalList x (PolyList.mul p q) = evalList x p * evalList x q := by
  induction p with
  | nil => show (0 : R) = 0 * _; rw [zero_mul]
  | cons a p ih =>
    show evalList x (PolyList.add (PolyList.smul a q) (0 :: PolyList.mul p q)) = _
    rw [evalList_add, evalList_smul]
    show a * evalList x q + (0 + x * evalList x (PolyList.mul p q)) = (a + x * evalList x p) * _
    rw [ih, Ring.zero_add, right_distrib, Ring.mul_assoc]
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.app:
/-- Function application `app F x`: the `y` with `⟪x, y⟫ ∈ F` (chosen; `∅` if there is none). -/
noncomputable def app (F x : ZFSet) : ZFSet :=
  open Classical in
  if h : ∃ y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ F then Classical.choose h else ∅
Foundations.Sets.PSet.equiv_of_mem_iff:
/-- **Extensionality for pre-sets.** Pre-sets with the same members (up to
equivalence) are equivalent. -/
theorem equiv_of_mem_iff {x y : PSet} (h : ∀ z, z ∈ x ↔ z ∈ y) : Equiv x y := by
  cases x with
  | mk α A =>
    cases y with
    | mk β B =>
      refine equiv_iff.2 ⟨fun a => ?_, fun b => ?_⟩
      · exact (h (A a)).1 (func_mem (mk α A) a)
      · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (h (B b)).2 (func_mem (mk β B) b)
        exact ⟨a, ha.symm⟩
Foundations.Types.STLC.inr_red:
/-- **Right injections of reducible terms are reducible.** -/
theorem inr_red {A B : Ty} {b : Term} (hb : RED B b) : RED (.sum A B) (inr b) := by
  refine ⟨SN.map_of_inv inr inr_inv ((cr B).1 _ hb), fun a h => ?_, fun b' h => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b'', he, _⟩ := red_inv inr inr_inv h
    cases he
  · obtain ⟨b'', he, hr⟩ := red_inv inr inr_inv h
    cases he
    exact red_red hb hr
