Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.sq_aux:
/-- One half of `sameCut_sq`, using approximation of squares by rational squares. -/
theorem sq_aux (hF : Archimedean F) {a : F} {b : G} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (h : SameCut a b) (q : Q) (hq : ofRat q < a * a) : ofRat q < b * b := by
  by_cases hq0 : (0 : F) ≤ ofRat q
  · have hapos : 0 < a := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
      have : a = 0 := by grind
      rw [this] at hq; grind
    obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩ := exists_rat_sq_between hF hapos hq0 hq
    have hrb := (h r).1 hr2
    have hr0 : (0 : G) < ofRat r := by
      have := (ofRat_lt (K := F) (p := 0) (q := r)).1 (by rw [ofRat_zero]; exact hr1)
      have := (ofRat_lt (K := G) (p := 0) (q := r)).2 this
      rwa [ofRat_zero] at this
    have hqr : q < r * r := by
      rw [← ofRat_lt (K := F), ofRat_mul]; exact hr3
    have hqr' : ofRat (K := G) q < ofRat r * ofRat r := by
      rw [← ofRat_mul]; exact (ofRat_lt (K := G)).2 hqr
    have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt hrb) (Std.le_of_lt hr0)
    have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hrb (by grind : (0 : G) < b)
    grind
  · have h1 : ofRat (K := G) q < 0 := by
      have := (ofRat_lt (K := F) (p := q) (q := 0)).1 (by rw [ofRat_zero]; grind)
      have := (ofRat_lt (K := G) (p := q) (q := 0)).2 this
      rwa [ofRat_zero] at this
    have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hb hb
    grind
Foundations.Numbers.R.bounded_above:
/-- A continuous function on `[a, b]` is bounded above. -/
theorem bounded_above {f : R → R} {a b : R} (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ContinuousAt f x) :
    ∃ M, ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → f x ≤ M := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hno
  have hx : ∀ n : Nat, ∃ x, (a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b) ∧ (n : R) < f x := fun n => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
    exact hno ⟨n, fun x h1 h2 => by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h3; exact h ⟨x, ⟨h1, h2⟩, by grind⟩⟩
  let xs : Nat → R := fun n => (hx n).choose
  have hxs : ∀ n, (a ≤ xs n ∧ xs n ≤ b) ∧ (n : R) < f (xs n) := fun n => (hx n).choose_spec
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, L, hL⟩ := bolzano_weierstrass (bounded_of_mem fun n => (hxs n).1)
  have haL : a ≤ L := le_of_tendsto hL fun k => (hxs (φ k)).1.1
  have hLb : L ≤ b := tendsto_le hL fun k => (hxs (φ k)).1.2
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := tendsto_comp (hf L haL hLb) hL 1 (by grind)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := archimedean (f L + 1)
  let k := max N m
  have k1 := abs_lt.1 (hN k (by omega))
  have k2 := (hxs (φ k)).2
  have k3 : (m : R) ≤ (φ k : R) :=
    OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le _ _ (by have := le_of_strictMono hφ k; omega)
  simp only at k1
  grind

Foundations.Logic.Computability.kleene_n:
/-- **Kleene's normal form theorem.** A code `c` outputs `n` on `xs` iff there is a
computation trace `t` satisfying the (computable) T-predicate whose recorded output is
`n`. Hence every partial recursive function has the form `out(μt. T(e, x⃗, t))`. -/
theorem kleene_normal_form (c : Code) (xs : List Nat) (n : Nat) :
    Eval c xs n ↔ ∃ t, kleeneT (encode c) (encList xs) t = true ∧ traceOut t = n := by
  rw [eval_iff_derivable, derivable_iff_exists_tree]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, hv, hr⟩
    refine ⟨t, by simp [kleeneT, hv, hr, judg], by simp [traceOut, hr, judg]⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, hT, rfl⟩
    simp only [kleeneT, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at hT
    obtain ⟨⟨hv, h₁⟩, h₂⟩ := hT
    exact ⟨t, hv, by rw [troot_eq t, h₁, h₂]⟩

/-- **Continuity ⇔ preimages of open sets are open.** -/
theorem continuous_iff_isOpen_preimage (f : X → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ V : Y → Prop, IsOpen V → IsOpen (fun x => V (f x)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hf V hV x hx
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, h⟩ := hV (f x) hx
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := hf x ε hε
    exact ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => h _ (by rw [dist_comm]; exact hδ' y (by rw [dist_comm]; exact hy))⟩
  · intro hf x ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hf (ball (f x) ε) (isOpen_ball _ _) x (by
      show dist (f x) (f x) < ε; rw [dist_self]; exact hε)
    exact ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => by
      have := h y (by rw [dist_comm]; exact hy); unfold ball at this; rw [dist_comm]; exact this⟩

/-- A finite list of formulas has a common bound beyond which all variables are fresh. -/
theorem eventually_fresh_list : ∀ l : List (Formula L), ∃ k, ∀ x, k ≤ x → ∀ φ ∈ l, φ.Fresh x

Foundations.Geometry.Klein.one_le_inv:
/-- The invariant is at least `1`, with equality only for equal points. -/
theorem one_le_inv {a b : Pt R} (ha : n2 a < 1) (hb : n2 b < 1) : 1 ≤ inv a b := by
  have hk := key_ineq a b
  have hd := Pt.d2_nonneg a b
  have hpos : 0 < (1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b) := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind) (by grind)
  have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hd (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 1 - n2 b)
  unfold inv
  have hne : (1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b) ≠ 0 := by grind
  have e : (1 - dot a b) * (1 - dot a b) / ((1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b)) - 1 =
      ((1 - dot a b) * (1 - dot a b) - (1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b)) / ((1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b)) := by
    grind
  have : 0 ≤ ((1 - dot a b) * (1 - dot a b) - (1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b)) /
      ((1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b)) := by
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind) (by have := Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hpos; grind)
  grind

Foundations.Logic.Ordinals.ON.NF:
/-- **Cantor normal form**: in `ω^a + b`, the leading exponent of `b` is at most `a`,
and all exponents are themselves in normal form. -/
inductive NF : ON → Prop where
  /-- `0` is normal. -/
  | zero : NF zero
  /-- `ω^a + b` is normal if `a`, `b` are and `b`'s leading exponent is `≤ a`. -/
  | oadd {a b : ON} : NF a → NF b → (∀ a' b', b = oadd a' b' → ¬ lt a a') → NF (oadd a b)
Foundations.Numbers.R.pos_add:
/-- The sum of positive reals is positive. -/
theorem pos_add {x y : R} : Pos x → Pos y → Pos (x + y) := by
  induction x using ind with | h a => ?_
  induction y using ind with | h b => ?_
  rintro ⟨ε₁, h₁, N₁, hN₁⟩ ⟨ε₂, h₂, N₂, hN₂⟩
  refine ⟨ε₁ + ε₂, by grind, max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have := hN₁ n (by omega); have := hN₂ n (by omega)
  simp only [add_apply]; grind

/-- `θ` has only the free variable `0` if `ψ` does. -/

/-- **A group mapping onto `S₅` is not solvable.** In particular, a Galois group isomorphic to
`S₅` is not solvable, which by Galois's criterion (not formalised) means the corresponding
equation is not solvable by radicals. -/
theorem not_solvable_of_surjective_S5 {G : Type u} [Group G] (f : G →* Perm (Fin 5))

/-- `x ≤ |x|` and `-x ≤ |x|`. -/

  rcases abs_cases x with h' | h' <;> grind
Foundations.Algebra.inv_swap:
/-- For distinct `a`, `b`, exactly one of `(a, b)` and `(b, a)` is out of order. -/
theorem inv_swap {n : Nat} {a b : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b) : inv b a = !inv a b := by
  have hv : a.val ≠ b.val := fun e => h (Fin.ext e)
  unfold inv
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hv with hl | hl
  · have h1 : a < b := hl
    have h2 : ¬ b < a := fun e => absurd (show b.val < a.val from e) (by omega)
    simp [h1, h2]
  · have h1 : b < a := hl
    have h2 : ¬ a < b := fun e => absurd (show a.val < b.val from e) (by omega)
    simp [h1, h2]
/-- **Limits are unique in Hausdorff spaces.** -/
theorem Converges.unique {τ : Topology X} (hτ : IsHausdorff τ) {s : Nat → X} {L M : X}
    (hL : Converges τ s L) (hM : Converges τ s M) : L = M := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hne
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hLU, hMV, hd⟩ := hτ L M hne
  obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := hL U hU hLU
  obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := hM V hV hMV
  exact hd _ (h₁ (max N₁ N₂) (by omega)) (h₂ (max N₁ N₂) (by omega))
Foundations.Logic.FO.eval_iff_exists_grb:
/-- **The graph of every partial recursive function is Σ₁**: `c` outputs `y` on `x⃗`
iff the bounded formula `grb c a` holds for some bound `w`. -/
theorem eval_iff_exists_grb (c : Code) (a : Nat) (e : Nat → Nat) :
    Eval c (List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => e (i + 1)) (e 0) ↔
      ∃ w, Sat stdModel (fun n => if n = a + 1 then w else e n) (grb c a) := by
  rw [eval_iff_exists_evalB]
  refine exists_congr fun w => ?_
  rw [sat_grb]
  simp only [ite_true, show ∀ i : Nat, i + 1 = a + 1 ↔ i = a from fun i => by omega]
  have : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => (if (i : Nat) = a then w else e (i + 1))) =
      List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => e (i + 1) := by
    congr 1; funext i; simp [Nat.ne_of_lt i.isLt]
  rw [this]; simp
Foundations.Types.SystemF.num_apply:
/-- Instantiating a numeral and feeding it `f` and `x`: `n̄ [A] f x ⟶* fⁿ x`. -/
theorem num_apply (n : Nat) (A : Ty) (f x : Term) :
    Red (app (app (tapp (num n) A) f) x) (iterApp f x n) := by
  have h₁ : Step (tapp (num n) A) (lam (lam (iterApp (var 1) (var 0) n))) := by
    have := Step.tbeta (lam (lam (iterApp (var 1) (var 0) n))) A
    unfold num
    simpa [tyInst, tySubst, tySubst_iterApp] using this
  have h₂ : Step (app (lam (lam (iterApp (var 1) (var 0) n))) f)
      (lam (iterApp (rename Nat.succ f) (var 0) n)) := by
    have := Step.beta (lam (iterApp (var 1) (var 0) n)) f
    simpa [inst, subst, subst_iterApp, up, cons] using this
  have h₃ : Step (app (lam (iterApp (rename Nat.succ f) (var 0) n)) x) (iterApp f x n) := by
    have := Step.beta (iterApp (rename Nat.succ f) (var 0) n) x
    simpa [inst, subst_iterApp, subst, cons, subst_cons_rename_succ] using this
  exact ((Star.single (Step.appL (Step.appL h₁))).tail (Step.appL h₂)).tail h₃
Foundations.Algebra.neg_one_pow_int:
/-- Powers of `-1` in `ℤ` depend only on the parity of the exponent. -/
theorem neg_one_pow_int (n : Nat) : (-1 : Int) ^ n = if n % 2 = 0 then 1 else -1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Int.pow_succ, ih]
    by_cases hn : n % 2 = 0
    · rw [ite_true_of hn, ite_false_of (by omega)]; rfl
    · rw [ite_false_of hn, ite_true_of (by omega)]; rfl

  | 0 => eval_zero_M e
  | n + 1 => by simp only [numeral, eval_succ_M, eval_numeral_M e n, numM]
Foundations.Logic.Ordinals.ord_bump:
/-- **Bumping the base does not change the ordinal.** The hereditary base-`(c+3)`
representation of `bump c n` is the hereditary base-`(c+2)` representation of `n`. -/
theorem ord_bump (c : Nat) : ∀ n, ord (c + 1) (bump c n) = ord c n := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
  have hb : 2 ≤ c + 2 := by omega
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn; rw [bump_zero, ord_zero, ord_zero]
  have he₁ := pow_lg_le hb n (by omega)
  have he₂ := lt_pow_lg hb n
  have hpos := Nat.pow_pos (n := lg (c + 2) n) (show 0 < c + 2 by omega)
  have hr : n - (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n < (c + 1) * (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n := by
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_succ] at he₂
    rw [Nat.mul_comm]; omega
  have hR := (bump_main c (lg (c + 2) n)).2 _ (c + 1) hr (by omega)
  have hm := bump_pos c hn
  have hYpos := Nat.pow_pos (n := bump c (lg (c + 2) n)) (show 0 < c + 3 by omega)
  have hlg : lg (c + 1 + 2) (bump c n) = bump c (lg (c + 2) n) := by
    refine lg_eq_of (by omega) (by rw [hm]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _) ?_
    rw [hm]
    show _ < (c + 3) ^ (bump c (lg (c + 2) n) + 1)
    rw [Nat.pow_succ]
    have := mul_add_three ((c + 3) ^ bump c (lg (c + 2) n)) c
    omega
  have hbn : bump c n ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [ord_pos (c + 1) hbn, hlg, ord_pos c hn]
  have hsub : bump c n - (c + 1 + 2) ^ bump c (lg (c + 2) n) =
      bump c (n - (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n) := by
    rw [hm]; show (c + 3) ^ _ + _ - (c + 3) ^ _ = _; omega
  rw [hsub, ih _ (lg_lt hb hn), ih _ (by omega)]

Foundations.Numbers.Arith.mem_of_dvd_pro:
/-- A prime dividing a product of primes is one of them. -/
theorem mem_of_dvd_prod {p : Nat} (hp : Prime p) :
    ∀ {l : List Nat}, (∀ q ∈ l, Prime q) → p ∣ prod l → p ∈ l
  | [], _, h => by
    simp only [prod] at h
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h; have := hp.1; omega
  | q :: l, hl, h => by
    simp only [prod] at h
    rcases euclid_lemma hp h with h' | h'
    · rcases (hl q (List.mem_cons_self ..)).2 p h' with h'' | h''
      · have := hp.1; omega
      · rw [h'']; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _
        (mem_of_dvd_prod hp (fun r hr => hl r (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr)) h')
Foundations.Algebra.not_constructible_of:
/-- **Roots of rational cubics without rational roots are not constructible.** If `α` is a
root of a cubic over `ℚ` with no rational root, then `[ℚ(α) : ℚ] = 3`, which cannot divide the
degree `2^k` of a quadratic tower containing `α`. -/
theorem not_constructible_of_cubic {α : Ω} (C : CubicRoot (ratField hΩ hc) α) :
    ¬ Constructible hΩ hc α := by
  intro hα
  obtain ⟨F, hT, hαF⟩ := hα.mem_tower
  obtain ⟨h, hfin, k, hk⟩ := hT.deg_pow_two
  let L := C.field hΩ
  have hLF : L.le F := C.field_le hΩ h hαF
  obtain ⟨hfinL, hdegL⟩ := C.deg_field hΩ
  have hfin2 := finiteExt_of_tower (C.le_field hΩ) hLF hfin
  obtain ⟨_, htower⟩ := tower_law hΩ (C.le_field hΩ) hLF hfinL hfin2
  have : deg _ F h = deg L F hLF * 3 := by rw [← hdegL]; exact htower
  apply three_not_dvd_pow_two k
  rw [← hk, this]
  exact Nat.dvd_mul_left 3 _
Foundations.Algebra.Group.npow:
/-- Natural-number powers: `a ^ 0 = 1` and `a ^ (n+1) = a ^ n * a`. -/
def npow (a : G) : Nat → G
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => npow a n * a
Foundations.Logic.MaximalConsistent.trut:
/-- **Truth lemma.** Under the valuation determined by a maximal consistent theory
`M`, a formula is true exactly when it belongs to `M`. -/
theorem truth : ∀ φ : Formula, φ.eval (valuation M) = true ↔ M φ
  | bot => by simp only [eval]; exact ⟨nofun, fun h => absurd (Derives.hyp h) hM.1⟩
  | var n => by simp [eval, valuation]
  | imp a b => by
      have ia := truth a
      have ib := truth b
      simp only [eval, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true']
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h)
        · have : ¬ M a := fun h' => by rw [← ia] at h'; simp_all
          exact hM.closed (Derives.imp_of_neg (.hyp ((hM.neg_iff a).2 this)))
        · exact hM.closed (Derives.imp_of_right (.hyp (ib.1 h)))
      · intro h
        by_cases ha : M a
        · exact Or.inr (ib.2 (hM.closed (Derives.impE (.hyp h) (.hyp ha))))
        · left
          cases e : eval (valuation M) a
          · rfl
          · exact absurd (ia.1 e) ha
  | conj a b => by
      simp only [eval, Bool.and_eq_true, truth a, truth b]
      exact ⟨fun h => hM.closed (Derives.conjI (.hyp h.1) (.hyp h.2)),
        fun h => ⟨hM.closed (Derives.conjE₁ (.hyp h)), hM.closed (Derives.conjE₂ (.hyp h))⟩⟩
  | disj a b => by
      simp only [eval, Bool.or_eq_true, truth a, truth b]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h)
        · exact hM.closed (Derives.disjI₁ (.hyp h))
        · exact hM.closed (Derives.disjI₂ (.hyp h))
      · intro h
        refine Classical.byContradiction fun hc => ?_
        simp only [not_or] at hc
        exact (hM.neg_iff _).1 (hM.closed (Derives.neg_disj
          (.hyp ((hM.neg_iff a).2 hc.1)) (.hyp ((hM.neg_iff b).2 hc.2)))) h
Foundations.Numbers.Arith.dvd_fact:
/-- Every `k` with `1 ≤ k ≤ n` divides `n!`. -/
theorem dvd_fact {k n : Nat} (h1 : 1 ≤ k) (h2 : k ≤ n) : k ∣ fact n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [fact]
    by_cases hk : k = n + 1
    · rw [hk]; exact Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _
    · exact Nat.dvd_mul_left_of_dvd (ih (by omega)) _
Foundations.Combinatorics.Clique:
/-- A set `S` (a list) is a **clique of colour `b`** for the colouring `c`: all pairs of
distinct elements have colour `b`. -/
def Clique (c : Nat → Nat → Bool) (b : Bool) (S : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≠ y → c x y = b
Foundations.Numbers.R.Tendsto.congr_even:
/-- Changing finitely many terms does not affect convergence: if `a` and `b` agree from some
index on, they have the same limits. -/
theorem Tendsto.congr_eventually {a b : Nat → R} {L : R} (h : Tendsto a L) (N : Nat)
    (hab : ∀ n, N ≤ n → a n = b n) : Tendsto b L := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h ε hε
  exact ⟨max M N, fun n hn => by rw [← hab n (by omega)]; exact hM n (by omega)⟩
Foundations.Algebra.ratField:
/-- **The prime field** `ℚ ⊆ Ω` of a field of characteristic zero: the quotients `a / b` of
integers with `b ≠ 0`. -/
def ratField (hΩ : IsField Ω) (hc : CharZero Ω) : Subfield Ω where
  carrier x := ∃ a b : Int, b ≠ 0 ∧ x * (Int.cast (b) : Ω) = (Int.cast (a) : Ω)
  zero_mem := ⟨0, 1, by decide, by grind⟩
  one_mem := ⟨1, 1, by decide, by grind⟩
  add_mem := by
    intro x y ⟨a, b, hb, hx⟩ ⟨c, d, hd, hy⟩
    refine ⟨a * d + c * b, b * d, Int.mul_ne_zero hb hd, ?_⟩
    rw [Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_add, Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul,
      Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, ← hx, ← hy]
    grind
  neg_mem := by
    intro x ⟨a, b, hb, hx⟩
    refine ⟨-a, b, hb, ?_⟩
    rw [Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_neg, ← hx]; grind
  mul_mem := by
    intro x y ⟨a, b, hb, hx⟩ ⟨c, d, hd, hy⟩
    refine ⟨a * c, b * d, Int.mul_ne_zero hb hd, ?_⟩
    rw [Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, ← hx, ← hy]
    grind
  inv_mem := by
    intro x ⟨a, b, hb, hx⟩ hx0
    have hb' : (Int.cast (b) : Ω) ≠ 0 := fun h => hb (hc b h)
    have ha : (Int.cast (a) : Ω) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at hx
      rcases hΩ.isDomain.2 _ _ hx with h1 | h1
      · exact hx0 h1
      · exact hb' h1
    have ha' : a ≠ 0 := fun h => ha (by rw [h]; grind)
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hΩ.2 _ ha
    refine ⟨(Int.cast (b) : Ω) * t, ⟨b, a, ha', ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · grind
    · grind

Foundations.Algebra.FiniteType.count_eq_:
/-- A property holds of everything exactly when its count is the cardinality. -/
theorem count_eq_card {P : α → Prop} : count P = card α ↔ ∀ x, P x := by
  have h := count_add_count_not P
  constructor
  · intro hc x
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hx
    have : count (fun x => ¬ P x) = 0 := by omega
    exact count_eq_zero.1 this x hx
  · intro hall
    have : count (fun x => ¬ P x) = 0 := count_eq_zero.2 fun x hx => hx (hall x)
    omega

Foundations.Numbers.Q.sqrt_two_irrationa:
/-- **Irrationality of √2.** There is no rational number whose square is `2`. -/
theorem sqrt_two_irrational : ¬ ∃ q : Q, q * q = 2 := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  induction q using ind with | h n d hd => ?_
  simp only [mk_mul, ofNat_def, mk_eq_mk] at hq
  have hq' : n * n = 2 * (d * d) := by grind
  have h1 : (n * n).natAbs = (2 * (d * d)).natAbs := by rw [hq']
  simp only [Int.natAbs_mul] at h1
  exact nat_sq_ne_two_sq d.natAbs (by omega) n.natAbs h1
Foundations.Numbers.R.HasIntegral.add:
/-- **Linearity I.** `∫ (f + g) = ∫ f + ∫ g`. -/
theorem HasIntegral.add {f g : R → R} {a b I J : R} (hf : HasIntegral f a b I)
    (hg : HasIntegral g a b J) : HasIntegral (fun y => f y + g y) a b (I + J) := ⟨hf.1, fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hf.2 (ε / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h₂⟩ := hg.2 (ε / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₁ hδ₂
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun l hl hm => ?_⟩
  have k1 := h₁ l hl (hm.mono hδ1)
  have k2 := h₂ l hl (hm.mono hδ2)
  rw [rsum_add]
  have k3 := abs_add (rsum f a l - I) (rsum g a l - J)
  rw [show rsum f a l - I + (rsum g a l - J) = rsum f a l + rsum g a l - (I + J) by grind] at k3
  grind⟩

/-- Two subgroups with the same elements are equal. -/
theorem ext {H K : Subgroup G} (h : ∀ x, x ∈ H ↔ x ∈ K) : H = K := by
  cases H with
  | mk c1 o1 m1 i1 =>
    cases K with
    | mk c2 o2 m2 i2 =>
      have : c1 = c2 := funext fun x => propext (h x)
      subst this
      rfl

Foundations.Algebra.artin:
/-- **Artin's theorem.** For a finite group `H` of `n` automorphisms of `L`, the extension
`L / Fix(H)` is finite of degree exactly `n`. -/
theorem artin (hΩ : IsField Ω) (hdist : ∀ i j, σ i = σ j → i = j) (hone : ∃ i, σ i = 1)
    (hmul : ∀ i j, ∃ k, σ k = σ i * σ j) :
    FiniteExt (famFix σ) L (famFix_le σ) ∧ deg (famFix σ) L (famFix_le σ) = n := by
  let F := famFix σ
  have hFF := F.isField hΩ
  have hnone : ¬ ∃ u : Fin (n + 1) → L.over F (famFix_le σ), LinIndep F u := by
    intro ⟨u, hu⟩
    obtain ⟨c, ⟨j0, hj0⟩, hcF, hc⟩ :=
      artin_dependent σ hΩ hdist hone hmul (fun j => (⟨(u j).1, (u j).2⟩ : L)) (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    have := hu (fun j => ⟨(c j).1, hcF j⟩) (by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [KSubspace.coe_isum]
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hc
      rw [Subfield.coe_isum] at this
      exact this) j0
    exact hj0 (Subtype.ext (show (c j0).1 = (0 : L).1 from congrArg (fun z : {x // x ∈ famFix σ} => z.1) this))
  obtain ⟨hfin, hle⟩ := finDim_of_no_indep hFF n hnone
  refine ⟨hfin, Nat.le_antisymm hle ?_⟩
  exact card_aut_le hΩ (famFix_le σ) hfin (famOver σ) (fun i j h => hdist i j
    (FieldAut.ext fun x => congrArg (fun τ : FieldAut F L => τ.toFun x) h))

  obtain ⟨W, rfl⟩ := mem_ofFamily.1 h

    fun z => WFRel.mem_otype.1 z.2
  refine ⟨fun z => Classical.choose (hpt z), fun z z' hzz' => Subtype.ext ?_⟩

  let g : β → α := fun b => Classical.choose (hfs b)
  have hg : ∀ b, f (g b) = b := fun b => Classical.choose_spec (hfs b)

/-- **Equality** of computable functions is a computable test. -/
theorem eq {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) (hg : Comp g) : CompB fun n => f n == g n := by
  have := Comp.ite0 (Comp.add (Comp.sub hf hg) (Comp.sub hg hf)) (Comp.const 1) (Comp.const 0)
  refine Comp.congr this fun n => ?_
  try dsimp only
  by_cases h : f n = g n
  · simp [h]
  · have : (f n == g n) = false := by simpa using h
    rw [this]; simp; omega

theorem sameCut_unique (hG : Archimedean G) {a : F} {b b' : G} (h : SameCut a b)

    have := (h r).1 ((h' r).2 hr2); grind

equal values. -/
theorem func_congr {Γ : Theory L} {n : Nat} (f : L.Func n) {ts ts' : Fin n → Term L}
    (h : ∀ i, Γ ⊢₁ eq (ts i) (ts' i)) : Γ ⊢₁ eq (.func f ts) (.func f ts') := by

Foundations.Algebra.neg_one_qr_iff:
/-- **Fermat's criterion for `-1`.** `-1` is a quadratic residue modulo an odd prime `p` exactly
when `p ≡ 1 (mod 4)`. -/
theorem neg_one_qr_iff (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) : IsQR (p - 1) p ↔ p % 4 = 1 := by
  classical
  have h3 := hp.1
  have hnd : ¬ p ∣ p - 1 := fun h => by have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h; omega
  have he := euler_criterion hp hodd hnd
  rw [pred_pow_mod h3] at he
  have hh : half p % 2 = 0 ↔ p % 4 = 1 := by unfold half; omega
  by_cases hq : IsQR (p - 1) p
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte, true_iff] at he ⊢
    apply hh.1
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hne; rw [ite_false_of hne] at he; omega
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte, false_iff] at he ⊢
    intro h4; rw [ite_true_of (hh.2 h4)] at he; omega

/-- **Zeros of sine.** `sin x = 0` if and only if `x = kπ` for an integer `k`. -/
theorem sin_eq_zero_iff (x : R) : sin x = 0 ↔ ∃ k : Int, x = (k : R) * pi := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm2⟩ := exists_int_mul_pi x
    have hy : sin (x - (m : R) * pi) = 0 := by
      rw [← sin_add_int_mul_pi_eq_zero _ m, show x - (m : R) * pi + (m : R) * pi = x by grind]
      exact h
    refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hne
    have := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (x := x - (m : R) * pi) (by grind) (by grind)
    grind
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have := (sin_add_int_mul_pi_eq_zero 0 k).2 sin_zero
    rw [show (0 : R) + (k : R) * pi = (k : R) * pi by grind] at this
    exact this

/-- **One-step β-reduction**, anywhere inside a term. -/
inductive Step : Term → Term → Prop
  /-- The β-rule `(λ. t) u ⟶ t[u]`. -/
  | beta (t u : Term) : Step (app (lam t) u) (inst t u)
  /-- Reduce in the function part. -/
  | appL {t t' u : Term} : Step t t' → Step (app t u) (app t' u)
  /-- Reduce in the argument. -/
  | appR {t u u' : Term} : Step u u' → Step (app t u) (app t u')
  /-- Reduce under a binder. -/
  | lam {t t' : Term} : Step t t' → Step (lam t) (lam t')
Foundations.Algebra.RingHom.injective_if:
/-- A ring homomorphism is injective iff its kernel is `{0}`. -/
theorem injective_iff_ker {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (f : RingHom R S) :
    (∀ a b, f.toFun a = f.toFun b → a = b) ↔ (∀ x, f.toFun x = 0 → x = 0) := by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx; exact h x 0 (by rw [hx, f.map_zero])
  · intro h a b hab
    have : f.toFun (-a + b) = 0 := by rw [f.map_add, f.map_neg, hab, neg_add_cancel]
    have h0 := h _ this
    have := congrArg (a + ·) h0
    simp only [add_neg_cancel_left, add_zero] at this
    exact this.symm

/-- A relation that is functional and total on `α` and injective yields an
injection `α → β` (choosing the value at each point). -/
theorem injective_of_rel {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (r : α → β → Prop)
    (inj : ∀ a a' b, r a b → r a' b → a = a') (tot : ∀ a, ∃ b, r a b) :
    ∃ f : α → β, Function.Injective f :=
  ⟨fun a => Classical.choose (tot a), fun a a' h => by
    have h₁ := Classical.choose_spec (tot a)
    have h₂ := Classical.choose_spec (tot a')
    simp only at h
    rw [h] at h₁
    exact inj a a' _ h₁ h₂⟩

Foundations.Logic.kalmar_lemma:
/-- **Kalmár's lemma.** If the atoms of `φ` lie in `L`, then the row hypotheses for
`v` derive `φ` or `¬φ`, according to whether `φ` is true or false under `v`. -/
theorem kalmar_lemma (v : Valuation) (L : List Nat) :
    ∀ φ : Formula, (∀ a ∈ atoms φ, a ∈ L) → rowHyps v L ⊢ signed (eval v φ) φ
  | bot, _ => Derives.neg_bot _
  | var p, h => Derives.hyp ⟨p, h p (by simp [atoms]), rfl⟩
  | imp a b, h => by
      have ha := kalmar_lemma v L a (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      have hb := kalmar_lemma v L b (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      cases ea : eval v a <;> cases eb : eval v b <;>
        simp only [ea, eb, signed] at ha hb <;> simp only [eval, ea, eb, signed]
      · exact Derives.imp_of_neg ha
      · exact Derives.imp_of_right hb
      · exact Derives.neg_imp ha hb
      · exact Derives.imp_of_right hb
  | conj a b, h => by
      have ha := kalmar_lemma v L a (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      have hb := kalmar_lemma v L b (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      cases ea : eval v a <;> cases eb : eval v b <;>
        simp only [ea, eb, signed] at ha hb <;> simp only [eval, ea, eb, signed]
      · exact Derives.neg_conj₁ ha
      · exact Derives.neg_conj₁ ha
      · exact Derives.neg_conj₂ hb
      · exact Derives.conjI ha hb
  | disj a b, h => by
      have ha := kalmar_lemma v L a (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      have hb := kalmar_lemma v L b (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      cases ea : eval v a <;> cases eb : eval v b <;>
        simp only [ea, eb, signed] at ha hb <;> simp only [eval, ea, eb, signed]
      · exact Derives.neg_disj ha hb
      · exact Derives.disjI₂ hb
      · exact Derives.disjI₁ ha
      · exact Derives.disjI₁ ha

Foundations.Types.STLC.fundamental:
/-- **The fundamental lemma of logical relations.** A well-typed term with
reducible terms substituted for its free variables is reducible. -/
theorem fundamental {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A : Ty} (h : HasType Γ t A) :
    ∀ σ, (∀ n B, Γ[n]? = some B → RED B (σ n)) → RED A (subst σ t) := by
  have hcons : ∀ {Γ : Ctx} {A : Ty} {σ : Nat → Term} {u : Term},
      (∀ n B, Γ[n]? = some B → RED B (σ n)) → RED A u →
      ∀ n B, (A :: Γ)[n]? = some B → RED B (cons u σ n) := by
    intro Γ A σ u hσ hu n B hn
    cases n with
    | zero => simp at hn; subst hn; exact hu
    | succ n => exact hσ n B (by simpa using hn)
  induction h with
  | var hn => intro σ hσ; exact hσ _ _ hn
  | lam _ ih =>
    intro σ hσ
    exact lam_red fun u hu => by rw [inst_up]; exact ih _ (hcons hσ hu)
  | app _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro σ hσ; exact ih₁ σ hσ _ (ih₂ σ hσ)
  | pair _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro σ hσ; exact pair_red (ih₁ σ hσ) (ih₂ σ hσ)
  | fst _ ih => intro σ hσ; exact (ih σ hσ).1
  | snd _ ih => intro σ hσ; exact (ih σ hσ).2
  | inl _ ih => intro σ hσ; exact inl_red (ih σ hσ)
  | inr _ ih => intro σ hσ; exact inr_red (ih σ hσ)
  | case _ _ _ ih ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro σ hσ
    exact case_red (ih σ hσ)
      (fun a ha => by rw [inst_up]; exact ih₁ _ (hcons hσ ha))
      (fun b hb => by rw [inst_up]; exact ih₂ _ (hcons hσ hb))
  | absurd _ ih => intro σ hσ; exact absurd_red (ih σ hσ)
Foundations.Sets.PSet.Equiv.trans:
/-- Extensional equivalence is transitive. -/
theorem Equiv.trans {x y z : PSet} : Equiv x y → Equiv y z → Equiv x z := by
  induction x generalizing y z with
  | mk α A ih =>
    cases y with
    | mk β B =>
      cases z with
      | mk γ C =>
        intro hxy hyz
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := equiv_iff.1 hxy
        obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := equiv_iff.1 hyz
        refine equiv_iff.2 ⟨fun a => ?_, fun c => ?_⟩
        · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h1 a
          obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h3 b
          exact ⟨c, ih a hb hc⟩
        · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h4 c
          obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h2 b
          exact ⟨a, ih a ha hb⟩
Foundations.Topology.Wallis.wallis:
/-- **The Wallis product** (Wallis 1656). `Π_{n ≥ 1} (2n)²/((2n − 1)(2n + 1)) = π/2`: the partial
products converge to `π/2`. -/
theorem wallis : Tendsto wp (pi / 2) := by
  have hb : ∀ n : Nat, abs (wp n - hpi) ≤ hpi * (1 / ((n : R) + 1)) := fun n => by
    rw [wp_eq]
    have r := I_rec (2 * n)
    have a1 := I_anti (2 * n); have a2 := I_anti (2 * n + 1)
    have p1 := I_pos (2 * n); have p3 := I_pos (2 * n + 2)
    have c1 : ((2 * n : Nat) : R) = 2 * (n : R) := by grind
    rw [c1] at r
    rw [show 2 * n + 1 + 1 = 2 * n + 2 by omega] at a2
    have hp := hpi_pos
    have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    generalize I (2 * n) = a at *
    generalize I (2 * n + 1) = b at *
    generalize I (2 * n + 2) = c at *
    generalize (n : R) = N at *
    -- `(2N+1)/(2N+2) · a = c ≤ b ≤ a`.
    have hrb : b / a ≤ 1 := by
      have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right a1 (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 p1))
      rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; grind
    have hrl : 1 - 1 / (N + 1) ≤ b / a := by
      have hc : c = (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 2) * a := by grind
      have k : (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 2) ≤ b / a := by
        have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show c ≤ b from a2)
          (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 p1))
        have ia := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show a ≠ 0 by grind)
        have e : c * a⁻¹ = (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 2) := by
          rw [hc, Semiring.mul_assoc, ia, Semiring.mul_one]
        rw [e] at k1
        rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv b]; exact k1
      have : 1 - 1 / (N + 1) ≤ (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 2) := by
        have e : (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 2) = 1 - 1 / (2 * N + 2) := by grind
        rw [e]
        have := one_div_le_one_div (by grind : 0 < N + 1) (by grind : N + 1 ≤ 2 * N + 2)
        grind
      grind
    have e : hpi * b / a - hpi = hpi * (b / a - 1) := by grind
    rw [e, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hp)]
    apply OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Std.le_of_lt hp)
    have : 0 < 1 / (N + 1) := div_pos (by grind) (by grind)
    exact abs_le.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eps_small (div_pos hε hpi_pos)
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have k := hN n hn
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left k hpi_pos
  have e : hpi * (ε / hpi) = ε := by have := hpi_pos; grind
  show abs (wp n - pi / 2) < ε
  have := hb n
  unfold hpi at *
  grind

/-- **The Goodstein sequence** of `n`: start with `n`; at step `k` (current base

Foundations.Sets.SchroederBernstein.sbMa:
/-- `sbMap` is surjective. -/
theorem sbMap_surjective (hg : Function.Injective g) : Function.Surjective (sbMap f g) := by
  intro b
  by_cases hb : InC f g (g b)
  · -- `g b` is in `InC`; it is not a base point, so it is `g (f a)` with `a ∈ InC`
    have key : ∀ x, InC f g x → x = g b → ∃ a, InC f g a ∧ f a = b := by
      intro x hx
      cases hx with
      | base x hn => intro hx; exact absurd ⟨b, hx.symm⟩ hn
      | step a ha => intro hx; exact ⟨a, ha, hg hx⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := key (g b) hb rfl
    exact ⟨a, sbMap_of_inC f g ha⟩
  · exact ⟨g b, hg (g_sbMap_of_not f g hb)⟩

/-- **Term substitutions compose.** -/
theorem subst_subst (t : Term) : ∀ τ σ, subst τ (subst σ t) = subst (subst τ ∘ σ) t := by
  induction t with
  | var n => intros; rfl
  | app t u iht ihu => intros; simp only [subst, iht, ihu]
  | lam t ih => intro τ σ; simp only [subst, ih, up_comp]
  | tlam t ih =>
    intro τ σ
    simp only [subst, ih]
    congr 2
    funext n
    exact (tyRename_subst _ _ _).symm
  | tapp t B ih => intros; simp only [subst, ih]
Foundations.Topology.Vitali.shift_disjoi:
/-- **Translates of `V` by distinct related amounts are disjoint.** -/
theorem shift_disjoint {r s : R} (hr : I r) (hs : I s) (hrs : r ≠ s) (hrel : Rel r s) {x : R}
    (h1 : shift V r x) (h2 : shift V s x) : False := by
  obtain ⟨a, n, hrel⟩ := hrel
  have hn := succ_pos n
  have hlem : ∀ v w : R, V v → V w → ∀ e : Int, v - w = (s - r) + (e : R) → False := by
    intro v w hv hw e he
    have hvw : v = w := V_unique hv hw ⟨-a + e * ((n : Int) + 1), n, by
      have := Ring.intCast_natCast (α := R) n
      have : (((-a + e * ((n : Int) + 1)) : Int) : R) = -(a : R) + (e : R) * ((n : R) + 1) := by
        grind
      rw [this, he]; grind⟩
    have hv := hv.1; have hw := hw.1
    unfold I at hr hs hv hw
    have h1' : (-2 : R) < (e : R) := by grind
    have h2' : (e : R) < (2 : R) := by grind
    have k1 := (intCast_lt (K := R) (a := -2) (b := e)).1 (by grind)
    have k2 := (intCast_lt (K := R) (a := e) (b := 2)).1 (by grind)
    have : e = -1 ∨ e = 0 ∨ e = 1 := by omega
    rcases this with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> grind
  obtain ⟨_, h1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨_, h2⟩ := h2
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 <;> rcases h2 with h2 | h2
  · exact hlem _ _ h1 h2 0 (by grind)
  · exact hlem _ _ h1 h2 (-1) (by grind)
  · exact hlem _ _ h1 h2 1 (by grind)
  · exact hlem _ _ h1 h2 0 (by grind)
Foundations.Combinatorics.erdos_szekeres:
/-- **The Erdős–Szekeres theorem.** Among the first `n² + 1` terms `a 0, …, a (n²)` of a
sequence of pairwise distinct natural numbers there is a strictly increasing or a
strictly decreasing subsequence of length `n + 1`. -/
theorem erdos_szekeres (a : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat)
    (hinj : ∀ i j, i < j → j ≤ n * n → a i ≠ a j) :
    HasMono (· < ·) a n (n * n) ∨ HasMono (· > ·) a n (n * n) := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hno => ?_
  simp only [not_or] at hno
  obtain ⟨hinc, hdec⟩ := hno
  let N := n * n
  -- the labels
  let inc : Nat → Nat := fun i => findGreatest (MonoEnd (· < ·) a i) n
  let dec : Nat → Nat := fun i => findGreatest (MonoEnd (· > ·) a i) n
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
    · exact absurd ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ _ => by simp [h], fun p q hpq hq => by omega⟩ hinc
    · exact h
  have inc_spec : ∀ i, MonoEnd (· < ·) a i (inc i) :=
    fun i => findGreatest_spec n 1 (by omega) hn (monoEnd_one _ a i)
  have dec_spec : ∀ i, MonoEnd (· > ·) a i (dec i) :=
    fun i => findGreatest_spec n 1 (by omega) hn (monoEnd_one _ a i)
  have inc_pos : ∀ i, 1 ≤ inc i := fun i => le_findGreatest n 1 hn (monoEnd_one _ a i)
  have dec_pos : ∀ i, 1 ≤ dec i := fun i => le_findGreatest n 1 hn (monoEnd_one _ a i)
  have inc_le : ∀ i, inc i ≤ n := fun i => findGreatest_le _ n
  have dec_le : ∀ i, dec i ≤ n := fun i => findGreatest_le _ n
  -- two positions with the same label
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hj, he⟩ := pigeonhole (n * n) (n * n + 1)
    (fun i => (inc i - 1) * n + (dec i - 1))
    (fun i _ => by
      have h₁ := inc_le i; have h₂ := dec_le i; have h₃ := inc_pos i; have h₄ := dec_pos i
      have : (inc i - 1) * n ≤ (n - 1) * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right n (by omega)
      have : (n - 1) * n + n = n * n := by
        rw [← Nat.succ_mul, show (n - 1).succ = n by omega]
      omega)
    (by omega)
  obtain ⟨hI, hD⟩ := pair_code_inj (by have := dec_le i; have := dec_pos i; omega)
    (by have := dec_le j; have := dec_pos j; omega) he
  have hI' : inc i = inc j := by have := inc_pos i; have := inc_pos j; omega
  have hD' : dec i = dec j := by have := dec_pos i; have := dec_pos j; omega
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne (hinj i j hij (by omega)) with h | h
  · have hext := monoEnd_extend (r := fun x y => x < y) (fun x y z => Nat.lt_trans) (inc_pos i) (inc_spec i) hij h
    have := le_findGreatest n _ (monoEnd_bound hinc (by omega) hext) hext
    show False
    have : inc i + 1 ≤ inc j := this
    omega
  · have hext := monoEnd_extend (r := fun x y => x > y) (fun x y z h₁ h₂ => Nat.lt_trans h₂ h₁) (dec_pos i) (dec_spec i)
      hij h
    have := le_findGreatest n _ (monoEnd_bound hdec (by omega) hext) hext
    have : dec i + 1 ≤ dec j := this
    omega

/-- A structure satisfying all universal closures of PA axioms under a single
environment is a model of PA (under every environment), by the coincidence lemma. -/
theorem isModel_of_PAClosure {M : Structure Arith} {e₀ : Nat → M.Dom}
    (h : ∀ χ, PAClosure χ → Sat M e₀ χ) : IsModel M PA := by
  refine ⟨⟨e₀ 0⟩, ?_⟩
  intro ψ hψ e
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := eventually_fresh ψ
  let e' : Nat → M.Dom := fun n => if n < B then e n else e₀ (n - B)
  have h₁ := (sat_allN ψ B e₀).1 (h _ ⟨ψ, B, hψ, rfl⟩) e' fun n => by
    simp only [e', show ¬ (n + B < B) by omega, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  refine (sat_congr_fresh ψ fun n hn => ?_).1 h₁
  have : n < B := Classical.byContradiction fun hn' => hn (hB n (by omega))
  simp only [e', this, ite_true]
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.total_pr:
/-- **The law of total probability** (two cases):
`P(A) = P(A | B) P(B) + P(A | Bᶜ) P(Bᶜ)`, provided both conditioning events are possible. -/
theorem total_probability {A B : Event α} (hB : P.prob B ≠ 0) (hB' : P.prob (fun x => ¬ B x) ≠ 0) :
    P.prob A = P.cond A B * P.prob B + P.cond A (fun x => ¬ B x) * P.prob (fun x => ¬ B x) := by
  rw [← prob_and_eq_cond_mul P hB, ← prob_and_eq_cond_mul P hB']; exact prob_split P A B

/-- **Zagier's map is an involution** on `S`. -/
theorem zagier_zagier (hp : IsPrime p) (h4 : p % 4 = 1) {t : Nat × Nat × Nat} (h : InS p t) :
    zagier (zagier t) = t := by
  obtain ⟨x, y, z⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz, _, _⟩ := h.facts hp h4
  by_cases h1 : x + z < y
  · rw [zagier_eq1 x y z h1, zagier_eq3 (x + 2 * z) z (y - x - z) (by omega) (by omega)]
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and]; omega
  · by_cases h2 : x < 2 * y
    · rw [zagier_eq2 x y z h1 h2, zagier_eq2 (2 * y - x) y (x + z - y) (by omega) (by omega)]
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and]; omega
    · rw [zagier_eq3 x y z h1 h2, zagier_eq1 (x - 2 * y) (x + z - y) y (by omega)]
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and]; omega

Foundations.Numbers.Cut.exists_real:
/-- Every cut is the cut of some Cauchy real (the supremum of its lower part). -/
theorem exists_real (A : Cut) : ∃ x : R, ∀ q, A.lower q ↔ R.ofQ q < x := by
  let S : R → Prop := fun y => ∃ q, A.lower q ∧ y = R.ofQ q
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.nonempty
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := A.bounded
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := R.exists_lub S ⟨_, a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨R.ofQ b, fun y ⟨q, hq, hy⟩ => by
    rw [hy]; exact Std.le_of_lt (R.ofQ_lt.2 (lt_of_mem hq hb))⟩
  refine ⟨L, fun q => ⟨fun hq => ?_, fun hq => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨r, hr, hAr⟩ := A.open_ hq
    have := hL1 _ ⟨r, hAr, rfl⟩
    have := R.ofQ_lt.2 hr
    grind
  · have : ¬ ∀ y, S y → y ≤ R.ofQ q := fun h => by have := hL2 _ h; grind
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hno
    apply this
    rintro y ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hc
    exact hno (A.down hr (R.ofQ_lt.1 (by grind)))
Foundations.Topology.sum_k_bern:
/-- `Σ_k k · C(n, k) xᵏ (1 − x)ⁿ⁻ᵏ = n x` (here `n = m + 2`). -/
theorem sum_k_bern (m : Nat) (x : R) :
    R.fsum (fun k => (k : R) * bern (m + 2) k x) (m + 3) = ((m + 2 : Nat) : R) * x := by
  unfold bern
  have e : R.fsum (fun k => (k : R) * ((fact (m + 2) : R) * (expTerm x k * expTerm (1 - x) (m + 2 - k))))
      (m + 3) = (fact (m + 2) : R) *
        R.fsum (fun k => (k : R) * (expTerm x k * expTerm (1 - x) (m + 1 + 1 - k))) (m + 1 + 2) := by
    rw [← fsum_const_mul]; apply fsum_congr; intro k _; grind
  rw [e, moment1, show x + (1 - x) = 1 by grind, expTerm_one, fact_succ', fact_succ']
  have hm0 : (0 : R) ≤ (m : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  have hpos := OrderedRing.mul_pos (show (0 : R) < (m : R) + 1 by grind) (fact_pos' m)
  grind

Foundations.Logic.FO.exists_add_mul_mod:
/-- **Solving a linear congruence.** If `P` and `d` are coprime, then `a + t·P` can be
made congruent to any `r` modulo `d`. -/
theorem exists_add_mul_mod {P d : Nat} (hcop : Nat.Coprime P d) (hd : 0 < d) (a r : Nat) :
    ∃ t, (a + t * P) % d = r % d := by
  obtain ⟨x, y, h⟩ := bezout P d
  rw [hcop] at h
  let T : Int := ((r : Int) - a) * x
  have hnn : 0 ≤ T % d := Int.emod_nonneg _ (by omega)
  refine ⟨(T % d).toNat, mod_eq_of_int_dvd ⟨-((r : Int) - a) * y - (T / d) * P, ?_⟩⟩
  have ht : (((T % d).toNat : Nat) : Int) = T % d := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn
  have hdef : T % d = T - d * (T / d) := Int.emod_def T d
  push_cast
  rw [ht, hdef]
  have hx : x * P = 1 - y * d := by simp at h; omega
  show (a : Int) + (((r : Int) - a) * x - d * (T / d)) * P - r = _
  grind
Foundations.Combinatorics.good_child:
/-- **The key step**: a good node of a finitely branching tree has a good child. -/
theorem good_child (hT : IsTree T) (hfb : FinBranching T) {l : List Nat} (hl : Good T l) :
    ∃ a, Good T (l ++ [a]) := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hno => ?_
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hfb l
  -- every child `a < B` has a depth beyond which it has no extensions
  have hbad : ∀ a, ∃ n, ¬ ∃ m, T (l ++ [a] ++ m) ∧ m.length = n := by
    intro a
    refine Classical.byContradiction fun h => hno ⟨a, fun n => ?_⟩
    exact Classical.byContradiction fun h' => h ⟨n, h'⟩
  -- a common depth for all children `a < B`
  have hcommon : ∀ k, ∃ N, ∀ a, a < k → ∀ m, T (l ++ [a] ++ m) → m.length < N := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, fun a ha => absurd ha (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hbad k
      refine ⟨max N₁ n, fun a ha m hm => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 ha with ha | rfl
      · have := hN₁ a ha m hm; omega
      · refine Classical.byContradiction fun hlt => hn ?_
        exact ext_shorter hT hm (by omega)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcommon B
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hml⟩ := hl (N + 1)
  match m, hml with
  | a :: m', hml =>
    have hchild : T (l ++ [a]) := hT _ m' (by simpa using hm)
    have := hN a (hB a hchild) m' (by simpa using hm)
    simp at hml; omega

Foundations.Numbers.R.monotone_convergen:
/-- **Monotone convergence theorem.** An increasing sequence of reals that is bounded above
converges. -/
theorem monotone_convergence {a : Nat → R} (hmono : ∀ n, a n ≤ a (n + 1))
    (hbdd : ∃ B, ∀ n, a n ≤ B) : ∃ L, Tendsto a L := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := exists_lub (fun x => ∃ n, x = a n) ⟨_, 0, rfl⟩
    (by obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hbdd; exact ⟨B, fun x ⟨n, hn⟩ => hn ▸ hB n⟩)
  refine ⟨L, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
  have : ¬ ∀ x, (∃ n, x = a n) → x ≤ L - ε := fun h => by have := hL2 _ h; grind
  have : ∃ N, L - ε < a N := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno; apply this
    rintro x ⟨n, rfl⟩
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h; exact hno ⟨n, by grind⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := this
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => abs_lt.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := mono_le hmono hn; grind
  · have := hL1 _ ⟨n, rfl⟩; grind
Foundations.Topology.Wallis.B_le:
/-- **The error term is small**: `Bₙ ≤ (π/2)² Aₙ / (2n + 2)`. -/
theorem B_le (n : Nat) : B n ≤ hpi * hpi * (A n / (2 * (n : R) + 2)) := by
  have hab := Std.le_of_lt hpi_pos
  -- Pointwise: `x² cos^{2n} ≤ (π/2)² (cos^{2n} − cos^{2n+2})`.
  have hle := HasIntegral.mono hab
    (hasIntegral_integral hab fun x _ _ => continuousAt_x2cos (2 * n) x)
    (((hasIntegral_integral hab fun x _ _ => continuousAt_cos_pow (2 * n) x).const_mul (hpi * hpi)).add
      ((hasIntegral_integral hab fun x _ _ => continuousAt_cos_pow (2 * n + 1 + 1) x).const_mul
        (-(hpi * hpi)))) fun t h0 h1 => by
      have hj := jordan h0 h1
      have hsq : t * t ≤ hpi * sin t * (hpi * sin t) := by
        have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj h0
        have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hj (Std.le_trans h0 hj)
        grind
      have hC := pow_le_pow_left.pow_nonneg (cos_mem h0 h1).1 (2 * n)
      have py := sin_sq_add_cos_sq t
      have k := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq hC
      show t * t * cos t ^ (2 * n) ≤ hpi * hpi * cos t ^ (2 * n) + -(hpi * hpi) * (cos t ^ (2 * n) * cos t * cos t)
      have ss : sin t * sin t = 1 - cos t * cos t := by grind
      have e : hpi * sin t * (hpi * sin t) * cos t ^ (2 * n) =
          hpi * hpi * cos t ^ (2 * n) + -(hpi * hpi) * (cos t ^ (2 * n) * cos t * cos t) := by
        rw [show hpi * sin t * (hpi * sin t) * cos t ^ (2 * n) =
          hpi * hpi * (sin t * sin t) * cos t ^ (2 * n) by grind, ss]
        grind
      rw [e] at k; exact k
  have eA : A (n + 1) = integral (fun x => cos x ^ (2 * n + 1 + 1)) 0 hpi := by
    unfold A I; rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 by omega]
  have hr := A_rec n
  have hpos := A_pos n
  have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  unfold A at hr hpos ⊢; unfold B
  unfold A at eA
  rw [← eA] at hle
  have eI : integral (fun y => cos y ^ (2 * n)) 0 hpi = I (2 * n) := rfl
  rw [eI] at hle
  generalize I (2 * n) = a at *
  generalize I (2 * (n + 1)) = a' at *
  have h2 : (2 * (n : R) + 2) ≠ 0 := by grind
  have i := Field.mul_inv_cancel h2
  have ha' : a' = (2 * (n : R) + 1) * (2 * (n : R) + 2)⁻¹ * a := by
    calc a' = a' * ((2 * (n : R) + 2) * (2 * (n : R) + 2)⁻¹) := by rw [i, Semiring.mul_one]
      _ = ((2 * (n : R) + 2) * a') * (2 * (n : R) + 2)⁻¹ := by grind
      _ = ((2 * (n : R) + 1) * a) * (2 * (n : R) + 2)⁻¹ := by rw [hr]
      _ = _ := by grind
  rw [ha'] at hle
  rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
  generalize (2 * (n : R) + 2)⁻¹ = J at *
  have hJ : 1 - (2 * (n : R) + 1) * J = J := by grind
  have e : hpi * hpi * a + -(hpi * hpi) * ((2 * (n : R) + 1) * J * a) = hpi * hpi * (a * J) := by
    rw [show hpi * hpi * a + -(hpi * hpi) * ((2 * (n : R) + 1) * J * a) =
      hpi * hpi * a * (1 - (2 * (n : R) + 1) * J) by grind, hJ]; grind
  rw [e] at hle; exact hle

`n + 0 = n` and `n + succ m = succ (n + m)`. -/

theorem euler_identity : exp (I * ofReal pi) + 1 = 0 := by
  rw [exp_I_mul, cos_pi, sin_pi]
  apply ext
  · show -1 + (0 * 0 - 1 * 0) + 1 = (0 : R); grind
  · show 0 + (0 * 0 + 1 * 0) + 0 = (0 : R); grind

Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.fresh_subst:
/-- A substitution acting only on the free variables that actually occur (formulas). -/
theorem Formula.fresh_subst_of :
    ∀ (φ : Formula Arith) {x : Nat} {σ : Nat → Term Arith},
      (∀ n, ¬ φ.Fresh n → (σ n).Fresh x) → (φ.subst σ).Fresh x
  | .bot, _, _, _ => trivial
  | .eq t s, _, _, h => ⟨Term.fresh_subst_of t fun n hn => h n fun hf => hn hf.1,
      Term.fresh_subst_of s fun n hn => h n fun hf => hn hf.2⟩
  | .rel R _, _, _, _ => (R : Empty).elim
  | .imp φ ψ, _, _, h => ⟨fresh_subst_of φ fun n hn => h n fun hf => hn hf.1,
      fresh_subst_of ψ fun n hn => h n fun hf => hn hf.2⟩
  | .conj φ ψ, _, _, h => ⟨fresh_subst_of φ fun n hn => h n fun hf => hn hf.1,
      fresh_subst_of ψ fun n hn => h n fun hf => hn hf.2⟩
  | .disj φ ψ, _, _, h => ⟨fresh_subst_of φ fun n hn => h n fun hf => hn hf.1,
      fresh_subst_of ψ fun n hn => h n fun hf => hn hf.2⟩
  | .all φ, x, σ, h | .ex φ, x, σ, h => by
      refine fresh_subst_of φ (x := x + 1) fun n hn => ?_
      cases n with
      | zero => simp only [Subst.lift, Term.Fresh]; omega
      | succ m => exact Term.fresh_rename_succ _ (h m hn)

  { f with
    invFun := fun y => Classical.choose (surj y)

Foundations.Numbers.ofQ_embedding:
/-- **ℚ embeds in ℝ.** `ofQ` is injective and preserves `0`, `1`, `+`, `×` and `≤`. -/
theorem ofQ_embedding :
    R.ofQ 0 = 0 ∧ R.ofQ 1 = 1 ∧ (∀ p q, R.ofQ (p + q) = R.ofQ p + R.ofQ q) ∧
    (∀ p q, R.ofQ (p * q) = R.ofQ p * R.ofQ q) ∧ (∀ p q, p ≤ q ↔ R.ofQ p ≤ R.ofQ q) ∧
    (∀ p q, R.ofQ p = R.ofQ q → p = q) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, R.ofQ_add, R.ofQ_mul, fun p q => R.ofQ_le.symm, fun p q h => ?_⟩
  have h1 := R.ofQ_le.1 (le_of_eq h : R.ofQ p ≤ R.ofQ q)
  have h2 := R.ofQ_le.1 (le_of_eq h.symm : R.ofQ q ≤ R.ofQ p)
  exact Q.le_antisymm h1 h2
where
  le_of_eq {x y : R} (h : x = y) : x ≤ y := Or.inr h

Foundations.Combinatorics.hall_iff:
/-- **Hall's marriage theorem, both directions**: a finite family has a system of
distinct representatives iff it satisfies Hall's condition. -/
theorem hall_iff (A : Nat → Nat → Prop) :
    (∃ f : Nat → Nat, (∀ i, i < N → f i < M ∧ A i (f i)) ∧
      ∀ i j, i < N → j < N → i ≠ j → f i ≠ f j) ↔
    ∀ I : Nat → Prop, cnt I N ≤ cnt (union N A I) M :=
  ⟨fun ⟨f, hf, hinj⟩ => hall_necessary N M A f hf hinj, hall N M A⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.sin_pos_of_pos_of_:
/-- **Sine is positive on `(0, π)`.** -/
theorem sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi {x : R} (h0 : 0 < x) (hx : x < pi) : 0 < sin x := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hcos, hpos⟩ := pi_div_two_spec
  have hnn : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ pi / 2 → 0 ≤ cos t := fun t h1 h2 => by
    rcases (by grind : t < pi / 2 ∨ t = pi / 2) with h | h
    · exact Std.le_of_lt (hpos t h1 h)
    · rw [h, hcos]; grind
  rcases (by grind : x ≤ pi / 2 ∨ pi / 2 < x) with h | h
  · have k1 : sin 0 < sin (x / 2) := strictMono_of_deriv_pos (a := 0) (b := x / 2)
      (fun t _ _ => hasDerivAt_sin t) (fun t h1 h2 => hpos t h1 (by grind))
      (Std.le_refl 0) (by grind) (Std.le_refl _)
    have k2 : sin (x / 2) ≤ sin x := monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (a := x / 2) (b := x)
      (fun t _ _ => hasDerivAt_sin t) (fun t h1 h2 => hnn t (by grind) (by grind))
      (Std.le_refl _) (by grind) (Std.le_refl _)
    rw [sin_zero] at k1; grind
  · rw [show x = (x - pi / 2) + pi / 2 by grind, sin_add_pi_div_two]
    exact hpos _ (by grind) (by grind)

Foundations.Algebra.Subgroup.map:
/-- The **image** of a subgroup under a homomorphism is a subgroup. -/
def map {K : Type v} [Group K] (f : G →* K) (M : Subgroup G) : Subgroup K where
  carrier y := ∃ x, x ∈ M ∧ f x = y
  one_mem := ⟨1, M.one_mem, f.map_one⟩
  mul_mem := by
    intro a b ⟨x, hx, hxa⟩ ⟨y, hy, hyb⟩
    exact ⟨x * y, M.mul_mem hx hy, by rw [f.map_mul', hxa, hyb]⟩
  inv_mem := by
    intro a ⟨x, hx, hxa⟩
    exact ⟨x⁻¹, M.inv_mem hx, by rw [f.map_inv, hxa]⟩

/-- On the unit disc, `|p(w)| ≤ Σ |cₖ|`. -/
theorem cabs_peval_le (l : List C) {w : C} (hw : cabs w ≤ 1) : cabs (peval l w) ≤ pnorm l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => show cabs 0 ≤ 0; rw [cabs_zero]; grind
  | cons c l ih =>
    show cabs (c + w * peval l w) ≤ cabs c + pnorm l
    have := cabs_add c (w * peval l w)
    rw [cabs_mul] at this
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw (cabs_nonneg (peval l w))
    grind
Foundations.Combinatorics.infinite_ramse:
/-- **The infinite Ramsey theorem** (Ramsey 1930). For every 2-colouring `c` of the
pairs of natural numbers there is an infinite monochromatic set: a strictly increasing
sequence `f` and a colour `b` with `c (f i) (f j) = b` for all `i < j`. -/
theorem infinite_ramsey : ∃ (b : Bool) (f : Nat → Nat), (∀ i j, i < j → f i < f j) ∧
    ∀ i j, i < j → c (f i) (f j) = b := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_bool fun k => majority c (chain c k)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hmono⟩ := hb.enum
  refine ⟨b, fun i => pick (chain c (g i)), fun i j hij => (chain_prop c (hmono i j hij)).1,
    fun i j hij => ?_⟩
  rw [(chain_prop c (hmono i j hij)).2]; exact hg i

/-- `Bₙ ≥ 0`. -/

/-- The **stabiliser** of `x`: the elements of `G` fixing `x`. It is a subgroup. -/
def stabilizer (x : X) : Subgroup G where
  carrier g := g • x = x
  one_mem := one_smul x
  mul_mem := by intro a b ha hb; show (a * b) • x = x; rw [mul_smul, hb, ha]
  inv_mem := by intro a ha; show a⁻¹ • x = x; rw [← ha, inv_smul_smul, ha]
Foundations.Combinatorics.monoEnd_le:
/-- Earlier entries of a subsequence ending at `i` are at positions `≤ i`, and (for a
transitive `r`) are `r`-related to `a i` or equal to it. -/
theorem monoEnd_le {i k : Nat} {s : Nat → Nat} (hs : s (k - 1) = i)
    (h : ∀ p q, p < q → q < k → s p < s q ∧ r (a (s p)) (a (s q))) (p : Nat) (hp : p < k) :
    s p ≤ i ∧ (s p = i ∨ r (a (s p)) (a i)) := by
  by_cases hpk : p = k - 1
  · subst hpk; exact ⟨Nat.le_of_eq hs, Or.inl hs⟩
  · have := h p (k - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [hs] at this
    exact ⟨Nat.le_of_lt this.1, Or.inr this.2⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.fsum_split:
/-- Splitting a sum: `Σ_{k<m+n} aₖ = Σ_{k<m} aₖ + Σ_{k<n} aₘ₊ₖ`. -/
theorem fsum_split (a : Nat → R) (m n : Nat) :
    fsum a (m + n) = fsum a m + fsum (fun k => a (m + k)) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => show fsum a m = fsum a m + 0; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [← Nat.add_assoc, fsum_succ, ih, fsum_succ]; grind
Foundations.Numbers.R.abs_exp_sub_le:
/-- **Quadratic estimate.** `|exp y − exp x − (y − x) exp x| ≤ |y − x|²/2 · exp (|x| + 1)` when
`|y − x| ≤ 1`. -/
theorem abs_exp_sub_le {x y : R} (hxy : abs (y - x) ≤ 1) :
    abs (exp y - exp x - (y - x) * exp x) ≤
      abs (y - x) * abs (y - x) / 2 * exp (abs x + 1) := by
  let M := abs x + 1
  have hx : abs x ≤ M := by grind
  have hy : abs y ≤ M := by
    have := abs_add (y - x) x; rw [show y - x + x = y by grind] at this; grind
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by have := abs_nonneg x; grind
  -- The series of error terms `E n / n!` sums to the left-hand side…
  have h1 : HasSum (fun n => powErr x y n / (fact n : R))
      (exp y - exp x - (y - x) * exp x) := by
    refine (((hasSum_exp y).sub (hasSum_exp x)).sub ((hasSum_derTerm x).const_mul (y - x))).congr
      fun n => ?_
    unfold expTerm derTerm powErr
    have := fact_pos' n
    grind
  -- …and its first two terms vanish.
  have h2 : HasSum (fun n => powErr x y (2 + n) / (fact (2 + n) : R))
      (exp y - exp x - (y - x) * exp x) := by
    have := (hasSum_shift_iff (a := fun n => powErr x y n / (fact n : R)) 2).2 h1
    have e : fsum (fun n => powErr x y n / (fact n : R)) 2 = 0 := by
      rw [fsum_succ, fsum_succ, fsum_zero]; unfold powErr
      show 0 + (y ^ 0 - x ^ 0 - ((0 : Nat) : R) * x ^ (0 - 1) * (y - x)) / ((1 : Nat) : R) +
        (y ^ 1 - x ^ 1 - ((1 : Nat) : R) * x ^ (1 - 1) * (y - x)) / ((1 * 1 : Nat) : R) = 0
      show 0 + (y ^ 0 - x ^ 0 - ((0 : Nat) : R) * x ^ 0 * (y - x)) / ((1 : Nat) : R) +
        (y ^ 0 * y - x ^ 0 * x - ((1 : Nat) : R) * x ^ 0 * (y - x)) / ((1 * 1 : Nat) : R) = 0
      grind
    rw [e, show exp y - exp x - (y - x) * exp x - 0 = exp y - exp x - (y - x) * exp x by grind]
      at this
    exact this
  -- Each term is dominated by `|y − x|²/2 · Mⁿ/n!`.
  have h3 : ∀ n, abs (powErr x y (2 + n) / (fact (2 + n) : R)) ≤
      abs (y - x) * abs (y - x) / 2 * expTerm M n := abs_powErr_div_le hx hy
  have := abs_hasSum_le h3 h2 ((hasSum_exp M).const_mul (abs (y - x) * abs (y - x) / 2))
  exact this
Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.Fresh:
/-- `Formula.Fresh x φ`: the variable `x` does not occur free in `φ`. Under a
quantifier the free variable `x` is called `x + 1`. -/
def Formula.Fresh : Nat → Formula L → Prop
  | _, .bot => True
  | x, .eq t s => t.Fresh x ∧ s.Fresh x
  | x, .rel _ ts => ∀ i, (ts i).Fresh x
  | x, .imp φ ψ => Formula.Fresh x φ ∧ Formula.Fresh x ψ
  | x, .conj φ ψ => Formula.Fresh x φ ∧ Formula.Fresh x ψ
  | x, .disj φ ψ => Formula.Fresh x φ ∧ Formula.Fresh x ψ
  | x, .all φ => Formula.Fresh (x + 1) φ
  | x, .ex φ => Formula.Fresh (x + 1) φ
Foundations.Numbers.Cut.lub:
/-- **Completeness of the Dedekind reals.** A nonempty set of cuts which is bounded above has a
least upper bound: the union of the lower parts. -/
theorem lub (S : Cut → Prop) (hne : ∃ A, S A) (hbdd : ∃ M, ∀ A, S A → A ≤ M) :
    ∃ L, (∀ A, S A → A ≤ L) ∧ ∀ M, (∀ A, S A → A ≤ M) → L ≤ M := by
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hbdd
  let L : Cut :=
    { lower := fun q => ∃ A, S A ∧ A.lower q
      nonempty := by obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := A₀.nonempty; exact ⟨q, A₀, hA₀, hq⟩
      bounded := by
        obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := M.bounded
        exact ⟨q, fun ⟨A, hA, hAq⟩ => hq (hM A hA q hAq)⟩
      down := fun ⟨A, hA, hAq⟩ h => ⟨A, hA, A.down hAq h⟩
      open_ := fun ⟨A, hA, hAq⟩ => by
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hAr⟩ := A.open_ hAq
        exact ⟨r, hr, A, hA, hAr⟩ }
  exact ⟨L, fun A hA q hq => ⟨A, hA, hq⟩, fun M' hM' q ⟨A, hA, hAq⟩ => hM' A hA q hAq⟩
Foundations.Numbers.R.tendsto_unique:
/-- **Uniqueness of limits.** A sequence has at most one limit. -/
theorem tendsto_unique {a : Nat → R} {L M : R} (hL : Tendsto a L) (hM : Tendsto a M) : L = M := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hne
  have hpos : 0 < abs (L - M) := by rcases abs_cases (L - M) with h | h <;> grind
  obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := hL (abs (L - M) / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := hM (abs (L - M) / 2) (by grind)
  have k1 := h₁ (max N₁ N₂) (by omega)
  have k2 := h₂ (max N₁ N₂) (by omega)
  have k3 := abs_add (L - a (max N₁ N₂)) (a (max N₁ N₂) - M)
  rw [abs_sub_comm] at k1
  have e : L - a (max N₁ N₂) + (a (max N₁ N₂) - M) = L - M := by grind
  rw [e] at k3
  grind

Foundations.Logic.Ordinals.bump_main:
/-- **The two key estimates on bumping**, proved by a joint strong induction:
bumping is strictly monotone, and if `r < k·b^e` with `k ≤ b` then
`bump r < k·(b+1)^{bump e}`. -/
theorem bump_main (c : Nat) : ∀ n, (∀ m, m < n → bump c m < bump c n) ∧
    (∀ r k, r < k * (c + 2) ^ n → k ≤ c + 2 → bump c r < k * (c + 3) ^ bump c n) := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
  have hb : 2 ≤ c + 2 := by omega
  -- monotonicity at `n`
  have hM : ∀ m, m < n → bump c m < bump c n := by
    intro m hmn
    have hn : n ≠ 0 := by omega
    rw [bump_pos c hn]
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · subst hm; rw [bump_zero]
      have := Nat.pow_pos (n := bump c (lg (c + 2) n)) (show 0 < c + 3 by omega); omega
    have he₁ := pow_lg_le hb n (by omega)
    have he₂ := lt_pow_lg hb n
    have hf₁ := pow_lg_le hb m (by omega)
    have hf₂ := lt_pow_lg hb m
    have hfe : lg (c + 2) m < lg (c + 2) n + 1 := exp_lt_of_pow (by omega) hf₁ (by omega)
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hfe with h | h
    · -- smaller leading exponent
      have hm' : m < 1 * (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n := by
        rw [Nat.one_mul]
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hf₂ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) h)
      have := (ih _ (lg_lt hb hn)).2 m 1 hm' (by omega)
      rw [Nat.one_mul] at this; omega
    · have hle : (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n ≤ m := h ▸ hf₁
      have hpos := Nat.pow_pos (n := lg (c+2) n) (show 0 < c + 2 by omega)
      have := (ih (n - (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n) (by omega)).1
        (m - (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n) (Nat.sub_lt_sub_right hle hmn)
      rw [bump_pos c hm, h]
      omega
  refine ⟨hM, ?_⟩
  -- the bound at `n`, by induction on `r`
  intro r
  induction r using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ r ihr =>
  intro k hr hk
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | h
    · simp at hr
    · exact h
  have hYpos := Nat.pow_pos (n := bump c n) (show 0 < c + 3 by omega)
  by_cases hr0 : r = 0
  · subst hr0; rw [bump_zero]; exact Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hYpos
  have hf₁ := pow_lg_le hb r (by omega)
  have hf₂ := lt_pow_lg hb r
  have hkb : k * (c + 2) ^ n ≤ (c + 2) ^ (n + 1) := by
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm ((c + 2) ^ n)]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hk
  have hfn : lg (c + 2) r < n + 1 := exp_lt_of_pow (by omega) hf₁ (by omega)
  rw [bump_pos c hr0]
  rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hfn with h | h
  · -- leading exponent `f < n`
    have hs : r - (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) r < (c + 1) * (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) r := by
      rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_succ] at hf₂
      rw [Nat.mul_comm]; omega
    have h₁ := (ih _ h).2 _ (c + 1) hs (by omega)
    have h₂ := hM _ h
    have h₃ : (c + 3) ^ (bump c (lg (c + 2) r) + 1) ≤ (c + 3) ^ bump c n :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) h₂
    rw [Nat.pow_succ] at h₃
    have h₄ : (c + 3) ^ bump c n ≤ k * (c + 3) ^ bump c n := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hk1
    have h₅ := mul_add_three ((c + 3) ^ bump c (lg (c + 2) r)) c
    omega
  · -- leading exponent `f = n`
    rw [h]
    rw [h] at hf₁
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [Nat.succ_mul] at hr ⊢
    have := ihr (r - (c + 2) ^ n)
      (by have := Nat.pow_pos (n := n) (show 0 < c + 2 by omega); omega) k' (by omega) (by omega)
    omega

Foundations.Combinatorics.IsRamsey:
/-- **The Ramsey property** `N → (s, t)`: every symmetric 2-colouring of the pairs of
any set of at least `N` vertices has a red `s`-clique or a blue `t`-clique. -/
def IsRamsey (s t N : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ c : Nat → Nat → Bool, (∀ x y, c x y = c y x) → ∀ V : List Nat, V.Nodup → N ≤ V.length →
    HasClique c true s V ∨ HasClique c false t V
Foundations.Numbers.C.nrm_cterm_le:
/-- `‖zⁿ/n!‖ ≤ ‖z‖ⁿ/n!`. -/
theorem nrm_cterm_le (z : C) (n : Nat) : nrm (cterm z n) ≤ expTerm (nrm z) n := by
  unfold nrm cterm expTerm
  rw [div_natCast_re _ (fact_pos n), div_natCast_im _ (fact_pos n), abs_div_pos (fact_pos' n),
    abs_div_pos (fact_pos' n), Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
  have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (nrm_pow_le z n)
    (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 (fact_pos' n)))
  unfold nrm at this
  grind
Foundations.Types.STLC.normal_iff_step?_:
/-- **Normality is decidable**: `step?` returns `none` exactly on normal terms. -/
theorem normal_iff_step?_none (t : Term) : Normal t ↔ step? t = none := by
  constructor
  · intro hn
    cases hs : step? t with
    | none => rfl
    | some t' => exact absurd (step?_sound _ _ hs) (hn t')
  · intro hs t' h
    have := step?_complete h
    rw [hs] at this
    exact absurd this (by simp)
Foundations.Algebra.euler_criterion:
/-- **Euler's criterion.** For an odd prime `p` and `p ∤ a`, `a^((p-1)/2) ≡ 1 (mod p)` if `a` is
a quadratic residue and `a^((p-1)/2) ≡ -1 (mod p)` otherwise. -/
theorem euler_criterion (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) {a : Nat} (ha : ¬ p ∣ a) :
    a ^ half p % p = (by classical exact if IsQR a p then 1 else p - 1) := by
  classical
  have ⟨h2, _, _⟩ := half_spec hp hodd
  by_cases hq : IsQR a p
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte]
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hq
    have hxp : ¬ p ∣ x := by
      intro hd; apply ha
      have : a % p = 0 := by rw [← hx, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hd]; simp
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero this
    rw [Nat.pow_mod, ← hx, ← Nat.pow_mod]
    exact sq_pow_half hp hodd hxp
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte]
    have hsq : (a ^ half p % p) * (a ^ half p % p) % p = 1 := by
      rw [← Nat.mul_mod, ← Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, h2]
      exact fermat p a hp ha
    rcases sq_eq_one hp (Nat.mod_lt _ (by have := hp.1; omega)) hsq with h | h
    · exact absurd h (pow_half_ne_one_of_not_qr hp hodd ha hq)
    · exact h

/-- Inversion in a subgroup is inversion in `G`. -/

Foundations.Numbers.N.le:
/-- The order on `N`: `n ≤ m` means that `m` is reached from `n` by adding something. -/
def le (n m : N) : Prop := ∃ k : N, n + k = m
Foundations.Algebra.sq_inj:
/-- **Squares of `1, …, (p-1)/2` are distinct modulo `p`.** -/
theorem sq_inj (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) {u v : Nat} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hv0 : 0 < v) (hu : u ≤ half p)
    (hv : v ≤ half p) (h : u * u % p = v * v % p) : u = v := by
  have ⟨_, _, h3⟩ := half_spec hp hodd
  have key : ∀ u v, 0 < u → 0 < v → u ≤ half p → v ≤ half p → u < v → u * u % p = v * v % p → False := by
    intro u v hu0 hv0 hu hv huv h
    have hm := Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq h.symm
    rw [Nat.mul_self_sub_mul_self_eq] at hm
    rcases hp.dvd_mul (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hm) with hd | hd
    · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd; omega
    · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd; omega
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy u v with hl | he | hg
  · exact (key u v hu0 hv0 hu hv hl h).elim
  · exact he
  · exact (key v u hv0 hu0 hv hu hg h.symm).elim
Foundations.Probability.sumL_le:
/-- **Monotonicity** of sums. -/
theorem sumL_le {l : List α} {f g : α → R} (h : ∀ x ∈ l, f x ≤ g x) : sumL l f ≤ sumL l g := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact Std.le_refl _
  | cons a l ih =>
      simp only [sumL_cons]
      have h₁ := h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      have h₂ := ih fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)
      grind
Foundations.Numbers.Z.mul_le_mul_of_pos:
/-- **Order is compatible with multiplication by positives.**
If `0 < z` and `x ≤ y` then `z * x ≤ z * y`. -/
theorem mul_le_mul_of_pos {x y z : Z} (hz : 0 < z) : x ≤ y → z * x ≤ z * y := by
  induction x using ind with | h a b => ?_
  induction y using ind with | h c d => ?_
  induction z using ind with | h e f => ?_
  simp only [LT.lt, zero_def, mk_le, mk_mul] at *
  intro h
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, e = f + k := ⟨e - f, by omega⟩
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k h
  simp only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul] at *
  omega

/-- Multiplication: `(a − b)(c − d) = (ac + bd) − (ad + bc)`. -/
def mul : Z → Z → Z :=
  Quotient.lift₂ (fun p q => mk (p.1 * q.1 + p.2 * q.2) (p.1 * q.2 + p.2 * q.1))
    (fun _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => by
      apply Quotient.sound
      simp only [rel_iff] at *; grind)

Foundations.Algebra.char_prime:
/-- **The characteristic of a finite field is prime.** -/
theorem char_prime {p : Nat} (hp : 0 < p ∧ (ncast p : F) = 0)
    (hmin : ∀ m, m < p → ¬ (0 < m ∧ (ncast m : F) = 0)) : IsPrime p := by
  have h1 : p ≠ 1 := by intro h; rw [h] at hp; exact hF.1 hp.2.symm
  refine ⟨by omega, fun d hd => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hd
  have hd0 : 0 < d := by apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; intro h; rw [h] at he; omega
  have he0 : 0 < e := by apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; intro h; rw [h] at he; omega
  have hprod : (ncast d : F) * ncast e = 0 := by rw [← ncast_mul, ← he]; exact hp.2
  rcases hF.isDomain.2 _ _ hprod with h | h
  · have : ¬ d < p := fun hlt => hmin d hlt ⟨hd0, h⟩
    right; have := Nat.le_of_dvd hp.1 ⟨e, he⟩; omega
  · have : ¬ e < p := fun hlt => hmin e hlt ⟨he0, h⟩
    left
    have : d * e ≥ d * p := Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (by omega)
    have : d * p ≥ 1 * p := Nat.mul_le_mul_right p hd0
    have : e ≤ p := Nat.le_of_dvd hp.1 ⟨d, by rw [he, Nat.mul_comm]⟩
    have : d * e = p := he.symm
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 d with hd1 | hd1
    · have : d * e ≥ 2 * e := Nat.mul_le_mul_right e hd1
      omega
    · omega
Foundations.Algebra.MulAction.count_orbi:
/-- The size of an orbit divides the order of the group. -/
theorem count_orbit_dvd (x : X) : count (orbit G x) ∣ card G :=

Foundations.Algebra.pred_pow_mod:
/-- Powers of `-1 ≡ p - 1` modulo `p`. -/
theorem pred_pow_mod (h2 : 2 ≤ p) (n : Nat) :
    (p - 1) ^ n % p = if n % 2 = 0 then 1 else p - 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < p)]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, ih]
    by_cases hn : n % 2 = 0
    · rw [ite_true_of hn, ite_false_of (by omega), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : p - 1 < p),
        Nat.one_mul, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    · rw [ite_false_of hn, ite_true_of (by omega), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : p - 1 < p),
        pred_mul_pred_mod h2]
Foundations.Sets.barber:
/-- **The barber (pure logic).** For any relation `r` on any type, nothing bears
`r` to exactly those things that do not bear `r` to themselves. This is the
logical core of Russell's paradox. -/
theorem barber {α : Sort _} (r : α → α → Prop) : ¬ ∃ b, ∀ x, r x b ↔ ¬ r x x := by
  rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
  have h := hb b
  have hn : ¬ r b b := fun hr => h.1 hr hr
  exact hn (h.2 hn)
Foundations.Logic.Derives.lem:
/-- The law of excluded middle `φ ∨ ¬φ` is derivable (classically). -/
theorem lem (Γ : Theory) (φ : Formula) : Γ ⊢ disj φ (neg φ) := by
  apply raa
  apply negE (assume _ _)
  apply disjI₂
  apply negI
  apply negE ((assume _ _).weaken₁ _)
  exact disjI₁ (assume _ _)
Foundations.Types.SystemF.tru_red:
/-- **The conditional computes**: `true [A] a b ⟶* a`. -/
theorem tru_red (A : Ty) (a b : Term) : Red (app (app (tapp tru A) a) b) a := by
  have h₁ : Step (tapp tru A) (lam (lam (var 1))) := Step.tbeta _ _
  have h₂ : Step (app (lam (lam (var 1))) a) (lam (rename Nat.succ a)) := by
    have := Step.beta (lam (var 1)) a
    simpa [inst, subst, up, cons] using this
  have h₃ : Step (app (lam (rename Nat.succ a)) b) a := by
    have := Step.beta (rename Nat.succ a) b
    rwa [inst, subst_cons_rename_succ] at this
  exact ((Star.single (Step.appL (Step.appL h₁))).tail (Step.appL h₂)).tail h₃
Foundations.Numbers.C.continuous_cabs_pe:
/-- `z ↦ |p(z)|` is continuous. -/
theorem continuous_cabs_peval (l : List C) (z₀ : C) :
    ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ z, cabs (z - z₀) < δ →
      abs (cabs (peval l z) - cabs (peval l z₀)) < ε := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, h⟩ := peval_lipschitz l z₀
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both (by grind : (0 : R) < 1)
    (div_pos hε (by grind : 0 < K + 1))
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have k := h z (by grind)
  have k1 := cabs_sub_le (peval l z) (peval l z₀)
  have k2 := cabs_sub_le (peval l z₀) (peval l z)
  rw [cabs_sub_comm (peval l z₀)] at k2
  have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt hz) hK
  have k4 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ2 (by grind : 0 ≤ K + 1)
  have e : (K + 1) * (ε / (K + 1)) = ε := by grind
  exact abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩

/-- Right distributivity: `(a + b) * c = a * c + b * c`. -/

/-- The **polymorphic identity** `Λα. λx. x : ∀α. α → α`. -/

Foundations.Logic.FO.trenameStep:
/-- One step of `trename`: add the parameter `d` to every variable index. -/
def trenameStep (q : Nat) : Nat :=
  bif fst (cvN q) == 0 then pair 0 (snd (cvN q) + cvP q)
  else bif fst (cvN q) == 2 then pair 2 (cvRec q (snd (cvN q)))
  else bif fst (cvN q) == 3 || fst (cvN q) == 4 then
    pair (fst (cvN q)) (pair (cvRec q (fst (snd (cvN q)))) (cvRec q (snd (snd (cvN q)))))
  else cvN q
Foundations.Logic.lindenbaum_lemma:
/-- **Lindenbaum's lemma.** Every consistent theory is contained in a maximal
consistent theory. -/
theorem lindenbaum_lemma {Γ : Theory} (hΓ : Consistent Γ) :
    ∃ M, Γ.Subset M ∧ MaximalConsistent M := by
  refine ⟨lindenbaum Γ, fun ψ h => ⟨0, h⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hbot
    obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := hbot.finite_premises
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := lindenbaum_finite Γ L hL
    exact consistent_stage hΓ n (hd.weaken hn)
  · intro φ
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_allUpTo φ
    rcases extend_decides (allUpTo n) (stage Γ n) φ hn with h | ⟨Δ', hsub, hinc⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨n + 1, h⟩
    · refine Or.inr fun hc => hc ?_
      refine Classical.byContradiction fun hc' => ?_
      exact hinc (fun hb => hc' (hb.weaken (insert_mono
        (hsub.trans fun ψ h => ⟨n + 1, h⟩) φ)))
Foundations.Logic.HDerives:
/-- **Hilbert-style derivability.** `HDerives Γ φ` (written `Γ ⊢ₕ φ`) holds when `φ`
is obtained from premises in `Γ` and axioms by repeated modus ponens. -/
inductive HDerives (Γ : Theory) : Formula → Prop where
  /-- Premises are derivable. -/
  | hyp {φ} : Γ φ → HDerives Γ φ
  /-- Axioms are derivable. -/
  | ax {φ} : HAxiom φ → HDerives Γ φ
  /-- Modus ponens: from `φ → ψ` and `φ` infer `ψ`. -/
  | mp {φ ψ} : HDerives Γ (imp φ ψ) → HDerives Γ φ → HDerives Γ ψ
Foundations.Logic.FO.Subst.lift_comp:
/-- Lifting commutes with composition of substitutions. -/
theorem Subst.lift_comp (τ σ : Nat → Term L) :

  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n => exact Term.rename_succ_subst_lift (τ n) σ

Foundations.Types.STLC.HasType.toNf:
/-- **Normal terms are normal proofs.** A normal well-typed term yields a normal
derivation of its type, and a neutral one a neutral derivation. -/
theorem HasType.toNf {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A : Ty} (h : HasType Γ t A) (hn : Normal t) :
    Nf Γ A ∧ (Neutral t → Ne Γ A) := by
  induction h with
  | var hx => exact ⟨.ne (.hyp hx), fun _ => .hyp hx⟩
  | lam _ ih =>
    exact ⟨.impI (ih fun t' h => hn _ (Step.lam h)).1, fun h => h.elim⟩
  | @app Γ t u A B h₁ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    have hneu : Neutral t := neutral_of_arr h₁ (by rintro s rfl; exact hn _ (Step.beta s u))
    have hne := (ih₁ fun t' h => hn _ (Step.appL h)).2 hneu
    have hne' : Ne Γ B := .impE hne (ih₂ fun t' h => hn _ (Step.appR h)).1
    exact ⟨.ne hne', fun _ => hne'⟩
  | pair _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    exact ⟨.andI (ih₁ fun t' h => hn _ (Step.pairL h)).1 (ih₂ fun t' h => hn _ (Step.pairR h)).1,
      fun h => h.elim⟩
  | @fst Γ t A B h ih =>
    have hneu : Neutral t := neutral_of_prod h (by rintro a b rfl; exact hn _ (Step.fstPair a b))
    have hne : Ne Γ A := .andE₁ ((ih fun t' h => hn _ (Step.fst h)).2 hneu)
    exact ⟨.ne hne, fun _ => hne⟩
  | @snd Γ t A B h ih =>
    have hneu : Neutral t := neutral_of_prod h (by rintro a b rfl; exact hn _ (Step.sndPair a b))
    have hne : Ne Γ B := .andE₂ ((ih fun t' h => hn _ (Step.snd h)).2 hneu)
    exact ⟨.ne hne, fun _ => hne⟩
  | inl _ ih => exact ⟨.orI₁ (ih fun t' h => hn _ (Step.inl h)).1, fun h => h.elim⟩
  | inr _ ih => exact ⟨.orI₂ (ih fun t' h => hn _ (Step.inr h)).1, fun h => h.elim⟩
  | @case Γ t u₁ u₂ A B C h _ _ ih ih₁ ih₂ =>
    have hneu : Neutral t := neutral_of_sum h
      (by rintro a rfl; exact hn _ (Step.caseInl a u₁ u₂))
      (by rintro a rfl; exact hn _ (Step.caseInr a u₁ u₂))
    have hne : Ne Γ C := .orE ((ih fun t' h => hn _ (Step.case₀ h)).2 hneu)
      (ih₁ fun t' h => hn _ (Step.case₁ h)).1 (ih₂ fun t' h => hn _ (Step.case₂ h)).1
    exact ⟨.ne hne, fun _ => hne⟩
  | @absurd Γ t C h ih =>
    have hne : Ne Γ C := .botE ((ih fun t' h => hn _ (Step.absurd h)).2 (neutral_of_bot h))
    exact ⟨.ne hne, fun _ => hne⟩

/-- `pshift z₀ p` evaluates to `p(z₀ + w)`. -/
theorem peval_pshift (z₀ : C) (l : List C) (w : C) : peval (pshift z₀ l) w = peval l (z₀ + w) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c l ih =>
    show peval (padd [c] (padd (pscale z₀ (pshift z₀ l)) (0 :: pshift z₀ l))) w = _
    rw [peval_padd, peval_padd, peval_pscale]
    show c + w * 0 + (z₀ * peval (pshift z₀ l) w + (0 + w * peval (pshift z₀ l) w)) =
      c + (z₀ + w) * peval l (z₀ + w)
    rw [ih]; grind

/-- A finite list of formulas: those of depth `≤ n` built from atoms `< n`. As `n`

def allUpTo : Nat → List Formula
  | 0 => [bot]

Foundations.Numbers.R.HasDerivAt.unique:
/-- Derivatives are unique. -/
theorem HasDerivAt.unique {f : R → R} {d₁ d₂ x : R} (h₁ : HasDerivAt f d₁ x)
    (h₂ : HasDerivAt f d₂ x) : d₁ = d₂ := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hne
  have hpos : 0 < abs (d₁ - d₂) := by rcases abs_cases (d₁ - d₂) with h | h <;> grind
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, k₁⟩ := h₁ (abs (d₁ - d₂) / 4) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, k₂⟩ := h₂ (abs (d₁ - d₂) / 4) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₁ hδ₂
  have hy : abs (x + δ / 2 - x) = δ / 2 := by
    rw [show x + δ / 2 - x = δ / 2 by grind]; rcases abs_cases (δ / 2) with h | h <;> grind
  have a1 := k₁ (x + δ / 2) (by grind)
  have a2 := k₂ (x + δ / 2) (by grind)
  rw [hy] at a1 a2
  have a3 := abs_add (f (x + δ / 2) - f x - d₂ * (x + δ / 2 - x))
    (-(f (x + δ / 2) - f x - d₁ * (x + δ / 2 - x)))
  rw [abs_neg, show f (x + δ / 2) - f x - d₂ * (x + δ / 2 - x) +
    -(f (x + δ / 2) - f x - d₁ * (x + δ / 2 - x)) = (d₁ - d₂) * (δ / 2) by grind, abs_mul] at a3
  have : abs (δ / 2) = δ / 2 := by rcases abs_cases (δ / 2) with h | h <;> grind
  rw [this] at a3
  have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
    (by grind : abs (d₁ - d₂) / 4 + abs (d₁ - d₂) / 4 < abs (d₁ - d₂)) (by grind : (0 : R) < δ / 2)
  grind

/-- One bisection step preserves the invariant and halves the interval. -/
theorem step_spec {P : Q → Prop} {p : Q × Q} (h1 : ¬ P p.1) (h2 : P p.2) (h3 : p.1 ≤ p.2) :
    ¬ P (step P p).1 ∧ P (step P p).2 ∧ (step P p).1 ≤ (step P p).2 ∧ p.1 ≤ (step P p).1 ∧
      (step P p).2 ≤ p.2 ∧ ((step P p).2 - (step P p).1) * 2 = p.2 - p.1 := by
  unfold step
  by_cases h : P ((p.1 + p.2) / 2)
  · rw [ite_eq_left h]; exact ⟨h1, h, by grind, by grind, by grind, by grind⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_right h]; exact ⟨h, h2, by grind, by grind, by grind, by grind⟩
Foundations.Logic.Computability.comp_tva:
/-- Tree validity is computable, provided the rules are. -/
theorem comp_tvalid (hstep : CompB fun n => step (fst n) (fst (snd n)) (snd (snd n))) :
    Comp (tvalid step) := by
  have hg : Comp (treeStep step) := by
    unfold treeStep
    refine CompB.and (CompB.and (CompB.step3 hstep
      (Comp.fst (Comp.fst (Comp.fst (Comp.snd Comp.id))))
      (Comp.snd (Comp.fst (Comp.fst (Comp.snd Comp.id))))
      (Comp.fst (Comp.snd (Comp.fst (Comp.snd Comp.id)))))
      (CompB.eq (Comp.llen (Comp.fst (Comp.snd (Comp.fst (Comp.snd Comp.id)))))
        (Comp.llen (Comp.snd (Comp.snd (Comp.fst (Comp.snd Comp.id))))))) ?_
    · refine CompB.ballLt ?_ (Comp.llen (Comp.snd (Comp.snd (Comp.fst (Comp.snd Comp.id)))))
      have ht : Comp fun r => fst (snd (fst r)) := Comp.fst (Comp.snd (Comp.fst Comp.id))
      have hcs : Comp fun r => snd (snd (fst (snd (fst r)))) := Comp.snd (Comp.snd ht)
      have hjs : Comp fun r => fst (snd (fst (snd (fst r)))) := Comp.fst (Comp.snd ht)
      have hc : Comp fun r => lnth (snd (snd (fst (snd (fst r))))) (snd r) :=
        Comp.lnth hcs (Comp.snd Comp.id)
      exact CompB.and (CompB.and (CompB.lt hc ht)
        (CompB.eq (Comp.histGet (Comp.snd (Comp.snd (Comp.fst Comp.id))) ht hc) (Comp.const 1)))
        (CompB.eq (Comp.fst (Comp.fst hc)) (Comp.lnth hjs (Comp.snd Comp.id)))
  have := Comp.comp (Comp.covRec hg) (Comp.pair (Comp.const 0) Comp.id)
  exact Comp.congr this fun n => by simp [Computability.tvalid]

/-- An *equivalence* (bijection with explicit inverse) between two types: a pair of maps
