Foundations.Topology.interval_in_open:
/-- The key step: if open `U`, `V` cover `[a, b]`, are disjoint on it, and `a ∈ U`, then `U`
contains all of `[a, b]`. -/
theorem interval_in_open {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b) {U V : R → Prop} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hV : IsOpen V) (hcov : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → U x ∨ V x)
    (hdis : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → U x → V x → False) (ha : U a) :
    ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → U x := by
  let S : R → Prop := fun x => a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b ∧ ∀ y, a ≤ y → y ≤ x → U y
  have hSa : S a := ⟨Std.le_refl a, hab, fun y h1 h2 => by rw [show y = a by grind]; exact ha⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := exists_lub S ⟨a, hSa⟩ ⟨b, fun x hx => hx.2.1⟩
  have hac : a ≤ c := hc1 a hSa
  have hcb : c ≤ b := hc2 b fun x hx => hx.2.1
  -- Below `c`, everything is in `U`.
  have hbelow : ∀ y, a ≤ y → y < c → U y := fun y hy1 hy2 => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hy
    have := hc2 y fun x hx => by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hxy; exact hy (hx.2.2 y hy1 (by grind))
    grind
  rcases hcov c hac hcb with hcU | hcV
  · obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := hU c hcU
    have hall : ∀ y, a ≤ y → y ≤ c → U y := fun y h1 h2 => by
      rcases (by grind : y < c ∨ y = c) with h | h
      · exact hbelow y h1 h
      · rw [h]; exact hcU
    rcases (by grind : c = b ∨ c < b) with h | h
    · intro x h1 h2; exact hall x h1 (by grind)
    · -- Otherwise `S` would contain a point beyond `c`.
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨c', h1, h2, h3⟩ : ∃ c', c < c' ∧ c' ≤ b ∧ c' ≤ c + ε / 2 := by
        rcases (by grind : c + ε / 2 ≤ b ∨ b < c + ε / 2) with h' | h'
        · exact ⟨c + ε / 2, by grind, h', Std.le_refl _⟩
        · exact ⟨b, h, Std.le_refl b, Std.le_of_lt h'⟩
      have := hc1 c' ⟨by grind, h2, fun y hy1 hy2 => by
        rcases (by grind : y ≤ c ∨ c < y) with h'' | h''
        · exact hall y hy1 h''
        · exact hball y (show abs (c - y) < ε from abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩)⟩
      grind
  · -- `c ∈ V`: points just below `c` would lie in both `U` and `V`.
    exfalso
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := hV c hcV
    have hac' : a < c := by
      rcases (by grind : a = c ∨ a < c) with h | h
      · exact absurd (h ▸ hcV) (fun h' => hdis a (Std.le_refl a) hab ha h')
      · exact h
    obtain ⟨y, h1, h2, h3⟩ : ∃ y, a ≤ y ∧ y < c ∧ c - y < ε := by
      rcases (by grind : a ≤ c - ε / 2 ∨ c - ε / 2 < a) with h' | h'
      · exact ⟨c - ε / 2, h', by grind, by grind⟩
      · exact ⟨a, Std.le_refl a, hac', by grind⟩
    exact hdis y h1 (by grind) (hbelow y h1 h2)
      (hball y (show abs (c - y) < ε from abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩))
Foundations.Logic.FO.D0:
/-- **Bounded (Δ₀) formulas.** -/
inductive D0 : Formula Arith → Prop where
  /-- Equations. -/
  | eq (t s : Term Arith) : D0 (eq t s)
  /-- Inequalities `t ≤ s`. -/
  | le (t s : Term Arith) : D0 (substL [t, s] leF)
  /-- Falsum. -/
  | bot : D0 bot
  /-- Implication. -/
  | imp {φ ψ} : D0 φ → D0 ψ → D0 (imp φ ψ)
  /-- Conjunction. -/
  | conj {φ ψ} : D0 φ → D0 ψ → D0 (conj φ ψ)
  /-- Disjunction. -/
  | disj {φ ψ} : D0 φ → D0 ψ → D0 (disj φ ψ)
  /-- Bounded universal quantifier `∀x ≤ T`. -/
  | ball (T : Term Arith) {φ} : D0 φ → D0 (all (imp (boundF T) φ))
  /-- Strictly bounded universal quantifier `∀x < T`. -/
  | ballS (T : Term Arith) {φ} : D0 φ → D0 (all (imp (boundSF T) φ))
  /-- Bounded existential quantifier `∃x ≤ T`. -/
  | bex (T : Term Arith) {φ} : D0 φ → D0 (ex (conj (boundF T) φ))
Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.exists_fa:
/-- **Existence of factorisations in `F[x]`.** Over a field, every non-zero non-unit
polynomial is a product of irreducible polynomials. -/
theorem exists_factorization (hF : IsField F) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p : Polynomial F), natDegree p = n → p ≠ 0 → ¬ IsUnit p →
      ∃ L : List (Polynomial F), (∀ q, q ∈ L → Irreducible q) ∧ lprod L = p := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro p hpn hp0 hpu
    by_cases hirr : Irreducible p
    · exact ⟨[p], fun q hq => by rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hq]; exact hirr, Ring.mul_one p⟩
    · have : ∃ b c, p = b * c ∧ ¬ IsUnit b ∧ ¬ IsUnit c := by
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hno
        apply hirr
        refine ⟨hp0, hpu, fun b c hbc => ?_⟩
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hbc'
        exact hno ⟨b, c, hbc, fun h => hbc' (Or.inl h), fun h => hbc' (Or.inr h)⟩
      obtain ⟨b, c, rfl, hb, hc⟩ := this
      have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hp0; rw [h, zero_mul]
      have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hp0; rw [h, mul_zero]
      have hdeg := natDegree_mul hF.isDomain hb0 hc0
      have hb1 : natDegree b ≠ 0 := fun h => hb (isUnit_of_natDegree_zero hF hb0 h)
      have hc1 : natDegree c ≠ 0 := fun h => hc (isUnit_of_natDegree_zero hF hc0 h)
      obtain ⟨L1, hL1, hp1⟩ := ih _ (by omega) b rfl hb0 hb
      obtain ⟨L2, hL2, hp2⟩ := ih _ (by omega) c rfl hc0 hc
      refine ⟨L1 ++ L2, fun q hq => ?_, by rw [lprod_append, hp1, hp2]⟩
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hq with h | h
      · exact hL1 q h
      · exact hL2 q h
Foundations.Logic.FO.eval_prec_iff_beta:
/-- Primitive recursion, unfolded with a β-coded sequence of intermediate values. -/
theorem eval_prec_iff_beta (f g : Code) (xs : List Nat) (m y : Nat) :
    Eval (.prec f g) (m :: xs) y ↔ ∃ A B, Eval f xs (gbeta A B 0) ∧
      (∀ j, j < m → Eval g (j :: gbeta A B j :: xs) (gbeta A B (j + 1))) ∧ y = gbeta A B m := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    -- the values of the recursion below `m`
    have hval : ∀ j, j ≤ m → ∃ r, Eval (.prec f g) (j :: xs) r := by
      intro j hj
      induction m generalizing y with
      | zero => rw [Nat.le_zero.1 hj]; exact ⟨y, h⟩
      | succ m ih =>
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj) with hj' | rfl
          · cases h with
            | prec_succ h₁ _ => exact ih _ h₁ (by omega)
          · exact ⟨y, h⟩
    let r : Nat → Nat := fun j => if hj : j ≤ m then Classical.choose (hval j hj) else 0
    have hr : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ m), Eval (.prec f g) (j :: xs) (r j) := fun j hj => by
      simp only [r, hj, dite_true]; exact Classical.choose_spec (hval j hj)
    obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := beta_lemma m r
    refine ⟨A, B, ?_, fun j hj => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hAB 0 (Nat.zero_le _)]
      cases hr 0 (Nat.zero_le _) with
      | prec_zero h' => exact h'
    · rw [hAB j (by omega), hAB (j + 1) hj]
      cases hr (j + 1) hj with
      | prec_succ h₁ h₂ =>
          rw [Eval.det h₁ (hr j (by omega))] at h₂; exact h₂
    · rw [hAB m (Nat.le_refl _)]; exact Eval.det h (hr m (Nat.le_refl _))
  · rintro ⟨A, B, h₀, hs, rfl⟩
    have : ∀ j, j ≤ m → Eval (.prec f g) (j :: xs) (gbeta A B j) := by
      intro j hj
      induction j with
      | zero => exact .prec_zero h₀
      | succ j ih => exact .prec_succ (ih (by omega)) (hs j (by omega))
    exact this m (Nat.le_refl _)

/-- Evaluation of a sum. -/
theorem evalList_add (x : R) (p q : List R) :
    evalList x (PolyList.add p q) = evalList x p + evalList x q := by
  induction p generalizing q with
  | nil => show evalList x q = 0 + _; rw [Ring.zero_add]
  | cons a p ih =>
    cases q with
    | nil => show _ = _ + 0; rw [add_zero]; rfl
    | cons b q =>
      show (a + b) + x * evalList x (PolyList.add p q) = (a + x * evalList x p) + (b + x * evalList x q)
      rw [ih, left_distrib]; ac_rfl

/-- **The functor category** `C ⥤ D`: functors as objects, natural transformations as
arrows. -/
instance functorCategory (C : Type u₁) [Category.{v₁} C] (D : Type u₂) [Category.{v₂} D] :
    Category.{max u₁ v₂} (C ⥤ D) where
  Hom F G := NatTrans F G
  id F := NatTrans.id F
  comp α β := NatTrans.vcomp α β
  id_comp _ := NatTrans.ext fun _ => id_comp _
  comp_id _ := NatTrans.ext fun _ => comp_id _
  assoc _ _ _ := NatTrans.ext fun _ => assoc _ _ _
Foundations.Logic.FO.fcode_inj:
/-- **The numbering of formulas is injective.** -/
theorem fcode_inj : ∀ {φ ψ : Formula Arith}, fcode φ = fcode ψ → φ = ψ := by
  intro φ
  induction φ using Formula.arith_induction with
  | hb => intro ψ h; cases ψ using Formula.arith_cases <;> simp [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at h ⊢
  | he t s =>
      intro ψ h; cases ψ using Formula.arith_cases <;> simp [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at h
      rw [tcode_inj h.1, tcode_inj h.2]
  | hi φ ψ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro χ h; cases χ using Formula.arith_cases <;> simp [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at h
      rw [ih₁ h.1, ih₂ h.2]
  | hc φ ψ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro χ h; cases χ using Formula.arith_cases <;> simp [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at h
      rw [ih₁ h.1, ih₂ h.2]
  | hd φ ψ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro χ h; cases χ using Formula.arith_cases <;> simp [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at h
      rw [ih₁ h.1, ih₂ h.2]
  | ha φ ih =>
      intro χ h; cases χ using Formula.arith_cases <;> simp [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at h
      rw [ih h]
  | hx φ ih =>
      intro χ h; cases χ using Formula.arith_cases <;> simp [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at h
      rw [ih h]
Foundations.Types.STLC.subject_reduction:
/-- **Subject reduction (preservation).** Reduction preserves types. -/
theorem subject_reduction {Γ : Ctx} {t t' : Term} {A : Ty} (h : Step t t') (ht : HasType Γ t A) :
    HasType Γ t' A := by
  induction h generalizing Γ A with
  | beta t u =>
    cases ht with
    | app h₁ h₂ => cases h₁ with
      | lam h₁ => exact h₁.inst h₂
  | fstPair a b => cases ht with
    | fst h => cases h with
      | pair h₁ _ => exact h₁
  | sndPair a b => cases ht with
    | snd h => cases h with
      | pair _ h₂ => exact h₂
  | caseInl t u₁ u₂ => cases ht with
    | case h h₁ _ => cases h with
      | inl h => exact h₁.inst h
  | caseInr t u₁ u₂ => cases ht with
    | case h _ h₂ => cases h with
      | inr h => exact h₂.inst h
  | appL _ ih => cases ht with
    | app h₁ h₂ => exact .app (ih h₁) h₂
  | appR _ ih => cases ht with
    | app h₁ h₂ => exact .app h₁ (ih h₂)
  | lam _ ih => cases ht with
    | lam h => exact .lam (ih h)
  | pairL _ ih => cases ht with
    | pair h₁ h₂ => exact .pair (ih h₁) h₂
  | pairR _ ih => cases ht with
    | pair h₁ h₂ => exact .pair h₁ (ih h₂)
  | fst _ ih => cases ht with
    | fst h => exact .fst (ih h)
  | snd _ ih => cases ht with
    | snd h => exact .snd (ih h)
  | inl _ ih => cases ht with
    | inl h => exact .inl (ih h)
  | inr _ ih => cases ht with
    | inr h => exact .inr (ih h)
  | case₀ _ ih => cases ht with
    | case h h₁ h₂ => exact .case (ih h) h₁ h₂
  | case₁ _ ih => cases ht with
    | case h h₁ h₂ => exact .case h (ih h₁) h₂
  | case₂ _ ih => cases ht with
    | case h h₁ h₂ => exact .case h h₁ (ih h₂)
  | absurd _ ih => cases ht with
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (ih h)

/-- Imaginary part of `w / r` for a real `r > 0`. -/
theorem div_natCast_im (w : C) {m : Nat} (hm : 0 < m) : (w / (m : C)).im = w.im / (m : R) := by
  have hpos : (0 : R) < (m : R) := OrderedRing.pos_natCast_of_pos _ hm

  rw [mul_im, inv_re, inv_im]

Foundations.Logic.Ordinals.ord:
/-- **The hereditary base-`(c+2)` representation** of `n`, as an ordinal notation:
`n = b^e + r` with `e = lg n` becomes `ω^{ord e} + ord r` — the base `b` is replaced by
`ω` throughout. -/
def ord (c n : Nat) : ON :=
  if h : n = 0 then .zero
  else .oadd (ord c (lg (c + 2) n)) (ord c (n - (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n))
termination_by n
decreasing_by
  · exact lg_lt (by omega) h
  · have := Nat.pow_pos (n := lg (c + 2) n) (show 0 < c + 2 by omega); omega

/-- Left distributivity. -/

  induction p with
  | nil => intro n; simp [mul, add_zero]
  | cons a p ih =>
    intro n
    rw [coeff_add, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_add, left_distrib]
    cases n with
    | zero => simp only [coeff_cons_zero, add_zero] <;> ac_rfl
    | succ k => simp only [coeff_cons_succ]; rw [ih k, coeff_add]; ac_rfl

/-- **Pythagoras' identity.** `sin² x + cos² x = 1`. -/
theorem sin_sq_add_cos_sq (x : R) : sin x * sin x + cos x * cos x = 1 := by
  have hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun t => sin t * sin t + cos t * cos t)
      (cos t * sin t + sin t * cos t + (-sin t * cos t + cos t * -sin t)) t := fun t =>
    ((hasDerivAt_sin t).mul (hasDerivAt_sin t)).add ((hasDerivAt_cos t).mul (hasDerivAt_cos t))
  have := const_of_deriv_zero' hd (fun t => by grind) x 0
  rw [sin_zero, cos_zero] at this
  grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.provable_nonHalts_c:
/-- **Provability of non-halting is computably enumerable.** Some code halts on
`(⌜c⌝, x)` exactly when PA proves the sentence "`c` does not halt on `x`". -/
theorem provable_nonHalts_ce :
    ∃ q : Code, ∀ (c : Code) (x : Nat), Halts q [encode c, x] ↔ PA ⊢₁ nonHaltsF c x := by
  obtain ⟨cPA, hPA⟩ := PA_theorems_ce
  obtain ⟨cg, hcg⟩ := gcode_comp
  let cG : Code := .comp cg (vec1 (pairOf (.proj 0) (.proj 1)))
  have hG : ∀ e x, Eval cG [e, x] (gcode e x) := fun e x => by
    have := eval_comp1 (eval_pairOf (xs := [e, x]) (.proj (i := 0)) (.proj (i := 1))) (hcg (pair e x))
    simpa using this
  refine ⟨.comp cPA (vec1 cG), fun c x => ?_⟩
  rw [← hPA, ← gcode_spec]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hc⟩ := eval_comp1_inv hm
    rw [Eval.det hv (hG _ _)] at hc
    exact ⟨m, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    exact ⟨m, eval_comp1 (hG _ _) hm⟩

/-- **Limit of a constant multiple.** -/
theorem Tendsto.const_mul (c : R) {a : Nat → R} {L : R} (ha : Tendsto a L) :
    Tendsto (fun n => c * a n) (c * L) := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηc⟩ := exists_mul_le c (by grind : 0 < ε / 2)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ha η hη
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [show c * a n - c * L = c * (a n - L) by grind, abs_mul]
  have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt (hN n hn)) (abs_nonneg c)
  grind

Foundations.Algebra.derivedSeries_surj:
/-- **Homomorphic images of the derived series.** If `f : G →* H` is surjective, every element of
the `k`-th derived subgroup of `H` is the image of an element of the `k`-th derived subgroup of
`G`. -/
theorem derivedSeries_surj {G : Type u} {H : Type v} [Group G] [Group H] (f : G →* H)
    (surj : ∀ y, ∃ x, f x = y) :
    ∀ k y, y ∈ derivedSeries H k → ∃ x, x ∈ derivedSeries G k ∧ f x = y := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro y _; obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := surj y; exact ⟨x, trivial, hx⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro y hy
    induction hy with
    | of h =>
      obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := ih a ha
      obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ := ih b hb
      refine ⟨commutator a' b', Closure.of ⟨a', b', ha', hb', rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      unfold commutator
      rw [f.map_mul', f.map_mul', f.map_mul', f.map_inv, f.map_inv]
    | one => exact ⟨1, Closure.one, f.map_one⟩
    | mul _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
      obtain ⟨x1, hx1, rfl⟩ := ih1
      obtain ⟨x2, hx2, rfl⟩ := ih2
      exact ⟨x1 * x2, Closure.mul hx1 hx2, f.map_mul' x1 x2⟩
    | inv _ ih1 =>
      obtain ⟨x1, hx1, rfl⟩ := ih1
      exact ⟨x1⁻¹, Closure.inv hx1, f.map_inv x1⟩

Foundations.Topology.Outer.outer_interva:
/-- **The outer measure of an interval is its length**: `m*([a, b]) = b − a`. -/
theorem outer_interval {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b) : outer (fun x => a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b) = b - a := by
  have hex : ∃ s, CoverSum (fun x => a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b) s := ⟨_, coverSum_le a b (ε := 1) (by grind) hab⟩
  unfold outer
  rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true hex)]
  obtain ⟨h4, h5⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (exists_lub _ (outer_ne hex) (outer_bdd _))
  generalize Classical.choose (exists_lub _ (outer_ne hex) (outer_bdd _)) = L at h4 h5
  -- `a − b` is an upper bound of `{−s}`, and nothing smaller is.
  have up : L ≤ a - b := h5 _ fun t ht => by have := coverSum_ge hab ht; grind
  have low : a - b ≤ L := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hlt
    have := h4 (-(b - a + (a - b - L) / 2)) (by
      rw [show - -(b - a + (a - b - L) / 2) = b - a + (a - b - L) / 2 by grind]
      exact coverSum_le a b (by grind) hab)
    grind
  grind

Foundations.Topology.Ascoli.tri_index:
/-- The index `k` of the pair `tri k = (n, m)` is at most `n² + m`. -/
theorem tri_index (k : Nat) : k ≤ (Vitali.tri k).1 * (Vitali.tri k).1 + (Vitali.tri k).2 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact Nat.le_refl 0
  | succ k ih =>
    have hle := Vitali.tri_le k
    show k + 1 ≤ (if (Vitali.tri k).2 < (Vitali.tri k).1 then ((Vitali.tri k).1, (Vitali.tri k).2 + 1)
      else ((Vitali.tri k).1 + 1, 0)).1 * (if (Vitali.tri k).2 < (Vitali.tri k).1 then
      ((Vitali.tri k).1, (Vitali.tri k).2 + 1) else ((Vitali.tri k).1 + 1, 0)).1 +
      (if (Vitali.tri k).2 < (Vitali.tri k).1 then ((Vitali.tri k).1, (Vitali.tri k).2 + 1)
      else ((Vitali.tri k).1 + 1, 0)).2
    generalize (Vitali.tri k).1 = n at ih hle ⊢
    generalize (Vitali.tri k).2 = m at ih hle ⊢
    split
    · simp only; omega
    · simp only
      have : m = n := by omega
      subst this
      have : (m + 1) * (m + 1) = m * m + 2 * m + 1 := by
        rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add]; omega
      omega

theorem peval_padd (l m : List C) (z : C) : peval (padd l m) z = peval l z + peval m z := by
  induction l generalizing m with
  | nil => show peval m z = 0 + peval m z; grind
  | cons a l ih =>
    cases m with
    | nil => show peval (a :: l) z = peval (a :: l) z + 0; grind

Foundations.Logic.FO.Theory.pullback_shi:
/-- A finite list of members of a shifted theory comes from a finite list of members
of the original theory. -/
theorem pullback_shift {Γ : Theory L} : ∀ l : List (Formula L), (∀ ψ ∈ l, shift Γ ψ) →
    ∃ l' : List (Formula L), (∀ χ ∈ l', Γ χ) ∧ (ofList l).Subset (shift (ofList l'))
  | [], _ => ⟨[], by simp, fun _ h => by simp [ofList] at h⟩
  | ψ :: l, h => by
      obtain ⟨χ, hχ, rfl⟩ := h ψ (by simp)
      obtain ⟨l', hl', hsub⟩ := pullback_shift l (fun ψ hψ => h ψ (by simp [hψ]))
      refine ⟨χ :: l', fun θ hθ => ?_, fun θ hθ => ?_⟩
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hθ with rfl | hθ
        · exact hχ
        · exact hl' θ hθ
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hθ with rfl | hθ
        · exact ⟨χ, by simp [ofList], rfl⟩
        · obtain ⟨θ', h₁, h₂⟩ := hsub θ hθ
          exact ⟨θ', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h₁, h₂⟩

  have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg z.re) (abs_nonneg z.im)

  have e2 : abs z.im * abs z.im = z.im * z.im := by rw [← abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (mul_self_nonneg _)]
  grind

Foundations.Numbers.Q.not_complete:
/-- **ℚ is not complete.** The set `{q ∈ ℚ | q² < 2}` is nonempty (it contains `1`) and bounded
above (by `2`), but it has no least upper bound in `ℚ`. -/
theorem not_complete :
    (∃ q : Q, q * q < 2) ∧ (∃ M : Q, ∀ q : Q, q * q < 2 → q ≤ M) ∧
    ¬ ∃ s : Q, (∀ q : Q, q * q < 2 → q ≤ s) ∧ ∀ M : Q, (∀ q : Q, q * q < 2 → q ≤ M) → s ≤ M := by
  refine ⟨⟨1, by grind⟩, ⟨2, fun q hq => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro h
    have h2 : (2 : Q) < q := by grind
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Q.le_of_lt' h2) (by grind : (0 : Q) ≤ q)
    grind
  rintro ⟨s, hs1, hs2⟩
  have h1 : 1 ≤ s := hs1 1 (by grind)
  have hss : s * 1 ≤ s * s := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by grind)
  have hne : s * s ≠ 2 := fun h => sqrt_two_irrational ⟨s, h⟩
  rcases (by grind : s * s < 2 ∨ 2 < s * s) with hlt | hgt
  · -- `s` is too small: `s + h` is still in the set, for a suitable `h > 0`.
    let h := (2 - s * s) / (2 * s + 2)
    have hpos : 0 < h := div_pos (by grind) (by grind)
    have e : h * (2 * s + 2) = 2 - s * s := by grind
    have hle1 : h ≤ 1 := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction
      intro hc
      have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : Q) < h - 1) (by grind : (0 : Q) < 2 * s + 2)
      grind
    have hh : h * h ≤ h * 1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle1 (Q.le_of_lt' hpos)
    have := hs1 (s + h) (by grind)
    grind
  · -- `s` is too big: `s − h` is still an upper bound, for a suitable `h > 0`.
    let h := (s * s - 2) / (2 * s)
    have hpos : 0 < h := div_pos (by grind) (by grind)
    have e : h * (2 * s) = s * s - 2 := by grind
    have ht : 0 < s - h := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction
      intro hc
      have := OrderedRing.mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by grind : s - h ≤ 0)
        (by grind : (0 : Q) ≤ 2 * s)
      grind
    have hh : 0 ≤ h * h := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (Q.le_of_lt' hpos) (Q.le_of_lt' hpos)
    have hub : ∀ q : Q, q * q < 2 → q ≤ s - h := by
      intro q hq
      apply Classical.byContradiction
      intro hc
      have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : Q) < q - (s - h)) (by grind : (0 : Q) < q + (s - h))
      grind
    have := hs2 (s - h) hub
    grind

Foundations.Algebra.c3_eq_commutator:
/-- **Every 3-cycle is a commutator of 3-cycles**: for distinct `a, b, c, d, e`,
`(a b c) = [(a b d), (a c e)]`. -/
theorem c3_eq_commutator {n : Nat} {a b c d e : Fin n}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (had : a ≠ d) (hae : a ≠ e) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hbd : b ≠ d)
    (hbe : b ≠ e) (hcd : c ≠ d) (hce : c ≠ e) (hde : d ≠ e) :
    c3 a b c = commutator (c3 a b d) (c3 a c e) := by
  unfold commutator
  rw [c3_inv hab hbd had, c3_inv hac hce hae]
  apply ext; intro x
  simp only [mul_apply, c3_apply hab hbc hac, c3_apply hab hbd had, c3_apply hac hce hae,
    c3_apply had (Ne.symm hbd) hab, c3_apply hae (Ne.symm hce) hac]
  have := Ne.symm hab; have := Ne.symm hac; have := Ne.symm had; have := Ne.symm hae
  have := Ne.symm hbc; have := Ne.symm hbd; have := Ne.symm hbe; have := Ne.symm hcd
  have := Ne.symm hce; have := Ne.symm hde
  by_cases h1 : x = a
  · subst h1; simp [*]
  · by_cases h2 : x = b
    · subst h2; simp [*]
    · by_cases h3 : x = c
      · subst h3; simp [*]
      · by_cases h4 : x = d
        · subst h4; simp [*]
        · by_cases h5 : x = e
          · subst h5; simp [*]
          · simp [*]

Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.mem_hartogs_of_in:
/-- An ordinal `o` that injects into `α` lies in `ℵ(α)`: copy the order of `o` onto
a part of `α`; the order type of the copy is `o` again. -/
theorem mem_hartogs_of_injective {o : ZFSet} (ho : IsOrdinal o) {j : {z // z ∈ o} → α}
    (hj : Function.Injective j) : o ∈ hartogs α := by
  -- the copied order
  let W : WFRel α :=
    { dom := fun x => ∃ z, j z = x
      R := fun x y => ∃ z w, j z = x ∧ j w = y ∧ z.1 ∈ w.1
      lives := fun x y ⟨z, w, hz, hw, _⟩ => ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, ⟨w, hw⟩⟩
      trans := fun x y u ⟨z, w, hz, hw, hzw⟩ ⟨w', v, hw', hv, hwv⟩ => by
        have : w = w' := hj (hw.trans hw'.symm)
        subst this
        exact ⟨z, v, hz, hv, (ho.mem v.2).mem_trans hzw hwv⟩
      wf := by
        have key : ∀ z : ZFSet, ∀ hz : z ∈ o,
            Acc (fun x y => ∃ z w, j z = x ∧ j w = y ∧ z.1 ∈ w.1) (j ⟨z, hz⟩) := by
          refine mem_induction _ (fun z ih hz => ⟨_, fun y ⟨z', w, hz', hw, hzw⟩ => ?_⟩)
          have : w = ⟨z, hz⟩ := hj hw
          subst this
          subst hz'
          exact ih z'.1 hzw z'.2
        refine ⟨fun x => ⟨_, fun y ⟨z', w, hz', hw, _⟩ => ?_⟩⟩
        subst hz'
        exact key z'.1 z'.2 }
  -- the rank of the copy of `z` is `z`
  have hrank : ∀ z : ZFSet, ∀ hz : z ∈ o, rank W.R W.wf (j ⟨z, hz⟩) = z := by
    refine mem_induction _ (fun z ih hz => ext fun u => ?_)
    rw [mem_rank]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, ⟨z', w, rfl, hw, hzw⟩, rfl⟩
      have : w = ⟨z, hz⟩ := hj hw
      subst this
      rw [ih z'.1 hzw z'.2]
      exact hzw
    · intro hu
      have hu' : u ∈ o := ho.1 z hz hu
      exact ⟨j ⟨u, hu'⟩, ⟨⟨u, hu'⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩, rfl, rfl, hu⟩, (ih u hu hu').symm⟩
  have hot : W.otype = o := by
    apply ext
    intro u
    rw [WFRel.mem_otype]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ⟨z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [hrank z.1 z.2]
      exact z.2
    · intro hu
      exact ⟨j ⟨u, hu⟩, ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, rfl⟩, (hrank u hu).symm⟩
  exact mem_ofFamily.2 ⟨W, hot.symm⟩

Foundations.Logic.FO.lob:
/-- **Löb's theorem** (abstract form: the derivability conditions are hypotheses; the
diagonal lemma is our theorem for `Q`). If `T ⊇ Q` satisfies (D1)–(D3) for `P`, and
`T ⊢ □φ → φ`, then `T ⊢ φ`. -/
theorem lob {T : Theory Arith} (hQ : ∀ ψ, Q ψ → T ⊢₁ ψ) {P : Formula Arith}
    (hD : Derivability T P) {φ : Formula Arith} (h : T ⊢₁ imp (box P φ) φ) : T ⊢₁ φ := by
  -- the diagonal sentence `δ ↔ (□δ → φ)`
  let δ := diagSentence (imp P φ.shift)
  have hd : T ⊢₁ iffF δ (imp (box P δ) φ) := by
    have := proves_of_Q_proves hQ (diagonal_lemma (imp P φ.shift))
    rwa [inst_imp, shift_inst] at this
  have h₁ : T ⊢₁ imp δ (imp (box P δ) φ) := Proves.conjE₁ hd
  have h₂ := hD.d1 _ h₁
  have h₃ : T ⊢₁ imp (box P δ) (box P (imp (box P δ) φ)) := Proves.impE (hD.d2 _ _) h₂
  have h₅ := imp_trans h₃ (hD.d2 (box P δ) φ)
  have h₇ : T ⊢₁ imp (box P δ) (box P φ) := imp_S h₅ (hD.d3 δ)
  have h₈ : T ⊢₁ imp (box P δ) φ := imp_trans h₇ h
  have h₉ : T ⊢₁ δ := Proves.impE (Proves.conjE₂ hd) h₈
  exact Proves.impE h₈ (hD.d1 _ h₉)

/-- Order on the rationals is compatible with addition: `x ≤ y ↔ x + z ≤ y + z`. -/
theorem add_le_add_iff {x y : Q} (z : Q) : x ≤ y ↔ x + z ≤ y + z := by
  induction x using ind with | h a b hb => ?_
  induction y using ind with | h c d hd => ?_
  induction z using ind with | h e f hf => ?_
  simp only [mk_add, mk_le]
  rw [← int_le_cancel_pos (k := f * f) (Int.mul_pos hf hf)]
  have e1 : (a * f + e * b) * (d * f) = a * d * (f * f) + e * b * d * f := by grind
  have e2 : (c * f + e * d) * (b * f) = c * b * (f * f) + e * b * d * f := by grind
  rw [e1, e2]; omega

  | impI {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : Nf (A :: Γ) B → Nf Γ (.arr A B)
  | andI {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : Nf Γ A → Nf Γ B → Nf Γ (.prod A B)
  | orI₁ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : Nf Γ A → Nf Γ (.sum A B)
  | orI₂ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : Nf Γ B → Nf Γ (.sum A B)

Foundations.Logic.FO.grb:
/-- **Bounded graph formula** of code `c` at arity `a`: free variable `0` is the output,
`1, …, a` the inputs, and `a + 1` the bound `w` on all quantifiers. -/
def grb : Code → Nat → Formula Arith
  | .zero, _ => eq (v 0) zero
  | .succ, a => eq (v 0) (succ (if a = 0 then zero else v 1))
  | .proj i, a => eq (v 0) (if i < a then v (i + 1) else zero)
  | @Code.comp k f gs, a =>
      bexN k (a + 1) (conj
        (conjL (List.ofFn fun i : Fin k =>
          (grb (gs i) a).subst (Env.cons (v i) fun j => v (j + 1 + k))))
        ((grb f k).subst (Env.cons (v k) fun j => v (if j < k then j else a + 1 + k))))
  | .prec _ _, 0 => bot
  | .prec f g, a + 1 =>
      -- `∃A ≤ w ∃B ≤ w`; then B = v 0, A = v 1, y = v 2, m = v 3, rest = v 4 …, w = v (a + 4)
      ex (conj (boundF (v (a + 2))) (ex (conj (boundF (v (a + 3))) (conj (conj
        -- `∃r ≤ w (r = β(A, B, 0) ∧ f(rest) = r)`
        (ex (conj (boundF (v (a + 4))) (conj (substL [v 0, v 2, v 1, zero] betaB)
          ((grb f a).subst (Env.cons (v 0) fun j => v (j + 5))))))
        -- `∀j < m ∃u ≤ w ∃z ≤ w (u = β(A,B,j) ∧ z = β(A,B,j+1) ∧ g(j, u, rest) = z)`
        (all (imp (boundSF (v 3))
          (ex (conj (boundF (v (a + 5))) (ex (conj (boundF (v (a + 6)))
            (conj (conj (substL [v 1, v 4, v 3, v 2] betaB)
                (substL [v 0, v 4, v 3, succ (v 2)] betaB))
              ((grb g (a + 2)).subst (Env.cons (v 0) fun j => v (precIdx j)))))))))))
        -- `y = β(A, B, m)`
        (substL [v 2, v 1, v 0, v 3] betaB)))))
  | .mu f, a =>
      conj ((grb f (a + 1)).subst (Env.cons zero (Env.cons (v 0) fun j => v (j + 1))))
        (all (imp (boundSF (v 0))
          (ex (conj (boundF (v (a + 2)))
            (conj ((grb f (a + 1)).subst (Env.cons (v 0) (Env.cons (v 1) fun j => v (j + 3))))
              (neg (eq (v 0) zero)))))))

Foundations.Geometry.nat_sq_ne_three_sq:
/-- No natural number squared is three times a positive square (infinite descent). -/
theorem nat_sq_ne_three_sq : ∀ b : Nat, 0 < b → ∀ a : Nat, a * a ≠ 3 * (b * b) := by
  intro b
  induction b using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ b ih =>
    intro hb a h
    obtain ⟨c, hc | hc | hc⟩ : ∃ c, a = 3 * c ∨ a = 3 * c + 1 ∨ a = 3 * c + 2 := ⟨a / 3, by omega⟩
    · subst hc
      have h' : b * b = 3 * (c * c) := by grind
      obtain ⟨e, he | he | he⟩ : ∃ e, b = 3 * e ∨ b = 3 * e + 1 ∨ b = 3 * e + 2 :=
        ⟨b / 3, by omega⟩
      · subst he
        exact ih e (by omega) (by omega) c (by grind)
      · subst he; grind
      · subst he; grind
    · subst hc; grind
    · subst hc; grind

/-- In a finite field, some positive multiple of `1` is `0`. -/
theorem exists_ncast_eq_zero : ∃ p, 0 < p ∧ (ncast p : F) = 0 := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hno
  have hinj : ∀ i j : Nat, (ncast i : F) = ncast j → i = j := by
    intro i j h
    rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy i j with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exfalso; apply hno; refine ⟨j - i, by omega, ?_⟩
      have e := ncast_add (R := F) i (j - i)
      rw [show i + (j - i) = j by omega, ← h] at e
      grind
    · exact heq
    · exfalso; apply hno; refine ⟨i - j, by omega, ?_⟩
      have e := ncast_add (R := F) j (i - j)
      rw [show j + (i - j) = i by omega, h] at e
      grind
  have hnd := nodup_map_of_injective hinj (List.nodup_range (n := card F + 1))
  have := length_le_card hnd
  rw [List.length_map, List.length_range] at this
  omega

/-- **Trisecting the angle is impossible** (Wantzel, 1837). The number `cos 20°` satisfies
`8x³ = 6x + 1` (from `cos 60° = 1/2` and `cos 3θ = 4cos³θ - 3cos θ`), and no root of this
equation is constructible. Hence the angle of `60°` cannot be trisected with straightedge and
compass. -/
theorem trisecting_the_angle_impossible {γ : Ω}
    (h : ((8 : Int) : Ω) * (γ * γ * γ) = ((6 : Int) : Ω) * γ + 1) :
    ¬ Constructible hΩ hc γ := by
  apply not_constructible_of_cubic hΩ hc
  exact {
    d := ((8 : Int) : Ω), a := 0, b := ((-6 : Int) : Ω), c := ((-1 : Int) : Ω)
    hd := intCast_mem_ratField hΩ hc 8
    ha := (ratField hΩ hc).zero_mem
    hb := intCast_mem_ratField hΩ hc (-6)
    hc := intCast_mem_ratField hΩ hc (-1)

Foundations.Probability.FinProb.ind_part:
/-- The indicator of an event is the sum of its pieces along a partition. -/
theorem ind_partition {B : Nat → Event α} {n : Nat} (A : Event α) (x : α)
    (hx : (∃ i, i < n ∧ B i x) ∧ ∀ i j, i < n → j < n → B i x → B j x → i = j) :
    ind A x = sumN n fun i => ind (fun y => A y ∧ B i y) x := by
  obtain ⟨⟨i₀, hi₀, hB₀⟩, huniq⟩ := hx
  -- split the range at `i₀`
  have key : ∀ m, m ≤ n → sumL (List.range m) (fun i => ind (fun y => A y ∧ B i y) x) =
      if i₀ < m then ind A x else 0 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro _; simp
    | succ m ih =>
        intro hmn
        rw [List.range_succ, sumL_append, ih (by omega)]
        simp only [sumL_cons, sumL_nil]
        by_cases hm : m = i₀
        · subst hm
          simp only [Nat.lt_irrefl, ite_false, Nat.lt_succ_self, ite_true, ind_and,
            show ind (B m) x = 1 by simp [ind, hB₀]]
          grind
        · have hBm : ind (fun y => A y ∧ B m y) x = 0 := by
            have hn : ¬ (A x ∧ B m x) := fun h => absurd (huniq m i₀ (by omega) hi₀ h.2 hB₀) hm
            rcases ind_cases (fun y => A y ∧ B m y) x with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩
            · exact absurd h hn
            · exact h
          rw [hBm]
          by_cases h : i₀ < m
          · simp [h, show i₀ < m + 1 by omega]; grind
          · simp [h, show ¬ i₀ < m + 1 by omega]; grind
  rw [sumN, key n (Nat.le_refl _)]; simp [hi₀]

Foundations.Numbers.Cut:
/-- **Dedekind cuts.** A cut is given by its lower part: a nonempty, bounded-above, downward
closed set of rationals with no greatest element. -/
structure Cut where
  /-- The lower part of the cut. -/
  lower : Q → Prop
  /-- Some rational is in the lower part. -/
  nonempty : ∃ q, lower q
  /-- Some rational is not in the lower part. -/
  bounded : ∃ q, ¬ lower q
  /-- The lower part is closed downwards. -/

/-- `g ^ k = 1` exactly when the order of `g` divides `k`. -/
theorem pow_eq_one_iff_dvd (g : G) (k : Nat) : g ^ k = 1 ↔ orderOf g ∣ k := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [pow_mod_orderOf] at h
    apply Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hne
    exact pow_ne_one_of_lt_orderOf g (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne)
      (Nat.mod_lt _ (orderOf_pos g)) h

    rw [hc, pow_mul, pow_orderOf, one_pow]

Foundations.Geometry.Klein.quad_root:
/-- `σ = (r − B)/(2A)` with `r² = B² + 4AC` solves `Aσ² + Bσ − C = 0`. -/
theorem quad_root {A B C r σ : R} (hA : A ≠ 0) (hr : r * r = B * B + 4 * A * C)
    (hσ : (r - B) / (2 * A) = σ) : A * (σ * σ) + B * σ - C = 0 := by
  have h2A : 2 * A ≠ 0 := by grind
  have h2 : 2 * A * σ = r - B := by rw [← hσ]; grind
  have hsq : (2 * A * σ) * (2 * A * σ) = (r - B) * (r - B) := by rw [h2]
  have hB2 : B * (2 * A * σ) = B * (r - B) := by rw [h2]
  have h4 : 4 * A * (A * (σ * σ) + B * σ - C) = 0 := by grind
  have h4' : 4 * A ≠ 0 := by grind
  grind

/-- **Variance of a sum**: `Var(X + Y) = Var X + Var Y + 2 Cov(X, Y)`. -/
theorem Var_add (X Y : α → R) : P.Var (fun x => X x + Y x) = P.Var X + P.Var Y + 2 * P.Cov X Y := by
  rw [Var_eq, Var_eq, Var_eq, Cov, E_add]
  have : (fun x => (X x + Y x) * (X x + Y x)) =

  | k + 1 => by
      simp only [shiftNC, natRec, snd_pair] at *

Foundations.Sets.koenig_surj:
/-- **Kőnig's theorem, surjection form** (no choice of values is needed beyond one per
coordinate). If no `κ i` maps onto `μ i`, then the sum `Σ i, κ i` does not map onto
the product `Π i, μ i`. -/
theorem koenig_surj {ι : Type u} {κ μ : ι → Type v}
    (h : ∀ i, ¬ ∃ f : κ i → μ i, Function.Surjective f) :
    ¬ ∃ F : (Σ i, κ i) → (∀ i, μ i), Function.Surjective F := by
  rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
  -- at each coordinate, a value missed by all functions from the `i`-th summand
  have miss : ∀ i, ∃ y : μ i, ∀ x : κ i, F ⟨i, x⟩ i ≠ y := fun i =>
    Classical.byContradiction fun hn => h i ⟨fun x => F ⟨i, x⟩ i, fun y =>
      Classical.byContradiction fun hy => hn ⟨y, fun x hx => hy ⟨x, hx⟩⟩⟩
  let d : ∀ i, μ i := fun i => Classical.choose (miss i)
  obtain ⟨⟨i, x⟩, hx⟩ := hF d
  exact Classical.choose_spec (miss i) x (congrFun hx i)

Foundations.Sets.WellOrdering.PWO.append:
/-- Append a new element `a` on top of a partial well-ordering not containing it. -/
def PWO.append (M : PWO α) (a : α) (ha : ¬ M.dom a) : PWO α where
  dom := fun x => M.dom x ∨ x = a
  lt := fun x y => M.lt x y ∨ (M.dom x ∧ y = a)
  lt_dom := by
    rintro x y (h | ⟨hx, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨Or.inl (M.lt_dom x y h).1, Or.inl (M.lt_dom x y h).2⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inl hx, Or.inr rfl⟩
  irrefl := by
    rintro x (h | ⟨hx, rfl⟩)
    · exact M.irrefl x h
    · exact ha hx
  trans := by
    rintro x y z (hxy | ⟨hx, rfl⟩) (hyz | ⟨hy, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (M.trans x y z hxy hyz)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨(M.lt_dom x y hxy).1, rfl⟩
    · exact absurd (M.lt_dom _ z hyz).1 ha
    · exact absurd hy ha
  total := by
    rintro x y (hx | rfl) (hy | rfl)
    · rcases M.total x y hx hy with h | h | h
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨hx, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hy, rfl⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
  wf := by
    intro S hS
    by_cases hM : ∃ x, S x ∧ M.dom x
    · obtain ⟨m, hSm, hm, hmin⟩ := M.wf S hM
      refine ⟨m, hSm, Or.inl hm, fun y hSy _ hym => ?_⟩
      rcases hym with h | ⟨_, rfl⟩
      · exact hmin y hSy (M.lt_dom y m h).1 h
      · exact ha hm
    · obtain ⟨x, hSx, hx⟩ := hS
      have hxa : x = a := hx.resolve_left fun h => hM ⟨x, hSx, h⟩
      subst hxa
      refine ⟨x, hSx, Or.inr rfl, fun y hSy _ hyx => ?_⟩
      rcases hyx with h | ⟨hy, _⟩
      · exact ha (M.lt_dom y x h).2
      · exact hM ⟨y, hSy, hy⟩

Foundations.Numbers.C.cis_pow:
/-- **De Moivre's formula.** `(cos θ + i sin θ)ᵏ = cos kθ + i sin kθ`. -/
theorem cis_pow (θ : R) (k : Nat) : cis θ ^ k = cis ((k : R) * θ) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    show (1 : C) = cis (((0 : Nat) : R) * θ)
    rw [show ((0 : Nat) : R) * θ = 0 by grind]
    apply ext
    · show (1 : R) = cos 0; rw [cos_zero]
    · show (0 : R) = sin 0; rw [sin_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    show cis θ ^ k * cis θ = _
    rw [ih, cis_add]; congr 1; grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_telescoping:
/-- Moving the tags of any tagged partition to mean value points makes the Riemann sum of `F'`
telescope to exactly `F b − F a`; the partition points (hence the mesh) are unchanged. -/
theorem exists_telescoping_tags {F f : R → R} {b : R} :
    ∀ (l : List (R × R)) (a : R), IsTagged a l b →
      (∀ t, a ≤ t → t ≤ b → HasDerivAt F (f t) t) →
      ∃ l', IsTagged a l' b ∧ (∀ δ, MeshLt δ a l → MeshLt δ a l') ∧ rsum f a l' = F b - F a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro a hl _
    have : a = b := hl; subst this
    exact ⟨[], rfl, fun _ _ => trivial, by show (0 : R) = F a - F a; grind⟩
  | cons p l ih =>
    intro a hl hd
    obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hl
    have hxb := h3.le
    obtain ⟨l'', k1, k2, k3⟩ := ih x h3 fun s hs1 hs2 => hd s (by grind) hs2
    obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := exists_mvt_point (F := F) (f := f) (Std.le_trans h1 h2)
      fun s hs1 hs2 => hd s hs1 (by grind)
    refine ⟨(c, x) :: l'', ⟨hc1, hc2, k1⟩, fun δ hm => ⟨hm.1, k2 δ hm.2⟩, ?_⟩
    show f c * (x - a) + rsum f x l'' = F b - F a
    rw [k3]; grind

/-- The alternating sums `F⁽ⁱ⁾ = Σ_{j ≤ n} (−1)ʲ f⁽²ʲ⁺ⁱ⁾`; `F = nivenF 0`, `F' = nivenF 1`,
`F'' = nivenF 2`. -/

  toFun := eval x
  map_add a b := by
    induction a using Quotient.ind; induction b using Quotient.ind
    exact evalList_add x _ _
  map_mul a b := by

def curryAdjunction (A : Type u) : Adjunction (prodFunctor A) (expFunctor A) where
  homEquiv _ _ :=
    { toFun := fun f x a => f (x, a)

/-- Distinct first digits separate the points: one lies in `[0, 1/3]`, the other in `[2/3, 1]`. -/
theorem val_ne_of_head {b b' : Nat → Bool} (hne : b 0 ≠ b' 0) : val b ≠ val b' := by
  intro he
  have h := three_val b; have h' := three_val b'
  have m := val_mem (fun k => b (k + 1)); have m' := val_mem (fun k => b' (k + 1))
  cases hb : b 0 <;> cases hb' : b' 0 <;> rw [hb] at h hne <;> rw [hb'] at h' hne
  · exact hne rfl
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true] at h h'; grind
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true] at h h'; grind

/-- Multiplication respects equivalence in the left factor. -/
theorem mul_congr_left {p p' : List R} (h : Eqv p p') (q : List R) : Eqv (mul p q) (mul p' q) := by
  induction p generalizing p' with
  | nil =>
    intro n
    rw [coeff_mul_of_eqv_nil (fun k => (h k).symm)]; rfl
  | cons a p ih =>
    cases p' with
    | nil => intro n; rw [coeff_mul_of_eqv_nil h]; rfl

      intro n

      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k => simp only [coeff_cons_succ]; rw [ih hp k]

Foundations.Numbers.R.HasIntegral.unique:
/-- **Uniqueness of the integral** (for `a ≤ b`). -/
theorem HasIntegral.unique {f : R → R} {a b I J : R} (hab : a ≤ b) (hI : HasIntegral f a b I)
    (hJ : HasIntegral f a b J) : I = J := by
  apply eq_of_abs_lt_all
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hI.2 (ε / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h₂⟩ := hJ.2 (ε / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₁ hδ₂
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hm⟩ := exists_tagged hab hδ
  have k1 := h₁ l hl (hm.mono hδ1)
  have k2 := h₂ l hl (hm.mono hδ2)
  rw [abs_sub_comm] at k1
  have k3 := abs_add (I - rsum f a l) (rsum f a l - J)
  rw [show I - rsum f a l + (rsum f a l - J) = I - J by grind] at k3
  grind
Foundations.Numbers.C.exists_polar:
/-- **Polar form.** Every non-zero complex number is `|u| (cos θ + i sin θ)`. -/
theorem exists_polar {u : C} (hu : u ≠ 0) : ∃ θ, u = ofReal (cabs u) * cis θ := by
  have hr := cabs_pos hu
  have hrr := cabs_mul_self u
  obtain ⟨θ, hc, hs⟩ := exists_angle (x := u.re / cabs u) (y := u.im / cabs u) (by
    unfold normSq at hrr
    have : cabs u ≠ 0 := by grind
    grind)
  refine ⟨θ, ext ?_ ?_⟩
  · show u.re = cabs u * cos θ - 0 * sin θ; rw [hc]; grind
  · show u.im = cabs u * sin θ + 0 * cos θ; rw [hs]; grind

inductive Star {α : Type _} (R : α → α → Prop) : α → α → Prop
  | refl (a : α) : Star R a a
  | tail {a b c : α} : Star R a b → R b c → Star R a c

/-- Order: `a − b ≤ c − d` iff `a + d ≤ c + b`. -/

  Quotient.lift₂ (fun p q => p.1 + q.2 ≤ q.1 + p.2)
    (fun _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => by
      simp only [rel_iff] at *
      apply propext; omega)
Foundations.Types.SystemF.pairV_apply:
/-- Instantiating a pair value and feeding it a consumer `k`. -/
theorem pairV_apply (a b k : Term) (C : Ty) : Red (app (tapp (pairV a b) C) k) (app (app k a) b) := by
  have h₁ : Step (tapp (pairV a b) C)
      (lam (app (app (var 0) (rename Nat.succ a)) (rename Nat.succ b))) := by
    have := Step.tbeta (lam (app (app (var 0) (rename Nat.succ (tyRename Nat.succ a)))
      (rename Nat.succ (tyRename Nat.succ b)))) C
    unfold pairV
    simpa [tyInst, tySubst, ← rename_tySubst, tySubst_cons_tyRename_succ] using this
  have h₂ : Step (app (lam (app (app (var 0) (rename Nat.succ a)) (rename Nat.succ b))) k)
      (app (app k a) b) := by
    have := Step.beta (app (app (var 0) (rename Nat.succ a)) (rename Nat.succ b)) k
    simpa [inst, subst, cons, subst_cons_rename_succ] using this
  exact (Star.single (Step.appL h₁)).tail h₂
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.omega_bridge:
/-- **Bridge theorem (ω ≅ ℕ).** The map `vn : Nat → ZFSet` sends `0` to `∅`
and `n + 1` to `succ (vn n)`, is injective, and its values are exactly the
members of `ω`; moreover it turns `<` into `∈` and `≤` into `⊆`. Hence `ω`
with `∅` and `succ` is an exact copy of Lean's natural numbers. -/
theorem omega_bridge :
    vn 0 = ∅ ∧ (∀ n, vn (n + 1) = succ (vn n)) ∧ Function.Injective vn ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ ω ↔ ∃ n, vn n = x) ∧
      (∀ m n, m < n ↔ vn m ∈ vn n) ∧ (∀ m n, m ≤ n ↔ vn m ⊆ vn n) :=
  ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl, vn_injective,
   fun _ => ⟨fun h => let ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_omega.1 h; ⟨n, hn.symm⟩,
             fun ⟨n, hn⟩ => mem_omega.2 ⟨n, hn.symm⟩⟩,
   fun _ _ => vn_mem_vn_iff.symm, fun _ _ => vn_subset_vn_iff.symm⟩

/-- Coefficients scale. -/

Foundations.Algebra.three_not_dvd_pow_tw:
/-- `3` divides no power of `2`. -/
theorem three_not_dvd_pow_two (k : Nat) : ¬ 3 ∣ 2 ^ k := by
  have h : ∀ k, 2 ^ k % 3 = 1 ∨ 2 ^ k % 3 = 2 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact Or.inl rfl
    | succ k ih => rw [Nat.pow_succ]; omega
  intro hd
  have := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hd
  rcases h k with h1 | h1 <;> omega

Foundations.Numbers.R.expTerm_nonneg:
/-- Terms of the exponential series at `x ≥ 0` are non-negative. -/
theorem expTerm_nonneg {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (n : Nat) : 0 ≤ expTerm x n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => unfold expTerm; show (0 : R) ≤ 1 / ((1 : Nat) : R); grind
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [expTerm_succ]
    have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg ih (div_pos' hx (by grind : (0 : R) < (n : R) + 1))
where
  /-- A non-negative number divided by a positive one is non-negative. -/
  div_pos' {a b : R} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 ≤ a / b := by
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg ha (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hb))
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.succ_injective:
/-- **The successor operation is injective** on all sets (a consequence of
foundation: it rules out `x ∈ y ∈ x`). -/
theorem succ_injective : Function.Injective succ := by
  intro x y h
  have hx : x ∈ succ y := h ▸ mem_succ_self x
  have hy : y ∈ succ x := h ▸ mem_succ_self y
  rcases mem_succ.1 hx with hxy | hxy
  · exact hxy
  · rcases mem_succ.1 hy with hyx | hyx
    · exact hyx.symm
    · exact absurd hyx (mem_asymm hxy)

Foundations.Algebra.lprod_perm:
/-- The product does not depend on the order of the factors. -/
theorem lprod_perm {L M : List R} (h : L.Perm M) : lprod L = lprod M := by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a _ ih => show a * _ = a * _; rw [ih]
  | swap a b l => show b * (a * lprod l) = a * (b * lprod l); ac_rfl
  | trans _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2
Foundations.Algebra.Ideal.IsMaximal:
/-- An ideal is **maximal** if it is proper (does not contain `1`) and no ideal lies strictly
between it and the whole ring: any ideal containing it and some element outside it
contains `1`. -/
def IsMaximal (I : Ideal R) : Prop :=
  (1 : R) ∉ I ∧ ∀ J : Ideal R, (∀ x, x ∈ I → x ∈ J) → (∃ a, a ∈ J ∧ a ∉ I) → (1 : R) ∈ J

/-- There is no normal proof of excluded middle `A ∨ ¬A` for an atom `A`. -/
theorem no_nf_lem (k : Nat) : ¬ Nf [] (.sum (.atom k) (neg (.atom k))) := by
  intro h
  cases h with
  | ne h => exact no_closed_ne h
  | orI₁ h => cases h with
    | ne h => exact no_closed_ne h
  | orI₂ h => cases h with
    | ne h => exact no_closed_ne h
    | impI h => cases h with
      | ne h => have := ne_atom_ctx h; cases this

Foundations.Numbers.R.cos_eq_zero_iff:
/-- **Zeros of cosine.** `cos x = 0` if and only if `x = π/2 + kπ` for an integer `k`. -/
theorem cos_eq_zero_iff (x : R) : cos x = 0 ↔ ∃ k : Int, x = pi / 2 + (k : R) * pi := by
  rw [← sin_add_pi_div_two, sin_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨k - 1, ?_⟩
    have : ((k - 1 : Int) : R) = (k : R) - 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; grind
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
    have : ((k + 1 : Int) : R) = (k : R) + 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; grind
Foundations.Numbers.C.not_orderable:
/-- **ℂ is not orderable.** There is no total relation `≤` on `C` that is compatible with
addition, makes products of non-negatives non-negative, and has `0 < 1`. (In any such order
`i² = −1` would be a non-negative square.) -/
theorem not_orderable :
    ¬ ∃ le : C → C → Prop, (∀ a b, le a b ∨ le b a) ∧ (∀ a b c, le a b → le (a + c) (b + c)) ∧
      (∀ a b, le 0 a → le 0 b → le 0 (a * b)) ∧ ¬ le 1 0 := by
  rintro ⟨le, htot, hadd, hmul, h10⟩
  have hneg : ¬ le 0 (-1) := fun h => by
    have := hadd 0 (-1) 1 h
    rw [show (0 : C) + 1 = 1 by grind, show (-1 : C) + 1 = 0 by grind] at this
    exact h10 this
  rcases htot 0 I with h | h
  · have := hmul I I h h; rw [I_sq] at this; exact hneg this
  · have h' := hadd I 0 (-I) h
    rw [show I + -I = 0 by grind, show (0 : C) + -I = -I by grind] at h'
    have := hmul (-I) (-I) h' h'
    rw [show -I * -I = I * I by grind, I_sq] at this
    exact hneg this

/-- **Doubling is a homomorphism** `(ℤ,+) → (ℤ,+)`, `a ↦ 2a`; its kernel is trivial and its

Foundations.Algebra.res_add_ne:
/-- Two residues never add up to `p`. -/
theorem res_add_ne {j k : Nat} (hj : j < half p) (hk : k < half p) :
    res a p j + res a p k ≠ p := by
  have ⟨_, _, h3⟩ := half_spec hp hodd
  intro h
  have hm : ((j + 1) * a + (k + 1) * a) % p = 0 := by
    rw [Nat.add_mod]; unfold res at h; rw [h, Nat.mod_self]
  rw [← Nat.add_mul] at hm
  rcases hp.dvd_mul (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hm) with hd | hd
  · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd; omega
  · exact ha hd

Foundations.Logic.FO.sat_of_isQModel:
/-- Conversely, a model of `Q` satisfies its axioms under every environment. -/
theorem sat_of_isQModel (hM : IsQModel M) (e : Nat → M.Dom) : ∀ ψ, Q ψ → Sat M e ψ := by
  intro ψ hψ
  cases hψ <;> simp only [Sat, Env.cons, eval_succ_M, eval_zero_M, eval_add_M, eval_mul_M,
    eval_var_M, neg]
  · exact fun x => hM.succ_ne_zero x
  · exact fun x y => hM.succ_inj x y
  · intro x
    rcases hM.zero_or_succ x with h | ⟨y, h⟩
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨y, h⟩
  · exact fun x => hM.add_zero x
  · exact fun x y => hM.add_succ x y
  · exact fun x => hM.mul_zero x
  · exact fun x y => hM.mul_succ x y
Foundations.Types.STLC.Nf.toND:
/-- Normal derivations are derivations. -/
theorem Nf.toND {Γ : List Formula} {A : Formula} : Nf Γ A → ND Γ A
  | .ne h => Ne.toND h
  | .impI h => .impI (Nf.toND h)
  | .andI h₁ h₂ => .andI (Nf.toND h₁) (Nf.toND h₂)
  | .orI₁ h => .orI₁ (Nf.toND h)
  | .orI₂ h => .orI₂ (Nf.toND h)
Foundations.Numbers.R.rsum_le_rsum:
/-- Riemann sums are monotone in the function (for genuine tagged partitions). -/
theorem rsum_le_rsum {f g : R → R} {a b : R} {l : List (R × R)} (hl : IsTagged a l b)
    (hfg : ∀ t, a ≤ t → t ≤ b → f t ≤ g t) : rsum f a l ≤ rsum g a l := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => show (0 : R) ≤ 0; grind
  | cons p l ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hl
    have hxb := h3.le
    have k1 := ih h3 fun s hs1 hs2 => hfg s (by grind) hs2
    have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfg t h1 (by grind)) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ x - a)
    show f t * (x - a) + rsum f x l ≤ g t * (x - a) + rsum g x l
    grind

Foundations.Logic.Computability.CompB.lt:
/-- **Order** `f n < g n` is a computable test. -/
theorem lt {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) (hg : Comp g) : CompB fun n => decide (f n < g n) := by
  have := Comp.ite0 (Comp.sub (Comp.succ hf) hg) (Comp.const 1) (Comp.const 0)
  refine Comp.congr this fun n => ?_
  try dsimp only
  by_cases h : f n < g n
  · simp [h]; omega
  · simp [h]; omega
Foundations.Categories.Category:
/-- A **category**: objects (the type `C`), morphisms `Hom X Y` between any two objects,
identities and an associative composition `comp f g` ("first `f`, then `g`") with the
identities as units. -/
class Category (C : Type u) where
  /-- The morphisms from `X` to `Y`. -/
  Hom : C → C → Type v
  /-- The identity morphism of `X`. -/
  id : (X : C) → Hom X X
  /-- Composition in diagrammatic order: `comp f g` is "first `f`, then `g`". -/
  comp : {X Y Z : C} → Hom X Y → Hom Y Z → Hom X Z
  /-- The identity is a left unit. -/
  id_comp : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : Hom X Y), comp (id X) f = f
  /-- The identity is a right unit. -/
  comp_id : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : Hom X Y), comp f (id Y) = f
  /-- Composition is associative. -/
  assoc : ∀ {W X Y Z : C} (f : Hom W X) (g : Hom X Y) (h : Hom Y Z),
    comp (comp f g) h = comp f (comp g h)
Foundations.Types.SystemF.normal_iff_ste:
/-- **Normality is decidable**: `step?` returns `none` exactly on normal terms. -/
theorem normal_iff_step?_none (t : Term) : Normal t ↔ step? t = none := by
  constructor
  · intro hn
    cases hs : step? t with
    | none => rfl
    | some t' => exact absurd (step?_sound _ _ hs) (hn t')
  · intro hs t' h
    have := step?_complete h
    rw [hs] at this
    exact absurd this (by simp)

  induction n with
  | zero => show (1 : R) = 1 * 1; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', pow_succ', ih]; grind

Foundations.Algebra.isum_comm:
/-- **Fubini for finite sums**: the order of summation can be swapped. -/
theorem isum_comm {κ : Type w} [FiniteType κ] (f : ι → κ → A) :
    isum (fun i => isum (fun k => f i k)) = isum (fun k => isum (fun i => f i k)) := by
  unfold isum
  induction (elems : List ι) with
  | nil => exact (isum_zero (ι := κ)).symm
  | cons a l ih =>
    show lsum ((elems : List κ).map (f a)) + lsum (l.map _) = _
    rw [ih]
    exact (isum_add (fun k => f a k) (fun k => lsum (l.map fun i => f i k))).symm

Foundations.Types.STLC.ND.sound:
/-- **Soundness for truth tables.** Whatever is derivable from true hypotheses is true. -/
theorem ND.sound {Γ : List Formula} {A : Formula} (h : ND Γ A) (v : Nat → Bool) :
    (∀ B ∈ Γ, Holds v B) → Holds v A := by
  induction h with
  | hyp hn => intro hΓ; exact hΓ _ (List.mem_of_getElem? hn)
  | impI _ ih =>
    intro hΓ ha
    exact ih fun B hB => by
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hB with rfl | hB
      · exact ha
      · exact hΓ B hB
  | impE _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro hΓ; exact ih₁ hΓ (ih₂ hΓ)
  | andI _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro hΓ; exact ⟨ih₁ hΓ, ih₂ hΓ⟩
  | andE₁ _ ih => intro hΓ; exact (ih hΓ).1
  | andE₂ _ ih => intro hΓ; exact (ih hΓ).2
  | orI₁ _ ih => intro hΓ; exact Or.inl (ih hΓ)
  | orI₂ _ ih => intro hΓ; exact Or.inr (ih hΓ)
  | orE _ _ _ ih ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro hΓ
    rcases ih hΓ with ha | hb
    · exact ih₁ fun B hB => by
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hB with rfl | hB
        · exact ha
        · exact hΓ B hB
    · exact ih₂ fun B hB => by
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hB with rfl | hB
        · exact hb
        · exact hΓ B hB
  | botE _ ih => intro hΓ; exact (ih hΓ).elim

vertex ranges `{0, …, V−1}` (those with `V² ≤ length`) carry no monochromatic
`s`-set. -/

  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩

Foundations.Numbers.CauSeq.abs_mul_sub_l:
/-- The key estimate for products: `xy − x'y' = x(y − y') + y'(x − x')`, so if `|x| ≤ A`,
`|y'| ≤ B` and the differences are below `ε/(A+B)`, the products differ by less than `ε`. -/
theorem abs_mul_sub_lt {x y x' y' A B ε : Q} (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B) (_hε : 0 < ε)
    (hx : abs x ≤ A) (hy' : abs y' ≤ B)
    (h1 : abs (y - y') < ε / (A + B)) (h2 : abs (x - x') < ε / (A + B)) :
    abs (x * y - x' * y') < ε := by
  have k1 := abs_mul_lt hx hA h1
  have k2 := abs_mul_lt hy' hB h2
  have k3 := abs_add (x * (y - y')) (y' * (x - x'))
  have e : x * (y - y') + y' * (x - x') = x * y - x' * y' := by grind
  rw [e] at k3
  have e2 : A * (ε / (A + B)) + B * (ε / (A + B)) = ε := by grind
  grind

theorem prod_equinum_of_le {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (h : IsInfinite α) (hβ : CardLE β α)
    (b₀ : β) : Equinum (α × β) α := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hβ
  obtain ⟨m, hm, _⟩ := mul_self_equinum h
  refine schroeder_bernstein (f := fun p : α × β => m (p.1, k p.2)) (g := fun a => (a, b₀))
    (fun p q hpq => ?_) (fun a b h => (Prod.mk.inj h).1)
  have := hm hpq
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at this
  exact Prod.ext this.1 (hk this.2)

Foundations.Numbers.R.IsTagged:
/-- `IsTagged a l b`: the list `l = [(t₁, x₁), …, (tₙ, xₙ)]` is a **tagged partition** of
`[a, b]`: the points `a = x₀ ≤ x₁ ≤ ⋯ ≤ xₙ = b` increase, and each tag lies in its piece,
`xᵢ₋₁ ≤ tᵢ ≤ xᵢ`. -/
def IsTagged : R → List (R × R) → R → Prop
  | a, [], b => a = b
  | a, (t, x) :: l, b => a ≤ t ∧ t ≤ x ∧ IsTagged x l b

/-- The logarithm is characterised by its bounds. -/
theorem lg_eq_of {b e n : Nat} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (h₁ : b ^ e ≤ n) (h₂ : n < b ^ (e + 1)) :
    lg b n = e := by
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := Nat.le_trans (Nat.pow_pos (by omega)) h₁
  have a := exp_lt_of_pow (by omega) (pow_lg_le hb n hn) h₂
  have c := exp_lt_of_pow (by omega) h₁ (lt_pow_lg hb n)
  omega
Foundations.Numbers.Arith.factorization_:
/-- **Fundamental theorem of arithmetic, uniqueness.** Two lists of primes with the same product
are permutations of each other: the prime factorisation is unique up to order. -/
theorem factorization_unique :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List Nat}, (∀ p ∈ l₁, Prime p) → (∀ p ∈ l₂, Prime p) →
      prod l₁ = prod l₂ → l₁.Perm l₂
  | [], l₂, _, h₂, h => by
    cases l₂ with
    | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
    | cons q l₂ =>
      exfalso
      have hq := (h₂ q (List.mem_cons_self ..)).1
      simp only [prod] at h
      have : q ∣ 1 := ⟨prod l₂, h⟩
      have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) this
      omega
  | p :: l₁, l₂, h₁, h₂, h => by
    have hp := h₁ p (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hmem : p ∈ l₂ := mem_of_dvd_prod hp h₂ ⟨prod l₁, by rw [← h]; rfl⟩
    have hperm := List.perm_cons_erase hmem
    have h' : prod l₁ = prod (l₂.erase p) := by
      have := prod_perm hperm
      simp only [prod] at h this
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by have := hp.1; omega) (h.trans this)
    have ih := factorization_unique (fun q hq => h₁ q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq))
      (fun q hq => h₂ q (List.mem_of_mem_erase hq)) h'
    exact (ih.cons p).trans hperm.symm

Foundations.Logic.FO.EvalB:
/-- **Bounded evaluation**: `EvalB w c xs y` says that `c` outputs `y` on `xs` by a
computation all of whose intermediate values (and β-codes of sequences) are `≤ w`. -/
def EvalB (w : Nat) : Code → List Nat → Nat → Prop
  | .zero, _, y => y = 0
  | .succ, xs, y => y = xs.headD 0 + 1
  | .proj i, xs, y => y = xs.getD i 0
  | @Code.comp k f gs, xs, y => ∃ vs : Fin k → Nat, (∀ i, vs i ≤ w) ∧
      (∀ i, EvalB w (gs i) xs (vs i)) ∧ EvalB w f (List.ofFn vs) y
  | .prec _ _, [], _ => False
  | .prec f g, m :: rest, y => ∃ A, A ≤ w ∧ ∃ B, B ≤ w ∧
      ((∃ r, r ≤ w ∧ r = gbeta A B 0 ∧ EvalB w f rest r) ∧
        ∀ j, j < m → ∃ u, u ≤ w ∧ ∃ z, z ≤ w ∧ (u = gbeta A B j ∧ z = gbeta A B (j + 1)) ∧
          EvalB w g (j :: u :: rest) z) ∧ y = gbeta A B m
  | .mu f, xs, y => EvalB w f (y :: xs) 0 ∧ ∀ m, m < y → ∃ z, z ≤ w ∧ EvalB w f (m :: xs) z ∧ ¬ z = 0
Foundations.Categories.types_pullback:
/-- **The fibre product `{(x, y) | f x = g y}` is a pullback** in the category of types. -/
def types_pullback {X Y Z : Type u} (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    IsPullback f g {p : X × Y // f p.1 = g p.2} (fun p => p.1.1) (fun p => p.1.2) where
  w := funext fun p => p.2
  lift k₁ k₂ hk := fun w => ⟨(k₁ w, k₂ w), congrFun hk w⟩
  fac₁ _ _ _ := rfl
  fac₂ _ _ _ := rfl
  uniq k₁ k₂ hk h h₁ h₂ := funext fun w => Subtype.ext (by
    subst h₁ h₂
    rfl)

to `b`") that is functional and injective. Its domain and range are implicit. -/
structure PInj (α : Type u) (β : Type v) where
  /-- The graph of the partial injection. -/
  rel : α → β → Prop
  /-- Each point is sent to at most one point. -/

  /-- Distinct points are sent to distinct points. -/

/-- Cancellation in a domain: if `a ≠ 0` and `a * x = a * y` then `x = y`. -/
theorem IsDomain.mul_left_cancel (hD : IsDomain R) {a x y : R} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : a * x = a * y) : x = y := by
  have h0 : a * (x + -y) = 0 := by rw [left_distrib, h, mul_neg, add_neg_cancel]
  rcases hD.2 _ _ h0 with h1 | h1
  · exact absurd h1 ha
  · exact eq_of_sub_eq_zero h1

Foundations.Topology.Wallis.div_eq_div_o:
/-- Cross-multiplication: `x/y = z/w` when `x w = z y` (for `y, w ≠ 0`). -/
theorem div_eq_div_of {x y z w : R} (hy : y ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) (h : x * w = z * y) : x / y = z / w := by
  have iy := Field.mul_inv_cancel hy
  have iw := Field.mul_inv_cancel hw
  rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
  calc x * y⁻¹ = x * y⁻¹ * (w * w⁻¹) := by rw [iw, Semiring.mul_one]
    _ = (x * w) * y⁻¹ * w⁻¹ := by grind
    _ = (z * y) * y⁻¹ * w⁻¹ := by rw [h]
    _ = z * w⁻¹ * (y * y⁻¹) := by grind
    _ = z * w⁻¹ := by rw [iy, Semiring.mul_one]

Foundations.Logic.FO.Proves.ex_neg_of_ne:
/-- Classical quantifier duality: from `¬∀x φ` derive `∃x ¬φ`. -/
theorem ex_neg_of_neg_all {Γ : Theory L} {φ : Formula L} (h : Γ ⊢₁ (all φ).neg) :
    Γ ⊢₁ ex φ.neg := by
  apply raa
  refine impE (h.weaken₁ _) (allI (raa ?_))
  -- in context: shift (Γ ∪ {¬∃¬φ}) ∪ {¬φ}
  have hyp₁ : insert (shift (insert Γ (ex φ.neg).neg)) φ.neg ⊢₁ imp (ex φ.neg).shift bot :=
    hyp (Or.inr ⟨(ex φ.neg).neg, Or.inl rfl, rfl⟩)
  refine impE hyp₁ (exI (.var 0) ?_)
  show _ ⊢₁ (φ.neg.subst (Subst.lift fun n => .var (n + 1))).inst (.var 0)
  rw [lift_shift_inst_zero]
  exact assume _ _
Foundations.Types.STLC.peirce_unprovable:
/-- **Intuitionistic logic does not prove Peirce's law** `((A → B) → A) → A`, for
distinct atoms `A` and `B`. -/
theorem peirce_unprovable {i j : Nat} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ¬ ND [] (.arr (.arr (.arr (.atom i) (.atom j)) (.atom i)) (.atom i)) := by
  intro h
  cases cut_elimination h with
  | ne h => exact no_closed_ne h
  | impI h =>
    cases h with
    | ne h =>
      rcases ne_peirce_ctx h with he | ⟨_, hnf⟩
      · cases he
      · cases hnf with
        | ne h' => rcases ne_peirce_ctx h' with he | ⟨he, _⟩ <;> cases he
        | impI h' => cases h' with
          | ne h'' =>
            rcases ne_peirce_ctx₂ h'' with he | he
            · cases he; exact hij rfl
            · cases he

Foundations.Numbers.R.HasIntegral:
/-- `f` has **Riemann integral** `I` over `[a, b]` (where `a ≤ b`): Riemann sums over all
sufficiently fine tagged partitions are close to `I`. The condition `a ≤ b` is part of the
definition: for `b < a` there are no tagged partitions at all, and the approximation condition
alone would hold vacuously for every `I`. -/
def HasIntegral (f : R → R) (a b I : R) : Prop :=
  a ≤ b ∧ ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧
    ∀ l, IsTagged a l b → MeshLt δ a l → abs (rsum f a l - I) < ε

Foundations.Types.STLC.ne_dne_ctx':
/-- Neutral derivations from the single hypothesis `¬¬A`: either the hypothesis
itself, or the derivation passed through a proof of `¬A`. -/
theorem ne_dne_ctx' {k : Nat} : ∀ {Γ : List Formula} {C : Formula}, Ne Γ C →
    Γ = [neg (neg (.atom k))] → C = neg (neg (.atom k)) ∨ ND Γ (neg (.atom k))
  | _, _, @Ne.hyp _ n _ h, hΓ => by
    subst hΓ
    cases n with
    | zero => simp at h; exact Or.inl h.symm
    | succ n => simp at h
  | _, _, .impE h hu, hΓ => by
    rcases ne_dne_ctx' h hΓ with he | hnd
    · cases he; exact Or.inr hu.toND
    · exact Or.inr hnd
  | _, _, .andE₁ h, hΓ => by
    rcases ne_dne_ctx' h hΓ with he | hnd
    · cases he
    · exact Or.inr hnd
  | _, _, .andE₂ h, hΓ => by
    rcases ne_dne_ctx' h hΓ with he | hnd
    · cases he
    · exact Or.inr hnd
  | _, _, .orE h _ _, hΓ => by
    rcases ne_dne_ctx' h hΓ with he | hnd
    · cases he
    · exact Or.inr hnd

    rcases ne_dne_ctx' h hΓ with he | hnd
    · cases he
    · exact Or.inr hnd

/-- **Constructible numbers**: the smallest subset of `Ω` containing the rationals and closed
under addition, negation, multiplication, inverses and square roots — the numbers whose
lengths can be drawn with straightedge and compass from a unit length. -/
inductive Constructible : Ω → Prop
  | rat {x : Ω} : x ∈ ratField hΩ hc → Constructible x
  | add {x y : Ω} : Constructible x → Constructible y → Constructible (x + y)
  | neg {x : Ω} : Constructible x → Constructible (-x)
  | mul {x y : Ω} : Constructible x → Constructible y → Constructible (x * y)
  | inv {x y : Ω} : Constructible x → x * y = 1 → Constructible y
  | sqrt {x y : Ω} : Constructible x → y * y = x → Constructible y
Foundations.Logic.Computability.Comp.cov:
/-- **Closure under course-of-values recursion.** -/
theorem Comp.covRec {g : Nat → Nat} (hg : Comp g) :
    Comp fun p => Computability.covRec g (Computability.fst p) (Computability.snd p) := by
  have hH : Comp fun p => covHist g (Computability.fst p) (Computability.snd p) := by
    have := Comp.natRec (b := fun _ => 0)
      (s := fun q => Computability.pair (g (Computability.pair (Computability.fst (Computability.fst q))
          (Computability.pair (Computability.fst (Computability.snd q))
            (Computability.snd (Computability.snd q))))) (Computability.snd (Computability.snd q)) + 1)
      (Comp.const 0)
      (Comp.lcons (Comp.comp hg (Comp.pair (Comp.fst (Comp.fst Comp.id))
        (Comp.pair (Comp.fst (Comp.snd Comp.id)) (Comp.snd (Comp.snd Comp.id)))))
        (Comp.snd (Comp.snd Comp.id)))
      (Comp.snd Comp.id)
    refine Comp.congr this fun p => ?_
    try dsimp only
    generalize Computability.snd p = k
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => simp only [Computability.natRec, fst_pair, snd_pair, ih, covHist]
  exact Comp.comp hg (Comp.pair (Comp.fst Comp.id) (Comp.pair (Comp.snd Comp.id) hH))

/-- Additivity for continuous functions: `∫ₐᵛ f = ∫ₐᵘ f + ∫ᵤᵛ f` for `a ≤ u ≤ v`. -/
theorem integral_add_interval {f : R → R} {a u v : R} (hau : a ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v)
    (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ v → ContinuousAt f x) :
    integral f a v = integral f a u + integral f u v :=

Foundations.Logic.FO.tvar_spec:
/-- Correctness of `tvar`. -/
theorem tvar_spec (mode : Nat) (t : Term Arith) (d n : Nat) :
    tvar mode (tcode t) d n = tcode (liftN d (sigma mode t) n) := by
  rw [liftN_apply]
  by_cases h : n < d
  · simp [tvar, h]
  · simp only [tvar, h, decide_false, Bool.cond_false, ite_false]
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, n = d + m := ⟨n - d, by omega⟩
    subst hm
    rw [show d + m - d = m by omega]
    match mode, m with
    | 0, 0 => simp [sigma, Subst.single, trename_tcode]
    | 0, m + 1 =>
        have hb : (d + (m + 1) == d) = false := by simp
        simp only [beq_self_eq_true, Bool.cond_true, hb, Bool.cond_false, sigma, Subst.single,
          Term.rename, tcode_var]
        congr 1; omega
    | 1, m =>
        simp only [show (1 == 0) = false from rfl, beq_self_eq_true, Bool.cond_false,
          Bool.cond_true, sigma, Term.rename, tcode_var]
        congr 1; omega
    | k + 2, 0 =>
        simp [sigma, succSubst, Term.rename]
    | k + 2, m + 1 =>
        have hb : (d + (m + 1) == d) = false := by simp
        simp only [show (k + 2 == 0) = false from rfl, show (k + 2 == 1) = false from rfl,
          Bool.cond_false, hb, sigma, succSubst, Term.rename, tcode_var]
        congr 1; omega

Foundations.Logic.FO.Proves.subst_closed:
/-- **Substitution invariance of derivations.** If `Γ ⊢ φ` then `Γ[σ] ⊢ φ[σ]`. -/
theorem subst_closed {Γ : Theory L} {φ : Formula L} (h : Γ ⊢₁ φ) :
    ∀ σ : Nat → Term L, Γ.image σ ⊢₁ φ.subst σ := by
  induction h with
  | hyp hφ => exact fun σ => hyp ⟨_, hφ, rfl⟩
  | impI _ ih => exact fun σ => impI ((ih σ).weaken (image_insert _ _ σ))
  | impE _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact fun σ => impE (ih₁ σ) (ih₂ σ)
  | conjI _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact fun σ => conjI (ih₁ σ) (ih₂ σ)
  | conjE₁ _ ih => exact fun σ => conjE₁ (ih σ)
  | conjE₂ _ ih => exact fun σ => conjE₂ (ih σ)
  | disjI₁ _ ih => exact fun σ => disjI₁ (ih σ)
  | disjI₂ _ ih => exact fun σ => disjI₂ (ih σ)
  | disjE _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
      exact fun σ => disjE (ih₁ σ) ((ih₂ σ).weaken (image_insert _ _ σ))
        ((ih₃ σ).weaken (image_insert _ _ σ))
  | botE _ ih => exact fun σ => botE (ih σ)
  | raa _ ih => exact fun σ => raa ((ih σ).weaken (image_insert _ _ σ))
  | allI _ ih => exact fun σ => allI ((ih (Subst.lift σ)).weaken (image_shift _ σ))
  | allE t _ ih =>
      intro σ; rw [inst_subst]; exact allE (t.subst σ) (ih σ)
  | exI t _ ih =>
      intro σ; exact exI (t.subst σ) (by rw [← inst_subst]; exact ih σ)
  | @exE Γ φ ψ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro σ
      refine exE (ih₁ σ) ?_
      rw [← shift_subst_lift]
      exact (ih₂ (Subst.lift σ)).weaken ((image_insert _ _ _).trans
        (insert_mono (image_shift Γ σ) _))
  | refl t => exact fun σ => refl _
  | subst _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro σ; rw [inst_subst]
      exact subst (ih₁ σ) (by rw [← inst_subst]; exact ih₂ σ)

Foundations.Logic.FO.nonstd_bound:
/-- Only finitely many numerals are excluded by a finite list of formulas. -/
theorem nonstd_bound : ∀ l : List (Formula Arith), ∃ B, ∀ N, B ≤ N → ∀ χ ∈ l, ∀ n,
    χ = neg (eq (v 0) (numeral n)) → N ≠ n
  | [] => ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | χ :: l => by
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := nonstd_bound l
      by_cases hχ : ∃ n₀, χ = neg (eq (v 0) (numeral n₀))
      · obtain ⟨n₀, rfl⟩ := hχ
        refine ⟨max B (n₀ + 1), fun N hN χ' hχ' n hn => ?_⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hχ' with rfl | hχ'
        · simp only [neg] at hn
          injection hn with hn
          injection hn with _ hn
          have := numeral_inj hn
          omega
        · exact hB N (by omega) χ' hχ' n hn
      · refine ⟨B, fun N hN χ' hχ' n hn => ?_⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hχ' with rfl | hχ'
        · exact absurd ⟨n, hn⟩ hχ
        · exact hB N hN χ' hχ' n hn
Foundations.Numbers.Q.le_trans:
/-- `≤` on the rationals is transitive. -/
theorem le_trans {x y z : Q} : x ≤ y → y ≤ z → x ≤ z := by
  induction x using ind with | h a b hb => ?_
  induction y using ind with | h c d hd => ?_
  induction z using ind with | h e f hf => ?_
  simp only [mk_le]
  intro h1 h2
  rw [← int_le_cancel_pos hd]
  have h1' := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Int.le_of_lt hf)
  have h2' := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (Int.le_of_lt hb)
  grind

Foundations.Types.STLC.Nf.toTerm:
/-- **Normal proofs are normal terms**: a normal derivation is decorated by a
normal well-typed term. -/
theorem Nf.toTerm {Γ : List Formula} {A : Formula} : Nf Γ A → ∃ t, HasType Γ t A ∧ Normal t
  | .ne h => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, _⟩ := Ne.toTerm h
    exact ⟨t, ht, hn⟩
  | .impI h => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn⟩ := Nf.toTerm h
    refine ⟨.lam t, .lam ht, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    cases hx with
    | lam h => exact hn _ h
  | .andI h₁ h₂ => by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hna⟩ := Nf.toTerm h₁
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hnb⟩ := Nf.toTerm h₂
    refine ⟨.pair a b, .pair ha hb, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    cases hx with
    | pairL h => exact hna _ h
    | pairR h => exact hnb _ h
  | .orI₁ h => by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hna⟩ := Nf.toTerm h
    refine ⟨.inl a, .inl ha, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    cases hx with
    | inl h => exact hna _ h
  | .orI₂ h => by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hna⟩ := Nf.toTerm h
    refine ⟨.inr a, .inr ha, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    cases hx with
    | inr h => exact hna _ h

Foundations.Numbers.Arith.factorization_:
/-- **Fundamental theorem of arithmetic, existence.** Every positive integer is a product of a
(possibly empty) list of primes. -/
theorem factorization_exists {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ l : List Nat, (∀ p ∈ l, Prime p) ∧ prod l = n := by
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    by_cases h1 : n = 1
    · exact ⟨[], by simp, by simp [prod, h1]⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ := exists_prime_dvd (n := n) (by omega)
      have hp2 := hp.1
      have hm : 1 ≤ m := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with h | h
        · subst h; simp at hn
        · exact h
      have hlt : m < p * m := by
        have : 2 * m ≤ p * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hp2
        omega
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hprod⟩ := ih m hlt hm
      refine ⟨p :: l, ?_, by simp [prod, hprod]⟩
      intro q hq
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact hp
      · exact hl q h

Foundations.Numbers.Z.mul_one:
/-- One is the multiplicative identity. -/
theorem mul_one (x : Z) : x * 1 = x := by
  induction x using ind
  simp only [one_def, mk_mul, mk_eq_mk]; omega
Foundations.Topology.Ascoli.smono_lt:
/-- Strictly increasing index sequences preserve `<`. -/
theorem smono_lt {φ : Nat → Nat} (hφ : ∀ k, φ k < φ (k + 1)) {i j : Nat} (h : i < j) : φ i < φ j := by
  induction j with
  | zero => omega
  | succ j ih =>
    by_cases e : i = j
    · rw [e]; exact hφ j
    · have := ih (by omega); have := hφ j; omega
Foundations.Logic.FO.numM_inj:
/-- **Distinct numerals have distinct values.** -/
theorem numM_inj : ∀ {a b : Nat}, numM M a = numM M b → a = b
  | 0, 0, _ => rfl
  | 0, b + 1, h => absurd h.symm (hM.succ_ne_zero _)
  | a + 1, 0, h => absurd h (hM.succ_ne_zero _)
  | a + 1, b + 1, h => by rw [numM_inj (hM.succ_inj _ _ h)]
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.IsLimitOrdinal:
/-- A **limit ordinal** is a non-zero ordinal equal to the union of its members. -/
def IsLimitOrdinal (α : ZFSet) : Prop := IsOrdinal α ∧ α ≠ ∅ ∧ ⋃₀ α = α
Foundations.Numbers.Cut.ofRat_R:
/-- In `R`, the general embedding of `ℚ` is our `ofQ`. -/
theorem ofRat_R (q : Q) : OF.ofRat (K := R) q = R.ofQ q := by
  induction q using Q.ind with | h n d hd => ?_
  rw [OF.ofRat_mk]
  have e1 : ((n : Int) : R) = R.ofQ (n : Q) := rfl
  have e2 : ((d : Int) : R) = R.ofQ (d : Q) := rfl
  have h1 : R.ofQ (Q.mk n d hd) * R.ofQ (d : Q) = R.ofQ (n : Q) := by
    rw [← R.ofQ_mul]; congr 1
    rw [Q.intCast_def, Q.intCast_def, Q.mk_mul, Q.mk_eq_mk]; grind
  have h2 : (0 : R) < R.ofQ (d : Q) := by
    have := R.ofQ_lt.2 (show (0 : Q) < (d : Q) by rw [Q.intCast_def, Q.ofNat_def, Q.mk_lt]; simpa using hd)
    exact this
  rw [e1, e2]; grind
Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.coeff_C_z:
/-- The constant coefficient of `C a`. -/
@[simp] theorem coeff_C_zero (a : R) : coeff (C a) 0 = a := rfl
Foundations.Categories.Iso:
/-- An **isomorphism** between `X` and `Y`: arrows both ways composing to the identities. -/
structure Iso (X Y : C) where
  /-- The forward arrow. -/
  hom : X ⟶ Y
  /-- The backward arrow. -/
  inv : Y ⟶ X
  /-- Forward then backward is the identity. -/
  hom_inv_id : hom ≫ inv = 𝟙 X
  /-- Backward then forward is the identity. -/
  inv_hom_id : inv ≫ hom = 𝟙 Y
Foundations.Numbers.Cut.ofR_inj:
/-- `ofR` is injective. -/
theorem ofR_inj {x y : R} (h : ofR x = ofR y) : x = y := by
  rw [← toR_ofR x, ← toR_ofR y, h]
Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.leadingCo:
/-- **The leading coefficient of a non-zero polynomial is non-zero.** -/
theorem leadingCoeff_ne_zero {p : Polynomial R} (hp : p ≠ 0) : leadingCoeff p ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have h1 : DegLT p (natDegree p) := by
    intro n hn
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hn with e | lt
    · rw [← e]; exact h
    · exact degLT_natDegree hp n lt
  have := len_le h1
  rw [len_eq_natDegree_succ hp] at this
  omega
Foundations.Geometry.Pt.dot:
/-- The **dot product** `(a − b)·(c − b)`, measuring the angle at `b`. -/
def dot (a b c : Pt K) : K := (a.x - b.x) * (c.x - b.x) + (a.y - b.y) * (c.y - b.y)
Foundations.Logic.FO.sat_diagSentence:
/-- The diagonal sentence, semantically: in any model of `Q`, `δ` holds iff `ψ` holds
of the value of the numeral of `⌜δ⌝`. -/
theorem sat_diagSentence {M : Structure Arith} (hM : IsQModel M) (ψ : Formula Arith)
    (e : Nat → M.Dom) :
    Sat M e (diagSentence ψ) ↔ Sat M e (ψ.inst (numeral (fcode (diagSentence ψ)))) := by
  rw [sat_inst ψ, eval_numeral_M]
  conv => lhs; rw [diagSentence, sat_inst, eval_numeral_M, sat_diagTheta hM, diagC_fcode]
  rfl
Foundations.Numbers.Cut.npow:
/-- Natural-number powers of cuts. -/
noncomputable def npow (A : Cut) : Nat → Cut
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => npow A n * A
Foundations.Logic.FO.PA_incomplete_rosse:
/-- PA is incomplete (combining Gödel–Rosser with the consistency of PA relative to
Lean, `PA_consistent`). -/
theorem PA_incomplete_rosser :
    ∃ σ : Formula Arith, IsSentence σ ∧ ¬ PA ⊢₁ σ ∧ ¬ PA ⊢₁ neg σ :=
  PA_rosser PA_consistent
Foundations.Numbers.N.mul:
/-- Multiplication, defined by recursion on the second argument:
`n * 0 = 0` and `n * succ m = n * m + n`. -/
def mul : N → N → N
  | _, zero => zero
  | n, succ m => add (mul n m) n
Foundations.Logic.FO.Signature.Countable:
/-- **Countable signature.** Codes `0, 1, 2, …` enumerate (possibly with gaps and
repetitions) all function symbols and all relation symbols, together with their
arities. -/
class Signature.Countable (L : Signature) where
  /-- The function symbol with a given code, if any. -/
  funcCode : Nat → Option (Σ n, L.Func n)
  /-- Every function symbol has a code. -/
  funcCode_surj : ∀ n (f : L.Func n), ∃ k, funcCode k = some ⟨n, f⟩
  /-- The relation symbol with a given code, if any. -/
  relCode : Nat → Option (Σ n, L.Rel n)
  /-- Every relation symbol has a code. -/
  relCode_surj : ∀ n (R : L.Rel n), ∃ k, relCode k = some ⟨n, R⟩
Foundations.Numbers.Arith.Prime:
/-- A natural number is **prime** if it is at least `2` and its only divisors are `1` and
itself. -/
def Prime (p : Nat) : Prop := 2 ≤ p ∧ ∀ d, d ∣ p → d = 1 ∨ d = p
Foundations.Logic.FO.Comp.succSubC:
/-- The induction substitution on codes is computable. -/
theorem Comp.succSubC {f : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) : Comp fun n => FO.succSubC (f n) :=
  Comp.fsub (Comp.const _) (Comp.pair hf (Comp.const 0))
Foundations.Algebra.parity_conj:
/-- **Conjugate permutations have the same parity.** -/
theorem parity_conj {n : Nat} (π σ : Perm (Fin n)) : parity (π * σ * π⁻¹) = parity σ := by
  rw [parity_mul, parity_mul, parity_inv]
  cases parity π <;> cases parity σ <;> rfl
Foundations.Logic.Computability.llen_aux:
/-- Partial counts in the definition of `llen`. -/
theorem llen_aux (l : List Nat) : ∀ k, natRec (fun _ => 0)
    (fun p => snd (snd p) + (bif ldrop (fst p) (fst (snd p)) == 0 then 0 else 1))
    (encList l) k = min k l.length
  | 0 => by simp [natRec]
  | k + 1 => by
      simp only [natRec, fst_pair, snd_pair, llen_aux l k, ldrop_encList]
      by_cases h : k < l.length
      · have : (encList (l.drop k) == 0) = false := by
          cases hd : l.drop k with
          | nil => simp [List.drop_eq_nil_iff] at hd; omega
          | cons x t => simp [encList]
        rw [this]; simp; omega
      · have : (encList (l.drop k) == 0) = true := by
          rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)]; rfl
        rw [this]; simp; omega
Foundations.Types.Lambda.up:
/-- Lifting a substitution under a binder. -/
def up (σ : Nat → Term) : Nat → Term
  | 0 => var 0
  | n + 1 => rename Nat.succ (σ n)
Foundations.Logic.FO.IsSentence:
/-- A formula is a **sentence** if no variable occurs free in it. -/
def IsSentence (φ : Formula Arith) : Prop := ∀ x, φ.Fresh x
Foundations.Topology.lebesgue_number:
/-- **Lebesgue number lemma.** For an open cover of a sequentially compact set `K` there is
`δ > 0` such that every `δ`-ball around a point of `K` lies in a single member of the cover. -/
theorem lebesgue_number {K : X → Prop} (hK : IsSeqCompact K) {ι : Type} {U : ι → X → Prop}
    (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ∀ x, K x → ∃ i, U i x) :
    ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x, K x → ∃ i, ∀ y, dist x y < δ → U i y := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
  have hx : ∀ n : Nat, ∃ x, K x ∧ ∀ i, ∃ y, dist x y < 1 / ((n : R) + 1) ∧ ¬ U i y := fun n => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
    apply hno; refine ⟨1 / ((n : R) + 1), eps_pos n, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h'
    apply h; refine ⟨x, hx, fun i => ?_⟩
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h''
    exact h' ⟨i, fun y hy => by apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h3; exact h'' ⟨y, hy, h3⟩⟩
  let s : Nat → X := fun n => (hx n).choose
  have hs : ∀ n, K (s n) ∧ ∀ i, ∃ y, dist (s n) y < 1 / ((n : R) + 1) ∧ ¬ U i y :=
    fun n => (hx n).choose_spec
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, L, hL, hconv⟩ := hK s fun n => (hs n).1
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov L hL
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := hU i L hi
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hconv (ε / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := eps_small (by grind : (0 : R) < ε / 2)
  let k := max N₁ N₂
  obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := (hs (φ k)).2 i
  have k1 := hN₁ k (by omega)
  have k2 := hN₂ (φ k) (by have := le_of_strictMono hφ k; omega)
  apply hy2; apply hball
  have := dist_triangle L (s (φ k)) y
  have := dist_comm L (s (φ k))
  simp only at k1
  grind
